120696.excerpt_en: Work on building a new helicopter hangar at Longyearbyen Airport is already under way, after NOK 14 million was allocated in the revised national budget to begin the groundwork.
120696.subtitle_en: The government is strengthening the rescue service on Svalbard by hiring two large rescue helicopters from April 2014. The Governor of Svalbard currently has one large and one medium-sized helicopter.

120706.excerpt_en: “We are seeing pressure on snowmobile prices; we believe they are far too low even though costs are high. Prices have risen by only a few hundred kroner over the past ten years.”
120706.subtitle_en: Engineer G. Paulsen has had two years in the red. Managing director Trygve Steen of Spitsbergen Travel believes there is too little profit in snowmobile tours today.

120710.excerpt_en: Figures from Svalbard Snowmobile Rental (SSU) show that 2010 and 2011 were difficult years for the company. “The negative figures in the first year were due to the ash cloud. Then we carried the problems into the following year.”
120710.subtitle_en: Svalbard Snowmobile Rental has operated at a loss in recent years.

120740.excerpt_en: Although he applied after the deadline, the Governor of Svalbard has allowed Andreas Rebnor Olsen to hunt ten reindeer for sale and five for personal use. Olsen may also hunt ringed seals and bearded seals at sea and outside the regular hunting season.
120740.subtitle_en: Andreas Rebnor Olsen has been granted a commercial reindeer quota and may also trap foxes and hunt seals in Farmhamna.
120740.title_en: Allowed to hunt reindeer in Farmhamna

120745.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) is short of money and faces tough spending cuts to balance its books in the years ahead. That is why it applied to the state in May for an additional NOK 21.6 million for technical infrastructure.
120745.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council applied to the state for an additional NOK 40 million for schools, nurseries and technical infrastructure in 2013. They will not receive it.

120762.excerpt_en: It costs money to keep us going up here in the north. That said, each one of us does not cost very much.

120769.excerpt_en: “I did everything I could to catch Jørn. When I did, I gave him a bit of lip and asked if he fancied a cup of coffee.”
120769.subtitle_en: Firefighter Joachim Myhrvang’s crossing of the finish line typified the effort during Saturday’s relay for the TV fundraiser: Full throttle from start to finish. Whatever it took.
120769.title_en: Gave it everything for the TV fundraiser

120802.excerpt_en: “It is a major project, and there is great interest among Norwegian and international research institutions. We are currently working on the application for the project,” says Harald Steen, head of the Norwegian Polar Institute’s Centre for Ice and Climate Research, ICE.
120802.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute plans to freeze the research vessel “Lance” into the ice northeast of Svalbard and drift southwest with a team of researchers aboard.

120836.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard has received 25 consultation responses to the management plan for eastern Svalbard, which has been circulated for comment. The Norwegian Polar Institute’s response is the most comprehensive—and also the most critical.
120836.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute has little praise for the Governor of Svalbard’s proposed management plan for eastern Svalbard. The institute wants far stricter protection in the east.

120839.excerpt_en: “Last year we opened an office in Stockholm and began awarding funding for research, environmental protection and exploration. Among others, we have supported Børge Ousland,” says Camilla Hansen of the National Geographic Global Exploration Fund in Northern Europe.
120839.subtitle_en: National Geographic is awarding money to students researching climate and the environment. They would particularly like applications from Svalbard.

120843.excerpt_en: At the top of the lineup are three American acts: Nick Moss & The Flip Tops, Tad Robinson and Jace Everett. The latter became known for the theme song from the series “True Blood”, the song “Bad Things”.
120843.subtitle_en: Dark Season Blues is celebrating itself with major American names and artists who have shaped the festival.
120843.title_en: Ten Years of Blues in the Dark

120861.excerpt_en: Things start quietly when “Two Cooks for an Evening” comes up as the next auction lot. Jørn Hansen, one of the two cooks, sits at the back of the venue and follows the action. “Last year’s winner bids NOK 7,000,” says the auctioneer.
120861.subtitle_en: The cooking services of Jørn Hansen and Steve Daldorff Torgersen sold for NOK 21,000 at Sunday’s auction in aid of the televised charity appeal.
120861.tags_en: news, televised charity appeal, auction, cook

120865.excerpt_en: “We’re extremely pleased with the result and the way the auction was carried out,” says auction organiser Lene Villumsen. The auction raised a total of NOK 443,000 for this year’s televised charity appeal.
120865.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen’s residents were generous when they bid on the auction’s 94 lots on Sunday.

120900.excerpt_en: We moved to Longyearbyen at the end of September 1999. We experienced our first winter storm during the night of the 17th.
120900.subtitle_en: The Mine Worker After a Storm
120900.tags_en: winter storm, snow, opinion, reader submission, letter to the editor, mine worker, winter
120900.title_en: The Mine Worker After a Storm

120902.excerpt_en: She comes trotting lightly across the square, with two dogs on leads in front of her. There is something fresh-air-like about the girl in the red anorak, wind in her hair and a smile on her lips.
120902.subtitle_en: Her being in Svalbard is a planned coincidence. That is the sort of thing that happens when there is a will behind it.

120926.excerpt_en: The site extending from the Kroa building stood this spring and summer like a branch-strewn, dead forest in the centre of Longyearbyen. When plans for the new hotel were presented last autumn, John-Einar Lockert, one of the three owners, said construction would begin during the summer.
120926.subtitle_en: After hammering through hard-frozen tundra a year ago and then filling the site with piles, little has happened with the new hotel.

120941.excerpt_en: “It didn’t take long before we had filled the book,” says Senior Police Officer Arild Lyssand. He says that he and his colleague Jarle Odland drove to the airport and back, then stood at Sportscenteret for a quarter of an hour.
120941.subtitle_en: Police stopped six cars with defective lights during a 15-minute check at Sportscenteret on Friday.

120967.excerpt_en: Saugnes says he received a call about the nomination on Tuesday evening, and that it was a very pleasant call to receive. “I applied because it’s an exciting job, and I’m very pleased to have been ranked first,” he says by phone during a break in a budget meeting…
120967.subtitle_en: The local council has unanimously nominated Lars Ole Saugnes (55), chief municipal executive in Fet municipality, as chief administrative officer of the Longyearbyen local council.

121000.excerpt_en: “We want to hold a public celebration of local democracy within a sensible financial framework. That’s why we’ve chosen to organise a birthday party with professional content.”
121000.subtitle_en: The Longyearbyen local council is celebrating its tenth anniversary and inviting everyone to a public celebration on Monday.

121002.excerpt_en: “I’m not fond of the cold, and I’ve never been particularly interested in Svalbard,” he says, smiling broadly. Hans Edvard Nøis’s family history is both tangled and, in parts, meagre.
121002.subtitle_en: Once upon a time, Svalbard was positively teeming with members of the Nøis family. Last week, one of the last remaining relatives was enticed to head north to his ancestors’ realm.
121002.tags_en: Nøis, Svalbard life, back page, people

121015.excerpt_en: A year has passed since Longyearbyen got a new head of the local council. Of 900 votes, nearly 400 went to Labour’s Christin Kristoffersen from Tromsø, making her the town’s highest-ranking elected representative.

121020.excerpt_en: A condition report prepared by Sweco shows that the maintenance bill for Svalbardhallen could reach NOK 26 million over the next 10–15 years. “The hall is more than 15 years old, so it was time for a condition report.”
121020.subtitle_en: Svalbardhallen is beginning to show its age. Hall manager Kåre Hovland wants to make politicians aware that it will need considerable maintenance in the years ahead.

121026.excerpt_en: Aeco is not strongly opposed to the Governor of Svalbard’s proposal for a management plan for East Svalbard, as may be understood from the article on the matter in the previous issue of Svalbardposten. Aeco represents the cruise operators that arrange trips to East Svalbard and has a strong interest in this matter.
121026.subtitle_en: Not strongly opposed to the ‘East Svalbard proposal’
121026.tags_en: Aeco, management, East Svalbard, reader submission, opinion
121026.title_en: Not Strongly Opposed to the ‘East Svalbard Proposal’

121032.excerpt_en: “Happy birthday. This is my fourth time here, and it’s always just as cosy,” said Rita Engedalen, the first artist on stage.
121032.subtitle_en: Dark Season Blues 2012 officially opened on Thursday evening. Temperatures rose immediately at the cultural centre.
121032.tags_en: music, blues festival, Dark Season Blues, culture, Longyearbyen Cultural Centre, Svalbard life
121032.title_en: The Blues Get into Full Swing

121065.excerpt_en: Two autumns ago, Anja Solvik went on a boat trip in Svalbard with five others. “It unleashed explosive creativity. There were no distracting elements such as iPhones or children on the trip,” she says.
121065.subtitle_en: A reindeer head from trapper Tommy Sandal became art and now hangs in Galleri Svalbard.
121065.tags_en: Svalbard life, art, culture, exhibition, reindeer
121065.title_en: Nude Art with a Reindeer Head

121100.excerpt_en: Monday marks 50 years since the explosion at the Østre Sentralfelt section of the Kings Bay mines. The explosion killed 21 men, burying eleven of them forever 300 metres below ground.

121119.excerpt_en: “We were sitting in my room that evening when the power disappeared for a moment. Electricity was the lifeline of the mine.”
121119.subtitle_en: Fifty years have passed since the explosion at the Kings Bay mine. The blast caused no tremors on the surface. The only thing people in Ny-Ålesund noticed was the light flickering. In that instant, 21 men lost their lives, 300 metres underground. November 5, 1962, at 10:45 p.m.
121119.tags_en: magazine, mine safety, news, 21 dead, Kings Bay

121130.excerpt_en: “It’s absolutely fantastic. We’ve received nothing but positive feedback, from both artists and audiences.”
121130.subtitle_en: This year’s blues festival is the tenth in succession and the most successful in terms of attendance, music and finances.
121130.tags_en: magazine, news, blues festival, Dark Season Blues

121134.excerpt_en: “We are still waiting for answers from Kripos. That and the final autopsy report are all that remain before prosecutors can assess the case more closely,” says Senior Police Officer Arild Lyssand at the Governor of Svalbard’s Office.
121134.subtitle_en: On August 21, a woman was killed during a boat trip near Esmarkbreen. The Governor of Svalbard is still waiting for answers from Kripos.

121154.excerpt_en: People have squeezed together in teams around the tables at the pub on this Monday evening. They sit close together and talk quietly.
121154.subtitle_en: More and more people want to sharpen their skills on quiz questions. Some end up on television with Dan Børge Akerø.

121160.excerpt_en: “We had an intense, short training period. Last Monday, we took over ourselves.”
121160.subtitle_en: Merete Alstad-Jensen and her husband Steinar have taken over Gullgruva in Lompensenteret.

121178.excerpt_en: King Harald laid a wreath at the memorial monument to those who died in the Kings Bay mines. The 1962 accident was the fourth and largest explosion after operations resumed following the Second World War.
121178.subtitle_en: The explosion that killed 21 miners in 1962 was solemnly commemorated in Ny-Ålesund on Monday, exactly 50 years after the accident.
121178.tags_en: Ny-Ålesund, King Harald, news, Kings Bay disaster, Kings Bay, 1962, the King

121185.excerpt_en: There will be yet another royal visit to Svalbard. Queen Sonja has accepted the invitation to conduct the official opening of Polarjazz 2013.
121185.subtitle_en: King Harald is in Ny-Ålesund today, and in January Queen Sonja will open Polarjazz 2013.
121185.tags_en: news, Polarjazz, royal visit, Queen Sonja, Longyearbyen

121188.excerpt_en: The takeover is due to take place as early as next week, but it is not clear when the ship will be handed over to its new owner. NRK has been unable to confirm who the shipowner is, what he intends to use the ship for or what it cost.
121188.subtitle_en: According to NRK, a shipowner in Western Norway has bought Nordstjernen.
121188.title_en: Bought by a Shipowner in Western Norway

121201.excerpt_en: Svalbard fascinates in November, with its landscape in shades of grey for several hours. As are achromatic black-and-white photographs, which are often highly rewarding.

121212.excerpt_en: “For us, it is a great honour that the Queen will open Polarjazz. It is unusual for us too; we are not used to that kind of attention and do not know what demands it will place on us.”
121212.subtitle_en: Queen Sonja is coming to Longyearbyen in January with photographs of her own and to open Polarjazz.
121212.tags_en: news, Polarjazz, the gallery, the Queen, art
121212.title_en: To Open Polarjazz and an Exhibition

121217.excerpt_en: Olsen traps in Farmhamna and has planned to trap fox along the coast from the trapping station to Trygghamna, and then across Daumannsøyra. He is applying to use the service cabin for safety reasons, both for himself and for others seeking emergency shelter.
121217.subtitle_en: Andreas Rebnor Olsen has applied to the Governor of Svalbard for permission to use the service cabin in Trygghamna as an auxiliary station.
121217.title_en: Wants Trygghamna as an Auxiliary Station

121231.excerpt_en: Bydrift applied to Svalbard’s Environmental Protection Fund for support for eleven projects in this autumn’s allocation round. In total, it is applying for NOK 8.8 million.
121231.subtitle_en: The Bydrift board is demanding that the enterprise withdraw its four applications to the Environmental Protection Fund for new play areas in the town centre.
121231.tags_en: news, Bydrift, town centre, urban environment

121244.excerpt_en: Geir Aasebøstøl was a colleague and fellow worker at the Norwegian Polar Institute for longer and shorter periods from the early 1990s onward. He began in Ny-Ålesund, but later also worked in Tromsø and Longyearbyen.

121249.excerpt_en: The days in Ny-Ålesund during the commemoration of the 1962 explosion at Kings Bay were marked by grief as well as cheerfulness. One of the old-timers who helped lift the mood was William Albrigtsen from Olderdalen. He came to Longyearbyen in 1956, aged 19.
121249.subtitle_en: The years William Albrigtsen, 75, spent as a miner at Kings Bay were a good time. On Monday, he took part in the memorial ceremony for the colleagues who died in 1962.
121249.tags_en: Kings Bay, life in Svalbard, people, old miner

121255.excerpt_en: It was held on 5 November, exactly 50 years after the violent explosion at Kings Bay on 5 November 1962.
121255.subtitle_en: With King Harald present together with relatives and former colleagues, Monday’s memorial ceremony in Ny-Ålesund was a solemn occasion.
121255.tags_en: 21 dead, news, magazine, Kings Bay disaster, 50th-anniversary memorial

121279.excerpt_en: “We will market more non-motorised tours. Crossing Spitsbergen will then become a signature tour,” says expedition leader Stein Tore Pedersen of Basecamp Spitsbergen.
121279.subtitle_en: This year, both Basecamp and Spitsbergen Travel are offering tourists the chance to cross Spitsbergen from end to end. Both are organising the tour for the first time.

121284.excerpt_en: Matthew Loader of Sublime Promotions has the marketing plan for Lost Planet 3 ready. The game is about a man working on an alien planet of ice, where people try to harness the natural energy beneath the ground through mining.
121284.subtitle_en: A British company wants to use Pyramiden as a marketing backdrop for the computer game Lost Planet 3.
121284.title_en: Wants Pyramiden in a Computer Game

121325.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Harbour has drawn up a proposal for a new detailed plan for Bykaia. “The most important changes are that we are making better use of the areas than we have before.”
121325.subtitle_en: A new detailed plan for Bykaia gives the harbour space for warehouse buildings and container storage.

121329.excerpt_en: The local council is facing tight budget times, and the Administration Committee (AU) has asked the Culture and Recreation Enterprise to describe how it can reduce its budgets by NOK 1.5 million, around 12 per cent of next year’s total budget.
121329.subtitle_en: The Culture and Recreation Enterprise believes it is impossible to cut next year’s budget by NOK 1.5 million without reducing cultural services.
121329.tags_en: cultural life, news, culture, budget, Culture and Recreation Enterprise

121349.excerpt_en: I read with pleasure in the newspaper about the successful tenth anniversary of “Dark Season Blues 2012” and join the ranks of well-wishers, even though unfortunately I was unable to attend. Praise is due to the enthusiastic blues fans who, in their spare time, have once again managed to put on a successful blues weekend.
121349.title_en: Dark Season Blues and Mine Blues in Mine 3

121355.excerpt_en: “A giant walked through the land — humble and great.” Even Lützenkirchen (born Moldstad) died suddenly of meningitis on 17 October, aged 49.
121355.subtitle_en: “A giant walked through the land — humble and great.”
121355.title_en: Even — Full of Life and Quiet Mischief!

121359.excerpt_en: Kings Bay AS would like to take this opportunity to thank Svalbardposten for its press coverage of the memorial ceremony in Ny-Ålesund on 5 November.
121359.subtitle_en: Cleaning up the Kings Bay area.

121362.excerpt_en: “We encourage everyone who would like to join in. It’s important that we put together a strong team from Longyearbyen.”
121362.subtitle_en: Today, Longyearbyen’s teams will be selected for the NRK programme QuizDan. Quizmaster Håkon Strand hopes many people will turn up to take part.
121362.tags_en: quizdan, TV programme, news, culture, quiz

121386.excerpt_en: “I am incorrectly registered in the Norwegian National Population Register. I have been trying to change that for seven years, and I will not leave here until it has been sorted out,” says Freia Hutzschenreuter, 74.
121386.subtitle_en: Freia Hutzschenreuter was supposed to leave after the transit of Venus in the summer. Now she has set herself a new goal.
121386.title_en: Staying Even After Venus Has Passed

121390.excerpt_en: “Now my mind is completely blank,” Håkon Strand said after 160 quiz questions had been answered on Monday. “How did it go for you, Tom?” he asked Tom Ramberg at the neighbouring table. “I drew a blank on music and sport,” Ramberg said.
121390.subtitle_en: Ivar Andersen, Håkon Strand, Aimée L. Adamiak and Tom Ramberg will defend Svalbard’s honour in the middle of NRK’s prime-time line-up.
121390.tags_en: tv programme, news, nrk, winners, quiz

121417.excerpt_en: Darkness is currently descending over Svalbard, and the sky is transforming from light blue and pastel to dark blue and black. Svalbard residents are well acquainted with the Northern Lights flaring across the sky almost every evening during the polar night—and even in the middle of the day during the darkest winter.
121417.subtitle_en: Secrets of the Night Sky’s Light
121417.title_en: Secrets of the Night Sky’s Light

121424.excerpt_en: “The car taken at the hospital was found by the Polar Hotel; the other was taken privately and returned privately,” says Chief Police Constable Sidsel Svarstad of the Governor’s Office. The man who took the car parked outside a residential house was spotted by neighbours and arrested by the police.
121424.subtitle_en: One car was taken from the hospital and another from outside a residential house early Saturday morning. The cars have been found, and a man is suspected of drink-driving.

121436.excerpt_en: “Climate change is making the northern seas increasingly important for ecosystem management. The Institute of Marine Research is Norway’s largest polar research institute, so it is important for us to have close and productive cooperation with UNIS,” says research director Harald Loeng of the Institute of Marine Research in a press release.
121436.subtitle_en: Tomorrow, the Institute of Marine Research will open an office at the Research Park in Longyearbyen. It will foster closer cooperation between the institute and UNIS.
121436.tags_en: news, unis, institute of marine research, research, nature and environment
121436.title_en: Institute of Marine Research Opens Svalbard Office

121460.excerpt_en: In July this year, the Governor of Svalbard received an email claiming that the Coast Guard’s Dornier aircraft had flown too low over a walrus colony at Torellneset on Nordaustlandet.
121460.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has been reported to the Special Unit for Police Affairs after emails alleging illegal flying were not entered in the official records.
121460.tags_en: governor of svalbard, coast guard, walrus, torellneset, news
121460.title_en: Reported for Failing to Keep Records

121466.excerpt_en: The Ministry of Climate and the Environment has asked the Governor of Svalbard and the Norwegian Directorate for Nature Management for input after the Svalbard Environmental Protection Act was revised earlier this year. In addition to the Act, several regulations elaborate on its provisions.
121466.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard does not want to draw up separate regulations for trapping and polar bear protection in the field.

121480.excerpt_en: In a letter to the Ministry of Climate and the Environment, the Governor of Svalbard writes that it is considering removing the quotas for Arctic char in Svalbard’s lakes.
121480.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard is considering banning net fishing for Arctic char in freshwater.

121508.excerpt_en: After a turbulent period of ugly red figures and the threat of bankruptcy hanging over it, SAS managed to salvage what it could through numerous tough cuts. Pay cuts of up to 20 percent for some groups, reduced pensions, longer and more efficient working hours, and the dismissal of 800 administrative employees.
121508.subtitle_en: An SAS cure for the Community Council?
121508.title_en: An SAS Cure for the Community Council?

121511.excerpt_en: It is sad to hear that Freia’s latest contribution to Svalbardposten was denied space because it was written too cryptically. There are probably many contributions that should have been rejected if the only criterion were whether they were cryptic or not.
121511.subtitle_en: Dear Cryptic Freia, and Dear Selective Editorial Team!
121511.title_en: Dear Cryptic Freia, and Dear Selective Editorial Team!

121516.excerpt_en: How do you write a tribute to a good friend and neighbour who passed away far too soon? Where do you find words that can fully describe a truly good man, a down-to-earth pleasure-seeker, pragmatist and adventurer, thinker, prankster and collector, a loving family man, a steady member of society, and a generous and kind fellow human being?
121516.subtitle_en: Words at the End of the Journey
121516.title_en: Words at the End of the Journey

121529.excerpt_en: There is clearly an increasing need to keep an eye on all of us moving around this archipelago. Earlier this autumn, we wrote about how the Coast Guard in the summer practically flew low over a crowd of tourists and a herd of walruses at Torellneset on the southwestern side of Nordaustlandet.

121535.excerpt_en: “The Coast Guard wants to have an overview of ship traffic around Svalbard. It has also been verbally instructed to be alert to breaches of the Svalbard Environmental Protection Act, or suspicions of such breaches, when carrying out assignments,” Ingerø says.
121535.subtitle_en: Governor Odd Olsen Ingerø denies that the Coast Guard has expanded its monitoring activities in Svalbard to include the tourism industry.
121535.tags_en: tourism, fishing, fisheries, coast guard, news, business, governor of svalbard
121535.title_en: The Coast Guard in a New Role

121538.excerpt_en: It was on 11 July, southeast of Sjuøyane, that the aircraft flew at low altitude over the drift ice, passing very close over the polar bear.
121538.subtitle_en: In June, a Coast Guard aircraft scared walruses at sea in its eagerness to guard tourists. In July, the Coast Guard flew low over a polar bear to check that the tourists were not frightening the animal.
121538.tags_en: governor of svalbard, news, tourism, coast guard, fisheries, fishing, business

121565.subtitle_en: Employees at Longyearbyen Community Council are not afraid of flying. This year, they have a travel budget of NOK 4 million.

121579.excerpt_en: So far, four companies in Longyearbyen have applied to the Labour Inspection Authority for approval as cleaning companies: ISS, AEO Fredheim, Nuttakit Sirirutwaraton and Sompong Haug. A new regulation intended to safeguard employees’ health, safety and working environment requires all cleaning companies to be approved by the Labour Inspection Authority.

121619.excerpt_en: We are expensive to run. Our homes must be warm and every lamp must be lit.

121621.excerpt_en: A fire broke out inside the roof of the power plant on Friday morning. Shortly after 9 a.m., the fire was reported to be under control. “The fire at the power plant is confined to an area on the western side and is under control,” Longyearbyen Community Council writes on its website.

121718.excerpt_en: “The boiler startup went according to plan, and between 8 and 9 p.m. the power plant produced both electricity and district heating. The guys at the power plant have done a fantastic job,” says Bydrift general manager Marianne Aasen.

121763.excerpt_en: “We have completed a number of projects. So we expect activities related to the treatment plant to take place here in Longyearbyen next year.”

121772.excerpt_en: “2012 will be a terrible year. If the company had not hedged against currency fluctuations, the deficit would have been NOK 360 million,” says Store Norske managing director Per Andersson.

121793.excerpt_en: It smells burnt in the boiler room on Tuesday afternoon, four days after the fire. But the floor is dry, and there is little soot to be seen. “ISS has been here and cleaned, so it looks fine now,” says engine-room assistant Morten Sundby.

121797.excerpt_en: On Tuesday and Wednesday, an assessor from Gjensidige inspected the power plant to assess the extent of the damage. The repair costs will most likely be covered by insurance. “We do not yet know the full extent,” says Bydrift general manager Marianne Aasen.
121797.subtitle_en: The power plant is insured for NOK 77 million. The extent of the damage is not yet known.

121832.excerpt_en: So that no one is in any doubt: I am me—and Wenche Foss is/was herself. Merry Christmas to everyone out there.

121842.excerpt_en: “I have a brother who lives up here, which is why I moved here,” says Martin Olsen from Harstad. He came to Longyearbyen in October two years ago to work as an assistant at Polarflokken kindergarten.

121842.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page

After Airlift was rejected early in the tender process, three companies remained in contention: Lufttransport, Bristow Norway and CHC Helicopter Service.

121874.subtitle_en: After two terms as Russia’s consul general in Svalbard, Aleksander A. Antipov, 65, said goodbye to friends and acquaintances last week.

121901.excerpt_en: Things look good. There are only a few days left of the year, and everything seems to be more or less on schedule.

121903.subtitle_en: The consul general believes that a research institute in St Petersburg deceived Trust Arktikugol when the foundations for satellite antennas were built in Barentsburg last autumn.

121907.subtitle_en: For the first time in two months, Andreas Rebnor Olsen (23) saw other people when the Christmas helicopter descended into Farmhamna last Friday.

121929.excerpt_en: “We are pleased that we managed to make it happen,” says Yngve Ryel of SAS Ground Services in Tromsø.
121929.subtitle_en: Extra flights will operate to and from Longyearbyen on Saturday afternoon.

122075.excerpt_en: Taiichi Fox, or Wada, as he is called in Japanese, first came to Longyearbyen in February last year. “I had known about the place for a long time and dreamed of coming here. It is a unique place, the only one apart from Antarctica where there is no daylight in winter.”

122148.excerpt_en: Last Friday, there was intense activity inside the museum’s exhibition room. Staff from the National Museum, Pole Position, Svalbard Museum and the Governor of Svalbard’s office ensured that Munch’s painting “Self-Portrait with Cigarette” got on board the Orion aircraft waiting at the airport. Fifteen crates of equipment were packed away.

122158.excerpt_en: Basecamp Spitsbergen has been granted permission to use the Olavsrosa mark at Isfjord Radio. 122164.excerpt_en: Next weekend, Svalbard residents can immerse themselves in films of every genre from every corner of the world. The Tromsø International Film Festival (TIFF) is coming to Longyearbyen in partnership with local organizer CinemArctic. “These films have been hand-picked, and I think you can safely see them all.”
122164.subtitle_en: Everything is ready for next weekend’s film festival in Longyearbyen. There will be something for every taste: splatter, comedy, skate films, children’s films and food for thought.

122181.excerpt_en: In December 2011, the government decided to begin work on nominating parts of Svalbard for UNESCO’s World Heritage List.

122262.excerpt_en: Everyone living in Longyearbyen will have a good chance to see the Queen at the end of the month. The official itinerary is now ready, and says that the Queen will arrive on a scheduled flight on Wednesday.

Svalbardposten refers to a memo to the Ministry of the Environment dated 21...”

122438.excerpt_en: The fire at the power station in December was an eye-opener in many ways. Bydrift has now carried out a risk assessment and found that much needs to be done to safeguard the town’s emergency preparedness.

122442.excerpt_en: Roberts plans to move the cabin, called “Vaglebu,” from Paulamorenen in Rindersbukta to the area near Sporodden on the north side of Kvalvågen. In a briefing to the Governor, Roberts writes that he plans to move the cabin because increasing mining activity in its current location has made the site unsuitable.

The report worried many people because the valley is important both to the cabin owners at Vindodden and to those who head over to Sassenfjorden.

122602.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Coastal Administration hopes to reach an agreement with Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) under which LL invests in a new boat and transports the Coastal Administration’s pilots to and from ships. The matter was considered by the local council on the 11th.
122602.subtitle_en: Despite considerable skepticism, the Administration Committee supports borrowing money for a new harbor boat.

122618.excerpt_en: In a new book and in the UNIS course ‘The Stormy Sun and the Northern Lights’, astrophysicist Pål Brekke explains what is worth knowing about the aurora. Understanding of the northern lights has developed from myths into modern science.
122618.subtitle_en: This year and the next two years will be especially favorable for the northern lights. Astrophysicist Pål Brekke explains why, and how to capture the celestial dance on a memory card.
122618.tags_en: news, climate, astronomy, weather, northern lights

122622.excerpt_en: Public health services in the archipelago are provided by Longyearbyen Hospital, which has 22 employees. In addition, Barentsburg’s population receives healthcare from its hospital, owned and operated by Trust Arktikugol.
122622.subtitle_en: Many key health laws do not apply in Svalbard. Now the Ministry of Health and Care Services wants to introduce them there, including in Barentsburg.
122622.tags_en: news, politics, Longyearbyen Hospital, health, laws

122634.excerpt_en: In a letter to the Governor of Svalbard, Thai Ambassador Theerakun Niyom writes that Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn, 58, will come to Longyearbyen in March. She is the daughter of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit of Thailand.
122634.subtitle_en: Thailand’s Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn will visit Longyearbyen in March.

122648.excerpt_en: “There were more younger participants this year. That is probably connected to the fact that several of those attending lower secondary school are busy with the musical ‘Hair’, which is being staged at the cultural center,” says UKM project manager and director Mari Tefre.
122648.subtitle_en: This year’s cultural showcase for children and young people, UKM, was a great success with the audience. Of the 22 young people who took the stage at the cultural center, seven will advance to the county showcase for Troms in Finnsnes.
122648.tags_en: Svalbard life, culture, UKM, cultural showcase
122648.title_en: A Full House for Young People

122668.excerpt_en: Air activity will increase considerably next year. The reason is that Lufttransport is taking over the lucrative helicopter contract for the Governor of Svalbard as of the 1st.

122672.excerpt_en: Ragnhild in black Nesnalobber boots, black trousers and a black jacket. Emilie in brown hiking shoes, light-colored trousers and a red jacket.
122672.subtitle_en: What makes two eighteen-year-old girls from the far north of the world pack their bags and travel as far south as it is possible to go? Meet Ragnhild and Emilie.

122676.excerpt_en: “We are expanding the station building by nearly 500 square meters. Half of this will be part of the equipment hall, which will thereby double in size.”
122676.subtitle_en: SvalSat is preparing for the future and expanding both horizontally and vertically. Work is under way to expand the station building and erect a new antenna.

122699.excerpt_en: The politicians are being asked to make a major financial decision on whether Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) should purchase a pilot boat to transport the Norwegian Coastal Administration’s pilots. After several rounds, the matter will finally be decided on Tuesday evening.
122699.subtitle_en: Should Longyearbyen Local Council commit to providing pilot-boat services for the Norwegian Coastal Administration for the next ten years? The council will decide on Tuesday.
122699.title_en: Pilot Boat Case in the Local Council

122702.excerpt_en: Of the 137 entries submitted, it was the fifth-grader’s drawing that was selected by the jury.
122702.subtitle_en: Ten-year-old Siril Aurora Malmstein drew the sun that will adorn this year’s Sun Festival logo.
122702.tags_en: sun drawing, Sun Festival, the sun, sun, culture, Svalbard life

122724.excerpt_en: The Mushamna trapping station has stood empty since autumn 2009, and Austfjordnes since spring 2011. Both cabins are owned by the state and were previously rented to people who wanted to spend the winter there.
122724.subtitle_en: If the animal population is healthy, trapping will resume at Austfjordnes next year.
122724.title_en: New Trappers to Get a Chance

122727.excerpt_en: Senior police officer Trond Olsen says the man was splashed in the face with concrete mix while bolting. He was wearing safety goggles, but some of the material got inside them. “Rinsing was started immediately in Svea, and the man was then brought to Longyearbyen by helicopter,” Olsen says.
122727.subtitle_en: A man in his 50s was flown to Longyearbyen Hospital on Wednesday evening after getting concrete mix in his eye.

122743.excerpt_en: It is in the anniversary book of the Norwegian Association for Rock Blasting Technique (NFF) that former Store Norske director Robert Hermansen is listed alongside, among others, waterworks manager Ivar T. Henriksen, who defrauded Nedre Romerike Waterworks of millions of kroner.
122743.subtitle_en: The fact that Robert Hermansen has been included in a new book alongside well-known people who defrauded their companies has sparked reactions.

122753.excerpt_en: Keeping Longyearbyen running costs a great deal of money. It took two reports to establish that this small community is run in a way that is complicated, expensive, inefficient and confusing.

122759.excerpt_en: One of the last undeveloped commercial areas lies east of Svalbard Snøscooterutleie and covers 13,000 square metres. Today, the area is a favourite spot for birdwatchers; soon it will be developed.
122759.subtitle_en: Store Norske wants to facilitate new commercial buildings east of Svalbard Snøscooterutleie. Bird enthusiasts are urging politicians to think carefully.
122759.tags_en: Store Norske, development, birds, zoning plan, news

122771.excerpt_en: Not just anyone can attend upper secondary school at Longyearbyen School. Students must have, among other things, an average grade of at least 4, good conduct grades, suitability as role models, and documented good physical and mental health. “These requirements have been in place from the beginning.”
122771.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen School wants students from the mainland, but requires, among other things, that they be in good health and serve as good role models.
122771.tags_en: news, upper secondary, mainland students, Longyearbyen School
122771.title_en: Opening the Door to Model Students

122785.excerpt_en: “We are negotiating with two suppliers. We have a mandate from the Ministry of Education and Research to negotiate the laying of two cables.”
122785.subtitle_en: Preparations to lay submarine cables from Longyearbyen to Ny-Ålesund are underway. Next autumn, Ny-Ålesund will also have a high-speed connection to the outside world.
122785.tags_en: Ny-Ålesund, internet, fibre-optic cable, news, communications

122801.excerpt_en: In an application to the Governor of Svalbard, Svalbard Villmarkssenter writes that it has permission to use its cabin in Van Mijenfjorden commercially, provided it is used for non-motorized activities.
122801.subtitle_en: In December, Jason Roberts said he wanted to move his cabin from Rindersbukta because of mining noise. Now Svalbard Villmarkssenter wants to move because of dust.

122807.excerpt_en: Ingrid Pedersen died on 11 September last year, aged 79, without Svalbardposten having been informed.
122807.subtitle_en: Ingrid Pedersen was the first female pilot to fly over the North Pole in a single-engine aircraft. For years, she worked as a bush pilot in Svalbard with a small Cessna plane.

122830.excerpt_en: Last year, politicians approved an investment in new housing for employees. It has now emerged that Bydrift spent NOK 1 million less on housing than budgeted.
122830.subtitle_en: Bydrift has spent more than NOK 1 million on a climbing tower and barbecue shelter at Kullungen kindergarten. The work was not approved by politicians.
122830.tags_en: news, economy, Bydrift, kindergarten, climbing tower

122855.excerpt_en: “You must not bother others, you must be kind and nice, and otherwise you can do whatever you want,” sang Police Chief Bastian in a major Thorbjørn Egner production that I staged at the cultural centre this autumn. For children and with children.
122855.tags_en: reader contribution, letter to the editor, Hair, opinions

122859.excerpt_en: I read the opening paragraph of the newspaper’s review of the school production “Hair”, performed on Saturday, 9 February, with disbelief.
122859.subtitle_en: Letter from the principal of Longyearbyen School
122859.tags_en: reader contribution, letter to the editor, Hair, opinions
122859.title_en: Letter from the Principal of Longyearbyen School

122876.excerpt_en: Svalbard Museum wants to cull and taxidermy a walrus for its exhibition. The reason is that it currently has only an old, worn head borrowed from Tromsø Museum in 1983.
122876.subtitle_en: Svalbard Museum wants to replace an old head with a whole walrus. Now it is appealing the Governor’s refusal to authorize a cull.
122876.tags_en: Svalbard Museum, exhibition, appeal, walrus, news

122880.excerpt_en: The race started at 10 a.m. on Saturday from the old northern-lights station, with four teams on the starting line. A few minutes after the start, the final two teams were also heading up Adventdalen toward Passhytta.
122880.subtitle_en: Six teams entered the Hilmar Nøis sled-dog race. Less than ten seconds separated the first two teams.
122880.tags_en: competition, news, dog, Hilmar Nøis, sled-dog race

122892.excerpt_en: At around 10 a.m. last Tuesday, the two dogs escaped from a kennel and through an open gate. They began chasing two reindeer and attacked one of them.
122892.subtitle_en: A commercial kennel has been fined NOK 8,000 after two dogs injured a reindeer so badly that it had to be euthanized.

122906.excerpt_en: The Hilmar Nøis Trail sled-dog race started at 10 a.m. on Saturday from the old northern-lights station in Adventdalen. Liv Bjørsvik’s team was first back in town, with a time of 2:40:23.
122906.subtitle_en: Two sled-dog races were held at the weekend, with fierce competition for the podium places.

122926.excerpt_en: Down by the fjord in Ny-Ålesund stands the 1917 steam locomotive, a landmark and reminder of times past. In bad weather, seawater is whipped over it, and it has now suffered extensive rust damage.
122926.subtitle_en: The locomotive in Ny-Ålesund has large rust holes and is at risk of falling apart.
122926.tags_en: restoration, locomotive, cultural heritage, rust, news

122945.excerpt_en: In August, a French woman died after being struck by ice when Esmarkbreen calved in Ymerbukta. A French man was injured.
122945.subtitle_en: A French woman died when Esmarkbreen calved in August last year. The prosecution is not charging the travel company.
122945.tags_en: tourism, news, accident, Kripos, fatal accident, glacier accident, glacier safari, Governor of Svalbard

122954.excerpt_en: It is not officially sunny in Longyearbyen until the sun reaches the old hospital steps by Svalbard Church. That happens every year on the 8th.
122954.subtitle_en: The sun was already shining on the old hospital steps on Thursday. It will probably shine tomorrow as well, when the return of the sun is celebrated.
122954.tags_en: sun festival, sun, weather, sunlight, news, astronomy, Sun Day

122961.excerpt_en: “This is an issue that has been discussed since the surcharge was introduced. The surcharge was introduced contrary to the government’s guidelines.”
122961.subtitle_en: The business association says Posten is not entitled to charge extra for delivering packages to and from Svalbard.
122961.tags_en: postage, mail, business association, news, packages

122970.excerpt_en: After eight years in the editor’s chair, Birger Amundsen will soon step down. The editor and managing director position at Svalbardposten is initially a fixed-term appointment of two years, plus one year and another year.
122970.subtitle_en: The newspaper’s entire editorial staff will be replaced over the course of the year.
122970.tags_en: editor, svalbardposten, news, journalist, editorial staff

122995.excerpt_en: Secretary-General Frigg Jørgensen of Arctic Expedition Cruise Operators (AECO) says they decided as early as October, before knowing the outcome of the case, to review their guidelines. The operator showed pictures and explained what had happened during the accident.
122995.subtitle_en: The case against the travel company and guides following the fatal accident in Ymerbukta this summer has been dropped. Nevertheless, the cruise industry is considering tightening its guidelines for glacier travel.
122995.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, glacier accident, cruise, tourism, AECO, news

123030.excerpt_en: LNS Spitsbergen (LNSS) is seeing strong demand for one- and two-bedroom apartments.
123030.subtitle_en: Politicians are opening the way for LNS Spitsbergen to build small apartments instead of family homes at Elvesletta Syd.
123030.title_en: Opens the Door to Smaller Homes

123063.excerpt_en: The airport departure hall is bustling with people this Monday. In a smart blue uniform, 19-year-old Rune Furøy is standing behind SAS’s service desk.
123063.subtitle_en: Rune Furøy is working his way up in the air. That can mean dinner in Alta and dessert in Hammerfest.
123063.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, the flip side

123069.excerpt_en: It will hardly come as a surprise that the town’s young people drink. Nor, perhaps, that they currently hold Norway’s record for the amount of alcohol they put away.

123073.excerpt_en: It was a crisis the day before. This year, as last year, and every year before that.
123073.subtitle_en: With gold as its backdrop and 18 gilded performers on stage, this year’s Sun Festival revue was a sparkling and beautiful affair.
123073.tags_en: news, sun festival revue, glitter and glamour, magazine

123101.excerpt_en: From 1 May, new rules will apply to the import of dogs into Norway.
123101.subtitle_en: New EU requirements make it almost impossible to take dogs from Svalbard to the mainland.
123101.tags_en: regulations, norwegian food safety authority, dog, veterinarian, vet, news

123131.excerpt_en: “We are planning now and will start work this summer on building a bridge across the Bayelva and a road out to Brandalpynten. That work is to be completed during the course of next year,” says project manager Line Langkaas of the Norwegian Mapping Authority in Hønefoss.
123131.subtitle_en: In five years, a new geodetic Earth observatory is to be completed at Brandalpynten in Ny-Ålesund. Construction starts this summer.
123131.title_en: New Observatory Ready to Be Built

123141.excerpt_en: So many people wanted to see Kurt Nilsen that the Culture and Recreation Company extended the stage to make room for 60 extra chairs in the venue. A total of 303 seats were sold.
123141.subtitle_en: All extra tickets had sold out when Kurt Nilsen took the stage at the cultural centre on Monday.

123150.excerpt_en: After four years of hard work, glacial geologist Endre Før Gjermundsen is nearing completion of his doctoral research in north-western Spitsbergen. Several summer and winter expeditions have uncovered interesting scientific findings, and now it is time to climb the highest mountain in the area: Kongen.
123150.subtitle_en: On Tuesday evening, NRK will show “The King and the Longship”, a programme about Endre Før Gjermundsen’s doctoral research at UNIS.
123150.tags_en: programme, news, nature and environment, television, doctoral research, TV

article_keywords_en: chief inspector of the governor’s office
123155.excerpt_en: “There were four people on three snowmobiles, two of which broke down. One person in the group became slightly hypothermic, so they called us,” says chief inspector Trond Olsen of the Governor’s office.
123155.subtitle_en: On Tuesday evening, four people were picked up at Eskerfossen by the Governor of Svalbard’s rescue helicopter after snowmobile breakdowns.
123155.tags_en: rescue mission, governor of svalbard, helicopter, news

123168.excerpt_en: The coming season will be “Nordsyssel”’s last in the Governor’s service. A new vessel will be built and equipped for the 2014 season with the latest environmentally friendly technology, propulsion machinery and navigation equipment, according to the Governor of Svalbard.
123168.subtitle_en: Remøy Management AS has been awarded the contract for a new service vessel for the Governor of Svalbard.
123168.tags_en: new service vessel, governor of svalbard, nordsyssel, news

123216.excerpt_en: The decision to shut down the processing plant (ORV) was made on Saturday, 8 March.
123216.subtitle_en: Problems at the processing plant have led to a two-week halt in coal production at the Svea Nord mine. Production most likely resumed yesterday.

123235.excerpt_en: “We are on schedule and expect to complete our part of the work as planned in September,” says project manager Jostein Nordstrøm of Veidekke. Veidekke is the main contractor for the Lunckefjell development, with contractor Hæhre as its subcontractor.
123235.subtitle_en: Work on pushing deeper into Lunckefjellet is well under way. In September, the miners will take over, after the construction workers have exposed the coal seam. From that moment, coal will begin flowing out of the new Lunckefjell mine.

123288.excerpt_en: “The two reported that they were struggling to get up onto the snowfield from Mosseldalen. The female participant felt she had run out of strength and that her legs were exhausted.”
123288.subtitle_en: On Tuesday evening, the Governor of Svalbard picked up two ski tourists in Mosseldalen who were attempting to cross Spitsbergen lengthwise.
123288.tags_en: skiing, news, expedition, ski party, rescue operation
123288.title_en: Had to Pick Up Skiing Party

123305.excerpt_en: After a long period of bitter cold and almost cloudless skies, strong winds and heavy snow arrived on Wednesday. Fortunately, the precipitation and strong winds are temporary. “There will be wind today and during the first part of tomorrow.”
123305.subtitle_en: Windy with snow today, better for the rest of Easter.
123305.tags_en: wind, sun, snow, news, climate, weather
123305.title_en: This Is What the Easter Weather Will Be Like

123313.excerpt_en: The accident occurred on Maundy Thursday during a hike in the mountains above Longyearbyen. Duty chief inspector Per Andreassen says the Governor of Svalbard was notified at around 1:30 p.m., and that the man was picked up by the rescue helicopter.
123313.subtitle_en: A man in his 30s suffered head injuries after sliding nearly 200 metres from the summit of Sukkertoppen.

123349.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute’s (NP) assessment from 2008 was prepared in response to a request from the Governor of Svalbard for “a professional assessment of the potential environmental effects of using hovercraft in Svalbard”. The assignment was to provide a general professional assessment of potential environmental effects on environmental values in Svalbard.
123349.tags_en: letter to the editor, norwegian polar institute, opinion, reader contribution

123363.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard signed a contract with Remøy Management for a new service vessel on Thursday, 21 March.
123363.subtitle_en: Remøy Management AS has been awarded the contract for a new service vessel for the Governor of Svalbard. Nordsyssel AS is appealing the decision.
123363.tags_en: new service vessel, nordsyssel, governor of svalbard, news

123380.excerpt_en: The law currently states that the Security Act applies to Svalbard to the extent determined by the King. So far, no such determination has been made.
123380.subtitle_en: The Ministry of Defence wants to secure the EU’s Galileo satellite navigation programme and therefore believes it is necessary to apply the Security Act to Svalbard.

123396.excerpt_en: Shooting a polar bear on Svalbard hurts, and provokes reactions from the strangest cranks far south on the mainland.

123425.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard has granted Andreas Rebnor Olsen permission to remain in Farmhamna for the coming season. Earlier this year, the Governor made it clear to the station’s owner, Hans Lund, that Farmhamna must be sold, removed or transferred to the state if he is not going to use the station himself for overwinter trapping.
123425.subtitle_en: Andreas Rebnor Olsen will remain in Farmhamna for the next trapping season as well, but after that he will no longer be allowed to rent the station.
123425.tags_en: news, trapping, governor of svalbard, farmhamna

123444.excerpt_en: The orchestra was established in 2009 and is intended to serve the entire region, but has not yet visited Svalbard. “We regard Svalbard as part of Northern Norway, and a natural part of our touring area,” says orchestra director Tor Lægreid. He promises this will not be their last visit.
123444.subtitle_en: The North Norwegian Opera and Symphony Orchestra is bringing 60 musicians to Longyearbyen in May.
123444.title_en: Filling the Cultural Centre with Symphony

123453.excerpt_en: The small-team class was convincingly won by Lena Danielsen and Fredrik Lindgren with five dogs, in a time of 3:47:22. A total of 15 teams started at UNIS on Saturday; all but one participant is resident in Svalbard.
123453.subtitle_en: Solfrid Håkenstad and Erik Rodesjö won the 75-kilometre Trappers Trail dog race held at the weekend. The winners raced with eight dogs in the large-team class.
123453.tags_en: news, Trappers Trail, dog sled race

123458.excerpt_en: That the three men would end up in a comfortably heated hotel was not part of the plan. The reason was that the fourth member of the party frostbitten two toes while skiing to the east coast.
123458.subtitle_en: After years of inactivity since its closure in 1998, tourist activity is steadily increasing in the Russian mining town at the head of Billefjorden. On 1 March, Hotel Tulip opened its doors to overnight guests.

123460.excerpt_en: This year’s race is the fifth to be held and spans two days. The first stage runs 40 kilometres from UNIS via Adventdalen, Todalen, Bødalen and Colesdalen to Kapp Laila.
123460.subtitle_en: The participants in the Trappers Trail are heading from Kapp Laila and are expected to reach the finish at Huset at around 1 p.m. today. Fifteen teams set off from the starting area at UNIS on Saturday.

123467.excerpt_en: The man was sentenced to 24 days’ suspended imprisonment and a NOK 43,000 fine. He also lost his driving licence for one year, according to the ruling from Nord-Troms District Court issued on Thursday.
123467.subtitle_en: A man in his forties drove under the influence in Ny-Ålesund on New Year’s Day and ran off the road.
123467.tags_en: drunk driving, legal case, verdict, news
123467.title_en: Lost His Licence After Drunk Driving

123492.excerpt_en: Minister of Justice and Public Security Grete Faremo will be in Longyearbyen next Tuesday and Wednesday. It will be her first visit since taking over the ministerial post from Knut Storberget in November 2011.
123492.subtitle_en: Minister of Justice and Public Security Grete Faremo is coming to Longyearbyen next week. Emergency preparedness and rescue will be the main themes of the visit.
123492.tags_en: ministerial visit, news, Grete Faremo, Minister of Justice and Public Security

123510.excerpt_en: Black bald patches are clearly visible in the fur of the museum’s polar bear. A large area on its left hind paw is missing fur. “We’re rather exasperated these days,” says Tora Hultgreen, director of Svalbard Museum.
123510.subtitle_en: Svalbard Museum is exasperated that visitors are plucking fur from the museum’s polar bear.
123510.tags_en: tourism, theft, museum, polar bear, news

123529.excerpt_en: “He was alone right where it happened. There were people nearby who heard a rockfall occur.”
123529.subtitle_en: A Ukrainian miner in his thirties died after being struck by a rockfall in the mine in Barentsburg last Thursday.

123539.subtitle_en: Frode Sømme is stepping down as principal of Longyearbyen School after one school year. Principal turnover has been frequent since 2008.

123545.excerpt_en: The sun shines from a cloudless sky over the dog yard in Adventdalen on this Tuesday morning. Elin M.
123545.subtitle_en: A chance encounter at Easter brought Elin M. Lien (36) to Svalbard. It has yet to let her go.
123545.tags_en: dog, people, woman, back page, life in Svalbard

123557.excerpt_en: We continue with photographs from Bjørnar Nilsen’s collection from Sandnessjøen. He grew up in Longyearbyen after the war and remained there until 1961, when he was 18 years old.
123557.subtitle_en: This week’s historical photograph shows a group of fit, strapping fellows.
123557.tags_en: men, historical photograph, history, boys, life in Svalbard, Svalbard Turn, gymnastics

123567.excerpt_en: “It was fun to win. I had one dog that fooled around a bit on the way to Kapp Laila, which slowed the team down.”
123567.subtitle_en: The Trappers Trail dog race has never been run faster. Erik Rodesjö and Solfrid Håkenstad finished an hour faster this year than the 2009 winner, when the race was held for the first time.
123567.tags_en: news, dog sled race, Trappers Trail, magazine

123589.excerpt_en: “We have completed the design work. The costs and consequences of building a third antenna at the Eiscat facility will be decided this coming Wednesday.”
123589.subtitle_en: On Wednesday, Eiscat will decide whether a new NOK 300 million antenna should be built on Breinosa, on the roof of Mine 7.
123589.title_en: Yes or No to a New Antenna

123597.excerpt_en: In February, representatives of the Nordnorsk Kunstmuseum visited Longyearbyen to explore the possibilities of establishing a branch here.
123597.subtitle_en: Museum director Tora Hultgreen would gladly rent space to the Nordnorsk Kunstmuseum next year. In the longer term, the art museum could get its own premises in an expanded research park.

123608.excerpt_en: Last Friday, the board of Oppvekstforetaket decided to spend NOK 250,000 on a climbing tower for Longyearbyen Kindergarten. The tower has a price tag of NOK 650,000.
123608.subtitle_en: Oppvekstforetaket wants to build a new climbing tower and upgrade the outdoor play area at Longyearbyen Kindergarten. Price tag: NOK 1.2 million.

123633.excerpt_en: “The police closed the mine in connection with the accident. Once we had completed our work on the accident itself, the closure was lifted,” says Johan Furebotten, chief inspector at the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority for Northern Norway.
123633.subtitle_en: The mine in Barentsburg reopened last Thursday after being closed following the accident in which a miner was killed.
123633.tags_en: news, accident, fatal accident, Barentsburg, mine

123638.excerpt_en: This means the Governor of Svalbard will get a brand-new vessel for the 2014 season. The boat will be built at the Havyard shipyard in Sogn and equipped with the latest environmentally friendly technology.
123638.subtitle_en: The Ministry of Justice has rejected Nordsyssel’s complaint over the Governor of Svalbard’s decision to award Remøy Management the contract for a new governor’s vessel.
123638.tags_en: ship, Remøy, news, boat, emergency preparedness, service vessel, shipping, Governor of Svalbard

123641.excerpt_en: This week, Grete Faremo made her first visit to Longyearbyen since becoming minister for Svalbard in 2011. “I’ve wanted to come here ever since I became Minister of Justice and Public Security. Now the timing was right, and I know this is the best time to come here.”
123641.subtitle_en: Justice Minister Grete Faremo is granting NOK 800,000 for business development in Longyearbyen.
123641.tags_en: ministerial visit, news, Grete Faremo, Minister of Justice and Public Security

123657.excerpt_en: Interpreting signals is not easy. Least of all those that arrive as black letters on a white background.

123686.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Fire and Rescue Service carried out an inspection at the airport on March 5.
123686.subtitle_en: Svalbard Airport is commended for its fire-safety work, but must ensure that all new employees receive fire-safety training.
123686.tags_en: airport, news, fire safety, fire inspection
123686.title_en: A Little Criticism, Plenty of Praise for the Fire Service

123689.excerpt_en: Last year, the technology and industrial production vocational program (TIP) started in Longyearbyen with seven students, after the school reached an agreement with LNS Spitsbergen on a school workshop. This year’s students are now nearly finished with their first year, and twelve new students have applied for TIP next school year.
123689.subtitle_en: Twice as many applicants are choosing the vocational technology and industrial production program as the academic program this autumn.
123689.tags_en: upper secondary, news, vocational studies, school
123689.title_en: Plenty of Interest in Learning to Fix Things

123705.excerpt_en: “It’s good that they are addressing it, so they can find out whether it works or not,” says Emilie Ulsnes Sommervold, student council leader at Longyearbyen Upper Secondary School. Oppvekstforetaket has now begun reviewing the current upper-secondary arrangement and its approved deviations from the Education Act.
123705.subtitle_en: After three years with its own upper-secondary model, Oppvekstforetaket will now review the arrangement. The student council leader says it is long overdue.
123705.title_en: Upper Secondary School to Be Evaluated

123743.excerpt_en: The starting gun went at 10 o’clock for the 42-kilometre race. The freshest competitor was Trond Espen Haug of the Governor of Svalbard’s office.
123743.subtitle_en: Fifty people lined up for Saturday’s Gruveløpet. There was blue sky and sunshine from Svea to Longyearbyen.
123743.tags_en: ski race, cross-country race, competition, mine, news

123769.excerpt_en: What does spring mean to you? Send us your photo by email to: post@svalbardposten.no.

123801.excerpt_en: Two Norwegian ski tourists in their thirties shot the bear at close range as they were crossing Isbukta. On their expedition blog, they write that they first fired two signal shots at distances of 100 and 50 metres respectively.

124011.excerpt_en: Svalbard can be dangerous, even now when everything is glowing. Yes, perhaps especially now.

124196.subtitle_en: The old telegraph building in Ny-Ålesund is to be restored at a cost of NOK 1.6 million. The technical equipment currently on the mainland will be returned to the building.

124289.title_en: Moves to prevent Lågøya from being closed

124295.excerpt_en: May is a month of dramatic weather swings. People in Longyearbyen are therefore not particularly bothered by snow and wind on the 17th.
124295.subtitle_en: Snow arrived right on cue as this year’s 17 May parade set off. It intensified as the parade crossed back and forth through Longyeardalen, without dampening the joy.

124310.excerpt_en: In a letter to Bjørn Henningsen, the Governor of Svalbard writes that the question of a possible transfer of ownership of the trapping station from Hans Lund to Bjørn Henningsen has never been submitted to the Governor, and that he will therefore continue to regard Hans Lund as the rightful owner.
124310.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard does not approve Hans Lund’s sale of the trapping station at Farmhamna to Bjørn Henningsen in 1996.

124319.excerpt_en: “I was in Ny-Ålesund for a short time. I was based at Isfjord Radio, and was asked to hurry to Ny-Ålesund because the telegraph operator had taken his own life,” says Telle.
124319.subtitle_en: The man in the photograph from the telegraph office in Ny-Ålesund 50 years ago has been identified. It turned out to be Gunnar Torstein Telle from Bergen.
124319.title_en: The Man with the Morse Key

124342.excerpt_en: “Eiscat’s concern is that there is no guarantee of operating funds; that is why the decision was postponed. It is not a question of the antenna not being built,” says professor emeritus Asgeir Brekke.
124342.subtitle_en: Lack of funds has led the Eiscat Council to postpone its decision on a new Eiscat antenna.

124345.excerpt_en: “We have said that some people will leave through natural attrition, but there is no doubt that there will be redundancies. We have presented the employees with a plan showing that redundancies will occur,” Per Andersson states.

At the time, the Governor’s Office was concerned that the cabin should not serve as a bridgehead and thereby lead to increased motor traffic into more remote areas.
124348.subtitle_en: The Governor’s Office and Basecamp Spitsbergen disagree over the use of snowmobiles in connection with the tourist cabin in Adolfbukta, Billefjorden.

124357.excerpt_en: In Bjørnar Nilsen’s series of photographs, we move up onto Platåberget this week, with a view over Skjæringa and Sjøområdet. Comments?

124387.excerpt_en: “It all ended well, and I am so incredibly relieved.”
124387.subtitle_en: The seven dogs that fell into a crevasse on Thursday afternoon were rescued by crews from Airlift and the Governor’s Office on Saturday morning. None of the dogs was injured.

124392.excerpt_en: It was a brilliant day for all the running enthusiasts who turned up at Svalbardhallen on Saturday. Despite the sparse crowd, race director Elisabeth Bergstrøm was very pleased.
124392.subtitle_en: Around 210 people ran in this year’s Spitsbergen Marathon in Longyearbyen. Hilde Solland Plassen broke the old women’s marathon record with a time of three hours and twelve minutes.

124402.subtitle_en: The trip into the glacier area north of Isfjorden did not go as planned after seven of the dogs fell into a crevasse. On Monday, the tourist group was back in Longyearbyen.

124453.excerpt_en: You would have to search a long time to find local runners on this year’s participant lists. A total of 195 participants lined up at the start, and only a few of them ran the full marathon distance of 42.195 kilometres.

124453.title_en: More Foreigners Take Part in the Race

124528.excerpt_en: Managing director Per Andersson does not wish to speculate further about what may happen to the planned start-up of coal production at the Lunckefjell mine. The plan is to begin full-scale operations next year.
124528.subtitle_en: The serious situation at Store Norske may lead to the Lunckefjell mine being postponed. “If coal prices do not improve, that too will have to be considered,” says director Per Andersson.

124544.excerpt_en: “There are several bird books, but none in such a handy pocket format. And none that is as up to date,” boasts Georg Bangjord.
124544.subtitle_en: People are flocking as never before with binoculars and telephoto lenses on birdwatching trips. A new bird book aims to make it easier for them to identify what they see.

124557.excerpt_en: “We have conducted investigations in Barentsburg together with the Labour Inspection Authority and the Mining Inspectorate, and have also visited the accident site in the mine,” says deputy governor Lars Erik Alfheim. The rockfall occurred last Thursday evening, 300 metres underground.
124557.subtitle_en: The Governor has closed the mine until further notice following last Thursday’s rockfall accident, in which a 27-year-old Ukrainian miner was killed.

124572.excerpt_en: It has become warmer—that is a fact, just as it is a fact that there is far less ice in the sea here in the north. We can see it with our own eyes and read about it in all kinds of publications.

124575.excerpt_en: “We flew by helicopter over both Kongsøya and Svenskøya on 8 April and found only two dens.”
124575.subtitle_en: Kong Karls Land has for many years been the most important area for female polar bears giving birth. This spring, only two dens were observed in the archipelago, and no females with cubs were seen.

124593.excerpt_en: Tore was one of our strongest supporters and driving forces, and a good person of great integrity. He took over as chair of the board of Unis during a period of difficult financial conditions and, through his wisdom and leadership, helped turn the situation around toward new and sustainable growth.
124593.subtitle_en: It was a sad day for all current and former Unis employees when we received the news of Tore Vorrens’s death on Sunday, June 16, at just 69 years of age.

124645.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn believes holding a stage of the Arctic Race of Norway in and around Longyearbyen is a hair-raising idea. “But it is entirely possible,” says Helle M. Jakobsen.

124700.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten’s new editor is Eirik Palm. He is 47, lives in Hammerfest and comes from the job of editor-in-chief at Finnmark Dagblad.
124700.subtitle_en: Looking forward to coming to Svalbard.

124703.excerpt_en: In a room at Galleri Svalbard, two men are sitting amid a heap of what many would regard as electronic waste.

124727.excerpt_en: “The most important thing for me is that I now get a good harbour. There are no other alternatives in Bellsund,” says Sandal, who is making a brief stop in Longyearbyen.

124740.excerpt_en: The helicopter was stationed aboard the Coast Guard vessel “Nordkapp” when the pilot received an indication of engine trouble while out on what the Armed Forces call “a navigation patrol.” “When that happens, procedures are put into effect, including dumping fuel.”
124740.subtitle_en: Two Sundays ago, one of the Armed Forces’ Lynx helicopters had to make an emergency landing at Kinnvika because of problems with one of the aircraft’s two engines.

124764.excerpt_en: “When Helse Nord began this preservation work several years ago, I did not understand it at first. I thought they were working on the old hospital building farther up the valley.”

124788.title_en: Drunken brawling and pushing ended in a knife attack

124984.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the accident at 5:30 this morning. “A 55-year-old Ukrainian man suffered crush injuries to his legs. The accident occurred in the innermost part of the mine, where production takes place,” says Governor’s officer Frede Lamo.
124984.subtitle_en: A 55-year-old man is in hospital in Longyearbyen after a workplace accident in the Barentsburg mine early today.

124998.excerpt_en: “Everything was normal when our researchers left the bear, after placing it on its side so it could breathe freely,” explains senior researcher and section head Kit M. Kovacs of the Norwegian Polar Institute in Tromsø.
124998.subtitle_en: The bear that died in northern Edgeøya last week was a young male in good condition. Researchers found it dead two days after sedating and tagging it.
124998.title_en: Unexpected polar bear death on Edgeøya

125001.excerpt_en: Early Tuesday morning, a Ukrainian man in his 50s suffered serious crush injuries to one leg. The accident occurred in the part of the Barentsburg mine where production is taking place.
125001.subtitle_en: Representatives of the Governor of Svalbard, the Labour Inspection Authority and the Mining Inspectorate travelled to Barentsburg on Wednesday to investigate another serious mining accident.

125006.excerpt_en: In the first week of September, the Governor of Svalbard and the Labour Inspection Authority visited Barentsburg after receiving reports of unsafe work on scaffolding. The scaffolding used in the extensive restoration of the community centre was of particular interest to the inspectors.
125006.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority temporarily halted restoration work in Barentsburg.

125037.excerpt_en: Polarpuls, led by Trine Krystad, decided this year to give the season a proper flying start. “Many members have said they want individual follow-up for their training. That’s why we decided to invite two personal trainers to Longyearbyen,” says Krystad.
125037.subtitle_en: Polarpuls opened the season by inviting personal trainers to Longyearbyen to provide one-to-one coaching.

125042.excerpt_en: The story began in autumn 2006, when the owner of Taubanelageret, Jason Roberts, unlawfully began expanding the listed building, which was once a warehouse for the cableway system.
125042.subtitle_en: The story of Taubanelageret never seems to end. In yet another letter to the Governor of Svalbard, the Directorate for Cultural Heritage now announces that the order to remove the kerbstones and piles along the building is to be carried out.

125060.excerpt_en: With the loan from DNB, Store Norske has fully financed the Lunckefjell mine, the company writes in a press release. An agreement has also been reached to continue the overdraft facility at its current level to finance inventories.
125060.subtitle_en: Store Norske has entered into an agreement with DNB for an investment loan of NOK 500 million for the Lunckefjell mine.

125077.excerpt_en: Everything comes at a price—especially if you pick a fight with the authorities.

125082.excerpt_en: “We process around 400 tonnes an hour, and we’re very pleased with how things are going now,” says Cato Lund. He is Store Norske’s technical manager and responsible for the ore-processing plant, ORV.
125082.subtitle_en: The coal-washing plant in Svea has long been a headache for Store Norske. Now the machinery is running smoothly, chewing through the enormous piles of unprocessed coal in storage.

125087.excerpt_en: Hans Gunnar Skreslett, Arne Holand and Tom Ramberg were hunting near Vindodden on 7 September.
125087.subtitle_en: The hunters could only stand inside the cabin and watch as the polar bear enjoyed their kill.
125087.title_en: Bear helped itself to the hunters’ catch

125097.excerpt_en: The violent incident took place in the early hours of Sunday, 21 April, in an apartment block in Barentsburg.
125097.subtitle_en: Nord-Troms District Court has sentenced a 33-year-old Ukrainian for the knife attack in Barentsburg on 21 April this year.
125097.title_en: Ukrainian sentenced to two years in prison

125110.excerpt_en: Sport 1 has opened a new section in the premises formerly occupied by the children’s clothing shop Bajas.
125110.subtitle_en: The first shop in the country, Sport 1 has opened a section selling only the Bergans clothing brand.

125127.excerpt_en: In recent weeks, Fugro Offshore Survey has scanned the seabed and found the route the cable will take.
125127.subtitle_en: The route the fibre-optic cable will follow from Longyearbyen to Ny-Ålesund is ready.

125135.excerpt_en: “Now we’re going to hunt reindeer. And we’re doing it to get food,” Kristoffer Albrigtsen declared, unprompted and with great determination, when it became clear that a journalist would join the hunt.
125135.subtitle_en: The five-year-olds at Polarflokken kindergarten were fully engaged as they filled their quota of two reindeer.

125157.excerpt_en: The dog club (LHK) has applied to the Local Council for permission to begin expanding the dog yard by approximately 2,000 square metres to the east. Open to more The head of LHK, Elise Strømseng, says the expansion plans are part of a restructuring the club has been working on for some time. “LHK has previously been reserved for sled dogs and polar dogs.”
125157.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Dog Club plans to expand the town’s dog yard to include more than polar dogs. But implementation depends on securing financing.
125157.tags_en: Longyearbyen Dog Club, news, dog yard, LHK

125165.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute is responsible for naming land areas on Svalbard. On the 15th
125165.subtitle_en: King Harald V, like his father and grandfather, has had a tract of land on Svalbard named after him.
125165.title_en: Gets his name on Svalbard land

125173.excerpt_en: Governor’s officer Inge Meløy was notified of the accident at 2 a.m. “The Super Puma helicopter was airborne within 25 minutes. The injured man was picked up in Svea and taken to the hospital in Longyearbyen,” says Governor’s officer Inge Meløy.
125173.subtitle_en: A man in his 30s suffered head injuries after falling at Svea Nord last night.

125181.excerpt_en: The judgment from Nord-Troms District Court is entirely in line with prosecutor Lars Erik Alfheim’s sentencing demand. Defence counsel Anette Barlinn and the defendant are still weighing whether to appeal. “We are familiar with the judgment and will decide in the near future whether to appeal the sentence,” says Barlinn.
125181.subtitle_en: The 33-year-old Ukrainian has been sentenced to two years in prison for the knife incident in Barentsburg. He is considering appealing the sentence.
125181.title_en: Sentenced to two years in prison

125189.excerpt_en: In a letter to the Governor of Svalbard, Veselov has asked for details of how and to what extent the taxes paid by Trust Arktikugol and its employees are used for public measures in the Russian settlement.
125189.subtitle_en: Director General Aleksander P. Veselov feels that the residents of Barentsburg are being discriminated against in the tax matter.

125213.excerpt_en: In June next year, an entirely new vessel will take over as the Governor of Svalbard’s service vessel.
125213.subtitle_en: On Sunday, “Nordsyssel” will cast off and leave Svalbard for the very last time, after serving the Governor of Svalbard since 2003. Great uncertainty about the future prevails among the seven crew members.

125229.excerpt_en: They move slightly in the wind and are a reminder of the latitudes we live at. But they are not allowed to hang here.
125229.subtitle_en: The owners are being asked to remove the seals hanging from the cableway trestles at Gruve 6.

125237.excerpt_en: On Thursday afternoon, the fifth Oktoberfest in Longyearbyen began with a parade through the town centre. It was followed by an official opening led by NRK celebrity Torkjell Bærulfsen.
125237.subtitle_en: The world’s northernmost Oktoberfest opened with a parade and lederhosen.

125245.excerpt_en: When the survey vessel “Fugro Helmert” scanned the seabed, a total of nine objects were found that the fibre-optic cable scheduled for installation next year must not be laid near. “Of the nine positions, probably eight are wrecks.”
125245.subtitle_en: There may be several interesting wrecks on the seabed between Longyearbyen and Ny-Ålesund.
125245.title_en: Nine Places to Keep Clear Of

125283.excerpt_en: On the night of Thursday 26 September, the Governor of Svalbard’s helicopter, with a doctor and an anaesthetic nurse on board, was dispatched to Svea, where a workplace accident had occurred.
125283.subtitle_en: The man injured in the Svea Nord mine last week is doing relatively well under the circumstances.

125291.excerpt_en: This is the last issue of Svalbardposten with Birger Amundsen as editor. After eight years and eight months in the editor’s chair, he is stepping down.
125291.subtitle_en: Toothless journalism is what he hates most. After nearly nine years as editor of Svalbardposten, Birger Amundsen is moving on to new tasks.

125300.excerpt_en: “It was good to have a little more time to get our bearings. Now we can operate for a few more months while continuing to look for new premises—or a plot of land on which to build a fast-food restaurant,” says Sam Ziaei.
125300.subtitle_en: Sam Ziaei is relieved to have received permission to operate Classic Pizza in Lompensenteret until the end of the year.

125348.excerpt_en: Lompensenteret received money to purchase a defibrillator, and plenty was left over for the TV fundraising campaign. This was because Bruvik auctioned off the prototype of the watch model on Saturday and donated the proceeds to the aforementioned causes.
125348.subtitle_en: Lompensenteret, the annual TV fundraising campaign and watch designer Rune Bruvik all benefited from the launch of the Svalbard model last weekend.

125356.excerpt_en: In September, a reindeer calf was found dead in Bjørndalen. The calf had a great deal of foam around its mouth.
125356.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Veterinary Institute’s conclusion is clear.
125356.title_en: Reindeer Was Not Infected with Rabies
