133516.subtitle_en: A group of four locals wants to take over responsibility for the rubbish hut in the Sjøområdet area. This week, they applied to Longyearbyen Community Council to keep the hut standing for another year.

133520.excerpt_en: One of the most special things about living in Longyearbyen is the wildlife right outside our living-room door all year round. During the polar night, reindeer, Arctic foxes and ptarmigan provide entertainment from the animal kingdom among the houses.
133520.subtitle_en: There is little space left for animals and birds in Longyearbyen; something should be done about it.
133520.tags_en: letters to the editor, birds, wildlife, animals, opinion

133572.excerpt_en: Eight in ten Svalbard residents over the age of 18 read Svalbardposten weekly, both in print and as an e-paper. Seven in ten visit svalbardposten.no once or more each week to catch up on the news.
133572.subtitle_en: We also have the world’s best audience.

133584.excerpt_en: “I’m very worried. I’m keeping my fingers crossed, and I’ve never hidden the fact that I’m a strong supporter of coal mining in Svalbard,” says Geir Hekne (Conservative), deputy leader of Longyearbyen Community Council.
133584.subtitle_en: The board stresses that it believes in Store Norske, but doubts about future mining projects are now beginning to emerge. Employees are preparing for another storm.

133589.excerpt_en: For people who have travelled around Svalbard in recent years, it will hardly come as a surprise that walrus numbers are continuing to grow. In any case, this is now official: the results of the 2012 walrus counts in the archipelago were recently published in the journal Polar Research.
133589.subtitle_en: In any case, the near future looks bright for the walruses in our area.
133589.tags_en: letters to the editor, walrus, research, opinion, feature article
133589.title_en: Walrus Numbers Rise Sharply in Svalbard

133605.excerpt_en: The draw took place on 20 October, with Jørn Kjetil Hansen and Liv Torill Solberg representing the Longyearbyen Hunters’ and Anglers’ Association and the Governor of Svalbard, respectively, as observers.
133605.subtitle_en: Twenty-four hunters have been granted permission to trap foxes this winter.

133640.excerpt_en: Both the Labour Party and the Conservatives gained ground in a poll conducted by Norfakta Markedsanalyse for Svalbardposten in October. Svalbardposten based the poll on existing parties and parties that had officially announced they would field a list.
133640.subtitle_en: The Conservatives make a giant jump and the Liberals enter, but Labour would have had an outright majority if there were local council elections today.

133681.excerpt_en: Here is teacher Aud Mari Sveen with the pupils Svalbardposten met when the newspaper paid a visit in late January 1974. Sveen is originally from Lena in Austre Toten and came to Svalbard in autumn 1972 to begin her teaching career.
133681.subtitle_en: This time, we visit the preschool in Longyearbyen.
133681.tags_en: historical photograph, life in Svalbard, history

133702.excerpt_en: Solberg (Conservative) arrived in Longyearbyen on Sunday to learn about Exercise Svalbard, which begins on Tuesday. It is one of the largest civilian exercises ever held in Svalbard.
133702.subtitle_en: The government is making no promises, but Prime Minister Erna Solberg says it will consider helping the state-owned coal company in Svalbard.
133702.tags_en: the government, coal prices, Store Norske, news
133702.title_en: To Hold Talks with Store Norske

133720.excerpt_en: On Monday, board chair Annette Malm Justad met with the Ownership Department at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries to brief it on the situation facing the state-owned coal company in Svalbard.
133720.subtitle_en: The board is warning of “significant changes” to Store Norske’s operations. The coal company is heading for a nine-figure deficit in 2014.
133720.tags_en: Store Norske, coal prices, the board, news
133720.title_en: Warns of Major Changes to Operations

article_keywords_en: senior officers from the Governor’s Office
133745.excerpt_en: The 26-year-old man was sentenced to 24 days in unconditional imprisonment, as requested by the prosecutor, and must also pay NOK 2,000 in legal costs. Several threats It was 9.
133745.subtitle_en: The man who appeared in Nord-Troms District Court at the end of last month, charged with behaving extremely offensively toward two senior officers from the Governor’s Office, has now been sentenced.

133748.excerpt_en: This week, the largest exercise of its kind ever held in Svalbard was conducted. It followed many months of preparations involving several ministries, directorates, the Armed Forces, the Governor of Svalbard, UNN, healthcare personnel and other local forces.
133748.subtitle_en: It is in everyone’s interest that the evaluation is conducted through an exceptionally critical lens.
133748.tags_en: editorial, opinion, emergency preparedness, crisis exercise
133748.title_en: An Exam in the High Arctic

133751.excerpt_en: As the board held its first meeting with the Ownership Department at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries (NFD), the third-quarter report was released. It shows that the situation is worse than expected.
133751.subtitle_en: 2014 could be one of the worst years in Store Norske’s history, but employees believe the company will manage to reach safer waters.
133751.tags_en: the board, Lunckefjell, news, Svea, Store Norske, coal prices

133803.excerpt_en: Dear Monica. You don’t know me, but we have lived in the same town for many years.
133803.subtitle_en: Store Norske is struggling—more than it has in a long time.
133803.tags_en: opinion, Store Norske, letters to the editor

133812.excerpt_en: I refer to issue no. 42 of Svalbardposten, dated the 24th.

133815.excerpt_en: In December last year, nine people travelled to the meteorological station on Bear Island for a six-month adventure. One of them was Kirsti Lund Vik (34), daughter of former mine manager Johannes Vik. “I have lived in Svalbard before, and I have long wanted to experience the Arctic Ocean.”
133815.subtitle_en: Kirsti Lund Vik lived in Longyearbyen for much of her childhood. Last winter, she was on Bear Island and filmed by NRK together with her colleagues.

133837.excerpt_en: “What was special this time was how well we did in volleyball. Everything clicked,” says general manager Helle M.
133837.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen lost only in table tennis when the town’s sports stars faced arch-rivals Barentsburg on Saturday.

133854.excerpt_en: We are staying indoors this week and looking back at Nysalen, where 60 happy people gathered for an evening of dancing on 27 January 1974.
133854.tags_en: historical picture, life in Svalbard, history

133904.excerpt_en: Pictured is Pauline Skreslett performing Erik Bye and Henning Sommerro’s “Blå salme” at Svalbard Church. Skreslett was one of many artists who created an atmospheric Friday evening at the church and a fitting prelude to the polar night.
133904.subtitle_en: Diversity and high quality characterized this year’s KunstPause.
133904.tags_en: arts interlude, life in Svalbard, culture

133906.excerpt_en: The rather strange incident took place during the night before Saturday. The snowmobile dealers Ingeniør G.
133906.subtitle_en: The temptation proved too great when the man discovered the snowmobile on the stage. It did not end well.

133934.excerpt_en: With Hurtigruten’s recent announcement that the White Sea will become a future cruise destination, we may get an idea of the shipping company’s new owners. British investment fund TDR Capital, together with investors Trygve Hegnar and Petter Stordalen, will own all the shares in the company through the joint venture Silk Bidco.
133934.subtitle_en: The question remains, however, what Hurtigruten’s “new” cruise venture means for those of us on shore.
133934.tags_en: tourism, opinion, editorial, Hurtigruten Svalbard, Spitsbergen Travel

133941.excerpt_en: Espen Rotevatn has made strongly negative statements about Store Norske and coal mining on Svalbard at irregular intervals, most recently in Svalbardposten on 7 November.
133941.subtitle_en: “Phasing out coal mining cannot be done overnight, as Rotevatn proposes.”

133945.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen was built around mining, and without it there would be no settlement here. Remove today’s mining industry, and its soul disappears.
133945.subtitle_en: It is not wise to implement major changes in this community over a short period of time.

133953.excerpt_en: At some point between 19 November and 7.
133953.subtitle_en: In a few days, you may be able to witness a rare phenomenon in the sky southwest of Spitsbergen.

133967.excerpt_en: Kåre Karlstad was born in Mehamn in Finnmark and had experience in shipping before studying commerce and going into business—first importing timber from the Soviet Union, and later expanding his activities. The year was 1978, eleven years before the fall of the Berlin Wall and in the middle of the Cold War, with the Soviet bear as his closest neighbor.
133967.subtitle_en: As relations between Norway and Russia remain chilly and we mark the 25th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall, comes the story of someone who defied his fear of the Soviet Union, revived the Pomor trade and started a business in Barentsburg.
133967.tags_en: culture, book, life in Svalbard, Barentsburg, Barents textile, Cold War

134012.excerpt_en: The hunting inspectors are very pleased with this year’s reindeer hunters. “Some had forgotten to bring their firearms permits, but most were very competent, and the hunting inspectors got a good impression of the hunters,” says Bjarte Benberg, an adviser in nature and species management with the Governor of Svalbard.
134012.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has received the jaws from the reindeer hunt and can confirm that 186 animals fell to the hunters’ shots this autumn.

134040.excerpt_en: Ingeniør G. Paulsen AS (IGP) and Svalbard Snøcooterutleie AS (SSU) collaborated on this year’s snowmobile fair at Huset.
134040.subtitle_en: There was a well-attended snowmobile fair at Huset last weekend.
134040.title_en: Laid the groundwork for additional sales

134065.excerpt_en: In the autumn two years ago, John-Einar Lockert, Bård Heio and Tollef Svenkerud merged several of their smaller companies and formed the Svalbard Adventure Group. Last year was the group’s first year of operations.
134065.subtitle_en: Svalbard Adventure Group AS had a tough first year. The group made no money from either Svalbard Snøscooterutleie or its restaurant and hotel operations.

134080.excerpt_en: Thale and Lusie were among many who took photographs at this year’s Camp Svalbard in Ymerbukta. In the photography competition, Thale won first and fourth prizes, while Lusie took the bronze.
134080.subtitle_en: Thale Snibsøer and Lusie Kuraas’s photographs will remain on display at the Longyearbyen library for the foreseeable future.
134080.title_en: Young photographers showcase their best shots

134090.excerpt_en: The weather probably had some influence on attendance, but there were few vacant seats inside the church. Several people also chose to follow the concert from the fireside room.
134090.subtitle_en: Pauline Skreslett set the mood with Erik Bye and Henning Sommerro’s “Blå salme” at Svalbard Church on Friday.

134094.excerpt_en: “We’re on our way home from the museum group,” says Agnes Zadewasser. It is nearly 3:30 p.m. on Thursday afternoon, and the three eight-year-olds are in a hurry.
134094.subtitle_en: Aurora, Agnes and Adrian have learned a lot of secrets, but Picasso is an exception.
134094.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page, children

134149.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard went to the bar during the night before Tuesday after receiving reports of trouble. The disturbance turned out to be extensive. “We do not yet have an overview of how many were involved in the fight, but there were many,” says deputy governor Jens Olav Sæther.
134149.subtitle_en: During the night before Tuesday, an unknown number of young men were involved in a mass brawl in central Longyearbyen.

134151.excerpt_en: Concern is spreading in Longyearbyen after Store Norske submitted a quarterly report showing a negative result of NOK 225 million after the first nine months of the year. It is already clear that the deficit will most likely be the largest in the coal company’s history, and that the company needs help.
134151.subtitle_en: That is why the situation at the coal company should concern far more people than just its employees.

134157.excerpt_en: “People are taking it in stride and realizing the seriousness of the situation,” says Store Norske union representative Arild Olsen. When the proposed cuts were made public on Tuesday, he was in Svea to speak with his employees.
134157.subtitle_en: The question of a state guarantee for Store Norske will, in all likelihood, reach the national parliament.

134159.excerpt_en: “As I see it now, anything could happen,” says Bakken, who works as an AFIS officer for Store Norske at Svea airport. The couple met in Ny-Ålesund and moved to Longyearbyen in 2012, where they settled.
134159.subtitle_en: Linda Bakken (39) gives a warm look to little Sigbjørn (3 months), sitting on his father Kjell-Ove Skredlund’s (29) lap. The apartment at Vei 238 is cozy. At work, there is a storm raging.

134166.excerpt_en: Svalbard’s climate is changing rapidly. In fact, the temperature increase in Svalbard over recent decades is the greatest in all of Europe.
134166.subtitle_en: Is this what Svalbard winters will look like in the future? What are the consequences for society and the natural environment?
134166.tags_en: letter to the editor, feature article, climate, research, opinion

134184.excerpt_en: Nine company teams faced one another in the football tournament organised by Liverbirds Svalbard at Svalbardhallen last Saturday. Sweat poured from ten in the morning, and there was no questioning the players’ commitment.
134184.subtitle_en: Happy winners after the football tournament.

134194.excerpt_en: In the last issue, we showed a picture of the crew assigned to demolish the old loading facility at Gruve 2B. It is still 1964, and we are at the same mine.
134194.tags_en: historical picture, life in Svalbard, history

134233.excerpt_en: The Governor has so far refused to allow Basecamp Spitsbergen AS to use the cabin at Adolfbukta and “Båten i isen” as a base for guided snowmobile tours. The Ministry of Climate and Environment has now intervened and overturned the Governor’s decision.
134233.subtitle_en: The Ministry of Climate and Environment believes the Governor of Svalbard was too strict with Basecamp Spitsbergen.

134239.excerpt_en: After Bykaia Lagerutleie AS won its complaint against Longyearbyen Local Council’s (LL) definition of “cost price” for road connections, Avinor has begun rattling its sabre. Its concern is connection to water and district heating.
134239.subtitle_en: If Longyearbyen Local Council does not meet Avinor halfway, a new complaint about the fee system will be submitted to LL.
134239.title_en: Avinor Threatens a New Fee Dispute

134257.excerpt_en: The plans for the new hotels to be built at Elvesletta are now ready. Last spring, landowner Store Norske allocated three plots to three applicants.
134257.subtitle_en: Po Lin Lee will build a hotel with a spa and ice rink. Next door, Kroa will build new premises, probably in cooperation with another hotel.
134257.title_en: This Is What the Hotel Town at Elvesletta Will Look Like

134269.excerpt_en: Svalbard Adventure Group AS has begun construction of a new hotel by Kroa, while Sandmo & Svenkerud and Po Lin Lee will build hotels at Elvesletta. Last year, 51 percent of Longyearbyen’s accommodation capacity was utilised.
134269.subtitle_en: The tourism industry must expect lower occupancy and lower room rates when three new hotels are built within a short period.

134277.excerpt_en: “We have reviewed all road-connection fees since 1 October 2010 and found that we charged fees for roads even though LL incurred no costs related to them,” Belinda Brendlien of Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) told the politicians on the Administration Committee (AU) on Tuesday.
134277.subtitle_en: Twenty-eight developers overpaid Longyearbyen Local Council for road connections. Now they will get the money back.

134282.excerpt_en: In July, it became legal to produce beer and other alcohol on Svalbard, and at the end of October Kroa applied to brew its own Christmas beer. “Much of the food we sell as catch of the day and today’s slow-cooked dish, we have smoked ourselves.”
134282.subtitle_en: Jørn Kjetil Hansen at Kroa wanted to brew his own Christmas beer. He will not have time to do so because of uncertainty over who can grant permission.
134282.title_en: Not Allowed to Brew Christmas Beer

134319.excerpt_en: The woman in her 30s was part of a guided group, and they were travelling down Longyearbreen when things went wrong.
134319.subtitle_en: A person in a travelling party was thrown off a snowmobile on Saturday.
134319.title_en: Taken to UNN After Snowmobile Accident

134323.excerpt_en: Svlbardpoten wrote on 11 November about the launch of a 21-metre-high rocket from Andøya.
134323.subtitle_en: At quarter past nine, it will be possible to see a rare spectacle in the sky southwest of Spitsbergen.
134323.title_en: Now the Rocket Is Going Up

134352.excerpt_en: I am pleased that they have “come forward” in Svalbardposten on 14 November and taken part in a debate Longyearbyen sorely needs.
134352.subtitle_en: I certainly believe it does. And I venture to claim that Sveinung Lystrup Thesen and Kjetil Figenschou’s attitudes pose a greater threat to the company than mine do.
134352.tags_en: Store Norske, opinion, letter to the editor
134352.title_en: Does Store Norske Have a Future?

134362.excerpt_en: The flight was cancelled after a stopover in Tromsø on its way from Oslo. Despite rain and mild weather in Longyearbyen, runway conditions are not that poor. “There was medium to good braking action and not much wind in Longyearbyen,” says airport manager Morten Ulsnes at Longyearbyen Airport.
134362.subtitle_en: Tonight’s Christmas concert has consequently been cancelled, and Svalbardposten is delayed. An extra flight will be operated on Friday morning.

134369.excerpt_en: It was just as expected: On Monday, the board adopted the administration’s cost-cutting proposal for Store Norske. As a result, at least 100 jobs will disappear.

134375.excerpt_en: DNV GL, owned by the Foundation Det Norske Veritas, mapped the risk of pollution resulting from shipping accidents in Svalbard and Jan Mayen in two reports published in May and November this year.
134375.subtitle_en: There have been 48 shipping accidents around Svalbard in 15 years. No one knows how many near misses there have been during the same period.
134375.title_en: Risk of an Accident Every Six Years

134388.excerpt_en: Store Norske is not making money, and soon the coffers will be empty. The board has decided that at least a hundred people must go.
134388.subtitle_en: We would rather build symbols with lasting value.
134388.tags_en: opinion, Store Norske, letter to the editor

134389.excerpt_en: The picture shows Svalbard Turn securing victory in volleyball. The home team has just delivered a smash, and the ball flies between the opponent’s hands and hits the court floor.
134389.subtitle_en: The athletes from Barentsburg were a little sharper when they faced Svalbard Turn last Saturday.

134421.excerpt_en: So we are treating ourselves to another look at Christmas celebrations in 1952. The picture is from Ranveig and Erling Johan Nødtvedt’s apartment on the third floor of Huset.
134421.subtitle_en: Christmas is fast approaching, and this weekend it is time to light the Christmas trees.
134421.tags_en: historical picture, life in Svalbard, history
134421.title_en: Cosy Gatherings Around the Christmas Tree

134440.excerpt_en: The message everyone had been waiting for came on Monday this week: The board will scale back operations and get rid of at least 100 employees. Board chair Annette Malm Justad has just finished the meeting when Svalbardposten meets her.
134440.subtitle_en: By Christmas, at least 100 employees at Store Norske are to have been told they will not be continuing. Subcontractors are now also preparing for cuts.
134440.title_en: She Has to Make the Cuts

134470.excerpt_en: “Hi,” says Vitaly Shutko, hurrying straight into the changing room at Svalbardhallen this Saturday. Right behind him come the athletes from Barentsburg.
134470.subtitle_en: Vitaly Shutko, 32, and his wife Ksenia Matjunina, 28, have left Barentsburg and switched sides.
134470.title_en: Vitaly and Ksenia in New Colours

134497.excerpt_en: “In the end, we negotiated a rent agreement that everyone can live with. It was tense at times, but once we started negotiating, most things went smoothly,” says Steve Coulson, chief union representative for the Norwegian Association of Researchers at UNIS.
134497.subtitle_en: After a dispute over rent rates, UNIS and the trade unions have reached an agreement.
134497.title_en: Reached a Rent Agreement Everyone Can Live With

134553.excerpt_en: Fifteen candidates were nominated for Svalbardian of the Year. Of these, eight have been selected to compete for the honorary title.
134553.subtitle_en: Nine names are now competing for the title of Svalbardian of the Year 2014. You, the readers, decide who should be honoured.

134564.excerpt_en: It has long been known that businessman Benn Eidissen has been trying to buy Robert Hermansen’s cabin, a few kilometres northwest of Longyearbyen.
134564.subtitle_en: Through Isfjord Eiendom AS, Benn Eidissen has taken over the cabin belonging to former Store Norske director Robert Hermansen.

134581.excerpt_en: The annual Christmas Mile took place in Longyearbyen at the weekend. Around 20 hardy runners braved relatively cold weather and ran one of the two distances: the Christmas Sprint (3.3 km) or the full 9.9-kilometre distance.
134581.subtitle_en: Twenty people completed the race in central Longyearbyen.

134585.excerpt_en: “What I am left with is a clear impression that, first of all, we have a high level of trust as a knowledge-based society, and I encounter a great deal of understanding when I describe the effects,” says Christin Kristofersen (Labour) after a marathon of meetings in the capital. See page 16.
134585.subtitle_en: “There are no alternatives that are environmentally friendly.”
134585.tags_en: news, the crisis at Store Norske
134585.title_en: Plans to Invest in Industrial Coal

134600.excerpt_en: Chess fever has spread across the country, and we in Norway are extremely proud that Magnus Carlsen once again showed Vishy Anand the “winter road” and defended his world chess championship title in Sochi, Russia.
134600.subtitle_en: The chessboard and pieces presented here come from the trapping station at Kinghamna on Forlandet.

134627.excerpt_en: This is from the stay at Mine 4, and the picture was taken sometime in 1958 or 1959. It is break time, and the miners are gathered around the table.
134627.subtitle_en: Roald Westerbotn has sent us pictures from 1950s Longyearbyen, which we will be presenting in the time ahead.
134627.tags_en: historical photograph, life in Svalbard, history

134642.excerpt_en: The year is rapidly drawing to a close. 2014 ends with the decision on the biggest cost-cutting measure in Store Norske’s history, and for now we can only speculate about the scale of the downsizing at the cornerstone company.
134642.subtitle_en: You, the reader, are hereby challenged.

134648.excerpt_en: As tradition dictates, very many people turned up for the first Sunday of Advent in Longyearbyen. From one o’clock, events were held in and around Huset, and when the torchlight procession set off, there was a strong turnout for the walk down to town.
134648.subtitle_en: Last year, many people had less-than-kind things to say about Longyearbyen’s Christmas tree. This year, everyone is pleased.
134648.title_en: No Hard Feelings About the Christmas Tree

134673.excerpt_en: Last month, 52 millimetres of precipitation fell at the weather station in Longyearbyen. That is five and a half millimetres more than the previous record, set in 1993.
134673.subtitle_en: This November was the wettest since measurements began more than a century ago.

134682.excerpt_en: Weapons officer Arnstein Hatland of Ingeniør G. Paulsen concludes that the rifle with the jammed cartridge does not need to be deactivated.
134682.subtitle_en: That is the conclusion after a weapons expert examined the rifle with the jammed cartridge. The museum is now applying again for permission to display it without having the weapon deactivated.

134703.excerpt_en: The first trip of the year went to the Polish research station at Hornsund as early as 1 December.
134703.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard’s annual Christmas tours to the archipelago’s outposts are under way. Arild Lyssand of the Governor’s Office describes the trips as “good days at work”.
134703.title_en: Christmas Visits to the Outposts Under Way

134757.excerpt_en: On 16 December, Anundsen travels to Svalbard for the fourth time this year.
134757.subtitle_en: Minister of Justice and Public Security Anders Anundsen (Progress Party) wants to know what the government can do to help in the crisis.
134757.tags_en: news, the crisis at Store Norske

134775.excerpt_en: The meetings are taking place this week and next, and are part of the downsizing at the coal company. On Monday and Tuesday, Store Norske management held consultation meetings with union representatives to agree on the terms for the announced redundancies.
134775.subtitle_en: Around 40 employees will be called in for individual discussions at Store Norske.
134775.tags_en: news, Store Norske, the crisis at Store Norske, coal
134775.title_en: Employees Called in for Individual Meetings

134778.excerpt_en: The countdown to traditional coal mining on Svalbard has begun. Last week, the first workers were told that they were no longer part of Store Norske.
134778.subtitle_en: The countdown to traditional coal mining on Svalbard has begun.

134791.excerpt_en: The opening will take place on 6 February next year, at the Svalbard Museum premises. “Initially, contemporary art is what we particularly want to focus on.”
134791.subtitle_en: The Nordnorsk Kunstmuseum branch Kunsthall Svalbard will open with a royal visit and an exhibition by American artist Joan Jonas.
134791.title_en: Art Hall to Open in February

134794.excerpt_en: On 15 September next year, Governor Odd Olsen Ingerø’s term of office expires.
134794.subtitle_en: Odd Olsen Ingerø has welcomed new residents to Barentsburg nine times, but now it is over.

134822.excerpt_en: It is Friday morning, and former CEO Per Andersson has just come into the office after his final management meeting. “I’ve done some tidying up and made sure that what I’ve done has been safely handed over to those who will take over,” he says.
134822.subtitle_en: Just before at least 100 employees lost their jobs, Per Andersson boarded a plane south without a return ticket.
134822.tags_en: news, business, the crisis at Store Norske

134824.excerpt_en: There was considerable suspense at the weekend over whether the ice in Isfjorden would remain after the storm that raged through. Now we can conclude that it will.
134824.subtitle_en: The storm failed to break up the ice in the side fjords of Isfjorden last week. Everything is now in place for the hiking season.

134852.excerpt_en: “It went really well!” Frida Krystad, 14, is all smiles.
134852.subtitle_en: Seventy-six children took part in the Christmas Swim at the weekend. Some had enough to do just keeping themselves and their candle above water. Others sped to new records.
134852.title_en: From Candlelight Ceremony to New Records

134867.excerpt_en: As a small operator in the tourism industry, I face a wall of unnecessary bureaucracy from the current Governor’s administration. I am now thoroughly fed up, and following the article in the previous Svalbardposten about the proposed revised tourism regulations, I would like to express my views here.
134867.subtitle_en: “Is excessive bureaucracy the way forward for facilitating organized tourism?” asks Heinrich Eggenfellner in this contribution.

134887.excerpt_en: Ever since the company reported its acute problems, there has been activity at the highest local political level. Community council leader Christin Kristoffersen has held more than 30 meetings with key stakeholders and briefed the council on Tuesday about the progress made.
134887.subtitle_en: The community council has hired a communications adviser to explain what is really at stake in the Store Norske crisis.
134887.title_en: The Crisis Is About More Than Coal

134893.excerpt_en: The notices were sent out on Wednesday and Thursday. Next week, Store Norske management will hold so-called Section 15-1 meetings with those affected.
134893.subtitle_en: Around 40 permanent employees at Store Norske must attend consultations next week for the coal company to reach its target of reducing its workforce by 100.

134904.excerpt_en: Energy coal is as politically incorrect as an industrial product can be. But that dirty energy coal has a cousin with a much better reputation: industrial coal. “There is a great need for industrial coal, and today there is no alternative to using coal for this purpose.”
134904.subtitle_en: A focus on industrial coal would make it possible for the state to agree to support Store Norske.

134928.excerpt_en: Mo Industrial Park (MIP) in Rana has been brought up in various contexts in discussions about Store Norske in recent weeks. The reason is that MIP is a major consumer of industrial coal.
134928.subtitle_en: Arve Ulriksen, managing director of Mo Industrial Park, has long argued that Svalbard should focus on industrial coal.

134935.excerpt_en: Sixteen-year-olds Amalie Henriksen and Lusie Kuraas from the Longyearbyen Youth Council charmed local politicians with their presentation on voting rights for 16- and 17-year-olds. The two attended a course on the topic in Oppegård outside Oslo.
134935.subtitle_en: Who can come up with the best slogan to get 16- and 17-year-olds to vote in this autumn’s election?

134952.excerpt_en: The mobile base station is located beside the route used by snowmobilers travelling between Svea and Longyearbyen. Many employees in Svea usually travel by snowmobile instead of flying to and from their shifts.
134952.subtitle_en: High costs are the reason the mobile base station at Slaknosa will probably be discontinued.
134952.title_en: Base Station to Be Taken Out of Service

134975.excerpt_en: Anne Lise K. Sandvik is engaged in the community and active in public debate. She has worked hard for cultural life and, not least, gone all out for the fundraising campaign on television.
134975.subtitle_en: Anne Lise K. Sandvik has worked hard for Svalbard, but she is not alone. Who do you think deserves recognition?

134999.excerpt_en: With his head tilted and his mobile phone partly hidden among the white locks, he opens the door, nods almost distractedly, waves me in and disappears back into the phone conversation. “Private” reads the sign on the door to the right inside the entrance hall.
134999.subtitle_en: Artist Olaf Storø, 62, prefers tea with milk and honey—and he has good reason for it.

135003.excerpt_en: 2014 ended dramatically, with Store Norske, the cornerstone company, facing the largest staff reduction in its history; a total of 100 employees across all departments are affected. The effect on the local community is intensified as activity is reduced and the company effectively operates at half-speed for the next 18 months.
135003.subtitle_en: The psychological factor can easily cause the consequences to become greater than they actually need to be.

135008.excerpt_en: Minister of Justice and Public Security Anders Anundsen (Progress Party) went straight to the community council to discuss the cuts at Store Norske after landing in Longyearbyen on Tuesday afternoon. He was accompanied by Kjerstin Askholt, director general of the Polar Department, while members of the Administration Committee (equivalent to the executive committee) were waiting in the meeting room to review the situation with him.
135008.subtitle_en: The government is prepared for a decline in Svalbard’s population.
135008.title_en: “We Must Not Pretend This Is Not a Challenge”

135024.excerpt_en: Today is the deadline for nominating candidates for Svalbardian of the Year. Some of those nominated when Svalbardposten went to press on Wednesday included: Arild Olsen, head of the Store Norske mineworkers’ club, has had a busy autumn following the decision that the coal company must scale back operations and lay off employees.
135024.subtitle_en: Anne Lise K. Sandvik, the volunteers at Svalbard Turn and the community council leader have all worked hard for Svalbard over the past year. Who will be Svalbardian of the Year?

135032.excerpt_en: Hekne is busy with the Christmas cleaning in the garage at the fire station, where he works. He moved to Longyearbyen with his family at the age of eight, and at 16 got his first job as a plumber with Store Norske.
135032.subtitle_en: “I feel that this time we are in the most challenging period ever,” says Geir Hekne. Monday marked 43 years since he came to Svalbard.

135073.excerpt_en: As we enter the festive season, it is fitting to look back at the celebrations in 1958. We have kept to this year in recent weeks, and this picture too was sent to us by Roald Westerbotn.
135073.subtitle_en: What would Christmas be without a Christmas tree?
135073.tags_en: historical photo, life in Svalbard, history

135082.excerpt_en: For several years, there has been talk of grading and preparing the area east of Svalbard Snowmobile Rental (SSU) for commercial development. As early as 2011, politicians in the then Environment and Business Committee decided to put the plan for Sjøskrenten East out for consultation.
135082.subtitle_en: Store Norske wants to prepare the area east of Svalbard Snowmobile Rental for commercial buildings.

135116.excerpt_en: “Some of the responses to the residents’ survey have made us aware of things we otherwise would not have known about,” says Lars Ole Saugnes, chief administrative officer of the Longyearbyen Community Council (LL).
135116.subtitle_en: The Longyearbyen residents’ survey has been completed. The first direct consequence was switching off the lights in the climbing tower at Longyearbyen Kindergarten.

135122.excerpt_en: There is hectic activity at the Polish research station in Hornsund, Svalbard. The ten-member crew is preparing for one of the year’s absolute highlights: the Christmas visit from the Governor of Svalbard.
135122.subtitle_en: The Christmas-visit tradition is popular both with the Governor and with those receiving the visits.

135160.excerpt_en: “We celebrate Christmas because it’s winter—or so people will know that it’s winter. Because otherwise it wouldn’t really be winter.”
135160.subtitle_en: This year’s kindergarten panel stands out for disagreeing among themselves on important Christmas issues.

135171.excerpt_en: The opening will take place on 6 February at Svalbard Museum. “To begin with, we are particularly looking to focus on contemporary art.”
135171.subtitle_en: The Northern Norway Art Museum’s branch, Kunsthall Svalbard, opens with a royal visit and an exhibition by American artist Joan Jonas.

135173.excerpt_en: Some have made their own envelopes decorated with folded paper stars, stickers and glitter. Others have been more practical, photocopying wish lists and filling them out themselves.
135173.subtitle_en: It is a busy time for the Santa at Mine 2. His mailbox is filling with wish lists ranging from constrictor snakes to more peace and quiet.

135298.excerpt_en: Zahl Transport’s agreement with Store Norske and LNS Spitsbergen (LNSS) has expired. They are now considering ending sailings to Svalbard. “We have not scheduled any more sailings, and the agreement with the shipping company concerning ‘Green Frost’ has also expired.”
135298.subtitle_en: “Green Frost” is not coming back. Zahl Transport may have sailed away from Svalbard for the last time. That would give Bring a freight monopoly.

135314.excerpt_en: On 1 January, the notice period began for most of the 95 people losing their jobs at Store Norske. Over the next few months, the number of employees is to fall by approximately 250.
135314.subtitle_en: We are back to everyday life, and with it reality is beginning to sink in. It is also important to demonstrate action through concrete measures—and here, the measures should be forthcoming.

135328.excerpt_en: The Svalbard Seminar is a lecture series held over five evenings, with two talks each day. “We try to put together a programme with something of interest for everyone,” says Eva Therese Jenssen of UNIS.
135328.subtitle_en: This month marks the start of the 20th Svalbard Seminar. It will commemorate the 70th anniversary of the end of the war, and offer closer encounters with polar bears and glaciers.

135343.excerpt_en: Trust Arktikugol is working tirelessly to develop tourism in Barentsburg. Nevertheless, it will be a long time before tourists become highly significant to the Russian settlement’s revenues.
135343.subtitle_en: Aleksander P. Veselov dreams of taking tourists into the mines, but it is unclear when that might happen.
135343.title_en: Wants to Turn the Mines into an Attraction

135365.excerpt_en: Karin Fredheim sent us this picture, taken in 1939. “My father, Simon Drivmo, helped build the aerial tramway from Mine 1 to Longyearbyen in 1938–39, as well as the barracks in Sverdrupbyen.”
135365.subtitle_en: The aerial tramway was built between 1938 and 1939.

135394.excerpt_en: Decorated from top to bottom, with the finest ornaments on the walls and in every nook and cranny, as well as the best food, it was a wonderful Christmas celebration at Bjørnøya this year. “For the first time in several years, we had a real Christmas tree in the living room,” station manager Harald Emil Heide proudly says in…
135394.subtitle_en: The crew at Bjørnøya meteorological station had nothing to complain about this Christmas. Nor did the rest of Svalbard.
135394.title_en: A Real Christmas Tree and Cloudberries from Hølånda—in Bjørnøya

135409.excerpt_en: “The Governor of Svalbard has, generally speaking, great confidence in the tour operators on Svalbard.”
135409.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard cites safety and processing time as the reasons for future requirements giving tour operators two months’ notice of tour plans.

135425.excerpt_en: In the summer, a female bear got an ear tag caught in a fishing net that almost weighed as much as she did. A Svalbardposten journalist, who was accompanying the Governor of Svalbard’s clean-up cruise, filmed and photographed the incident, which sparked major debate about fishing waste and researchers’ tagging of polar bears.
135425.subtitle_en: The story about the polar bear that became caught in a fishing net was the most-read article on svalbardposten.no last year. Polar bears also played an important role in the next two spots.

135442.excerpt_en: “I look forward to taking on the exciting and demanding challenges that come with this position,” says Wenche Ravlo. The 49-year-old has a master’s degree in chemical engineering and further education in management, and has spent the past 15 years in various positions at Norske Skogindustrier ASA, including as plant director at…
135442.subtitle_en: Wenche Ravlo takes up her post in mid-February.
135442.title_en: From Norske Skog to Store Norske

135459.excerpt_en: On 20 February, Ravlo moves into the corner office inside Store Norske’s administration building in Longyearbyen.
135459.subtitle_en: “The challenge is to find a sustainable way to run the company while safeguarding its role as a cornerstone enterprise,” says Wenche Ravlo.

135468.excerpt_en: The pictures are from Monday afternoon’s rescue operation, when a Polish researcher in his 40s fell into a crevasse on Hansbreen, near the research station at Hornsund. The day in Hornsund began routinely, with two researchers heading out onto Hansbreen to take measurements.
135468.subtitle_en: The crevasse is so narrow that the rescuer has to squeeze his way down. A Polish researcher is waiting 25 metres below.
135468.title_en: This Is Where the Researcher Was Rescued

135502.excerpt_en: Last year, just over 14,200 researcher-days were carried out in Ny-Ålesund, an increase of about 1,600 days from the previous year. Norwegian researchers accounted for around 500 of these, and Kings Bay AS CEO Ole Øiseth hopes the trend will continue.
135502.subtitle_en: Greater investment in research during the polar night is also producing a new activity record in the research settlement.

135513.excerpt_en: “By the end of next week, we will be ready to present our recommendations,” confirms board chair Annette Malm Justad. At the board meeting in Oslo on 12.
135513.subtitle_en: The Store Norske board meets on Monday for the last time before the decisive meeting with the ministry and the bank.

135538.excerpt_en: “I expect a boss who gets things done. We have talked a lot, but we haven’t achieved enough,” says union shop steward Arild Olsen.
135538.subtitle_en: When Wenche Ravlo moves into the corner office on the second floor of Store Norske’s administration building, she breaks with a long tradition at the state-owned coal company.

135543.excerpt_en: “It is spectacular to experience. It is something everyone should experience at least once in their lifetime,” says Pål Brekke, senior adviser at the Norwegian Space Agency and adjunct professor at UNIS.
135543.subtitle_en: For two minutes and 27 seconds, Svalbard will be plunged into complete darkness. Preparations for the event have been under way for a long time.

135564.excerpt_en: “Everything is ready, so when the ice starts building up, we’ll set off,” says Steinar Rorgemoen, general manager of Basecamp Spitsbergen.
135564.subtitle_en: Noorderlicht is equipped and loaded for another season in the ice of Tempelfjorden. If the ice does not form, it will take tourists into the fjords.

135575.excerpt_en: Little ice on Tempelfjorden and Billefjorden last year made it impossible for tour operators to take tourists there. The tourist route to the former Russian settlement runs via the fjords, but it is also possible to drive there via the glacier systems.
135575.subtitle_en: This season, tour operators may take tourists outside Management Area 10 to visit Pyramiden.
135575.title_en: Allowed to Take Tourists Across the Glaciers

135591.excerpt_en: Studio Kairos, which is producing the films, recently had its application for funding from Svalbard’s Environmental Protection Fund rejected. The money was intended for distributing the material.
135591.subtitle_en: The ruthless Sval and Bard characters received no support from Svalbard’s Environmental Protection Fund. But the films are coming anyway.

135641.excerpt_en: A rapid winding-up, and the absence of a vital, thriving industrial company such as Store Norske, will harm research on Svalbard. Among other things, it will create a major challenge in recruiting new resident researchers.
135641.subtitle_en: A rapid winding-up of Store Norske will also affect research on Svalbard, writes Professor Snorre Olaussen of UNIS.

135644.excerpt_en: On 1 July, eligible voters in Svalbard can go to the polls to vote early in this autumn’s municipal and county elections.
135644.subtitle_en: Svalbard Conservative Party’s new leader Kjetil Figenschou (28) plans to focus on business policy to take power from the Labour Party this autumn.
135644.title_en: Wants to Give Labour a Proper Conservative Challenge

135692.excerpt_en: “The timing is very good for getting the port projects fully assessed so they can move forward,” says Kjerstin Askholt, director general in the Polar Affairs Department of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security. The ministry is doing what it can to speed up the work.
135692.subtitle_en: The crisis at Store Norske is adding urgency to efforts to expand port capacity in Longyearbyen.
135692.title_en: The Port Is Set to Become Longyearbyen’s New Lifeline

135713.excerpt_en: “A significant reduction in the Norwegian settlement in Svalbard as a result of the loss of jobs in the mining industry will undoubtedly affect the level of Norwegian presence and thus the basis for Norwegian sovereignty in the archipelago,” UNIS states in a letter to the Ministry of Education and Research. Well considered In the letter dated 18…
135713.subtitle_en: The University Centre in Svalbard wants to take on a larger role in Longyearbyen as Store Norske downsizes, and is ready to double its number of employees and students within a few years.

135735.excerpt_en: It is Saturday afternoon, and the final preparations are under way. Expedition and project leader Harald Steen notes that they will be five or six hours delayed before RV Lance can cast off and head for the polar ice.
135735.subtitle_en: “The trip of the century for the boys!” exclaims Alf Arne Pettersen. He is a first-timer on the most prestigious expedition the Norwegian Polar Institute has undertaken in recent times.

135754.excerpt_en: As usual, the new year got off to a breathless start for Polar Puls.
135754.subtitle_en: The most enthusiastic participants attended 16 hours of training—in three days.

135767.excerpt_en: The voting ended at midnight on Friday, with a total of 5,035 votes submitted by the deadline. Many also sent their votes by email.
135767.subtitle_en: The response during the “Svalbardian of the Year” poll has exceeded all expectations.
135767.title_en: Flood of Votes for Name of the Year

135775.excerpt_en: Last autumn, Christin Kristoffersen was asked by the nomination committee to be the top candidate again in this autumn’s municipal election.
135775.subtitle_en: Local council leader Christin Kristoffersen (Labour) has turned down the nomination committee of Svalbard Labour’s request.

135790.excerpt_en: 2014 was a record year for Ny-Ålesund, with no fewer than 14,200 research days. This also suggests that the target set by Kings Bay, which manages the buildings and infrastructure, is well within reach.
135790.subtitle_en: These are crucial questions in our time.
135790.title_en: Good Development Can Get Even Better

135804.excerpt_en: Several private apartments and cabins are now available to solar-eclipse tourists on the rental site airbnb.no. Several cost around NOK 20,000 per day.
135804.subtitle_en: Paal A. Lund is earning NOK 100,000 by renting out this apartment during the solar eclipse. Several private individuals are renting out houses and cabins for NOK 20,000 a day.
135804.title_en: Cashing In on the Solar Eclipse

135813.excerpt_en: Virtually all accommodation is full, and several private individuals have also rented out houses and cabins. How many will actually come to witness the celestial phenomenon is unknown. “We have received an overview of flights departing from and arriving at Avinor airports, but it is difficult to estimate anything.”
135813.subtitle_en: There is still no overview of how many people will come for the solar eclipse.

135836.excerpt_en: Among the visitors are two mothers with cubs. One of them settled down on the helicopter landing pad right beside the station.
135836.subtitle_en: The meteorological station has had visits from as many as six bears a day.
135836.tags_en: nature and environment, news, polar bears

135840.excerpt_en: Anne Karin Hufthammer, chair of the National Committee for the Assessment of Research on Human Remains (the Skeleton Committee), is concerned. The reason is that climate change is beginning to destroy the many hundreds of graves from the whaling era.
135840.subtitle_en: Graves in Svalbard have always been pushed up and eroded. But the process is now accelerating.
135840.title_en: Raises the Alarm over the Skeletons

135866.excerpt_en: At Nordhamna on Bjørnøya, the sea has eroded part of the shoreline where a grave lies. A human thighbone is protruding into the open air. “We assume that several bodies have already been washed out to sea as a result of the erosion,” says Snorre Haukalid, a cultural heritage adviser in the Governor’s environmental protection department.
135866.subtitle_en: The Governor has received permission from the Directorate for Cultural Heritage to excavate human remains on Bjørnøya.
135866.title_en: Excavation on Bjørnøya to Begin This Year

135880.excerpt_en: It is 8:30 p.m. on Tuesday. In Endalen, just a few hundred metres from the day facilities of the closed Gruve 5 mine, headlamps sweep back and forth through the darkness.
135880.subtitle_en: In temperatures of minus 10 degrees and occasionally strong winds, more than 70 children and adults crawled into their tents in Endalen.
135880.title_en: Slept Outside Under the Northern Lights

135908.excerpt_en: At the beginning of a new year, many people make New Year’s resolutions—out with bad habits, in with something new and good. I have never really bothered with such things myself, although they probably would have been appropriate.
135908.subtitle_en: If it is in the national interest that there is a community here in the north—one that functions well—why can’t the state, during a transitional period, support the company and enterprise that have been and remain our backbone for 99 years?
135908.title_en: With a Clean Slate—and Crayons to Go

135914.excerpt_en: Four dogs race around the kennel at full speed. They nudge one another a little and come over to Elise Strømseng, head of the Longyearbyen Dog Club, for some affection.
135914.subtitle_en: Dog owners make frequent use of the vet—for vaccinations, emergency care and advice.

135925.excerpt_en: Store Norske recorded a negative result of NOK 537 million in 2014. It was the company’s worst result ever and is forcing it to continue examining its cost situation.
135925.subtitle_en: Store Norske is asking the state for a loan of nearly half a billion kroner to get through the crisis.
135925.title_en: Store Norske Asks for NOK 450 Million

135966.excerpt_en: “We will assess both the board’s proposal and look at alternatives before approaching the government and parliament, and we will take the time necessary,” Business Minister Monica Mæland (Conservative) told Svalbardposten. Soon empty On Friday, she was handed the proposal from Store Norske’s board concerning the company’s refinancing.
135966.subtitle_en: Monica Mæland does not want to rush her assessment of the loan proposal from Store Norske’s board. But the coal company’s coffers will soon be empty.

136002.excerpt_en: The hall was packed when the Svalbard Seminar began on Tuesday evening. A total of 141 spectators had registered when Governor Odd Olsen Ingerø (bottom photo) welcomed everyone to this year’s seminar, the twentieth to be held.
136002.subtitle_en: The Svalbard Seminar is under way.

136024.excerpt_en: It suddenly went dark in Longyearbyen on Thursday afternoon. Parts of the town got their power back after 15 minutes, while the northern section was without electricity the longest.
136024.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen was completely or partly without electricity for just under half an hour on Thursday.

136037.excerpt_en: For almost a year, it has been clear that former Store Norske director Robert Hermansen and Bodø-based businessman Benn Eidissen had an agreement for the latter to buy Hermansen’s cabin at Vestpynten. But special rules governing cabin ownership on the island have made the deal challenging.
136037.subtitle_en: The Eidissen family and Isfjord Eiendom AS do not have a strong enough connection to Svalbard.
136037.title_en: Denied Purchase of Hermansen’s Cabin Palace

136042.excerpt_en: Christin Kristoffersen has informed the Labour Party’s nominations committee that she will not seek re-election. The decision was made public on the 14th.
136042.subtitle_en: This could become a problem for Labour in the coming election campaign.

136065.excerpt_en: “The bear has wandered inland towards Gruve 7. If it continues into Adventdalen, as it appears to be doing, we will end the search.”
136065.subtitle_en: On the night before Friday, the Governor of Svalbard searched for a polar bear near Longyearbyen. They found fresh tracks heading farther into Adventdalen.

136079.excerpt_en: The air is bitterly cold. A group of UNIS students is standing by the outlet of Isdammen.
136079.subtitle_en: You have ten minutes. Then you’re done.

136112.excerpt_en: Many will surely envy the people of Longyearbyen their climbing wall on the north wall of Svalbardhallen. With challenges in most varieties, from parquet flooring to ceiling panels, there are ample opportunities for everyone, young and old, to test themselves.
136112.subtitle_en: The climbing wall at Svalbardhallen has been in use for a long time, but on Sunday it was officially opened.

136121.excerpt_en: Last year, Tove Sandblost applied to drive a snowmobile in areas reserved for permanent residents. Sandblost had lived in Svalbard for 12 of the previous 14 years and had moved away from the archipelago three months before the planned trip with resident friends.
136121.subtitle_en: Former residents are denied snowmobile trips outside tourist areas.

136125.excerpt_en: Last weekend, it was WIFAL and the ladies’ turn to gather over lutefisk. It took place at Polarhotellet and, as tradition dictates, everyone wore hats.

136133.excerpt_en: Last week, the local council leader announced that she would not stand as the Labour Party’s lead local candidate in this autumn’s municipal and county elections. Regarding her time here and her decision, Kristoffersen says: “Moving to Svalbard meant coming to a place that impressed me greatly.”
136133.subtitle_en: Christin Kristoffersen (40) has spent four sometimes difficult years promoting Longyearbyen’s interests. This autumn, it comes to an end.

136143.excerpt_en: “I have gone through several rounds of discussions with the membership, but concluded that we are not numerous enough to field a list in the election,” says Kristin Furu Grøtting, group leader for the cross-party Common List (TF) on the local council.
136143.subtitle_en: The cross-party Common List held an outright majority during the first years of local democracy in Svalbard. The party will not field a list in this autumn’s election.
136143.title_en: Common List Calls It a Day

136169.excerpt_en: The project has been planned since the start of the school year last year. There were a few tentative rehearsals in September and December, but it is this week that things have really taken off. “It seems as though everyone has dropped everything to get this over the finish line.”
136169.subtitle_en: The musical “Dancing Queen,” performed by Longyearbyen’s eighth-, ninth- and tenth-graders, is ready to go.

136171.excerpt_en: Hovland received a total of 1,795 votes, compared with Olsen’s 1,606. Engagement has exceeded all expectations, with 5,035 votes cast online.
136171.subtitle_en: The race between Arild Olsen and Kåre Hovland was close for a long time, but the latter was ultimately named Svalbardian of the Year.

136180.excerpt_en: “I am probably a competent bridge player,” says Jon Aars, looking slightly up and to the right. Something in his expression reveals that he is probably understating it.
136180.subtitle_en: Polar bear researcher Jon Aars (48) could just as easily have become an expert on mice, seals or reindeer.
136180.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page

136193.excerpt_en: Some are small, fragile and need clothes to face the sparkling cold. Others are all fur and muscle and can run mile after mile with their owners riding behind on the sled.
136193.subtitle_en: Getting a dog in Svalbard is becoming increasingly popular. At the end of last year, there were 717 dogs here.

136291.excerpt_en: Just over six years after the last white paper on Norwegian Svalbard policy, the government announces a new course correction. The background is the situation at Store Norske, which has cut around 150 positions since 2013.
136291.subtitle_en: It is crucial that the government sees everything in context, says Svalbard Minister Anders Anundsen, who also wants to examine alternatives to coal-fired power.

136348.excerpt_en: Shipping companies sailing in Svalbard may therefore not need to re-register their vessels after all. Last summer, the Norwegian Maritime Authority gave shipping companies operating in Svalbard a deadline of 1.
136348.subtitle_en: The ministry was unaware that so many NIS-registered ships operate in Svalbard.

136363.excerpt_en: On Tuesday evening, Svalbardposten wrote that Justice Minister Anders Anundsen (Progress Party) had announced a new white paper on Svalbard during a debate in the Storting. Anundsen also stressed that it is crucial to view everything now happening in Svalbard in context, and that this will be an important issue for the government going forward.
136363.subtitle_en: The news of a new Svalbard white paper has been well received in Longyearbyen. But the question of the coal-fired power plant must be clarified quickly.

136385.excerpt_en: This autumn, the Norwegian Directorate for Civil Protection (DSB) inspected the power company’s electrical installations in Longyearbyen. They found eleven deviations, meaning breaches of regulations.
136385.subtitle_en: The power company is being reprimanded for leaving power cables unsecured on the ground. Now the Norwegian Directorate for Civil Protection demands that it put things right.

136394.excerpt_en: Last year, Polarjazz was all jazz. This year, it is a music festival.
136394.subtitle_en: Ticket sales for Polarjazz are looking promising. Saturday evening passes sold out two weeks before the concert. On Wednesday, the jazz gets underway.

136401.excerpt_en: It is pitch-dark, snow is swirling in the air and the wind is really howling when the sun comes to visit Svalbardposten this Monday. Nora H.
136401.subtitle_en: Nora H. Nævdal brought the sun to Svalbardposten on Monday. She had kept it secret for a long time.
136401.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page
136401.title_en: A Sneak Peek at the Sun

136415.excerpt_en: On the largest wall in the premises that will become Kunsthall Svalbard hangs a screen made of plywood panels. Projectors have been mounted on the ceiling, and the video art by opening artist Joan Jonas is in place.
136415.subtitle_en: Video art is already dancing across the wall. In a week, Queen Sonja will open the art hall.

136425.excerpt_en: There is an hour to go before the audience is let into the auditorium. Some have put on all or part of their costumes, or are halfway through their makeup.
136425.subtitle_en: Being an actor in a musical is an emotional roller coaster.
136425.title_en: From Tentative Fumbling to Assured Stagecraft

136465.excerpt_en: Leif Langnes sent us this picture, showing the last horse on the payroll of Store Norske Spitsbergen Kulkompani AS. “Sanitation worker Holand and the horse delivered materials for the coal quay at Hotellneset in April/May 1965,” he writes.
136465.tags_en: historical picture, life in Svalbard, history
136465.title_en: The Last Horse on the Payroll

136520.excerpt_en: It is minus 20 degrees and blue hour. The moon hangs above Hiorthfjellet as Heinrich Eggenfellner starts his quadcopter and takes us down the valley and over Longyearbyen.
136520.subtitle_en: You have probably never seen Longyearbyen like this before.

136521.excerpt_en: It was during the night of Saturday, 27 December, that the young female resident drove into a ditch in central Longyearbyen.
136521.subtitle_en: The woman who ended up in a ditch while over the limit during the Christmas holidays must serve 14 days in prison.

136540.excerpt_en: Ticket sales have gone well, and hopefully all the artists will make it up by plane from the mainland. The technical equipment was already in place on Wednesday morning. “We’re more or less finished setting up.”
136540.subtitle_en: By Wednesday morning, the stage was in place and music was streaming from the speakers at the Polar Hotel. Everything was ready for the jazz pre-party starting today.

136542.excerpt_en: Space was tight and the atmosphere was great at the pre-party in the Polar Hotel restaurant on Wednesday evening. The pre-party marks the start of this year’s jazz festival and the world’s northernmost jazz festival, with local musicians taking to the stage one after another to serve musical tasters to those in attendance.
136542.subtitle_en: The jazz festival is under way in Longyearbyen.

136598.excerpt_en: The moon casts a blue light over Revneset and Adventtoppen on the northern side of Adventfjord.
136598.subtitle_en: Avinor and Visit Svalbard want to give passengers a view, but the buses, taxis and private cars outside the terminal must then be moved.
136598.title_en: They Want a “WOW Effect” in the Arrivals Hall

136649.excerpt_en: There has been considerable suspense surrounding Basecamp Spitsbergen and the ship “Noorderlicht”, which is frozen into Tempelfjord and used as a tourist destination. In recent years, it has been difficult to find enough ice to freeze into.
136649.subtitle_en: On Tuesday, a group from Basecamp drove across frozen Tempelfjord from Fredheim to “Noorderlicht”.

136674.excerpt_en: On 25 April, the Svalbard Ski Marathon will take place once again.
136674.subtitle_en: Therese Johaug is just one of many. Participants in this year’s Svalbard Ski Marathon have a total of seven Olympic gold medals and 13 World Championship gold medals.

136689.excerpt_en: On Saturday, a small new world was brought into the café at the cultural centre. Little Blue and his friends live inside a black box. “What would you like to become when you grow up?” asks Kjell Matheussen of Dårekisten Teater.
136689.subtitle_en: The children of Longyearbyen thought the puppet theatre was so exciting that they could imagine becoming puppeteers themselves.
136689.title_en: Little Blue Captivates Young and Old

136708.excerpt_en: “There is more space at the cultural centre, and it will provide a better concert experience for those who have bought tickets.”
136708.subtitle_en: The concerts with Bo Kaspers Orkester, Morten Abel and Árstíðir are moving from the Polar Hotel to the cultural centre.

136778.excerpt_en: The Polar Hotel was not full on Friday, but Bugge Wesseltoft & The Organ Club went down a storm with the audience. Wesseltoft is a wizard on the keys.
136778.subtitle_en: The audience could not stand still when Bugge Wesseltoft struck up on Friday.

136796.excerpt_en: The man had set out from Nybyen with only a sleeping bag and compass as equipment. “He had gone hiking from Nybyen, but did not know where he had been.”
136796.subtitle_en: A Ukrainian man was taken to hospital with a frostbitten hand after spending the night outdoors in a sleeping bag.

136800.excerpt_en: The picture was taken as the aircraft flew over the polar ice. The continental shelf beneath the Arctic Ocean remains an unresolved issue, but climate change, accessibility and resources have increased the area’s strategic importance.
136800.subtitle_en: The seabed beneath this ice could create new tensions in 2015. But the Intelligence Service does not expect conflict.
136800.title_en: Expects New Tensions in the Arctic

136807.excerpt_en: In January, Store Norske requested an emergency loan of NOK 450 million because of the failing coal market and a record deficit. Svalbard Minister Anders Anundsen (Progress Party) later announced a new white paper on Svalbard.
136807.subtitle_en: On Tuesday, Longyearbyen’s politicians on the administration committee met the full Standing Committee on Business and Industry at the Storting.
136807.title_en: Met with the Standing Committee on Business and Industry

136832.excerpt_en: This week, the resident survey in Longyearbyen was presented. The survey shows that residents are largely satisfied with public services (see article on pages 4–5), and that we rank above the national average here.
136832.subtitle_en: That makes politics less interesting to the general public.

136850.excerpt_en: “Bugge Wesseltoft. We’ve really only seen him so far, but it was incredibly good, with an amazing atmosphere,” says Anja Niemi when challenged to name the highlight of this year’s festival.
136850.subtitle_en: Many travelled from the mainland to experience the festival in Longyearbyen. Polarjazz 2015 will probably be one of the best in its history.

136851.excerpt_en: There were no fewer than two openings of Kunsthall Svalbard, a branch of the Nordnorsk Kunstmuseum: the first on Friday with the Queen and invited guests, and the second on Saturday for the general public.
136851.subtitle_en: Queen Sonja lent splendour to the opening of Kunsthall Svalbard. Ánde Somby responded with a bear joik on Sámi National Day.
136851.tags_en: culture, life in Svalbard, Kunsthall Svalbard
136851.title_en: Ánde Delights Crowd with Bear Joik

136871.excerpt_en: That was clear during the naming of Svalbardian of the Year. Now the prize is ready: a work of art by Tove Sundt-Hansen, with a personal greeting to the winner.

136872.excerpt_en: The Polar Hotel is packed. Vidar Johnsen and musicians are on stage, the audience is enjoying a great concert, and behind the scenes the Polarjazz board is working flat out.
136872.subtitle_en: Polarjazz 2015 sold concert tickets worth NOK 650,000.
136872.title_en: No Minor Key in the Jazz Accounts

136904.excerpt_en: Sigvart Bjøntegaard from Kongsberg positively radiates energy and good humour. During a break in a busy day at Longyearbyen Kindergarten, the 57-year-old takes time to talk to Svalbardposten.
136904.subtitle_en: He would have liked to mix squash at the Svalbard Ski Marathon. But then Sigvart Bjøntegaard (57) became race director.
136904.tags_en: people, life on Svalbard, back page

136924.excerpt_en: Until now, Thon Hotels has refused to confirm that it is building a hotel in Longyearbyen. However, minutes from a pre-application meeting between Sweco and Longyearbyen Local Council in January this year state this explicitly.
136924.subtitle_en: Confirms that Thon will be the builder.

136941.excerpt_en: Wearing a survival suit and carrying a suitably stylish handbag, Queen Sonja arrived at Hopen’s meteorological station a week ago. The Queen was warmly welcomed by the island’s four station members. “We greatly appreciated that the Queen wanted to visit us at Hopen.”
136941.subtitle_en: Queen Sonja visited Hopen last Friday. According to station manager Ragnar Sønstebø, it was the first time the island had received royal guests.

136968.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) has completed its inspection round in Sjøområdet. Astrid Meek, LL’s senior development adviser, does not believe anyone is currently living illegally in Sjøområdet. “That does not mean the matter is finally closed.”
136968.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council has inspected the boathouses in Sjøområdet and concluded that no one is currently living there illegally.

136978.excerpt_en: Children run, climb and swing inside the climbing tower outside Longyearbyen Kindergarten. Small, well-wrapped bodies come whizzing out of the slide connected to the top of the tower. “Is it ready now?”
136978.subtitle_en: The children at Longyearbyen Kindergarten showed off their climbing tower when the culture minister arrived with funding last Friday.

137026.excerpt_en: The weekend forecast points to blowing snow and storm-force winds around Isfjorden and Nordenskiöld Land on Sunday. In some places, winds may reach hurricane force.
137026.subtitle_en: Sunday could bring truly severe weather. The Governor of Svalbard urges people heading outdoors to exercise caution.

137028.excerpt_en: On 11 January, RV “Lance” left Longyearbyen bound for the ice.
137028.subtitle_en: UPDATED: The Norwegian Polar Institute and the research vessel “Lance” had been prepared to break free and try again, but now the wind is coming to their rescue.
137028.title_en: Researchers Forced Out of the Ice

137057.excerpt_en: This was the visibility in central Longyearbyen early Sunday afternoon after the forecast storm hit Spitsbergen. Strong southeasterly winds are forecast over Nordenskiöld Land, but by Sunday evening the weather is expected to ease to a strong gale.
137057.subtitle_en: The storm hit Longyearbyen on Sunday morning.

137072.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the incident at 4:15 a.m. Wednesday. A helicopter was sent to the site, and the injured man was transported to the hospital in Longyearbyen.
137072.subtitle_en: A man is seriously injured after a mining accident in Barentsburg.
137072.title_en: Miner Suffers Back and Head Injuries

137079.excerpt_en: Three secondary-school pupils and two teachers from Beijing and Shanghai dropped by and decorated the classroom for Chinese New Year. The visit was organised by Bjørknes University College, which runs an exchange programme between China and Norway.
137079.subtitle_en: The tenth-graders at Longyearbyen School received visitors from the other side of the world last week.

137095.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the incident at 11:15 a.m. Thursday. The girl was part of a guided snowmobile convoy heading to Barentsburg when the snowmobile she was riding overturned at the bottom of Fardalen.
137095.subtitle_en: A minor girl suffered minor injuries in a snowmobile accident in Fardalen on Thursday morning.

137098.excerpt_en: A convoy consisting of seven snowmobiles in total ran into trouble at the head of Grønfjorden on Wednesday evening. The convoy entered an area with extensive surface water and became stuck.
137098.subtitle_en: A convoy of snowmobiles became stuck in surface water at the head of Grønfjorden on Wednesday evening.

137113.excerpt_en: “We have not signed any contract with Thon as of today. We have received a proposal that we are considering, and we will respond to it.”
137113.subtitle_en: Thon is building a hotel in Longyearbyen, but Kroa may not be joining the plans.
137113.tags_en: Thon, news, Kroa, tourism, hotel, business

137134.excerpt_en: “Had our course over the past few weeks continued, we would have been out of the ice in a couple of days.”
137134.subtitle_en: “Lance” was close to being forced out of the pack ice, but the storm drove it north again last Sunday. The ship is now once more heading towards the ice edge.
137134.title_en: Saved by the Storm from the South

137140.excerpt_en: A holiday in Svalbard is becoming cheaper. That is the consequence if the tourism industry’s plans are realised.
137140.subtitle_en: “Longyearbyen would be a good turnaround port.”

137142.excerpt_en: It began with the Christmas quiz and ended up on the back page of Svalbardposten. Rune Brendlien (46) answered every question correctly in Svalbardposten’s advent calendar, and now the prize has arrived: an iPhone 6 with the full package.
137142.subtitle_en: Rune Brendlien leaves no stone unturned. That is how you win a quiz.
137142.tags_en: people, life on Svalbard, back page

137156.excerpt_en: Twenty children and four coaches travelled to Tromsø last weekend to take part in Ishavssvøm, with many strong results in the pool. The young swimmers are Niva Stiberg, Vår E.
137156.subtitle_en: The swimming group from Svalbard Turn took part in a swim meet in Tromsø.

137186.excerpt_en: Three new hotels are planned in Longyearbyen over the next few years. The Spitsbergen Travel group is not afraid of the competition, but plans to build one itself. “We will also expand and develop.”
137186.subtitle_en: Spitsbergen Travel wants to build a large new hotel, but needs a site.
137186.tags_en: Thon, Spitsbergen Travel, travel industry, business, news, hotel, tourism

137194.excerpt_en: It has taken time to facilitate more residential construction in Gruvedalen. The proposal for the planning programme was first considered in September 2011.
137194.subtitle_en: Store Norske has now completed a new proposal for a detailed plan for Gruvedalen, but there will be no school bus up to the housing development.
137194.title_en: One step closer to new residential plots

137199.excerpt_en: One of the two companies is Better Moments. Managing director Eivind Aksnes and chair Niklas Gerhardsson started just over a year ago, mainly with snowmobile tours.
137199.subtitle_en: Two companies have bought rugged, covered boats to take tourists on day trips out of Isfjorden.

137209.excerpt_en: We got the idea two years ago. The weather on the fjord was often poor then, and we began considering getting a different type of boat, says Steinar Rorgemoen, chair of the new company.
137209.tags_en: Spitsbergen Guide Service, news, Ny-Ålesund, tourism, business

137227.excerpt_en: Jamie Carragher is one of Liverpool’s great legends, with 737 appearances for the Premier League club. Carragher has always been involved with children and has his own football school bearing his name. Last weekend, 41 children aged 8 to 16 took part in a weekend school with Carragher’s instructors.
137227.subtitle_en: “Football school is great fun, even though it is a little difficult to understand the instructors,” say Live Laursen Bertelsen (10) and Sofie Marlen Solberg (11).

137237.excerpt_en: Bruce Grobbelaar made a private visit to Longyearbyen last weekend after being invited by Liverbirds Svalbard. The goalkeeping legend now lives in Corner Brook, Newfoundland, Canada, so he was not particularly surprised by the conditions. “I’m used to winter and snow, and especially cold temperatures.”
137237.subtitle_en: Twenty-one years after his last game for Liverpool, few can match Bruce Grobbelaar (67) for popularity.

137247.excerpt_en: Better Moments and Spitsbergen Guide Service both received valuable help from Innovation Norway to get their boating ventures off the ground (see the article on the previous page). Svalbard Bryggeri, Store Norske and Svalbard Vet were also among those granted funding last year (see fact box).
137247.subtitle_en: Funding from Innovation Norway is soaring.
137247.title_en: More than seven million in start-up funding for Longyearbyen

137301.excerpt_en: “Lance” is now in loose ice, more than a month ahead of schedule, and the Coast Guard vessel “Svalbard” is on its way to help get the research vessel back into the ice.
137301.subtitle_en: Equipment is being packed after the research vessel was forced out of the ice.
137301.tags_en: Norwegian Polar Institute, ice expedition, research, news, Lance

137333.excerpt_en: The news came this week from the Ministry of Education and Research: Norway’s Arctic Student Welfare Organisation will receive funding in 2015 for 200 new student homes. Eighty of these will be built in connection with UNIS.
137333.subtitle_en: The government is funding 80 new student rooms in Longyearbyen, but it is unclear when construction will begin.

137339.excerpt_en: Ravlo spent Monday and Tuesday talking to employees and visiting Svea Nord, Lunckefjell and the processing plant in Svea. “It was really all right to go there. I can feel that there is a real fighting spirit, and many people are putting in quite a lot of effort,” she says.
137339.subtitle_en: Wenche Ravlo does not rule out further staff cuts at Store Norske. She began the week underground.

137352.excerpt_en: On Wednesday, “Lance” was once again at 83 degrees north after the research vessel had to pack up its equipment and leave the ice the previous weekend. The reason was that the ship was forced out of the ice.
137352.subtitle_en: The fact that “Lance” was forced out of the ice may provide more answers about climate change. Meanwhile, the world is beginning to take serious notice of the research expedition.
137352.title_en: Ice expedition strengthens Norway’s standing in the Arctic

137356.excerpt_en: A group is gathered around the grand piano, singing at the top of their lungs. Suddenly, silence falls inside the cinema at Huset. “What was the number about?” “Er, no, we’re not saying.”
137356.subtitle_en: Opening night is approaching. It is chaos, and hopefully everything will turn out well. As always.
137356.title_en: Laughter is just around the corner

137372.excerpt_en: This usually happens in summer, but this year the goose got it seriously wrong. Stig Hammer says he was tipped off about the bird on Tuesday by Arild Hermansen.
137372.subtitle_en: It is not a common sight, but from time to time the greylag goose appears on Svalbard.

137387.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute has been commissioned by Klif (the Norwegian Climate and Pollution Agency) to obtain a better overview of motor traffic on Svalbard. Initially, snowmobile users will notice this through the installation of technical equipment that can count snowmobiles entering and leaving Longyearbyen.
137387.subtitle_en: The Ministry of Climate and the Environment and the Office of the Auditor General want an overview of motor traffic.
137387.title_en: Now the snowmobiles will be counted

137389.excerpt_en: This week it became known that Longyearbyen is considering a completely new type of quay as part of the port expansion. A floating quay that can receive cruise ships, store fuel, accommodate university staff and house a laboratory is one possible solution. “The plan is to have the floating quay fully designed during the summer.”
137389.subtitle_en: A floating quay unlike anything the world has seen is being considered for Longyearbyen.
137389.title_en: The future of the quay is floating

137392.excerpt_en: Many people have predicted a bleak future for Longyearbyen in the wake of the major problems that cornerstone company Store Norske has faced in recent years.
137392.subtitle_en: Tommy Anderssen feels the pessimism in Longyearbyen in his gut. But he is responding by investing millions in a new commercial building.
137392.title_en: Showing confidence in the future through investment

137453.excerpt_en: At the end of 2014, Svalbardposten had an approved circulation of 2,636 weekly copies, according to figures from the Norwegian Media Businesses’ Association (MBL) and the Norwegian Association of Local Newspapers (LLA). Last year, circulation was 2,561, but the newspapers have also changed the calculation method somewhat, so they receive credit for digital readers.

137466.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten had an approved circulation of 2,636 weekly copies in 2014, figures released this Tuesday show. These are pleasing results, but figures that are nevertheless difficult to compare with previous years.
137466.subtitle_en: That is reason to be pleased, but not to relax.

137470.excerpt_en: The aim is to develop a more accurate global reference framework, providing a better basis for measuring and monitoring the Earth. “Norway already holds an important position in international climate negotiations and climate research.”
137470.subtitle_en: The foundation stone was laid in Ny-Ålesund in October. Now, in a new resolution, the UN is calling for increased cooperation on Earth observation.

137488.excerpt_en: In the middle of the ongoing and intense debate over the parking rules outside the airport departure hall, local council leader Christin Kristoffersen parked illegally on Thursday afternoon.
