The car, a black Mercedes, stood empty for an extended period and caused traffic problems for taxis and other private cars.
137488.subtitle_en: Amid the debate over airport rules. “I hold my hands up,” says the local council leader.
137488.title_en: This is where Kristoffersen parks illegally

137509.excerpt_en: “I have told the chair of Store Norske that we are open to it, but there must be a signal that it is wanted.”
137509.subtitle_en: While Store Norske continually assesses operations and new measures, LNS Spitsbergen is ready to cooperate inside the mine. But the initiative must come from the coal company.

137520.excerpt_en: “A couple of years ago I was tired of guiding visitors. But now the desire has returned, and I think it is fine to do it a couple of times a week,” says Tommy Jordbrudal.
137520.subtitle_en: More and more tourists are asking for dog-sledding experiences. Tommy Jordbrudal is one of many answering the call.

137528.excerpt_en: The likely reason is that the number of vessels fishing for the species has increased sharply. During a recent inspection, the Coast Guard vessel KV “Nordkapp” registered around a dozen vessels fishing for crab.
137528.subtitle_en: Snow crab catches in the Loophole have been cut in half.

137545.excerpt_en: If everything goes according to plan, a new kennel with 80–100 four-legged residents will be ready in Bolterdalen in a year. Svalbard Adventure Group AS (SAG) wants to capture part of the growing market. “We are getting a new hotel next year, which means more guests.”
137545.subtitle_en: “Demand has increased, and the companies currently offering dog-sledding tours are often fully booked,” says John-Einar Lockert.
137545.title_en: Another Hundred Dogs in Just Over a Year

137564.excerpt_en: The German icebreaker Polarstern dropped the two Norwegian researchers off somewhere between Canada’s northernmost point and the North Pole on 30 August last year.
137564.subtitle_en: Yngve Kristoffersen (73) and Audun Tholfsen (43) are drifting in the Arctic Ocean and have not seen another person since last autumn.
137564.title_en: Half a Year Alone on the Ice

137599.excerpt_en: Deputy chair of the local council Geir Hekne, environmental protection chief Guri Tveito, tourism chief Ronny Brunvoll, Tapasbussen, Sweco, Telenor, Store Norske and, not least, outgoing local council chair Christin Kristoffersen all get a going-over in the revue “Wow! A New Coal Age!”
137599.subtitle_en: The house was packed. And everyone laughed.
137599.title_en: A Parade of Parodies from the Revue Group

137605.excerpt_en: The accident occurred at around 5:30 p.m. on Friday. “The man was part of a tour group. In Fardalen, he was traveling down a small slope when the snowmobile hit a bump.”
137605.subtitle_en: A visiting Norwegian man was flown to hospital in Tromsø on Friday evening after a snowmobile accident.
137605.title_en: Taken to Hospital After Snowmobile Accident

137621.excerpt_en: Seven-year-olds Ingeborg Andersen, Kjersti Hammer, Idar Bjørndal and Pia Helen Ervik were not alone on the old hospital steps at Skjæringa to mark the sun’s return to Longyearbyen. As tradition dictates, crowds had turned out for the occasion.
137621.subtitle_en: “The sun is there somewhere. It is only the clouds that are keeping it from getting through.”
137621.title_en: Day of the Sun Without the Sun

137639.excerpt_en: With scheduled flights, charter aircraft and private planes, during the period from the 18th to the 22nd…
137639.subtitle_en: Svalbard Airport, Longyear, is going to extraordinary lengths to accommodate all the aircraft coming to experience the solar eclipse.

137676.excerpt_en: There is an awful lot of talk about the sun these days, say five-year-olds Isak, Emma and Elias, all of whom attend Polarflokken kindergarten in Longyearbyen.
137676.subtitle_en: There are three things it is suitable to dress up as when you are five and going to attend a total solar eclipse.
137676.tags_en: people, life on Svalbard, back page

137682.excerpt_en: As tradition dictates, people turned out in droves to see Spitsbergen Revylag’s review of events from the past year in the world’s northernmost city. And the revue group delivered—as always.
137682.subtitle_en: Spitsbergen Revylag deserves plenty of praise for its tasteful jokes.

137690.excerpt_en: As tradition dictates, the Governor of Svalbard lends cabins to permanent residents on Svalbard. The draw was held this week, and the winners have now been announced.
137690.subtitle_en: The draw for Easter cabins is complete. Here are the winners.
137690.title_en: These People Get to Borrow Easter Cabins

137740.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen conservative veteran Geir Hekne has previously indicated that he would withdraw from local politics. But after pressure from the local community and his own party, he has entered the proverbial thinking box. “And I’m still in it.”
137740.subtitle_en: Geir Hekne is still in the thinking box.

137757.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten meets Czech eclipse tourists Martin Hajek (38), Lukas Novak (25) and Anna Vanclova (24) as they cycle down toward the fjord. They are impressed by what they see, but the main reason they are in Longyearbyen is the solar eclipse.
137757.subtitle_en: The Czechs have traveled to several solar eclipses before, and this was their excuse for visiting Svalbard.

137783.excerpt_en: Some moments are remembered more vividly than others. The moment we have talked about for the past couple of years, and will continue talking about, is pitch-black.
137783.subtitle_en: Given what visitors have paid, they have every reason to complain if the rest does not live up to expectations.

137814.excerpt_en: Bob Cooper is one of the senior executives of the Swedish mattress group Hästens. Together with 21 others from the company, which has a worldwide sales network, he has taken over the campsite by the airport, where they are seeking discomfort. “It sounds a little strange coming from a company that makes mattresses.”
137814.subtitle_en: “At Hästens, we believe you can expand your horizons by seeking out discomfort. The fact that there is a solar eclipse here while we are on a trip is simply a bonus.”
137814.title_en: Mattress Company Seeks Discomfort—and the Sun

137827.excerpt_en: “A little contest for votes is perfectly acceptable at a nomination meeting. It is only positive that a small local branch has two people ambitious enough to seek the top spot,” says Øyvind Snibsøer, leader of the Svalbard Labour Party.
137827.subtitle_en: Øyvind Snibsøer lost after putting himself forward as the leading candidate at Monday’s nomination meeting.

137845.excerpt_en: Elke Morgner is busy around the Longyearbyen Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps warehouse at Bykaia. As the corps coordinator, she is the members’ point of contact, handles all mail and invoices, takes part in accounting and budget work, and organizes social events.
137845.subtitle_en: Elke Morgner (34) originally wanted to go to Venezuela, then Canada.
137845.tags_en: people, life on Svalbard, back page

137888.excerpt_en: Stargate Media has placed a 360-degree panoramic camera on Amelnryggen north of Svea. The result is extraordinary, and by navigating you can look in every direction as the spectacular event unfolds.
137888.subtitle_en: Experience the total solar eclipse in a 360-degree panorama.

137920.excerpt_en: Hot sausages, buns, cocoa, hot blackcurrant cordial and coffee. There was no shortage of choice when the Arctic Nature Guide students treated people on the flat by the sea.
137920.subtitle_en: Marte and her fellow students served hot food and drinks in the biting cold.

137975.excerpt_en: The InReach system allows users to request help by pressing a button. Unfortunately, the system can also be triggered by mistake.
137975.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard responded to Von Postbreen northwest of Longyearbyen late Friday night.

137977.excerpt_en: Many dog kennels have been affected, and in the week before the race it was uncertain whether Svalbard’s annual highlight for the dog community would go ahead.
137977.subtitle_en: Veterinarians are unfamiliar with kennel cough on Svalbard, but now it is here. The organizers of the Trapper Trail dog race are taking precautions.

137985.excerpt_en: Yesterday, Basecamp had to bring all its teams back from Isfjord Radio by snowmobile. Three teams, comprising a total of 20 dogs, were transported back to Longyearbyen.
137985.subtitle_en: Svalbard’s dog-sledding industry is struggling after the mass kennel-cough outbreak in Longyearbyen.

137996.excerpt_en: The rest of the world is getting ever closer. We are reminded of that from time to time, most recently by the kennel-cough outbreak in Svalbard.
137996.subtitle_en: This is another small change, and there will be more of them.

138022.excerpt_en: “I’m beginning to get irritated by how long things are taking.”
138022.subtitle_en: The Store Norske union leader believes the state is spreading uncertainty throughout the community by hesitating to respond to the application for a crisis loan.
138022.title_en: The Mineworkers’ Club Is Tired of Waiting

138038.excerpt_en: “We have noticed marked growth in the number of visitors to our hotel in Barentsburg this year. But it is not certain that this is solely because of the fact that we have invested in it.”
138038.subtitle_en: Svalbardposten wrote last year that Trust Arktikugol would become “Tourist Arktikugol.” That has not happened yet, but work on it is continuing.
138038.title_en: Glad That More and More Families with Children Are Visiting Barentsburg

138055.excerpt_en: “I had never imagined that I would have a master’s degree at 24, much less a permanent job I enjoy so much,” Sara says when Svalbardposten meets her in her office at UNIS.
138055.subtitle_en: Sara Cohen, 26, is still getting used to the idea that she has a permanent and rewarding job.

138068.excerpt_en: The route leaves UNIS and continues up through Todalen and Bødalen, then down to Kapp Laila, where there will be a checkpoint, socializing and an overnight stay. “Everyone is responsible for themselves and their own things during the overnight stay at Kapp Laila, but spectators are also welcome to settle down and spend the night,” she says…
138068.subtitle_en: Elise Strømseng will compete with Team Rusk og Rask alongside Elin M. Lien when this year’s Trappers Trail starts at noon on Saturday.

138108.excerpt_en: You can never provide too much information. Most leaders and industry professionals know that, but there has been an unusual silence over Store Norske’s crisis loan.
138108.subtitle_en: An information drought in government offices. Underground in the mine, discontent is now beginning to grow.
138108.tags_en: opinion, editorial, coal crisis, Store Norske

138111.excerpt_en: Some who were due to take part in the annual dog race, which runs from Longyearbyen to Kapp Laila and back, did not even register. This was because of the kennel-cough outbreak among the town’s dogs.
138111.subtitle_en: The kennel-cough outbreak reduced the number of starters in Trappers Trail by one-third.

138115.excerpt_en: “Something happened overnight to some of the dogs that started the race,” says supervising veterinarian Harald Os of the Norwegian Food Safety Authority. The teams left Longyearbyen on Saturday and spent the night at Kapp Laila before the race continued on Sunday. “Only one dog was withdrawn from the race on Saturday evening.”
138115.subtitle_en: A kennel-cough outbreak meant that only 16 of the 24 registered teams started Trappers Trail. Of those, 13 reached the finish. Most of them had already withdrawn dogs along the way.
138115.title_en: More Teams Withdrawn Along the Way

138129.excerpt_en: Our local community has been kept on tenterhooks for a long time. Store Norske announced the company’s crisis last autumn and has had to make several redundancies since its application for a state crisis loan was submitted on the 16th.
138129.subtitle_en: For more than three months now, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries has held Longyearbyen’s fate in its hands.

138137.excerpt_en: While Store Norske waits for an answer from the government, coal prices are falling. On Wednesday, prices were about 15 dollars below the level the coal company had prepared for in the cost-cutting process that began last November.
138137.subtitle_en: Extra-high-quality coal could save the new Lunckefjell mine.
138137.title_en: Low Coal Prices Expected for Years

138179.excerpt_en: Before the race, an assessment was made of whether it should go ahead as planned because of the kennel-cough situation in town. In consultation with the Norwegian Food Safety Authority, it was decided to hold the race, since many of the registered teams were able to participate.
138179.subtitle_en: Trappers Trail 2015 thanks all the dogs, mushers, volunteers and sponsors/partners for their support and contributions to TT2015.

138182.excerpt_en: In recent years, however, I have had several interesting experiences suggesting that this belief is not correct. Here are some examples: I made my first certain observation in Wijdefjorden on 25 September 2008.
138182.subtitle_en: It has long been claimed that polar bears almost never regard Svalbard reindeer as prey.
138182.tags_en: opinion, reader letter, polar bear, reindeer
138182.title_en: About Polar Bears and Svalbard Reindeer

138196.excerpt_en: A week ago, Basecamp Spitsbergen AS brought all its dogs back from Isfjord Radio.
138196.subtitle_en: Both Basecamp and Svalbard Husky have lost revenue because of the kennel cough outbreak in Longyearbyen.

138201.excerpt_en: High turnover has always been a problem for continuity in Longyearbyen. Politics is no exception.
138201.subtitle_en: Only two of the seven elected to represent the Labour Party on the local council still sit there today.
138201.title_en: We Don’t Know Whom We’re Really Electing

138205.excerpt_en: At the upcoming meeting of the Administration Committee (AU), politicians will review the application for state funding for 2016. Last year, LL received NOK 132,674,000 from the state to operate Longyearbyen.
138205.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) is asking for NOK 28 million more in state funding next year.

138263.excerpt_en: “Local Newspaper of the Year” is a prestigious award presented during the gala dinner at the national conference of the Norwegian Association of Local Newspapers (LLA). The winner was revealed on Saturday.
138263.subtitle_en: Svalbardposten came second when Local Newspaper of the Year was announced on Saturday evening.
138263.tags_en: Local Newspaper of the Year 2014, news

138285.excerpt_en: The decision is based on an overall assessment and the outlook for the coal market. This is why the government, led by Minister of Trade and Industry Monica Mæland (H), has decided to give Store Norske more than the crisis-hit company requested. Huge deficit The company posted a record deficit of a staggering NOK 537 million in 2014.
138285.subtitle_en: The government is giving Store Norske NOK 500 million.

138307.excerpt_en: As a result, the newspaper will be published later than usual this Friday. The paper uses SAS to transport it to Svalbard, but on Thursday the newspapers were left behind in Tromsø.
138307.subtitle_en: The SAS flight was full, and there was no room for Svalbardposten.

138325.excerpt_en: There was great joy in the local community on Thursday evening when it became clear that Store Norske would receive NOK 500 million in crisis financing.

138347.excerpt_en: The newspaper racks in Longyearbyen have been mostly empty in recent weeks after the major national newspapers decided to halt shipments. The reason was high freight costs and a sharp decline in sales.
138347.subtitle_en: There will be no more empty newspaper racks on Svalbard after all. VG is now hitching a ride with Coop.

138352.excerpt_en: He arrived in Longyearbyen this week for a one-year temporary position at Svalbardposten, and Monday was the first time he set foot on Svalbard. “I’ve heard and seen a lot, and have always thought this must be something to experience. So when the opportunity arose, I seized it,” he says.
138352.subtitle_en: Svein Berg (64) is looking forward to getting started in his new job as a marketing consultant.

138366.excerpt_en: This week, the crew at Bjørnøya Meteorological Station had a visit from a bird. Snow buntings are present in large numbers, and the great tit—which only began arriving on Svalbard a few years ago—has also appeared at the bird feeder outside the station.
138366.subtitle_en: The jackdaw photographed on Bjørnøya this week is the 213th bird species recorded on Svalbard.
138366.title_en: No One Has Seen This Before

138384.excerpt_en: “What About Us?” is the name of the course offered to parents by the Norwegian Directorate for Children, Youth and Family Affairs (Bufetat).
138384.subtitle_en: Bufetat wants to help parents on Svalbard whose children have special needs.
138384.title_en: Offers Help to Parents in Difficult Circumstances

138396.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen’s population has grown by 161 people in total, from 1,966 permanent residents in 2006 to 2,127 at the end of last year. But despite the growth, the number of Norwegians has steadily declined.
138396.subtitle_en: In nine years, Longyearbyen has lost 130 Norwegians. The number of non-Norwegians has increased by 291.
138396.title_en: Fewer and Fewer Norwegians on Svalbard

138404.excerpt_en: Johan Sletten has had a cabin in Bjørndalen for more than 25 years. In recent years, clouds of sand from the airport have become an increasing problem. “Previously, the problem wasn’t so serious.”
138404.subtitle_en: “Every time a plane takes off from the airport, a cloud of sand comes flying toward us. We’re being sandblasted,” says cabin owner Johan Sletten in Bjørndalen.

138407.excerpt_en: “We ski the Wednesday races!!! And it’s always fun.”
138407.subtitle_en: A total of 130 children have taken part in the Wednesday races one or more times.

138446.excerpt_en: The man from Oslo is one of more than 850 people due to ski the Svalbard Ski Marathon on Saturday. But he is struggling to see how it will be possible. “Yesterday, about 50 people didn’t get their baggage on the flight.”
138446.subtitle_en: “We came to Svalbard to ski the Svalbard Ski Marathon. But SAS didn’t bring our baggage. Many don’t even have their skis,” says Petter Riiser. SAS is now putting on extra flights.

138468.excerpt_en: Kjølstad was followed by Øystein Pettersen and Niklas Dyrhaug. The top woman was Astrid Øyre Slind.
138468.subtitle_en: The Svalbard Ski Marathon has never had so many registered participants. Johan Kjølstad was this year’s winner.

138470.excerpt_en: “People here have waited and waited and asked what they are plotting now. But it’s politics,” says Svein J.
138470.subtitle_en: But the men at Mine 7 miss the colleagues and friends who had to leave. So there was no big celebration the day after the rescue either.

138490.excerpt_en: The message came in at 8 a.m. Sunday from the Lithuanian trawler “Plutonas,” which was fishing east of Hopen. “The report was that the boat had lost a man overboard, and the governor of Svalbard was asked to assist in the search,” says chief constable Christian Svarstad.
138490.subtitle_en: On Sunday morning, the governor of Svalbard received a distress call from a Lithuanian trawler reporting “man overboard.”

138501.excerpt_en: Kjerstin Askholt is a familiar figure in the Svalbard community. She is a lawyer and has been director general of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security’s Polar Department since 2003, giving her a natural close connection to the archipelago. “There are several good applicants for the job.”
138501.subtitle_en: Long-serving director general of the Polar Department, Kjerstin Askholt (52), is among the applicants for the position of governor of Svalbard.

138517.excerpt_en: The fine weather helped create a scene swarming with children and parents at the ski stadium in Todalen. The 130 participants set a record.
138517.subtitle_en: The Children’s Ski Festival has never had more participants.
138517.title_en: All-Out Effort from the Littlest Ones

138528.excerpt_en: The solution arrived at the eleventh hour. DNB is the bank for the crisis-hit coal company, which in turn is entirely dependent on credit.
138528.subtitle_en: The weekend before the solution for Store Norske was presented, DNB halted credit to the coal company. Now everyone is breathing a sigh of relief, but more layoffs may follow.
138528.title_en: The Bank Cut Off the Flow of Money

138537.excerpt_en: “Of course we want the matter to reach the Storting as quickly as possible, but we are confident that it will get there,” says local council leader Christin Kristoffersen (Labour). “But the challenges haven’t gone away?” “No, unfortunately you cannot legislate away a crisis or a difficult market, but we have been given the opportunity to…”

Passengers who were due to travel on the 4:40 a.m. flight last night will also be accommodated. “Then they will fill the remaining seats with passengers who were booked on the night flight,” Sølvi Jacobsen of SAS Ground Handling tells Svalbardposten.
140026.subtitle_en: The fog is lifting, and SAS is trying to land an extra aircraft this afternoon. But not everyone will get on.

140029.excerpt_en: A few weeks ago, a picture of a polar bear eating a white-beaked dolphin appeared in many online newspapers. The observation was remarkable: the dolphin species had never before been seen so far north, and consequently neither had a polar bear eating one.
140029.subtitle_en: Arctic cruise operators will continue reporting observations like this one.
140029.tags_en: narwhal, news, research, wildlife, polar bear

140033.excerpt_en: Reindeer hunting on Svalbard begins on Saturday, August 15.
140033.subtitle_en: 345 hunters are allowed to shoot Svalbard reindeer.

140068.excerpt_en: An interesting debate has been running in Svalbardposten in recent weeks. Linda Bakken questions opposition to coal mining on Svalbard, while the focus on tourism attracts no critical questions—at least not publicly.
140068.subtitle_en: Just ask Petter Stordalen the next time he lands in his private jet.
140068.title_en: As Everyone Knows, the World Is Not Ideal

140093.excerpt_en: Earlier this week it became known that the leader of a Czech tour group attacked by a polar bear near Fredheim on March 19 this year had been issued a NOK 10,000 fine by the police for failing to implement the necessary safety measures before the incident occurred.
140093.subtitle_en: The final penalty for the leader of the Czech tour group attacked by a polar bear in March will set a precedent for similar cases in the future.

140099.subtitle_en: Svalbard Museum has doubled its visitor numbers from last year, and the trend is only upward.

140124.excerpt_en: Cohabiting couple Per Østvang and Cecilie Nilsen, from Løten, got the best possible start to their holiday on Svalbard.
140124.subtitle_en: Last Thursday, 12.6 degrees was recorded at the weather station by Svalbard Airport. It was the warmest day so far this year, but nowhere near a record. Then the fog arrived.
140124.title_en: Enjoying the Sun and Warmth on Svalbard

140129.excerpt_en: “This is the biggest renovation ever carried out at the power plant,” says Kjetil Dahl Knutsen, showing us around the facility. The panel walls around the combustion chamber have been removed from one of the two furnaces.
140129.subtitle_en: 2.8 kilometers of piping must be replaced as the power plant’s service life is extended by 25 years.
140129.title_en: Major Upgrade at the Power Plant

140229.excerpt_en: “We do not have permission; that became clear in the middle of this week,” says polar bear researcher Jon Aars of the Norwegian Polar Institute. Svalbardposten reported on July 3…
140229.subtitle_en: Norway provided NOK 10 million for the project, but there will nevertheless be no polar bear survey on the Russian side.

140246.excerpt_en: A brief memorial service was held and flowers were laid at the July 22 memorial by Svalbard Church on Wednesday morning.
140246.subtitle_en: Today marks four years since terror struck Norway.

140320.excerpt_en: What brought you here? I was here for the first time in 2008, and simply had to come back, and back, and back.
140320.subtitle_en: Marcel Schütz is happiest out in Svalbard’s rugged wilderness. When he is finally home, the refrigerator is what he fears most.

140327.excerpt_en: “We do not have permission; that became clear in the middle of this week,” polar bear researcher Jon Aars of the Norwegian Polar Institute told Svalbardposten last Friday. No figures. What was to have been the first major Norwegian-Russian survey of the Barents Sea polar bear population since 2004 has come to a halt.
140327.subtitle_en: The sea ice has declined significantly since the previous Norwegian-Russian polar bear survey. Last year, Norway provided NOK 10 million for a new and better overview, but researchers are not being allowed onto the Russian side.
140327.title_en: No to Polar Bear Count on Russian Side

140422.excerpt_en: Dutchwoman Michelle van Dijk has written a book about her compatriot and polar hero Sjef van Dongen, who lived in Barentsburg for several years and, among other things, helped search for the airship Italia, which crashed on Nordaustlandet in 1928. “I came across a book he had written about his time on Svalbard, and I…
140422.subtitle_en: Michelle van Dijk wrote a book to honor the memory of Dutch polar hero Sjef van Dongen.

140459.excerpt_en: Fortunately, there have so far been no accidents between vulnerable and motorized road users on the stretch between the town quay and central Longyearbyen, but calls are now being made for a pedestrian path to be built. “It is a familiar issue.”
140459.title_en: Want to Sort Out the Chaos Road Between Town and Port

140463.excerpt_en: 2,000 people – 3,000 polar bears. That is roughly one of Svalbard’s marketing slogans.
140463.subtitle_en: The polar bear research project has been allowed to fade relatively quietly.

140495.excerpt_en: “Statistics for overnight stays in the first half of 2015 show that we have also seen steady, healthy growth this year,” Ronny Brunvoll, tourism director at Visit Svalbard, wrote in an email. From January to June, 73,281 so-called guest nights were recorded at accommodation establishments in Longyearbyen, Barentsburg and Pyramiden.
140495.subtitle_en: Visit Svalbard’s figures show that the number of tourists visiting Svalbard continues to rise.

140504.excerpt_en: “It was a fantastic experience for both the players and the coaches,” says Svalbard Turn coach Piotrek Jankowski. This year’s football tournament on Ekebergsletta in Oslo kicked off on the 26th.
140504.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn had a fantastic experience at this year’s Norway Cup tournament on Ekebergsletta in Oslo. They are eager to do it again next year.
140504.title_en: Fun Week at the Norway Cup

140551.excerpt_en: The SAS scheduled flight that landed at Svalbard Airport at 1:40 p.m. on Wednesday was missing almost half of the passengers’ baggage. “I can unfortunately confirm that 90 pieces of luggage were left at Oslo Airport. This is an error that should not happen.”
140551.subtitle_en: Ninety pieces of luggage that should have gone to Longyearbyen were left at Oslo Airport.
140551.title_en: SAS Plane Landed Without Half the Baggage

140568.excerpt_en: The cruise season is winding down, and once again discussion has turned to regulating the road from Bykaia to central Longyearbyen. The aim is to keep “sheep herds” out of traffic and thereby prevent potential accidents.
140568.subtitle_en: Visitors probably see it as less important, since it is not important to the hosts either.

140570.excerpt_en: She will only be here for five or six weeks, but Clara Flintrop has chosen to live in a tent instead of student accommodation. “I normally study in Bremen, and I’m working on a master’s degree.”
140570.subtitle_en: German biology student Clara Flintrop (25) has chosen a somewhat unconventional home while taking a course at UNIS.

140665.excerpt_en: “When Kjetil Dahl Knutsen, the initiator of the Topptrim Challenge, said it wasn’t about rushing, we got fired up and wanted to run the route as fast as possible,” Espen André Øverdal laughs. “And our time wasn’t bad, either.”
140665.subtitle_en: Espen André Øverdal and Ronny Lauritz Berntsen raced over ten mountain peaks around Longyearbyen in 6 hours and 11 minutes.

140673.excerpt_en: “I’m really looking forward to the first day of school. I’ve been waiting around a little all summer, so I’m looking forward to meeting the pupils and the other teachers,” says Susanne with a smile.
140673.subtitle_en: Susanne Setten Wingsternes, 33, is looking forward to starting work as a fourth-grade teacher at Longyearbyen School.
140673.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page
140673.title_en: Ready for the start of school

140697.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute is now well past the halfway point of the expedition, which was intended to be the first major polar bear count from Svalbard to Franz Josef Land in eleven years.
140697.subtitle_en: Russia denies that the application to count polar bears on the Russian side has been rejected. But Norway should remember that processing such cases takes time under Russian law, the Russian embassy writes.
140697.title_en: Polar bear application still being processed

140702.excerpt_en: A new school and kindergarten year is about to begin. Longyearbyen’s kindergartens have 100 per cent coverage, and the resident survey showed that most people in Longyearbyen are very satisfied with the kindergarten provision.
140702.subtitle_en: There will still be universal kindergarten coverage, the government’s maximum fee and two kindergarten admissions rounds a year.
140702.tags_en: Labour Party, kindergartens, reader contribution, local elections, opinions, politics, school

140714.excerpt_en: Trust Arktikugol has spent the past several years renovating the two mining communities, and several buildings have been renovated or demolished. The aim is to invest more in tourism, but the Governor of Svalbard fears the buildings contain hazardous substances.
140714.tags_en: Pyramiden, Governor of Svalbard, environment, Barentsburg, news
140714.title_en: Demolition of buildings halted in Barentsburg and Pyramiden

140738.excerpt_en: The Russian Federation devotes considerable attention to protecting polar bears and creating favourable conditions for them in their habitat in the Russian Arctic. Polar bear hunting in Russia has been prohibited by law since 1957.
140738.subtitle_en: The Russian Federation devotes considerable attention to protecting polar bears and creating favourable conditions for them.
140738.tags_en: opinions, reader contribution, polar bear, Russia
140738.title_en: The Russian Federation’s polar bear conservation policy

140744.excerpt_en: A group of academics, engineers and advanced UNIS students have been working on the Gruve 7 mountain since the end of June.
140744.subtitle_en: The new radar being built on the Gruve 7 mountain will form part of a global network studying particles in the ionosphere.

140746.excerpt_en: “We had two training sessions every day for a week. One was in each athlete’s main sport, while the other was joint training,” says Frida Krystad, 14.
140746.subtitle_en: Seven young athletes from Svalbard Turn are brimming with new inspiration after taking part in Youth Elite Sports Week in Tromsø.

140778.excerpt_en: When Store Norske’s board meets next Thursday, one issue will be whether coal mining in Svea should be wound down. “Everything has been done. We have delivered, but the market is not with us,” CEO Wenche Ravlo tells Svalbardposten.
140778.subtitle_en: The government may have to decide whether coal mining in Svea and Lunckefjell should cease next year.
140778.tags_en: news, coal, the Store Norske crisis, climate, society, environment
140778.title_en: Coal’s future could now be decided

140860.excerpt_en: The question of whether NIS-registered ships should be allowed to operate in Svalbard came up last summer, when the Norwegian Maritime Authority gave shipping companies operating in the north until 1 July 2015 to re-register their vessels.
140860.subtitle_en: LO believes that NIS-registered ships operating in Svalbard also amount to a green light for social dumping.
140860.tags_en: news, working life, maritime traffic, ship registry

140879.excerpt_en: The University Hospital of North Norway (UNN) has applied to paint Longyearbyen Hospital the same colour it is today. But Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) will not allow it.
140879.subtitle_en: Yellow is not cool, says Longyearbyen Local Council.

140894.excerpt_en: Kings Bay will be among those hit hard by a reduction in Store Norske’s services. The company has scheduled flights with Lufttransport between Longyearbyen and Ny-Ålesund twice a week—once in winter and twice in summer.
140894.subtitle_en: Svalbard’s business community is concerned about future air services.
140894.tags_en: news, coal, the Store Norske crisis, Kings Bay, research, tourism
140894.title_en: Feeling the impact of cuts to air services

140931.excerpt_en: “We appealed the decision, and last week Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) reversed its decision and ruled in our favour,” says case officer Hans Hansen of the University Hospital of North Norway (UNN). In early summer, LL rejected UNN’s application for an exemption from the town centre colour scheme.
140931.subtitle_en: The University Hospital of North Norway ignored Longyearbyen Local Council’s rejection and painted the hospital yellow.

140936.excerpt_en: Store Norske must continue downsizing. That became clear after today’s board meeting at the coal company, where the board considered various options for future operations.
140936.subtitle_en: “No basis for restarting operations at Lunckefjell.”
140936.title_en: 150 lose their jobs at Store Norske

140975.excerpt_en: Nature in Svalbard is fantastic: wild, beautiful and occasionally extreme.
140975.subtitle_en: ELECTION 2015: “Svalbard Labour Party wants to promote nature experiences close to town and non-motorized travel by, among other things, having simple picnic shelters built near the town.”
140975.tags_en: politics, local elections, reader contribution, Labour Party, opinions

140977.excerpt_en: We live a good life up here in the north. One reason is the great variety of activities on offer in culture, sport and outdoor life.
140977.subtitle_en: ELECTION 2015: They are an important guarantor of well-being, quality of life and public health for the people of Longyearbyen.
140977.tags_en: opinions, reader contribution, Liberal Party, local elections
140977.title_en: Associations, well-being and quality of life

140983.excerpt_en: At eleven o’clock on Wednesday, the ribbon was cut and Svalbard’s first major sewage treatment plant officially opened. That means the end of discharges into Kongsfjorden, which is used, among other things, as a marine laboratory with highly sensitive equipment.
140983.subtitle_en: Kings Bay has spent more than NOK 12 million on environmental measures in Ny-Ålesund since 2013. The sewage will not be discharged into the fjord either.
140983.tags_en: news, Longyearbyen, Kings Bay, discharges, environment

141009.excerpt_en: In the ranking, the Longyearbyen hotel shares first place with, among others, The Thief in Oslo.
141009.subtitle_en: The staff at Basecamp Spitsbergen are jumping for joy after being named Norway’s best hotel by booking service Hotels.com.
141009.title_en: Leapt to the top of the hotel rankings

141044.excerpt_en: Last week, the 34-year-old from Jabalpur in India’s Madhya Pradesh state earned her doctorate at the University Centre in Svalbard (UNIS). No Indian had done so before her.
141044.subtitle_en: Indian Teena Chauhan has done what none of her 1.3 billion compatriots has done before her.
141044.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page
141044.title_en: Got her hat handed to her

141061.excerpt_en: “We have to look out for one another,” says Ronny-André Olsen. The mine manager has just finished his lunch break.
141061.subtitle_en: The HSE manager fears the risk of injury at Store Norske will increase after the second round of cuts in just over six months. At the same time, the local council leader is calling for emergency measures after the cornerstone company announced 150 redundancies.
141061.tags_en: society, news, the Store Norske crisis
141061.title_en: Calls for emergency measures after cuts approved

141092.excerpt_en: On Thursday, Store Norske’s board decided to dismiss 150 employees and place Svea and the new Lunckefjell mine on care and maintenance from 2016.
141092.subtitle_en: The government is stepping up efforts with a new Svalbard white paper following the cuts at Store Norske.
141092.tags_en: politics, the Store Norske crisis, society, Anundsen, news
141092.title_en: “The coal crisis came faster than expected”

141146.excerpt_en: Why is a long-term perspective the cornerstone of everything we do? First, it takes a long time to reach the operational stage; today, an environmental impact assessment can take up to ten years. Production equipment must then be procured and built.
141146.subtitle_en: “We have given up the opportunity to take the driver’s seat in Arctic development.”
141146.tags_en: Store Norske, reader letter, coal, industry, mining, opinions
141146.title_en: The mining industry is a long-term enterprise

141160.excerpt_en: Refers to Store Norske’s announcement that large parts of its operations will be put on hold because of low coal prices. In this serious situation for the Svalbard community, we have reviewed the company’s 2014 annual report very carefully.
141160.subtitle_en: “The costs of social responsibility should be transferred to the Svalbard budget.”
141160.tags_en: Svalbard, opinions, reader letter, coal crisis, politics

141177.excerpt_en: No politicians in Longyearbyen would contradict Svalbard Venstre on the importance of Svalbard Turn and its role in wellbeing and quality of life. Svalbard Labour, however, has other input and views on the questions raised by Svalbard Turn and the proposals from Svalbard Venstre.
141177.subtitle_en: “Given the challenges Longyearbyen now faces, we need responsible financial policies and must assess funding for non-statutory tasks against the community’s resources and needs.”
141177.tags_en: opinions, local elections, reader letter, politics

141181.excerpt_en: On Thursday last week, we received the news we had feared. Store Norske must begin extensive staff cuts, which will have a major impact on our community.
141181.subtitle_en: “At the same time, we believe an important part of the restructuring is for the state to take over a significant share of the obligations relating to roads, energy and other infrastructure.”
141181.tags_en: politics, local elections, reader letter, coal crisis, opinions

141191.excerpt_en: On Friday, she gathered the employees at Gruve 7 for a meeting to brief them on the process ahead. The work to reduce the workforce at Store Norske began on Monday, and approximately 150 employees are to go by summer 2016.
141191.subtitle_en: Wenche Ravlo needs NOK 95 million annually for the next three years to avoid closing the Lunckefjell mine for good.
141191.tags_en: society, news, politics, the Store Norske crisis

141249.excerpt_en: Last summer, something happened that must not happen. The connection to the mainland was severed, the telephones stopped working, and there was no internet.
141249.subtitle_en: Space Norway AS is considering laying a third fibre-optic cable between Svalbard and the mainland.

141282.excerpt_en: Issue 36 of Svalbardposten has not yet arrived in Longyearbyen. SAS, which transports the newspaper from the printer in Tromsø, tried to land twice on Thursday but had to turn back.
141282.subtitle_en: The print edition of Svalbardposten is expected to reach the island on the late-morning flight.

141287.excerpt_en: “This is incredibly sad,” says manager Gunnhild Antonsen as she examines the damage to the climbing tower. When she and the others arrived at work early this morning, they discovered that one of the tower’s windows had been damaged.
141287.subtitle_en: Kullungen Nursery has once again been vandalized, and repairs will cost tens of thousands of kroner. The nursery will now be closed in the evenings.

141339.excerpt_en: A group led by Tone Løvberg has applied to the Longyearbyen Community Council for permission to keep artist Solveig Egeland’s Ocean Hope hut (the Rubbish Hut) standing for another year. This week, they received a positive response from the council, but the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries, as the landowner, has not yet commented.
141339.subtitle_en: A group has agreed to look after the Ocean Hope hut for another year. But the artist will not take responsibility for the structure.
141339.tags_en: Ocean Hope, the Rubbish Hut, news
141339.title_en: Opposition to demolishing the rubbish hut

141345.excerpt_en: A photograph of a sick and/or old polar bear, taken as it climbed onto an ice floe, is circulating widely online.
141345.subtitle_en: Nature is ruthless, and things like this happen all the time. It may sound cynical, but that’s how it is.
141345.title_en: To hell with facts—long live the click

141401.excerpt_en: Some of us find it difficult to see the difference between the parties in the local election. One difference is that the parties currently represented on the Community Council are divided over a possible expansion of the existing cultural centre to also include Galleri Svalbard.
141401.subtitle_en: These are important priority areas and will create jobs.
141401.tags_en: opinions, local elections, reader letter, politics
141401.title_en: The cultural centre and the gallery

141406.excerpt_en: SNSK is posting a substantial surplus, albeit expressed in negative krone figures. The overarching benefit lies in unique expertise acquired and maintained through Arctic industrial activity.
141406.subtitle_en: A surplus gives companies a right to exist.

141408.excerpt_en: The proposal is based on Svalbardposten’s theoretical calculation. Store Norske needs NOK 95 million annually to place the Lunckefjell mine on care and maintenance.
141408.subtitle_en: The government must consider the social benefits when deciding on Store Norske’s board resolution, says the head of the business association. He has support from experts.
141408.tags_en: Longyearbyen, the Store Norske crisis, society, news

141444.excerpt_en: It has become a tradition. When Polargirl docked in the Russian settlement on its final trip of the year last Friday, 35 schoolchildren and four teachers were waiting excitedly on the quay.
141444.subtitle_en: For the 13th time, a barbecue party was held on deck for the children of Barentsburg.

141458.excerpt_en: The latest review recorded 2,168 residents in Longyearbyen.
141458.subtitle_en: At its final meeting, the Longyearbyen Community Council heard that the town has a record number of residents. Otherwise, however, good news was in short supply.

141521.excerpt_en: The budget leak came after Minister of Health and Care Services Bent Høie (Conservative) had returned to shore after a trip on the Polarsyssel on Monday. In the national budget, the government allocates 7.
141521.subtitle_en: The Conservatives’ top candidate expects more.
141521.title_en: Allocates NOK 15 million for planning new port

141528.excerpt_en: On Monday, Conservative Bent Høie delivered the autumn’s first budget leak concerning Svalbard. The government is allocating NOK 15 million to planning a new port in Longyearbyen.
141528.subtitle_en: “Too little, too late,” says Labour about the government’s funding pledge.
141528.tags_en: news, politics, the Store Norske crisis, local elections
141528.title_en: “If this is the best they can do, I’m worried”

141540.excerpt_en: This is the consequence of the closure of operations in Svea and Lunckefjell being placed on care and maintenance. Last year, the airline carried 15,400 passengers in its Dornier 228 aircraft between Longyearbyen and Svea.
141540.subtitle_en: One of the two short-haul aircraft permanently stationed in Svalbard will, in all likelihood, be moved to the mainland.
141540.tags_en: air transport, coal crisis, news, aviation
141540.title_en: Coal cuts make for a hard landing

141546.excerpt_en: The parties in Svalbard have been criticised for being too similar. In a way, that is understandable.
141546.subtitle_en: “In that sense, we do not expect parties that have existed for 100 years to be the ones taking us into the future.”
141546.tags_en: opinions, local elections, reader letter, politics

141563.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen is entering a very exciting period, with uncertainty surrounding our cornerstone company, Store Norske. Downsizing at Store Norske will not only have serious consequences for Longyearbyen and its population, but will also affect the development of tourism.
141563.subtitle_en: “That is why we believe it is particularly important that tourism is given framework conditions that make growth possible.”
141563.tags_en: opinions, local elections, reader letter, politics
141563.title_en: Svalbard Conservatives Welcome Growth in Tourism

141566.excerpt_en: The Labour Party claims that representatives of Svalbard Venstre support the local council taking out a loan to expand the existing community centre to also include Galleri Svalbard. We reject this as pure fabrication.
141566.subtitle_en: The election campaign is being sullied when the Labour Party, in a reader letter in the previous issue, invents claims about Svalbard Venstre’s policies.
141566.title_en: A Rotten Claim from the Labour Party

141594.excerpt_en: I must say I was somewhat surprised when Espen Rotevatn said earlier this summer that “we hope Torgeir Prytz will stop using cheap Labour rhetoric”, because what exactly is “cheap Labour rhetoric”?
141594.subtitle_en: “If Olsen had taken the time to read our programme, he would have seen that we favour a restrictive approach to new borrowing, unlike his own party.”
141594.tags_en: politics, local elections, reader letter, opinions
141594.title_en: Length of Residence, Economic (Ir)responsibility and Rhetoric

141600.excerpt_en: The 39-year-old has worked for Store Norske since 2000, first in mine development, then as a production miner and later as a day-shift miner, all the time in Svea. On Monday, he received the call he had expected would come.
141600.subtitle_en: After 15 years in the mine, it is over. This week, Nick Weis-Fogh (39) was told he is out of work at Store Norske. Even so, he is most worried about his colleagues.
141600.tags_en: news, society, the Store Norske crisis
141600.title_en: “We’re Talking About Children, Spouses and Mortgages”

141620.excerpt_en: “Store Norske,” comes the immediate reply from several voices when Svalbardposten asks about the major local issue ahead of this year’s local elections. Eight of the eleven members of the town’s newly elected youth council have gathered at the youth club to discuss politics, and there is no shortage of engagement.
141620.subtitle_en: Several members of Longyearbyen’s youth council will vote for the first time this year. Most are worried about the future.
141620.tags_en: youth, youth council, local elections, news
141620.title_en: Young People Worried About the Future

141640.excerpt_en: We meet them among people arriving to cast their advance votes in the local elections. They register and stamp the ballots, directing voters to the voting booth and the ballot box.
141640.subtitle_en: A bookseller and a police officer make first-class election hosts.
141640.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page

141649.excerpt_en: “At first, we only thought of printing paper with green leaves on the school printer. Then we realised that paper would be wrong when we are running for the rainforest.”
141649.subtitle_en: The starting signal for this year’s TV campaign fundraiser was given on Saturday. As usual, it was marked with a colourful event.

141660.excerpt_en: For the past 40 years, Per Kyrre has made communicating Svalbard’s cultural heritage and history his main field of work, interest and priority. His vivid presentation of our local history always arouses great enthusiasm and renewed interest in Svalbard’s cultural heritage and international history.
141660.subtitle_en: Our foremost interpreter of Svalbard’s cultural history, archaeologist Per Kyrre Reymert, turns 70 on Friday, 25 August.

141722.excerpt_en: “How was your day?” “The first day tends to involve lots of practical matters, everything from connecting the PC and sorting out odds and ends to settling in. That is mostly what it is.”
141722.subtitle_en: “There have been lots of nice things, and my head is full,” says Kjerstin Askholt after her first day on the job as governor.

141726.excerpt_en: The Labour Party has reached a new high in Svalbard. The opinion poll we present in today’s paper shows support of 56.5 percent.
141726.subtitle_en: “The result was that the other politicians became more or less invisible, and therefore attracted no votes.”

141760.excerpt_en: Housing construction: In an ordinary town, renting a home costs roughly the same as paying the construction loan on that home. This regulates itself—if renting becomes much cheaper, many people will want to rent and rents will rise.
141760.subtitle_en: Some of us find it difficult to tell the parties apart in the local elections. Here are some of the choices available to you:
141760.tags_en: politics, local elections, reader letter, Labour Party, opinions

141763.excerpt_en: I won this spring’s competition for a nature trail in the upper-secondary school’s tourism competition. It is rather amusing that the Labour Party has stolen my idea and written it into its programme.
141763.subtitle_en: “Wondering which of them included it in the programme.”
141763.tags_en: opinions, local elections, reader letter, politics

141780.excerpt_en: Arild Olsen (Labour) has spent a great deal of time emphasising during the election campaign that he represents Svalbard Labour, not Store Norske. That is, of course, correct.
141780.subtitle_en: But to then claim that one wants to do something about social inequality borders on the comical.
141780.tags_en: politics, local elections, reader letter, opinions

141799.excerpt_en: In the opinion poll conducted by Norfakta for Svalbardposten, two things are particularly striking. One is that the Labour Party receives 56.5 percent of the votes among those who have decided.
141799.subtitle_en: But almost half of voters have not yet made up their minds.

141803.excerpt_en: “The guests do not come here to experience Longyearbyen. They want more.”
141803.subtitle_en: Snowmobile tourists must be allowed access to larger parts of Svalbard. It would give everyone a boost, says the Hurtigruten chief, who wants innovation, freedom and predictability in Svalbard.
141803.tags_en: news, environment, politics, travel, tourism, Hurtigruten Svalbard

141833.excerpt_en: This week, Green Party (MDG) Member of Parliament Rasmus Hansson visited Longyearbyen for the first time since the local branch was established in February.
141833.subtitle_en: Rasmus Hansson was delighted when he heard that a local branch of the Green Party had been established in Svalbard.

141888.excerpt_en: In Tuesday’s debate between the parties’ lead candidates on Rabalder, Venstre’s lead candidate answered a question from debate moderator Eirik Palm incorrectly. 143530.subtitle_en: The question is whether we are really willing to do something about our own way of life.

143580.excerpt_en: The 2016–19 financial plan projects that debt per resident in Longyearbyen will reach NOK 149,534 in three years. Only nine mainland municipalities currently have more debt per capita.

143580.tags_en: Longyearbyen local council, news, local elections

143583.excerpt_en: You do not have to read much about Svalbard before the name Grøndal starts recurring in old photographs. This has led to a widespread misunderstanding. “Many people think I grew up on Svalbard, but that is not true.”

143583.tags_en: people, life in Svalbard, back page

143619.excerpt_en: Local Council leader Arild Olsen (Labour) emphasises that he has not taken a position on cabin waste collection, as one might get the impression from today’s edition of Svalbardposten. “This is an issue that came up at a strategy conference some time ago, and later during the budget negotiations.”

143619.title_en: Cabin Waste Collection Up in the Air

143624.excerpt_en: This week, members of the executive committee of Longyearbyen Local Council were in Oslo for talks about Store Norske and the community’s future after the coal company reduced operations to a minimum and gave a total of 250 employees notice over an 18-month period. “A few weeks.” – That’s…
143624.subtitle_en: “Longyearbyen needs clarity,” says board chair Annette Malm Justad. But according to Minister of Trade and Industry Monica Mæland, it may still be several weeks before a conclusion is reached on Store Norske.
143624.title_en: “We Have to Move On, and I’m Mainly Thinking About the Organisation and the Uncertainty”

143648.excerpt_en: The board of the University Centre in Svalbard decided on Friday to appoint Nilsen as acting director when Ole Arve Misund leaves the university centre at the end of January. Misund resigned from his position in October and will take up a new job as director of the National Institute of Nutrition and Seafood Research (NIFES) in Bergen.
143648.subtitle_en: Frank Nilsen (44) has been appointed acting director of UNIS.

143651.excerpt_en: When the board of the University of Tromsø – The Arctic University of Norway meets on Tuesday, a proposal for input to the forthcoming Svalbard white paper will be presented.
143651.subtitle_en: “I think it is natural to assign that task to UiT.”
143651.title_en: University of Tromsø Wants to Take Over UNIS

143672.excerpt_en: Eirik Palm has been editor and general manager of Svalbardposten since 1 October 2013.
143672.subtitle_en: Editor and general manager Eirik Palm of Svalbardposten has resigned. He will take up a new position at Finnmark Estate Agency.

143678.excerpt_en: Lufttransport currently operates daily flights between Longyearbyen and Svea for Store Norske. When the coal company suspends operations next summer, they will no longer be necessary.
143678.subtitle_en: Store Norske is terminating its contract with the airline.

143684.excerpt_en: “I don’t want to wait until I’m in a wheelchair. I want to contribute to society and not become unable to work,” says the 25-year-old.

143702.subtitle_en: The final issue of the popular-science magazine Ottar this year is dedicated to the king of the Arctic.

143713.excerpt_en: It is Tuesday evening. The thermometer reads minus ten degrees.
143713.subtitle_en: Tiril was allowed to sleep overnight on the balcony on 25 April this year. Since then, she has slept there, joined by her big sister and the dog Rufus.

143768.excerpt_en: For all young people involved in cultural activities, the Youth Culture Festival (UKM) is a well-known opportunity to showcase their talents. By participating locally, they can progress to the county festival, and if they are very talented, from there to the national UKM final.

143813.excerpt_en: Rarely has debate been so heated in Longyearbyen’s highest political body as it was on Tuesday. Engaged politicians delivered numerous contributions, and rebuttal followed rebuttal in the debate.

144753.excerpt_en: Over the past few months, Radisson Blu Polar Hotel (the Polar Hotel) has undergone a major refurbishment.
