178084.subtitle_en: Kent Roar Nybø received a surprising bill from Gruvelageret.

178101.excerpt_en: This week’s historical photo shows the D/S “Ingerfem” at the quay at Hotellneset in 1960. “Ingerfem” was one of six “Inger” vessels belonging to Kjøde’s shipping company in Bergen (Ingeren, Ingerto, Ingertre, etc.).
178101.subtitle_en: Coal, cargo and passenger vessel at the quay in 1960.

178119.excerpt_en: Others can decide whether I’m wise or foolish, but I certainly understand what you mean when you write: “I’m tired of hearing about bad things! I’d much rather hear about all the cool things happening here in town!”
178119.subtitle_en: Thank you so much for a thoughtful and relevant letter to the editor—you’re a wise 11-year-old.
178119.title_en: Hi Freja, I’m taking that to heart too!

178122.excerpt_en: “Today’s travellers have high expectations, particularly when they come to Svalbard,” says Krisztina Uzonyi, manager of the Polar Hotel. Earthy natural colours greet you as you enter the newly renovated hotel, which Uzonyi is happy to show off.
178122.subtitle_en: The Polar Hotel was renovated over three months. Here is the result.
178122.tags_en: architecture, news, Hurtigruten Svalbard, hotel industry, construction industry, Polar Hotel, renovation
178122.title_en: “The colours were important when we renovated”

178125.excerpt_en: Tourists are increasingly seeking nature-based and high-risk activities. Incidents in which fishing tourists have drowned and mountain tourists have been caught in avalanches raise questions about safety in the tourism industry.
178125.subtitle_en: The authors ask whether preparedness is adequate for the increased activity in the Arctic, particularly given the growing number of tourists arriving.
178125.title_en: Does adventure tourism take safety and preparedness seriously?

178156.excerpt_en: Representatives of Longyearbyen Community Council (LL) and the University Centre in Svalbard (Unis) gathered at Unis on Friday, February 22, for a workshop where both parties presented projects, challenges and potential areas of cooperation.
178156.subtitle_en: To strengthen Longyearbyen’s advantage in cooperation on research, education and administration, Unis and LL have decided to expand their collaboration further.

178161.excerpt_en: Sunday was the first day of competition at the Special Olympics for Trym Eide Aunevik from Longyearbyen. He set a personal best by nearly four seconds in the 200-metre freestyle, then lowered his personal record in the 100-metre butterfly by an impressive 11 seconds.
178161.subtitle_en: Trym Eide Aunevik, 17, set personal records in both freestyle and butterfly at the Special Olympics in Abu Dhabi.
178161.tags_en: swimming, news, Trym Eide Aunevik, Special Olympics
178161.title_en: Great start for Trym in Abu Dhabi

178168.excerpt_en: When water began leaking into the tunnel leading to the vaults where the world’s most important seeds are stored in 2016, Statsbygg immediately began extensive repairs. Hæhre Entreprenør is now nearing completion of the construction project, and the new entrance is intended to keep out the milder, wilder and wetter climate of the future.
178168.subtitle_en: Building the Global Seed Vault cost NOK 48 million ten years ago. The repairs needed to waterproof the entrance will cost more than twice that amount.
178168.tags_en: Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Statsbygg, news, Hege Njaa Aschim, seed vault

178191.excerpt_en: “The charges are consistent with what we have maintained, and what he has explained all along,” the man’s defence lawyer, Ulf E. Hansen, told Svalbardposten.
178191.subtitle_en: The man who robbed the bank has not been charged with robbery.
178191.tags_en: SpareBank 1, robbery, state prosecutor, news, Nord-Troms District Court, crime, bank robbery, trial
178191.title_en: “He was a deeply depressed and desperate man”

178197.excerpt_en: Patients from Svalbard referred to UNN or other mainland hospitals receive around NOK 800 per day for food and accommodation. Travel is covered by Pasientreiser. “All the hotels in Tromsø were full, and the rooms available cost around NOK 2,500.”
178197.subtitle_en: What was supposed to be free hospital treatment has so far cost Anna Lena Ekeblad at least NOK 12,000.

178215.excerpt_en: The role of those who made Lunckefjellet accessible and those now erasing traces in Svea recalls the plays performed in Athens around 2,500 years ago: tragedies. Fate leads people into insoluble dilemmas.
178215.subtitle_en: Reinhard Mook reflects on the clean-up in Svea.

178231.excerpt_en: “Being present by the hospital steps where everyone sang and shouted for the sun was almost magical,” says Ingeborg Widerøe, 26.
178231.subtitle_en: She arrived on the day the sun returned, had never been north of the Arctic Circle and has already become a Svalbard resident.

178245.excerpt_en: Earlier in the championships, the 17-year-old swimmer from Longyearbyen swam to fourth and fifth place.
178245.subtitle_en: Trym Eide Aunevik swam to sixth place in his final event at the Special Olympics in Abu Dhabi.
178245.tags_en: Svalbard Turn, news, Trym Eide Aunevik, Special Olympics

178256.excerpt_en: As in many other countries and cities, Unis students will go on strike to show that they believe Norwegian climate policy is not strong enough. There will therefore be a climate strike on Friday the 22nd.

178289.excerpt_en: Large parts of Lompensenteret were flooded when a pipe burst during the morning. It has now emerged that the leak occurred when a pipe leading to a fire hose suddenly burst. “Now we must investigate and try to determine why the pipe burst.”
178289.subtitle_en: The major water leak at Lompensenteret on Tuesday, March 12, caused less damage than feared.

178290.excerpt_en: Latest: Svalbardposten arrived on the SAS flight on Thursday afternoon. Newspaper retailers received it at around 4 p.m.
178290.subtitle_en: Due to technical problems with the mail plane.
178290.tags_en: Svalbardbutikken, Svalbardposten, news, food, newspaper, mail plane

178297.excerpt_en: The girls we met were bursting to tell us about it. “We won seven of eight matches,” several of the girls who played on two different teams told us. “We played really well. That’s because we have good coaches and have trained a lot.”
178297.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn’s girls’ and boys’ football teams returned to Longyearbyen on Sunday after taking part in the Hamna tournament in Tromsø.

178309.excerpt_en: On Friday, 22 March, Artica invites everyone to experience a large-scale installation of sound, light, scent and printmaking, entitled A Gift to Svalbard.
178309.subtitle_en: On Friday, you can experience a very special Colombian gift to the town.
178309.title_en: A gift from south to north, at an angle

178314.excerpt_en: “We need to take a broader view. There are increasingly more tourists and increasingly more rental snowmobiles.”
178314.subtitle_en: Hurtigruten Svalbard has recently been granted permission to use the area by Forskningsparken to park its snowmobiles. The neighbours are far from pleased.
178314.tags_en: news, Longyearbyen land-use plan, snowmobile parking, Hurtigruten Svalbard

178348.excerpt_en: “For us, this means we have to find new ways of doing things,” says Tore Hoem, director of experiences at Hurtigruten Svalbard. Longyearbyen’s land-use plan states that snowmobile parking is not permitted in the area, identified as BUT8 in the case documents.
178348.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has overturned Longyearbyen Community Council’s decision to allow the tourism industry to park snowmobiles in the area east of UNIS.
178348.tags_en: snowmobile parking, Hurtigruten Svalbard, BUT8, Governor of Svalbard, news

178350.excerpt_en: They have been working flat out to secure somewhere for their students to live. Now they can breathe a sigh of relief.
178350.subtitle_en: The pieces are finally beginning to fall into place for Svalbard Folk High School’s first academic year.
178350.tags_en: student housing, news, Nybyen, Hurtigruten Svalbard, Coal Miners’ Cabin, housing market, Svalbard Folk High School
178350.title_en: They now know where their students will live

178355.excerpt_en: The tourism industry is growing rapidly while Svalbard is supposed to remain the world’s best-preserved wilderness. More and more people are calling for predictability and clear guidelines on how the balance between residents, tourists and businesses should look in the years ahead.
178355.subtitle_en: Clear guidelines are needed for how the tourism industry and the local community should coexist.
178355.title_en: Move the snowmobiles to the old airport

178374.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard has just completed a consultation on a possible temporary amendment to Section 8 of the Svalbard regulations governing motor traffic. In short, the proposed change would allow the Governor, without notice, to close snowmobile traffic on Billefjorden, Tempelfjorden, Van Mijenfjorden and Storfjorden between Wichebukta and Domen whenever conditions require it.
178374.subtitle_en: Bård Heio is critical of the travel restrictions and wants greater predictability for the tourism industry.
178374.title_en: Closed fjords— a breach of agreement

178401.excerpt_en: A snowmobile group travelling into Adventdalen on Friday afternoon had to receive assistance from the Governor of Svalbard after one person in the group drove off a steep slope. “Visibility in the area was very poor, with wind and blowing snow.”
178401.subtitle_en: Drove off a steep slope in Adventdalen.
178401.tags_en: snowmobile accident, road safety, news, Adventdalen, safety

178417.excerpt_en: This week’s historical photo was taken in 1960. It comes from Svalbard Museum’s photograph collection and was loaned by Tone Nødtvedt.
178417.subtitle_en: A skiing trip in beautiful Easter weather.

178423.excerpt_en: NRK was quickly on the scene, along with other TV channels, to capture all the four-legged furballs and Linda after they crossed the finish line. In this sport, special attention is always paid to the competitor who sledded her way into last place.
178423.subtitle_en: Linda Marie Monsen Vassdal claimed another personal victory in extreme sports. After completing 500 kilometres in Europe’s longest sled-dog race, the tough competitor could rest on her laurels.
178423.title_en: Linda—the last Viking of them all

178450.excerpt_en: A four-person team from the National Criminal Investigation Service (Kripos) gave a talk on Thursday before the weekend for all pupils aged ten and over. The topic was image sharing, and the campaign they have taken to almost every police district is called “Shareable?”.
178450.subtitle_en: Is it legal to share nude photos? Are children under 16 allowed to share nude photos of themselves? These were some of the questions answered by the lower-secondary students at Longyearbyen School when Kripos came to visit.
178450.title_en: Warned students against reckless photo sharing

178462.excerpt_en: Take a good look at the top photo. There is a polar bear on Bear Island—and that is no longer an everyday sight.
178462.subtitle_en: This year, Bear Island is living up to its name. With sea ice surrounding the entire island, meteorologists have spotted a polar bear there for the first time since 2011.
178462.tags_en: meteorological stations, polar bear, sea ice, Bear Island, news, climate

178484.excerpt_en: March began cold and has so far been below the monthly normal, but there is still much of the month left. Frost smoke has hovered over Adventfjorden, but the fjord is still ice-free.
178484.subtitle_en: This winter has been cold, but the mean air temperature in January and February has nevertheless remained above normal, as it has for 99 consecutive months (Figure 1).

178514.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Community Council (LL) was ordered by the County Governor of Troms and Finnmark in November to fulfil Ivano Cafuta’s right to primary education. The case is now being reconsidered by LL after it rejected his application for a place.
178514.subtitle_en: The County Governor asks LL to take into account that Ivano Cafuta (9) lives in Svalbard and has not been given a school place. It asks LL to provide a new response promptly.
178514.title_en: County Governor Demands New Response from LL over Ivano’s (9) School Place

178516.excerpt_en: Posten and Bring are currently struggling to keep the mail flight between the mainland and Svalbard on schedule. One of the two aircraft used is undergoing maintenance, and technical problems have now arisen with the other.
178516.subtitle_en: A crack in the wing of the mail plane that normally flies to Svalbard has left it grounded.
178516.tags_en: Posten, Coop Svalbard, mail plane, news
178516.title_en: There May Be No Mail Flight to Svalbard This Week

178530.excerpt_en: Cruise tourism is changing. Ports from Kristiansand in the south to the North Cape in the north are now joining forces to tighten environmental requirements for an industry that is a clear worst offender when it comes to greenhouse-gas emissions per passenger kilometre.
178530.subtitle_en: Several members of Friends of the Earth Norway believe local politicians must tighten environmental requirements for the cruise industry.

178545.excerpt_en: As head of Svalbard Airport, Ianssen faces a challenge. He simply does not have enough personnel to staff the control tower around the clock.
178545.subtitle_en: “We have had a staffing problem throughout 2018,” says airport manager Carl Einar Ianssen. Lufttransport fears the problem could lead to a weaker rescue response.
178545.tags_en: news, Svalbard Airport, emergency preparedness, working life, airport

178567.excerpt_en: With solar panels on Platåberget and power cables running down from the mountain along the road to a power plant on stilts in the sea, Spitzberg Holding plans to obtain solar energy for the hotel and ship they want to build. When the sun is insufficient, they will operate their own power plant using LNG (liquefied natural gas).
178567.subtitle_en: Spitzberg Holding plans to build an expedition ship and hotel with their own power supply. Ideally, they would also provide energy to Longyearbyen and other ships in the area.
178567.title_en: Plans Hotel and Ship with Its Own Power Plant

178569.excerpt_en: The police officer spotted three young boys who had ventured out onto the drift ice on Adventfjorden. The ice in the fjord is clearly unsafe. “This is the sort of boys’ mischief they carried out without giving it much thought.”
178569.subtitle_en: On Sunday, Senior Police Officer Anders Haugerud of the Governor of Svalbard saw something from his window that he did not particularly like.
178569.title_en: Dangerous Play on the Fjord Ice

178577.excerpt_en: “What Trym has done is absolutely enormous, and incredibly cool. He’s done something we simply didn’t expect of him,” says Laila Vidmar (16).
178577.subtitle_en: Trym Eide Aunevik (17) was celebrated by former classmates when he returned home from the Special Olympics.
178577.tags_en: Special Olympics, news, Longyearbyen School, Trym Eide Aunevik

178584.excerpt_en: On Wednesday morning, the Governor of Svalbard’s police department decided to conduct what is known as a preventive alcohol check. This means testing people planning to go snowmobiling for alcohol levels before they get on their vehicles.
178584.subtitle_en: “This is disheartening,” says Senior Police Officer Kjell Arne Lundin of the Governor of Svalbard.
178584.tags_en: alcohol checks, Governor of Svalbard, news
178584.title_en: Five Men Had Excessive Blood-Alcohol Levels Before a Snowmobile Trip

178598.excerpt_en: The organisers of the Svalbard Ski Marathon have met with both Longyearbyen Community Council and the emergency services (the Governor of Svalbard), and have been given permission to move the start and finish areas into town as they wish.
178598.subtitle_en: The finish will be in the town centre if there is enough snow.
178598.title_en: Ski Festival and Finish in the Town Centre

178615.excerpt_en: “When this opportunity came up, I thought, ‘Yes!’” says a delighted Espen Klungseth Rotevatn, the school’s principal. So what was the opportunity?
178615.subtitle_en: Teaching at Svalbard Folk High School will take place right in the town centre, thanks to an agreement with the Olav Thon Group.
178615.tags_en: student dormitory, students, student housing, school, news, Lompen Centre, Svalbard Folk High School
178615.title_en: This Is Where the Folk High School Will Be

178621.excerpt_en: Everyone understands that it is not possible to scale up emergency preparedness around Svalbard to deal with a major shipwreck or maritime disaster involving many people. Maintaining a permanent emergency response would be far too costly and would draw resources away from emergency preparedness elsewhere in the country.
178621.subtitle_en: Evacuating a large vessel in our waters would be an impossible task.

178624.excerpt_en: Much has been written and said about rescue preparedness on Svalbard. When Viking Sky suffered an engine failure at Hustadvika last weekend, the issue was once again brought to the fore.
178624.subtitle_en: Last weekend, the cruise ship Viking Sky experienced engine problems off the coast of northwestern Norway. Its 1,300 passengers had to be evacuated. “This shows how challenging ships of this size are,” says Governor Kjerstin Askholt.
178624.tags_en: Svalbard Cruise Network, Norwegian Maritime Authority, rescue capacity, news, Kjerstin Askholt, cruise tourism, preparedness, Governor of Svalbard
178624.title_en: Governor: “We must focus on prevention to ensure adequate preparedness”

178640.excerpt_en: The first cruise ship of the season arrives in Longyearbyen at the end of May. Growth in the number of calls and tourists in recent years has been phenomenal.
178640.subtitle_en: From 2007 to last year, the number of cruise tourists increased by 140 percent. Tourism is levelling off this year, but the port director believes it will pick up again later.

178650.excerpt_en: Marcus Bech-Mikalsen was elected leader of the largest local party last year. He is moving south in the summer and therefore had to step down. “I am grateful for the confidence I have received as leader of the party for a year.”
178650.subtitle_en: The annual meeting of Svalbard Labour has elected Elise Strømseng as its new leader.
178650.title_en: Elise (36) takes over the Labour Party

178660.excerpt_en: The mail plane that was grounded because of a crack in a wing has now been repaired, Posten press chief John Eckhoff wrote in an email to Svalbardposten.
178660.subtitle_en: The aircraft has now been repaired.

178673.excerpt_en: Knut Espen Solberg has been project manager for the Sarex exercises on Svalbard through the University of Stavanger in recent years. He has also worked on the follow-up after the Northguider accident during the Christmas holidays.
178673.subtitle_en: A cruise ship carrying many people represents a vastly greater challenge, but it is not possible to size emergency preparedness for the largest ships.

178681.excerpt_en: “I fell in love with Svalbard immediately when I first visited in 2008. The idea for Icepeople came from wanting to be here and do something here.”
178681.subtitle_en: It has been ten years since the first issue of Icepeople was published. “The first issue was absolute crap compared with what I publish now,” says Mark Sabbatini of the one-man newsroom.
178681.title_en: Never thought Icepeople would celebrate its tenth anniversary

178692.excerpt_en: This week’s historical photo was taken in the summer of 1960. It is one of many photos taken by Erling J.

178709.excerpt_en: The rise in Svalbard’s temperature is now three times as great as that measured in Eastern Norway and six times higher than the global temperature increase.
178709.subtitle_en: For the past hundred months, temperatures on Svalbard have been above normal. “The situation is unique,” says a climate researcher.
178709.title_en: “We must adapt to a new reality”

178739.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten asked Minister of Civil Preparedness and Svalbard Ingvil Smines Tybring-Gjedde (Progress Party) when a legislative amendment or order limiting the number of passengers on cruise ships to Svalbard would be introduced. “We are monitoring developments in cruise traffic around Svalbard and continually assessing emergency preparedness and preventive measures in light of activity in the area and experience…”
178739.subtitle_en: The minister for civil preparedness will not say whether legislative changes will be introduced to limit the number of cruise tourists on cruise ships visiting Svalbard.

178741.excerpt_en: “We have already taken five weeks of vacation. The family travelled to Thailand for the entire month of February, and we have no vacation left in 2019,” says Stine Teigen.
178741.subtitle_en: In February, the Longyearbyen Community Council decided that children must be taken out of kindergarten for three consecutive weeks during the school summer holidays. This leaves many parents in a bind.
178741.tags_en: Childhood and Culture Committee, Longyearbyen Community Council, Polarflokken Kindergarten, Community Council, Kullungen Kindergarten, FAU, kindergartens, news
178741.title_en: In a bind because of mandatory vacation

178747.excerpt_en: Last Friday, school pupils and students from UNIS went on strike to protest that current climate policy is far too unambitious. Around 150 children, teenagers and young adults took part.
178747.subtitle_en: The students went on strike for more ambitious climate policies. If the principal is to be believed, they will not have any problems with their absences.
178747.tags_en: students, strike, principal, news, Longyearbyen School, climate, youth

178752.excerpt_en: After the snowmobile trip from Longyearbyen to Svea, it is good to come inside to a ready-made lunch and a warm welcome. Brianna is one of the people working shifts for Svea Svalbard during the season, which runs from February to May/June: one week on and one week off.
178752.subtitle_en: Brianna Mills (28) is working her second season in Svea. She welcomes tourists, students, researchers and permanent residents with open arms.

178762.excerpt_en: On Svalbard, we have often discussed what resources we have available if a large cruise ship needs to be evacuated in an emergency. The incident at Hustadvika last weekend was a reminder.
178762.subtitle_en: Linda Bakken has lived on Svalbard for many years. She raises several important questions about the large cruise ships arriving in Longyearbyen and the emergency preparedness surrounding them.

178778.excerpt_en: In the Svalbard budget, a new backup power plant has been given priority, with an estimated price tag of NOK 55.5 million. The Government proposes that the state cover half and requires the local council to finance the rest itself.
178778.subtitle_en: The local council believes it is right for the Government to cover all the costs of a new backup power plant. Otherwise, energy for everyone in Longyearbyen will become even more expensive.
178778.title_en: LL Wants the State to Pick Up the Entire Bill

178786.excerpt_en: What strikes you when you arrive in Svalbard as a tourist is the focus on polar bears. Whatever you search for, you see pictures of polar bears.
178786.subtitle_en: This tourist believes the tourism industry places too much emphasis on seeing polar bears.

178792.excerpt_en: “I question whether the decision by the Education and Culture Committee (OKU) was premature,” local council leader Arild Olsen (Labour) said from the podium.
178792.subtitle_en: Local council politicians dislike the decision requiring parents to take their children out of day care for three consecutive weeks during the school holiday.
178792.tags_en: news, Kullungen Kindergarten, Polarflokken Kindergarten, Longyearbyen Local Council
178792.title_en: Families Were Heard by Local Politicians

178796.excerpt_en: On Wednesday morning, crews from Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) and LNS Spitsbergen were present in Sjøområdet. They were all working to determine where the water that has leaked out recently is coming from. “We do not know much yet, but the leak is not large enough to affect the pressure.”
178796.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council has found the leak and begun repairing the district heating network.
178796.title_en: District Heating Network Springs a Leak in Sjøområdet

178802.excerpt_en: Posten is once again having problems with its aircraft. As Svalbardposten understands it, the issue is a cracked windshield that prevents the plane from following its scheduled route north.
178802.subtitle_en: Svalbardposten will arrive in Longyearbyen on Thursday afternoon.
178802.title_en: This Week’s Print Edition in Stores Thursday Evening

178814.excerpt_en: The strong words come from Tommy Jordbrudal of the dog-sledding company Husky Travellers in Bolterdalen. “This caught us off guard,” says Fred Skancke Hansen of UNIS.
178814.subtitle_en: “This simply cannot happen again. It is outright animal cruelty. Sheer madness.”
178814.tags_en: news, kennel, UNIS, research, animal health, Bolterdalen, Adventdalen, dog sledding
178814.title_en: UNIS Caught Off Guard When Blasts Spooked Dogs

178829.excerpt_en: In June last year, police received an unusual report. A man was driving around asking random people whether they knew anyone who could sell him drugs.
178829.subtitle_en: A man in his 30s drove around Longyearbyen asking people whether they knew anyone who could sell him drugs.
178829.title_en: Do You Know Where to Get Any Drugs?

178844.excerpt_en: “We are now being told that the new arrangement will be introduced this year. Tomorrow, Friday, is the deadline for reporting when we will take the children out,” sighs Stine Teigen.
178844.subtitle_en: The Education and Culture Committee (OKU) maintains that, starting this year, children must be taken out of day care for three consecutive weeks during the school summer holiday.
178844.tags_en: OKU, Longyearbyen Local Council, Kullungen Kindergarten, Polarflokken Kindergarten, news
178844.title_en: OKU Stands Its Ground in Day-Care Dispute

178852.excerpt_en: The researchers who carried out seismic blasting in Adventdalen have encountered what they consider unexpected resistance. In a fiery Facebook post, dog owners with more than 600 dogs throughout the valley have reacted strongly to the research activity.
178852.subtitle_en: We have just written about snowmobiles used in commercial operations that, following complaints from neighbors, have been ordered to move because of noise and exhaust fumes. This week, however, the conflicting interests do not involve the tourism industry and permanent residents.
178852.title_en: Frightened Dogs Give Research a Bad Name

178858.excerpt_en: Kenneth J. Braithwaite was appointed US ambassador to Norway on the 8th.
178858.subtitle_en: The US ambassador to Norway visited Svalbard this week. He acknowledges climate change and says the US will invest in more research in the Arctic.
178858.title_en: Trump’s Man Finally Came to Svalbard

178866.excerpt_en: Twenty-three teams have signed up for the increasingly traditional dog race on Svalbard. Pål Remen of the race committee says this year’s route will be the same as last year’s. “We’re heading to Semmelbu on Saturday.”
178866.subtitle_en: Saturday will bring a flurry of dogs and excitement at UNIS as the 11th edition of Trappers Trail gets under way.
178866.tags_en: news, dog teams, dog race, Trappers Trail, Longyearbyen Dog Club

178868.excerpt_en: “I am naturally interested in local politics and the direction in which this community is developing. It is exciting to contribute,” says the newly elected leader of the Svalbard Labour Party.
178868.subtitle_en: Elise Strømseng (36) has been elected the new leader of the Svalbard Labour Party. She will not discuss the possibility of becoming local council leader.
178868.tags_en: news, Svalbard Labour Party, Elise Strømseng, Arild Olsen, Longyearbyen Local Council

178884.excerpt_en: “We have an experienced Svalbard resident at the top,” says outgoing Progress Party leader Arnt Vegar Jensen. It became known within the party group this week that Dybdahl would head the list.
178884.subtitle_en: The Progress Party is running in this year’s local election with Jørn Dybdahl at the top of its party list.
178884.tags_en: news, politics, local council, Progress Party, local elections
178884.title_en: At the top of the Progress Party list

178893.excerpt_en: The report written by the Labour Inspection Authority following the inspection states that “neither the developer nor the coordinator had heard of five of the eight companies involved in the construction project.” So far, Svalbardposten has reported that three of the companies will receive administrative fines.
178893.subtitle_en: Two more companies have received notices of possible fines from the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority after its inspection of Polarhotellet in late January.
178893.tags_en: news, Hurtigruten Svalbard, Labour Inspection Authority, Working Environment Act, working life, Polarhotellet
178893.title_en: Five of eight have been fined

178920.excerpt_en: To transport diesel to Svea, KV Svalbard will break through the fast ice from Akseløya to Kapp Amsterdam in Svea starting Monday, 8 April. “The Svea community depends on diesel to function.”
178920.subtitle_en: A diesel shortage in Svea has made it necessary to transport a new supply by sea. Store Norske CEO Jan Morten Ertsaas says they have launched an internal review to ensure this does not happen again.
178920.title_en: “We regret that we have ended up in this situation”

178933.excerpt_en: In recent years, Svalbard society has changed, and we are now in the midst of a major transition. It is time to put solutions in place that enable residents, visitors and businesses to function better together in the same town.
178933.subtitle_en: The authors believe it is time to put the brakes on, and make adjustments through facilitation and regulation.
178933.tags_en: local elections, cruise tourism, opinion, readers’ letter
178933.title_en: Growth creates a need for facilitation and regulation

178938.excerpt_en: When the Norwegian Association of Local Newspapers (LLA) held its annual meeting last weekend, the association’s annual journalism award was presented. The award went to former Svalbardposten journalist Line Nagell Ylvisåker.
178938.subtitle_en: “The glossy image is cracking,” Svalbardposten wrote on its front page. The story concerned tourist guides’ working conditions. Now the newspaper has won an award for the story.
178938.title_en: “Shows how important it is for people to dare to come forward”

178950.excerpt_en: “It has always been LL’s goal to reach an agreement with Nikoline’s family. We have also tried to learn as much as possible from the tragic incident,” Local Council leader Arild Olsen told local politicians on Monday.

179329.excerpt_en: The artist first visited Svalbard last summer, and she finds it a fascinating place. 179386.excerpt_en: There is adventure and excitement in traveling so far afield. The round trip from Bamsebu to Hornsund covers 200 kilometers on skis, through mountains, glaciers and valleys in an enchanting white landscape, with all its changing colors, weather and snow conditions.

Closed roads will also be reopened for general traffic,” the Governor of Svalbard writes on its website.

179416.excerpt_en: Hunt-loving aristocrats, royals and other members of the upper class had often shot elephants in Africa and tigers in India before heading north. In the mid-19th century, the Arctic was still largely unmapped.

179926.excerpt_en: Our routine is to collect the week’s edition of Svalbardposten from the postal service on Thursday morning. The bundles are then driven out to the various sales outlets.
179926.subtitle_en: Help us solve the mystery of the missing newspaper.

179931.excerpt_en: The newspaper is being delivered to the city’s shops and hotels as you read this. Working for Svalbardposten involves tasks one would not normally encounter at newspapers on the mainland.
179931.subtitle_en: The mystery of the missing newspaper was solved after more than an hour of intense detective work.

179948.excerpt_en: The large Svalbard Bygg operations building, with a footprint of 370 square meters, is under construction. Managing director Trond Håvelsrud has planned alternative ways of heating the building.
179948.subtitle_en: Svalbard Bygg applied to the Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund for funding for a wood-fired heating system and solar collectors. It received NOK 70,000 for the solar collectors.
179948.title_en: Received Funding for Rooftop Solar Collectors

179966.excerpt_en: This week, the Greens finalized their list for this autumn’s local elections. It was clear early on that Pål Berg would become the party’s top candidate and thus its candidate for local council chair.
179966.subtitle_en: Benjamin Vidmar is the only person standing for re-election for the Green Party (MDG). Everyone else on the list is new.

179972.excerpt_en: Venstre is fielding a list of 21 names. Eirik Berger of the nomination committee is very pleased. “We are extremely proud of the list we have put together.”
179972.subtitle_en: Venstre has finalized its list for this autumn’s election. Over the weekend, the party held its first campaign stand to gather input.
179972.title_en: See Who Is Standing for Venstre

179975.excerpt_en: “We’ll have a varied and strong list,” assures Elise Strømseng, leader of the Longyearbyen Labour Party. The Labour election list was not ready when Svalbardposten went to print this week.
179975.subtitle_en: The Labour Party is finalising its list on Sunday.

179990.excerpt_en: On Friday afternoon, seven of this year’s ten russe students were on their way to the Russe Gathering at Kongeparken in Stavanger. “So far, it’s been very quiet. We’re sitting on the bus to Stavanger,” says Ingeborg Jenssen.
179990.subtitle_en: On the night of 1 May, the Longyearbyen russe held their baptism ceremony in the town square. Frida Krystad was christened Polarræv by priestess Henriette Larssen.
179990.title_en: Frida Was Given the Name Polarræv

180018.excerpt_en: “This is absolutely fantastic,” says the school’s finance officer, Pål Berg. Last Friday, he met the Minister of Research and Higher Education, Iselin Nybø (Venstre), who confirmed the news to him.
180018.subtitle_en: Svalbard Folk High School is receiving more government funding because providing housing for its students is so expensive.
180018.tags_en: Svalbard Folk High School, student housing, national budget, politics, news, Venstre

180020.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen has a long history as an industrial community. Now other industries are gradually taking over from mining.
180020.subtitle_en: Workers’ rights were put on the agenda on 1 May, both in the banners carried in the parade and at the evening event at the cultural centre afterwards.
180020.title_en: Celebrated Workers’ Day in Strong, Cold Headwinds

180042.excerpt_en: “To be honest, I think I was elected president because almost a year ago I took the initiative and said we had to start preparing for the russe season,” says Frida. “We really got things moving.”
180042.subtitle_en: As early as June last year, Frida Krystad (18) took action to prepare for the russe celebrations.
180042.title_en: Took Charge and Became the Boss

180058.excerpt_en: On Sunday, the Svalbard Labour Party adopted its final list for October’s local election. There had been long-standing speculation that the new leader, Elise Strømseng, would take the top spot on the list.
180058.subtitle_en: Arild Olsen (Labour) hopes to continue as local council chair in Longyearbyen.
180058.tags_en: news, local council chair, Svalbard Labour Party, local election

180075.excerpt_en: Over 25 years, they have gone from using only boats part of the year to year-round sea freight and air transport. Now they also have an electric vehicle.
180075.subtitle_en: Bring Svalbard has received one of five models in the Posten Group.
180075.title_en: Celebrated 25 Years on Svalbard by Getting an Electric Delivery Van

180077.excerpt_en: It is not every day that you get the chance to suggest a name for an area—and perhaps even be allowed to name a mountain peak or glacier. Some of the maps to be printed later this year are missing place names in certain areas.
180077.subtitle_en: Every year, the Norwegian Polar Institute publishes new maps. This time, they are missing names for several large glaciers, headlands, bays and mountain peaks.
180077.title_en: Name a Glacier or Mountain Peak

180096.excerpt_en: “This is very positive for us,” was Per Erik Hanevold’s first reaction when he heard the news. The government has just published its proposal for a revised national budget.
180096.subtitle_en: The government proposes allocating an additional two million kroner to Kings Bay. The money will go towards upgrading buildings in Ny-Ålesund.
180096.tags_en: national budget, politics, Svalbard Folk High School, Polarsyssel, news, Ny-Ålesund, seed vault, emergency preparedness, government

180111.excerpt_en: Ole Reistad’s letter to the editor, published on 5 May, rightly points to the discrepancy between the report “Climate in Svalbard 2100” and the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate’s assessments.

180117.excerpt_en: Some will probably be surprised by the Conservatives’ leading candidate. In May last year, a year and a half before the election, Svalbard Conservative Party nominated Kjetil Figenschou as its leading candidate for this year’s election.
180117.subtitle_en: Stein-Ove Johannessen (43) will become local council chair if the Conservatives win this autumn’s election.
180117.tags_en: Svalbard Conservative Party, news, local election

180131.excerpt_en: A Bewick’s swan was observed in Adventdalen last weekend. That is highly unusual.
180131.subtitle_en: “This is rare. A little spice in everyday life,” says Bjørn Frantzen of the Longyearbyen Field Ornithological Society.

180152.excerpt_en: Eivind Bratsberg, head of the County Governor’s education section, confirms that the case is still being processed.
180152.subtitle_en: The County Governor of Troms and Finnmark wants an even broader basis for its consideration of the case involving nine-year-old Ivano Cafuta, who has been denied a place at Longyearbyen School.
180152.title_en: Coming to Meet the Family and School Administration

180170.excerpt_en: The Progress Party has the “youngest” local branch in Svalbard and is running eight candidates on its list.
180170.subtitle_en: The Progress Party’s list for this year’s election was finalized on Monday this week.

180175.excerpt_en: Wednesday this week was the final deadline for local parties to submit their lists for this autumn’s local election. In Longyearbyen, five parties are running lists.
180175.title_en: Parties gear up for local battle for your vote

180187.excerpt_en: Whether you celebrate Constitution Day by marching in a parade, standing on a mountain peak or staying at home in your living room, we wish you a wonderful day. According to the forecast, the weather will be splendid, with temperatures from zero to minus one degree, sunshine and only a light breeze.
180187.subtitle_en: We hope May 17 brings wonderful experiences for all our readers.
180187.tags_en: Constitution Day, news, party, celebration, May 17, Constitution Day

180194.excerpt_en: Games, cakes, soda and ice cream. And entertainment.
180194.subtitle_en: For many people, May 17 simply isn’t complete without a trip to Svalbardhallen.

180211.excerpt_en: “This came completely unexpectedly. I perhaps prefer having a small supporting role,” Ottar Svensen said when he received the award at a packed cultural center on May 17.
180211.subtitle_en: This year’s recipient of the Tyfus statuette has been involved in almost every aspect of the town’s cultural life during the 15 years he has lived here.

180214.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen’s resident mood-booster, Trym Aunevik, suddenly became the center of attention when his name was read out. He has made his mark in many fields, and over the past six months he has truly distinguished himself on the international swimming scene.
180214.subtitle_en: There was great cheering in the hall when this year’s recipient of the Youth Culture Grant was announced.
180214.tags_en: news, youth, culture, May 17, culture grant

180227.excerpt_en: The new public facility is scheduled to be ready on June 14 and will replace the tent that has housed the tourist information office in recent years.
180227.subtitle_en: The modules that will become a new public facility and a sanitary building are ready on the boat in the harbor. Piling work will begin shortly.
180227.title_en: Building a public facility and sanitary facilities

180249.excerpt_en: There has long been a desire to do something about the town’s pedestrian street.
180249.subtitle_en: The skate ramp may disappear, and Bruktikken may be relocated. Large lizards from the past are coming in. Plans for Gågata are beginning to take shape.
180249.title_en: New paving stones, new lawn—and lizards

180257.excerpt_en: When it emerged at the eleventh hour, just before construction began, that the new homes at Vei 232 would be 2.4 meters higher than originally planned, the closest neighbors complained. Eight neighbors submitted a complaint to Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) on the 23rd.
180257.subtitle_en: LL rejects the complaint from the neighbors of the construction project in Gruvedalen. Because they are only tenants and therefore—even though some have lived here for 15 years—do not have a sufficiently strong connection to the place.
180257.tags_en: news, Gruvedalen, building permit, construction cases, homebuilding, Statsbygg

180267.excerpt_en: When Svalbard Minister Ingvil Smines Tybring-Gjedde visited the power plant last Wednesday, both boilers stopped and the entire plant shut down. The town was switched to backup power and heating plants.
180267.subtitle_en: The power plant came to a complete stop during the minister’s visit.
180267.title_en: “It was rather fitting that the minister was here”

180273.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the accident at 11:30 a.m. on Sunday. A woman and a man had set out on a trip from the station on Friday.
180273.subtitle_en: Two people from the Polish research station were killed in an avalanche east of Hornsund at the weekend. They were found around lunchtime on Sunday.
180273.tags_en: avalanche, Hornsund, fatal accident, avalanche accident, news
180273.title_en: Two killed in avalanche in Hornsund

180300.excerpt_en: The station manager at Hornsund was in Poland when the avalanche accident occurred. Now he wants to get to Svalbard as quickly as possible to assist and support his colleagues.
180300.subtitle_en: “This is a difficult situation for all of us,” says station manager Wlodek Sielski. The names of the two people killed in the avalanche have now been released.
180300.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, avalanche accident, avalanche, news, Hornsund, summit tour
180300.title_en: Releasing the Names and More Details About the Accident

180307.excerpt_en: March 2019 was the 100th consecutive month with above-normal temperatures in Svalbard.
180307.subtitle_en: Svalbard is a powerful symbol of a changing climate. Norwegian politicians often bring international guests here to illustrate the dramatic changes. With good reason: climate change is clearly visible in the vulnerable Arctic landscape.
180307.title_en: Svalbard—from Coal Dependence to Renewable Role Model

180311.excerpt_en: It was on 10 December last year that the local council asked the administration to draw up a plan for establishing a project position focused on energy.
180311.subtitle_en: “If we are going to have an opinion on the energy transition, we need the capacity to work on it,” says operations engineer Rasmus Bøckmann.
180311.tags_en: energy efficiency, energy transition, news, power station

180319.excerpt_en: Frantz Vangen, chief union representative at Hurtigruten Svalbard, believes the process has been orderly. The employees were informed about the transfer of operations at a meeting on Monday the 6th.
180319.subtitle_en: From 1 June, all 23 cleaning workers currently employed by Hurtigruten Svalbard are scheduled to move to new contracts with ISS.
180319.title_en: ISS to Take Over Cleaning for Hurtigruten Svalbard

180324.excerpt_en: AirDNA is a monitoring company that searches for and systematises information about activity in housing markets through the Airbnb sharing service. The company also sells services related to correctly pricing rental properties, investment advice and analyses of rental markets.
180324.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council and Visit Svalbard want to learn more about Airbnb activity in Longyearbyen. They are getting help from an American company called AirDNA.

180338.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Environment Agency has previously rejected the establishment of monitoring stations in the Nordenskiöld Land and Sassen-Bünsow Land national parks. The Polar Institute appealed the decision.
180338.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Polar Institute has applied to set up weather stations at various locations on Spitsbergen.
180338.tags_en: protected area, news, Norwegian Polar Institute, Norwegian Environment Agency, climate, research, weather observations
180338.title_en: When Researchers Wanted to Set Up Stations in Protected Areas, the Directorate Put Its Foot Down

180347.excerpt_en: After three minutes talking to the Greens’ second candidate in this year’s local elections, we understand why the party has ranked Olivia Ericson so highly. Her infectious laughter, combined with a lack of self-importance, is captivating.
180347.subtitle_en: Olivia Ericson (36) is organised and likes plans. But plans are made to be changed.
180347.tags_en: people, Svalbard life, Svalbard Greens, Olivia Ericson, Greens, Svea Svalbard, back page

180356.excerpt_en: This year’s 17 May celebration on Bjørnøya was a crowded affair.
180356.subtitle_en: While Bjørnøya had an exceptionally large 17 May parade this year, the people’s parade on Hopen consisted of four people.
180356.title_en: Mixed 17 May Turnout on Bjørnøya and Hopen

180375.excerpt_en: “There appears to be a problem in the uppermost soil and rock layers at Sukkertoppen. It will be difficult to properly anchor the planned support structures,” says Øyvind Hellum, project manager for avalanche protection at Longyearbyen Local Council (LL).
180375.subtitle_en: In the worst-case scenario, it may become necessary to demolish 41 homes in Vei 228. They come in addition to the 139 housing units already slated for demolition.
180375.tags_en: avalanche protection, NVE, Ellen Fagerslett, Øyvind Hellum, news
180375.title_en: Another 41 Housing Units in the Danger Zone

180390.excerpt_en: “The new climate projections have established new parameters for the detailed design of the protective measures at Sukkertoppen. This applies particularly to the foundations,” regional director Knut Aune Hoseth writes in an email to Svalbardposten.
180390.subtitle_en: NVE will not prejudge the outcome, but the directorate admits that the climate projections have created new challenges.

180396.excerpt_en: They were found not far from the water’s edge. One woman and one man.
180396.subtitle_en: They set out on a ski trip from the research station on Friday. When they had not returned by Sunday morning, a search operation began. What they found was not what they had hoped for.

180410.excerpt_en: “We took a trial run of the new route and found that it was fine,” says 17 May committee chair Kristin Furu Grøtting.
180410.subtitle_en: Parade, speeches, ice cream, sausages and, not least, windless weather. Everything was as it should be on the national day.
180410.title_en: Longer route a success in the 17 May parade

180412.excerpt_en: Several of these homes are privately owned. Svalbardposten has previously followed Jon Bautz and his family’s long struggle to obtain compensation for their privately owned home on Vei 226.
180412.subtitle_en: The news that a further 41 homes may have to be demolished on Vei 228 came as a complete surprise to the people living there.

180425.excerpt_en: When Minister of Research and Higher Education Iselin Nybø (Liberal Party) recently visited Svalbard, she brought an unexpected financial gift. UNIS has already come a long way in using nature as a laboratory and classroom, and new ways of teaching students will now be developed.
180425.subtitle_en: Students in Svalbard are already working in the world’s largest classroom. Now UNIS is receiving an additional NOK 4.7 million to make field teaching even better.
180425.title_en: Almost NOK 5 million for more field-based teaching

180432.excerpt_en: Hear what these people have to say: Anne-Lise Klungseth Sandvik, an engaged permanent resident; Jo Gudbrand Lian, a Svalbard enthusiast; Tor Etrigan Engh, a local snowmobile driver and cook at Kroa; Anders Magnusson, a cook at Huset; and Olivia Ericson, who works at Svea Svalbard.
180432.subtitle_en: We round off the week with a short video featuring local tips and useful advice from people who know the town and its residents well.
180432.title_en: Have a good weekend from Longyearbyen

180460.excerpt_en: Many people turned up for an evening of country music. The tables were full, and some guests took the opportunity to arrive in boots and cowboy hats.
180460.subtitle_en: Cowboys do not often descend on Longyearbyen. But on Friday evening, the audience was treated to a solid dose of country music.
180460.title_en: A musical cowboy party at Huset

180473.excerpt_en: She meets Svalbardposten at Fruene. Beforehand, she had to think carefully about the request to appear on the back page. “The thought made me physically ill—almost nauseous, yes.”
180473.subtitle_en: Stine Teigen (40) leaves the summit hikes to others.
180473.tags_en: Svalbard Conservatives, Norwegian Arctic Student Welfare Organisation, Kroa, people, back page, Svalbard life

180479.excerpt_en: The time is long overdue to take a closer look at the facilities available for sport and physical activity in Longyearbyen. Svalbardhallen has been at capacity for several years.
180479.subtitle_en: We must put sports policy on the agenda.

180495.excerpt_en: Gym class was a little different last week. The police brought along some of the exercises used for admission to the Norwegian Police University College.
180495.subtitle_en: Two days before 17 May, the graduating students and the other pupils at the upper secondary school got to try police fitness tests.

180501.excerpt_en: A number of words such as arrogant and theatre have surfaced. Yes, the Governor of Svalbard is staging a performance, and it requires at least a master’s degree.
180501.subtitle_en: When it comes to the case concerning the traffic ban in Tempelfjorden, it is the part referring to “ad absurdum”, in the context of the Svalbard Treaty.

180531.excerpt_en: When the bear became a little too inquisitive and was heading straight for the town’s dog park, a helicopter was sent out to scare it away. Here you can see how it moved out towards Revneset.
180531.subtitle_en: The polar bear was filmed by the Governor of Svalbard and Lufttransport as they chased it out towards Revneset on Monday morning.
180531.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, news, Lufttransport, polar bear, helicopter, wildlife
180531.title_en: Here, the bear is chased towards Revneset

180538.excerpt_en: For us, it is not so important whether Arild Olsen, Terje Aunevik or Kjetil Figenschou becomes local council leader. Longyearbyen will be just fine regardless.
180538.subtitle_en: The Progress Party in Longyearbyen is the newcomer in the upcoming election.

180551.excerpt_en: The strategy is intended as a governing document providing clear guidelines for research activity at 79 degrees north. The Norwegian Polar Institute (NP) has academic leadership, while Kings Bay is responsible for facilitating the operation of the facilities.
180551.subtitle_en: The research strategy intended to strengthen Norway’s host role is ready. It is the first for Ny-Ålesund.

180553.excerpt_en: “This will be the world’s most environmentally friendly ship. It will be able to run solely on electricity for three hours, wherever in the world it is,” says Atle Brynestad.
180553.subtitle_en: If everything goes according to plan for these two men, the first cruise ship with its home port in Longyearbyen will soon be a reality.
180553.tags_en: business, Longyearbyen port, cruise tourism, cruise ship, ship registry, news
180553.title_en: First cruise ship to have its home port in Longyearbyen

180559.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten stopped by Klassekampen’s stand outside Svalbardbutikken on Tuesday. Carl Mathias Karlsson was signing up for a free three-week subscription to Klassekampen. “I’m from Oslo and know the newspaper a little from my time there,” says the 28-year-old.
180559.subtitle_en: Consto employee Carl Mathias Karlsson (28) was happy to accept a free three-week subscription to Norway’s reddest newspaper.
180559.title_en: Klassekampen celebrates 50th anniversary in the north

180601.excerpt_en: Businesses are struggling with more than just finding homes for new employees. Recently, LNSS bought a 300-square-metre warehouse for NOK 5 million on a leased plot.
180601.subtitle_en: There is no point injecting NOK 20 million into a local community if development plans and plots are not prepared for growth.
180601.title_en: Businesses Must Be Given Room to Grow

180606.excerpt_en: Terje Aunevik is the Liberal Party’s candidate for local council chair and managing director of logistics company Pole Position. The company, now owned by Store Norske, was involved for a long time but had to withdraw from the bidding for the warehouse at Bykaia.
180606.subtitle_en: Those aspiring to become local council chair after the autumn election have no trouble admitting that the town faces challenges concerning available land.
180606.tags_en: Stein-Ove Johannessen, Terje Aunevik, local election, Hotellneset, Arild Olsen, news

180637.excerpt_en: Svalsat is the world’s largest station for downloading data. Its customer list includes NASA and a number of other international clients.
180637.subtitle_en: On Saturday, Svalsat invited the public to an open day. It was popular with young and old alike.
180637.title_en: Many Wanted to Reach Longyearbyen’s Rooftop

180640.excerpt_en: Store Norske had closed the mine so that the women’s choir could perform in the surface facilities. Chairs had been set up in the large hall, and a small bar had been arranged.
180640.subtitle_en: The week’s cultural highlight came when Tundradundrene performed a concert in the mine.
180640.tags_en: Tundradundrene, Mine 7, concert, choir, culture, Store Norske, Svalbard life

180645.excerpt_en: Three groups of gymnasts demonstrated their skills on Wednesday evening. They are divided into three groups, with nine coaches in total.
180645.subtitle_en: Young gymnasts from Svalbard Turn showed their best side for parents and other attendees on Wednesday.

180687.excerpt_en: Fourteen-year-old Ella Krystad has lived in Longyearbyen virtually all her life. On Saturday, she ran 10 kilometres in 49:23, making her the fastest female runner.
180687.subtitle_en: Ella Krystad won the Spitsbergenmila in this year’s Spitsbergen Marathon. Longyearbyen also took a one-two finish in the men’s race, with 15-year-old Martin Higraff in second place.
180687.title_en: Ella (14) Was the Fastest Woman in the 10K

180711.excerpt_en: I’m wearing my snowmobile suit. Underneath, I have two layers of wool from head to toe.
180711.subtitle_en: Here I am, sitting on Deltaneset, enjoying the view. Fortunately, I’m not a badly dressed cruise pensioner.
180711.tags_en: search and rescue, Governor of Svalbard, Red Cross, rescue exercise, opinion, editorial, KV Svalbard, cruise, preparedness, exercise

180719.excerpt_en: Representatives from Troms and Finnmark County Municipality were in Longyearbyen last Monday and Tuesday to investigate further the case of Ivano Cafuta (9), who was refused a place at Longyearbyen School. “We have met both the boy and his family, as well as representatives from Longyearbyen Local Council and…”
180719.subtitle_en: The decision on a school place for Ivano Cafuta (9) will be ready within a couple of weeks.
180719.tags_en: rights, school, Longyearbyen Local Council, children, news

180774.excerpt_en: The new bylaws have been available for public inspection at Svalbardbutikken since 28 May and Thursday the 6th.
180774.subtitle_en: The new election rules will not change Svalbardbutikken’s special arrangements, such as subsidised milk and higher member rebates.

180787.excerpt_en: With 553 participants, plus the children taking part in the mini-marathon, this year’s Spitsbergen Marathon made history as the race with by far the most participants to date. And the growth may continue. “We have already received quite a few registrations for next year’s marathon.”
180787.subtitle_en: No one who ran the 2019 Spitsbergen Marathon complained, but absolutely everyone highlighted the strong winds as a tough challenge.
180787.title_en: Tough Marathon in Strong Winds, but Only Smiles in Sight

180789.excerpt_en: “It’s lovely to see that it’s back,” says Bjørn Frantzen of the Longyearbyen Field Biology Association (LoFF). But what is it?
180789.subtitle_en: It turns out to be an old acquaintance among the town’s ornithologists.
180789.tags_en: news, ornithology, goose, birdlife, animals, LoFF
180789.title_en: Unusual White Goose Spotted in Town—but What Is It?

180798.excerpt_en: At the tourism council’s board meeting in May, a unanimous board decided to expel the company, also known as Xarctic, effective immediately. The decision was taken because the company had breached the council’s guidelines. “They have violated the bylaws on several occasions.”
180798.subtitle_en: Experience Arctic was barred with immediate effect on 10 May after repeated violations of the association’s bylaws.
180798.tags_en: tourism industry, Visit Svalbard, news, guiding industry, tourism
180798.title_en: Barred from the Svalbard Tourism Council

180816.excerpt_en: “It’s simply nice to take part in this. Everyone has to contribute.”
180816.subtitle_en: Around a hundred enthusiastic litter pickers of all ages set out from Svalbardhallen on Wednesday afternoon.

180831.excerpt_en: Svalbard is a popular place for all kinds of businesses to start selling tourism products. New companies, including one-person businesses, keep appearing, all wanting a piece of the pie.
180831.subtitle_en: Tour operators and sole proprietorships that could damage the destination’s reputation must be stopped.

180843.excerpt_en: There is one fundamental difference between last year and this year, too. Last year, the Merseyside side lost to Real Madrid.
180843.subtitle_en: As last year, Liverpool reached the Champions League final. And as last year, Longyearbyen was marked by it.

180850.excerpt_en: “Polarsyssel” is almost at the vessel. The crew of “Havsel” has controlled the leak, and they have started the main engine so the boat can proceed under its own power,” says Alf Hågensen of the Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway (HRS).
180850.subtitle_en: The sealing vessel “Havsel” has brought the situation under control after taking on water early Thursday morning.
180850.tags_en: news, Havsel, Polarsyssel, Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway

180863.excerpt_en: On Wednesday, Svalbard police received a call from a cruise ship. The ship was then at Smeerenburg, in northwestern Spitsbergen.
180863.subtitle_en: There was a doctor on board, but his life could not be saved.
180863.tags_en: news, cruise, Governor of Svalbard, death
180863.title_en: Young man dies aboard cruise ship

180903.excerpt_en: Shortly before 5 p.m., the Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway (HRS) was notified that the cruise/passenger ship “Rembrandt van Rijn” was in trouble. The ship had run aground in Borebukta, on the opposite side of Isfjorden. “Polarsyssel” and the pilot boat “Elling Carlsen” are on site.
180903.subtitle_en: The cruise and passenger ship “Rembrandt van Rijn” is aground in Borebukta.

180909.excerpt_en: “I proposed holding local council meetings during the day. When that was voted down, it was undoubtedly the final nail in the coffin for my participation in local politics,” says Espen Klungseth Rotevatn (37).
180909.subtitle_en: Combining political office with family life ultimately became impossible for one of them. The other still serves on the local council, but says the most important thing is being a mother.
180909.tags_en: politics, local election, family, democracy, kindergarten, parents of young children, news
180909.title_en: “In the worst case, our age group could face a democratic deficit”

180916.excerpt_en: Four months remain before the people of Longyearbyen go to the polls. Svalbardposten has recently presented the lists of the parties standing in this autumn’s election.
180916.subtitle_en: Is it possible to combine the two? This week, we write about two politicians who have made different choices.
180916.title_en: Local politics needs parents of young children

180933.excerpt_en: At around 5 p.m. on Saturday, the Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway (HRS) was notified that the sailing ship “Rembrandt van Rijn” was in trouble in Borebukta, on the opposite side of Isfjorden from Longyearbyen. The vessel was aground.
180933.subtitle_en: The sailing ship “Rembrandt van Rijn” was towed off the shallows in Borebukta at around five o’clock Saturday morning.
180933.tags_en: Polarsyssel, Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway, Rembrandt van Rijn, news
180933.title_en: Escaped grounding with only minor damage

180936.excerpt_en: Increased precipitation causes more runoff from melting glaciers, greater river flows and larger quantities of sediment to be carried into Svalbard’s lakes. There is now solid evidence of this.
180936.subtitle_en: It is six metres long and may contain as much as 9,000 years of climate history. Samples from Lake Linné will help identify more reliable signs that today’s fluctuations are unnatural.
180936.tags_en: news, UNIS, Cape Linné, research, climate
180936.title_en: Seeking climate answers in Lake Linné

180953.excerpt_en: While collisions between birds and aircraft used to occur two or three times a month, it has now been several years since the last “bird strike,” as it is known in aviation jargon. Wind-turbine manufacturers and conservationists are now interested in Svalbard’s experience.
180953.subtitle_en: The number of bird collisions has dropped dramatically after Air Transport painted the propellers on its Svalbard aircraft in a special pattern.

180960.excerpt_en: Melkeveien has been without a bridge since August last year. The only way past the site has been to walk across the riverbed of the Longyearelva.
180960.subtitle_en: “We are considering both temporary and permanent solutions,” LL says. Until then, the shortest road connection between the town centre and Skjæringa remains without a bridge.
180960.title_en: New bridge at least a year away

180984.excerpt_en: At a meeting of the Longyearbyen election committee on Tuesday, it was decided to bar Albrigtsen from standing as a candidate in this autumn’s election. Albrigtsen was listed as the local list’s third candidate.
180984.subtitle_en: Roy Albrigtsen (50) of the Progress Party has been rejected as a candidate in this autumn’s election.
180984.tags_en: news, Progress Party, politics, local election
180984.title_en: Not Allowed to Stand for Election

180989.excerpt_en: “I’ve really found my dream job,” Ida says with a smile when she meets Svalbardposten at Fruene café. The 33-year-old is referring to the job she got at the school in Longyearbyen this spring. There, she does everything from working in the after-school program to covering classes, and she has caught the bug. “No two days are alike, and the children give so much.”
180989.subtitle_en: Ida Lehn (33) was going to become a mechanical engineer. That was before she started working at Longyearbyen School.
180989.tags_en: Svalbard Conservatives, Svalbard life, people, back page, Longyearbyen School

181016.excerpt_en: “A new camp is planned in Svea from December 2019, and this removes the basis for tourism operations in Svea. The owners of the tourism company Svea Svalbard AS, Hurtigruten and Store Norske, will carry out an orderly winding-up of the company,” writes SNSK CEO Jan Morten Ertsaas in a press release.
181016.subtitle_en: After three seasons of tourist operations, Svea Svalbard is coming to an end.
181016.tags_en: Svea, news, Svea Svalbard, Store Norske
181016.title_en: Tourism in Svea to Be Wound Up

181027.excerpt_en: The government has adopted new and stricter rules for passenger ships operating in Svalbard. The regulation enters into force on 1.
181027.subtitle_en: The most sensible approach is prevention, restrictions on traffic and stricter safety requirements.
181027.title_en: Right to Tighten Safety Requirements for Ships

181032.excerpt_en: In his understated manner, and with an undertone of well-established “men’s choir humor,” Lystrup Thesen guided the audience through a two-hour concert in truly unique surroundings.
181032.subtitle_en: Store Norske Mandskor, with host Sveinung Lystrup Thesen, had a packed Cableway Central laughing and crying.

181061.excerpt_en: At nine o’clock on Friday morning, TUI’s “Mein Schiff 4” pulled into port in Longyearbyen. The ship is carrying more than 2,500 passengers, over 90 percent of them German, and all are German-speaking.
181061.subtitle_en: “Mein Schiff” will remain berthed in Longyearbyen for twelve hours.
181061.title_en: German Cruise Tourists Greeted by Glorious Weather

181066.excerpt_en: Here we go again. At this morning’s editorial meeting, the Svalbardposten team agreed that it was time to launch the annual guessing competition for when the snow stump will fall.
181066.subtitle_en: The snow stump has become increasingly visible since the competition began in mid-June, when this picture was taken.
181066.title_en: When Will the Snow Stump Fall in 2019?

181084.excerpt_en: Beforehand, they rehearsed with experienced violinist Snorre Holmgren. The first thing they did was tune their violins.
181084.subtitle_en: Four of the music school’s six violinists gave a concert at Lompensenteret on Friday.
181084.title_en: Got to Rehearse with a Real Musician

181096.excerpt_en: With large rubbish bags in hand and an alert eye, the very youngest joined the adults in a hunt for litter.
181096.subtitle_en: Just over 100 people collected more than four tonnes of rubbish.
181096.title_en: This Is How Much Rubbish They Collected

181123.excerpt_en: “We have cheesecake from Italy, chocolate-chip cookies from Congo, a smoothie from Brazil and goulash, which is Hungary’s national dish,” says Linnea Våtvik (11). Together with the other members of the food group, Linnea found recipes for exotic and unfamiliar dishes on Google and made them herself.
181123.subtitle_en: The middle grades at Longyearbyen School organized their own “travel fair.”
181123.title_en: Tastes of Congo, Italy and Peru

181135.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten wrote in February that demolition of the first homes in Lia would begin in May. The alert reader may note that the calendar now says we are in mid-June.
181135.subtitle_en: The tender competition for clearing homes and buildings in Lia has still not been issued. As a result, demolition will not take place until after the summer at the earliest.
181135.title_en: More and More Homes Are Being Emptied, but Demolition Is Delayed

181159.excerpt_en: When applying for an unsecured personal loan, or consumer loan, there are several things you should remember. This type of financing is expensive, and it is easy to end up in a situation where servicing the debt becomes difficult.
181159.subtitle_en: Get tips on your rights as a borrower.
181159.title_en: Need Consumer Financing? Here’s What to Watch Out For

181169.excerpt_en: “I’ve been able to follow the choir in everything it has done—rehearsals, trips and parties,” says photographer Børge Damsgård. He has followed the choir for so long and so closely that he can almost be considered a member.
181169.subtitle_en: The photographer has followed Store Norske Mandskor for two and a half years. Last weekend, he opened a photography exhibition.
181169.tags_en: Svalbard life, culture, choir, photography, Cableway Central, Store Norske Mandskor

181185.excerpt_en: Good security and a high level of preparedness for unwanted incidents are crucial to sustainable development in Arctic communities and healthy economic development in the northern areas. All commercial activity in the north must therefore include a security and emergency-preparedness dimension.
181185.subtitle_en: That is how Rolf Jacobsen concludes his poem “North” from the collection “Open All Night.” Perhaps this has inspired important measures and decisions concerning societal security and emergency preparedness in the wake of recent events in the northern areas?

181197.excerpt_en: At the university guesthouse, guests are greeted by elephants, swans, flowers and other decorations beautifully folded from towels and washcloths. “They’re meant to be used, even though they’re decorations,” says the artist. To be on the safe side, she puts extra towels in the rooms so guests can enjoy her creations for a long time.
181197.subtitle_en: With nimble hands, Sunan Sangkharak (51) turns towels into pure art. Guests at UNIS Guesthouse respond with spontaneous delight.
181197.title_en: Making the Arctic More Beautiful, One Fold at a Time

181232.excerpt_en: On Monday, local politicians voted to purchase a new backup power solution for the town. They chose a “container solution” with an output of 6 megawatts.
181232.subtitle_en: To be delivered in just under a year.
181232.tags_en: news, energy solution, backup power, Energy Works

181236.excerpt_en: You have probably noticed it. Longyearbyen is the town of snowmobiles.
181236.subtitle_en: The Governor’s Office has had enough of snowmobiles and snowmobile wrecks left lying around Longyearbyen. “The town needs clear guidelines for parking snowmobiles and sleds,” says Lisbeth Hansen.
181236.tags_en: rubbish, snowmobile, snowmobile wrecks, scrap, news, land-use plan, Governor of Svalbard
181236.title_en: Ashamed of the Town’s Snowmobile Wrecks—Wants Clear Rules

181251.excerpt_en: There was recently a community cleanup, as well as another cleanup campaign this weekend in memory of Sarah Auffret, who died in a plane crash earlier this year. Silvia Galli has started her own campaign against cigarette butts.
181251.subtitle_en: It hardly adds up for Svalbard to be one of the world’s best-preserved wilderness areas and a sustainable destination when we produce 12 kilos of rubbish a day in the town centre alone.
181251.title_en: “We Don’t Want It to Be Like This”

181267.excerpt_en: Together with Hurtigruten Svalbard and Svalbardbutikken, Aktiv i friluft organized a local cleanup campaign for Sarah Auffret in Adventdalen last Sunday. Auffret died in a plane crash in Ethiopia this winter, in which all 157 people on board were killed.
181267.subtitle_en: Honoured her deceased friend by cleaning up rubbish in Adventdalen.
181267.tags_en: rubbish, news, environment, Aktiv i friluft, AECO, Adventdalen, cleanup

181272.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten meets Hauan at Sjøskrenten. We are located behind Svalbard Snowmobile Rental’s (SSU) premises.
181272.subtitle_en: “We clean up and clean up, both professionally and through volunteer efforts. But few businesses do anything—not until we call them,” says Karine Hauan of the local council.
181272.tags_en: waste management, business, news, environment, rubbish, Longyearbyen local council, waste
181272.title_en: “It’s a Paradox That This Is Allowed to Continue”

181297.excerpt_en: Former leader of Svalbard Labour, Marcus Bech Mikalsen (pictured), said goodbye at Monday’s local council meeting. The 34-year-old is moving to the mainland for family reasons after living in Longyearbyen for just over a decade.
181297.subtitle_en: Former leader of Svalbard Labour is moving to the mainland.
181297.tags_en: news, Marcus Bech Mikalsen, Svalbard Labour

181300.excerpt_en: “Many will probably say we are a drinking club with a choir problem,” host Sveinung Lystrup Thesen joked at the outset. In his understated manner, and with an undertone of well-established “men’s choir humour,” he guided the audience through a two-hour concert in highly unusual surroundings.
181300.subtitle_en: The Taubanesentralen men’s choir struck a chord with the audience, performing everything from love hymns to Ormen Lange.

181332.excerpt_en: Today, a place in a Longyearbyen kindergarten costs NOK 3,530 per month, including food. This is in line with the government’s maximum rates.
181332.subtitle_en: Svalbard Labour wants to introduce sibling discounts for families with children in kindergarten or after-school care.
181332.title_en: Sibling Discounts Between Kindergarten and After-School Care

181355.excerpt_en: Ninety percent of children who have received support through the organization score highly in a survey on quality of life. This is shown by a new report from SOS Children’s Villages.
181355.subtitle_en: Anne Lise Klungseth on behalf of SOS Children’s Villages
181355.title_en: Thank You for Cheering Us On for 70 Years

181371.excerpt_en: It is three and a half years since the Education and Culture Committee (OKU) of the Longyearbyen local council asked the administration to investigate a consolidated kindergarten service linked to Polarflokken Kindergarten. The idea has been for this new, large kindergarten to benefit from being located near Longyearbyen School.
181371.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen politicians are planning to bring the kindergartens together at one location in the future. It will be expensive.
181371.tags_en: education and upbringing, Polarflokken Kindergarten, Longyearbyen School, Longyearbyen local council, Kullungen Kindergarten, news
181371.title_en: Expensive Consolidation of the Youngest Children

181430.excerpt_en: The demolition of the Svea community has set several people thinking about logistics and reuse. On Monday, local council politicians were briefed on ideas and opportunities connected with the major changes now taking place in Svalbard.
181430.subtitle_en: The demolition of Svea and 140 homes in Longyearbyen presents opportunities that many could benefit from, says local council leader Arild Olsen (Labour).
181430.tags_en: Store Norske, Svea, Lunckefjell, LPO Architects, shutdown, news
181430.title_en: Plans to Reuse the Svea Community

181437.excerpt_en: Silje M. Hagen has been hired as the new general manager of all of Longyearbyen’s sports club.
181437.subtitle_en: “We look forward to her helping shape the club going forward with her creativity and enthusiasm,” says the chair.
181437.tags_en: news, Svalbard Turn, club leader, active outdoors, names
181437.title_en: She Is the New Head of Svalbard Turn

181451.excerpt_en: Tourism is an important part of Longyearbyen, and that is a good thing. But there are two major challenges: • Safety: Unfortunately, some visiting guides do not have sufficient expertise.
181451.subtitle_en: Pål Berg on tourism in Longyearbyen
181451.title_en: The Greens Say Yes to Responsible Tourism!

181466.excerpt_en: If you have not heard already, you should read on. On Thursday and Saturday, Longyearbyen will host two concerts of an exclusive kind.
181466.subtitle_en: “There’s no time to wait. Run and buy,” says concert promoter Jim Johansen.
181466.tags_en: news, culture, concert, Robert Plant, tickets, Longyearbyen Culture Centre

181472.excerpt_en: A year and a half ago, Maria Rossi (35), her partner and their two children packed their bags to experience their next adventure: Longyearbyen. “Both my partner and I travelled a lot in our previous lives—that is, before we had children.”
181472.subtitle_en: Maria Rossi (35) believes getting out of mobile coverage is underrated.
181472.title_en: “You Have to Look Up and Enjoy It”

181474.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard told Svalbardposten readers last week that they want permanent solutions for where the town’s snowmobiles may park. They are tired of snowmobiles and wrecks being parked haphazardly on the town’s roads.
181474.subtitle_en: To explore options for setting aside more areas for snowmobile parking.
181474.tags_en: rubbish, Store Norske, wrecked snowmobiles, snowmobile parking, news, Longyearbyen Local Council, waste, land-use plan, Governor of Svalbard
181474.title_en: Three Agencies Meet After Newspaper Reports on Wrecked Snowmobiles

181485.excerpt_en: “We knew it would work out in the end. But it has taken a very long time, and many people have been involved.”
181485.subtitle_en: Ivano Cafuta (9) and his family have won their appeal. The nine-year-old is entitled to primary education at Longyearbyen School.

181511.excerpt_en: After waiting a year, Ivano Cafuta (9) has received the school place he is entitled to at Longyearbyen School. The County Governor of Troms and Finnmark ruled on the 13th.
181511.subtitle_en: Although Svalbard has a reduced range of public services and a correspondingly low level of taxation, this boy must not bear the consequences. As long as he lives here, he must receive the education to which he is entitled.

181545.excerpt_en: That is the view of Karine Margrethe Hauan, LL’s operations engineer for waste management and the environment. According to the engineer, the sludge now being sent to Tromsø is minimally polluted.
181545.subtitle_en: Having to send the car-wash waste by boat to the mainland ought to be unnecessary.
181545.title_en: “Should Be Allowed to Deposit the Waste Here”

181548.excerpt_en: “Look at this. They’re lined up one after another,” says Fire Chief Jan Olav Sæter.
181548.subtitle_en: After reading about littering and wrecked snowmobiles, the fire chief decided it was time to take a tour of the town. He went snowmobile fuel-can hunting with Svalbardposten. And they quickly found plenty.
181548.tags_en: snowmobile parking, fire service, fire safety, Statsbygg, news
181548.title_en: “I Choose to Believe Much of This Is Due to Ignorance”

181553.excerpt_en: Coop Svalbardbutikken has long planned to expand the store. The extension will have two floors, including a “high” first floor with retail space.
181553.subtitle_en: The board believed one bidder’s offer was too low and wants a new tender round.
181553.title_en: New Tender Round for Svalbardbutikken Expansion

181558.excerpt_en: The Coast Guard was on site earlier this week, tasked with inspecting the damage and, if possible, breaking up the ice around the vessel. The amount of ice, which the Coast Guard said was surprisingly large, made working conditions difficult.
181558.subtitle_en: The “KV Svalbard” has been in Hinlopen Strait this week to investigate the damage to the shrimp trawler “Northguider.”
181558.tags_en: rescue operation, Hinlopen, KV Svalbard, Northguider, news, maritime accident
