The operation has been interrupted several times because of ice, while the wind has also been far stronger than forecast.
184125.subtitle_en: More ice and stronger winds than forecast are creating major challenges in Hinlopen.
184125.tags_en: news, Governor of Svalbard, Norwegian Coastal Administration, Hinlopen, Northguider

184132.excerpt_en: In the previous issue of Svalbardposten, Arild Olsen did something Svalbardposten itself has apparently struggled with lately: pointing out the political dividing lines.
184132.subtitle_en: Letter to the editor by Kjetil Figenchou
184132.tags_en: local elections, opinions, letter to the editor

184148.excerpt_en: Engagement was high among the striking pupils and students on Friday morning. The day’s climate strike was global and planned at around 3,000 locations around the world.
184148.subtitle_en: Students at Longyearbyen School and UNIS students were clear in their message: something must happen now.

184161.excerpt_en: In issue 34 of Svalbardposten, a candidate from the Svalbard Conservative Party writes that “We in the Conservative Party are strongly opposed to monopolies, whether public or private…” and further that “Operators such as Coop Svalbardbutikken have for many years operated with monopolistic prices…”, and “can run a shop in Longyearbyen at a good profit”.
184161.subtitle_en: Reply from Roy Albrigtsen—deputy leader of Longyearbyen’s Progress Party—to Svalbard Conservative Party’s Mats Vadum Wilmann (letter to the editor SP3419)

184170.excerpt_en: Campaign leader Anne Lise Klungseth Sandvik is unlikely to give up the tradition of raising the most per capita in the country. “Over many years, we have established a strong local volunteer tradition where creativity, cooperation, enjoyment, good humour and generosity have put us at the top of the fundraising rankings,” she says.
184170.subtitle_en: The main campaign day is 20 October, but in the weeks ahead a series of events will raise money for the cause.
184170.title_en: TV fundraising campaign gets under way this weekend

184184.excerpt_en: This year, a Russian player won the Svalbard Chess Championship. Vladimir Borisenko came first with six points, Bjørn Henningsen was second with five points, while Dan Celius took third place with four points.
184184.subtitle_en: Russian player Vladimir Borisenko took the win.

184196.excerpt_en: The Labour Party has always been a leading force for good framework conditions for cultural and sporting communities. That has also been the case locally, and through holding political office we have continually improved those conditions.
184196.subtitle_en: Letter to the editor from the Svalbard Labour Party

184201.excerpt_en: We live on an Arctic island halfway between the mainland and the North Pole! Not everyone is lucky enough to get that chance.
184201.subtitle_en: Letter to the editor, Merete Stiberg, Svalbard Labour Party

184208.excerpt_en: Creativity ran free during this year’s televised fundraising relay. One team, calling itself “Am I too late?”, turned up in bathrobes, with a cuddly polar bear as the baton.
184208.subtitle_en: The youths were fastest, and the Governor’s team—with plenty of heavy props—considered carrying out a doping test on the young athletes.
184208.tags_en: life in Svalbard, TV fundraising campaign, news, community life, relay
184208.title_en: Turned up with their own blue lights

184227.excerpt_en: We continue with another photograph taken by Hans Tollefsen in the late 1950s. The photographs have been lent to us by Svalbard Museum.
184227.subtitle_en: This week, we look back at Longyearbyen in the 1950s.
184227.title_en: A stroll with a pram in Longyearbyen

184233.excerpt_en: The Norwegian school is the country’s most important institution. It binds the entire nation together by ensuring that all the country’s children have the right to the same basic education.

184238.excerpt_en: “What if you sat down and took in your surroundings when you’re out walking?”
184238.subtitle_en: Where would you like a bench to rest on your walks close to town? You can now make suggestions.
184238.tags_en: news, outdoor life, loaf, walk, Longyearbyen Local Council, active outdoors
184238.title_en: Now You Can Decide Where You Want a Trail Bench

184245.excerpt_en: “We picked up a person at Trollsteinen. He had trouble with his legs and was unable to continue moving when they reached the summit,” says Senior Police Officer Arve Johnsen of the Governor of Svalbard’s office.
184245.subtitle_en: A man in his 30s ran into trouble with his legs while hiking to Trollsteinen.
184245.tags_en: summit hike, news, outdoor life, tourism, rescue operations
184245.title_en: Had to Be Rescued Down from Trollsteinen

184285.excerpt_en: As the election campaign heats up, the politicians chose to loosen their purse strings at the very last Local Council meeting. A proposal from Liberal Terje Aunevik to increase the allocation framework for cork money from NOK 3 million to 4 million was unanimously adopted by the Committee for Education, Youth and Culture (OKU) in early September.
184285.subtitle_en: The cultural community received an extra gift package on Monday evening. The Local Council decided to increase the framework for the Cork Money Fund.

184292.excerpt_en: On Sunday, police conducted an alcohol check on the fjord. For a couple of hours, they checked the operators of every boat entering or leaving Adventfjorden.
184292.subtitle_en: “You should not rule out similar checks next summer,” police say.
184292.tags_en: police, alcohol checks, boating, Adventfjorden, news
184292.title_en: Boat Operators Had to Take Breath Tests

184297.excerpt_en: Fire Chief Jan Olav Sæter regrets this, but hopes they can arrange it again next year. “Unfortunately, we don’t have the capacity to do this this year. It is due to capacity constraints.”
184297.subtitle_en: There will be no open day at the fire station to raise money for the annual TV charity appeal, as there has been traditionally.
184297.title_en: No Open Day at the Fire Station

184318.excerpt_en: The current term of the Local Council has been marked by less pleasant issues, such as avalanche challenges and enormous changes at the cornerstone company Store Norske. The sitting council has witnessed a town undergoing enormous change—in employment, the composition of the population, and the aftermath of the tragic 2015 avalanche.
184318.subtitle_en: Reader letter by Espen Klungseth Rotevatn.
184318.tags_en: opinion, local election, reader letters, politics
184318.title_en: Thoughts from a Political Early Retiree

184323.excerpt_en: The test flights are in their final phase, making the world’s first passenger aircraft for environmental monitoring Norwegian—or Svalbardian. It can be adapted. One Dornier aircraft has a so-called “pod” mounted beneath it, containing monitoring equipment.
184323.subtitle_en: For the past four years, Lufttransport has been working on a project to secure continued revenue when Store Norske ceases to be a client.

184339.excerpt_en: The new sound system has a budget of up to NOK 1.4 million. Longyearbyen has already received NOK 697,000 from the Musical Equipment Grant Scheme—half the cost.
184339.subtitle_en: The cultural community received another gift. The Local Council decided to provide matching funds for new sound equipment at Kulturhuset.
184339.title_en: Buying New, Giving Away the Old

184349.excerpt_en: Following Tuesday’s meeting of the Committee for Education, Youth and Culture (OKU), it is clear that a self-governing youth centre will be established as soon as possible. The young people are delighted. “It has taken five years to make this happen.”
184349.subtitle_en: For years, young people have worked to establish a self-governing youth centre. On Tuesday, they won the politicians’ support for the proposal.
184349.tags_en: youth club, youth council, politics, OKU, news, youth

184352.excerpt_en: A reader letter by Mats Vadum Wilmann (Centre Party, 12 September 2019), a candidate for Svalbard Conservative, argues that Svalbardbutikken, “with its monopolistic prices,” should face competition.
184352.title_en: Competition Could Harm the Longyearbyen Community

184362.excerpt_en: For six years, he tried to get to Svalbard for work. It was not until 2016 that an opportunity finally arose through his job with Securitas in Hammerfest.
184362.subtitle_en: Jan-Erik Nygård (39) works at Svalbardbutikken and is a familiar face to many. But he is actually a firearms technician.

184367.excerpt_en: Svalbard Museum has been carrying out the extensive registration work since 2011. On Friday, the Norwegian Meteorological Institute and Svalbard Museum could finally celebrate the opening of the Bjørnøya Radio museum building, featuring the island’s historic collections, together with the Governor of Svalbard and invited guests.
184367.subtitle_en: Bjørnøya is an important part of emergency preparedness.
184367.title_en: The Value of an Arctic Island

184380.excerpt_en: While Svalbard Liberal has been devising an election stunt with its “culture troupe,” some of the rest of us have been thinking about politics. Current cultural spending totals NOK 18.6 million, plus additional expenses under other headings, such as building costs. The Kåre Tveter collection is subsidized by several hundred thousand kroner annually.
184380.subtitle_en: Reader letter by Arnt Vegar Jenssen, leader of Longyearbyen’s Progress Party.
184380.title_en: Let’s Pay the Bills Before We Go Partying!

184382.excerpt_en: The election campaign is drawing to a close, which is probably just as well, since some people seem to be running out of factual arguments and their own policies. I am thinking particularly of Espen Rotevatn of the Greens and Per Nilsen of Labour.
184382.subtitle_en: Conservative Party second candidate Kjetil Figenschou comments on reader letters published last week by Espen Rotevatn of the Greens and Per Nilsen of Labour.

184402.excerpt_en: The lead candidates of all five parties in town took part, and an almost full Kulturhuset auditorium heard what the parties think about the environmental challenges facing Longyearbyen. Future energy solutions, the growing tourism industry, and growth and development in Longyearbyen were the topics debated.
184402.subtitle_en: For the past three weeks, students in the upper-secondary section of Longyearbyen School have been planning an environmental debate in connection with the local council election. It took place yesterday.
184402.tags_en: environment, local election, news, Longyearbyen School
184402.title_en: They Put the Politicians in Their Place

184403.excerpt_en: As the election campaign gets under way, many people in town do not have a permanent residential address. All the parties running in the election want to set aside more land for housing construction in Longyearbyen.
184403.subtitle_en: The town needs more homes. All the parties agree on that. Some want district heating in Sjøområdet, while others want central housing companies to coordinate the market. Here is what the parties want to do to improve the situation.
184403.tags_en: news, local elections, housing policy, housing shortage, homes, politics

184418.excerpt_en: We got to test Telenor’s 4G network before it reached the rest of the country. People have long been saying the same thing will happen when the 5G network is tested.
184418.subtitle_en: People have been talking about it for a long time. The men on the mast in the photograph are installing equipment that will eventually give Longyearbyen fifth-generation mobile coverage.
184418.tags_en: Telenor Svalbard, technology, news, tests, mobile phone, telecommunications

184423.excerpt_en: The entire project has carried a price tag of NOK 180 million. Statsbygg communications director Hege Njaa Aschim says progress has been controlled throughout. “We initially received NOK 100 million, but over time we ended up with a higher sum.”
184423.subtitle_en: On Monday this week, Hæhre Arctic handed over the new service building and the seed vault’s renovated access tunnel to Statsbygg.
184423.tags_en: news, seed vault, service building, Hæhre Arctic
184423.title_en: NOK 80 Million More Expensive Than Expected

184438.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen, too, saw strong engagement and a determination to fight for the environment. The slogans reflected our location in the Arctic and voiced concern about rising temperatures, melting glaciers and polar bears steadily losing sea ice in their habitat.
184438.subtitle_en: The global climate strike has engaged children and young people around the world.
184438.title_en: A Climate Cry from the North

184450.excerpt_en: Thought you knew everything about the nature around Longyearbyen? Think again. “I have learned so much from this work,” says Silje M., general manager of Svalbard Turn.
184450.subtitle_en: The idea first arose in 1994. Next week, every household will receive a hiking book at home.
184450.tags_en: Svalbard Turn, news, Loff, outdoor life, active outdoors, hiking
184450.title_en: Hiking Book on Its Way to Your Mailbox

184453.excerpt_en: Svalbardhallen opened in 1996. Since then, the population has grown, and those trying to fit all the training sessions into the timetable are scratching their heads to make sure every group gets time there. “There is always fierce competition for training slots.”
184453.subtitle_en: “The hall is important for the town’s quality of life. The joy of sport shown here every week is extremely important,” says the chair of Svalbard Turn.
184453.tags_en: Svalbard Turn, politics, news, local elections, public health, children, training, Svalbardhallen, youth

184463.excerpt_en: We have borrowed the photographs from Svalbard Museum. This week’s picture shows several children playing, including Kurt Adler Skog, Sylvi Tollefsen, Bernt Tollefsen and Jack Askvik.
184463.subtitle_en: We continue with a new photograph taken by Hans Tollefsen in the late 1950s. Perhaps someone knows the names of all the children?

184475.excerpt_en: “I was actually driving quite carefully, a bit like that car there,” says the unfortunate driver, pointing to a car coming down Road 500 at 20–30 kilometres per hour.
184475.subtitle_en: Friday’s slush has now turned to ice on the town’s roads. One motorist found that out at the junction between UNIS and Sjøskrenten.
184475.tags_en: accident, road departure, Governor of Svalbard, news, car, road safety

184485.excerpt_en: Most wish people a “good election.” A cliché that tells me I am making a poor choice if I do not vote as the letter writer wants.
184485.subtitle_en: Praise to SP for making room for the local council candidates’ letters to the editor. I have read them all and am trying to see what is actually being said—or merely hinted at—between the lines.
184485.tags_en: opinions, local elections, letters to the editor, readers’ letters, politics
184485.title_en: Reflections on the Election Letters in Svalbardposten

184508.excerpt_en: What we manage to achieve here in the far north of the globe will attract considerable attention, strengthening our sense of place and our reputation as a destination. Energy sources, energy systems, transport and logistics, waste management and consumption all combine to give Longyearbyen an unnecessarily poor climate and environmental record.
184508.subtitle_en: Let’s make this clear from the outset: Longyearbyen cannot save the world. But everyone can do a little.
184508.tags_en: opinions, local elections, letters to the editor, politics

184524.excerpt_en: We write about the rights of foreign workers—not because we want to expand public services, because we do not. But we believe that state-provided services should be the same for all workers and their children.
184524.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen FrP is trying to take local politics seriously. We have created a proper and honest platform and distributed it to households throughout the town. There, we explain what we support and what we oppose.
184524.tags_en: opinions, politics, letters to the editor, local elections

184526.excerpt_en: Lars Sandnesaunet was one of those who stopped by during the day. He had no complaints about the cake.
184526.subtitle_en: Sparebank 1 Nord-Norge’s Longyearbyen branch celebrated its first 60 years in town with a large marzipan cake on Wednesday, September 18.

184541.excerpt_en: “The circular economy has become incredibly important, and we have set ourselves the ambitious goal of saying that Longyearbyen should become the world capital of the circular economy,” says Jan Myhre, property manager at Longyearbyen Local Council (LL). Valuable reuse. This weekend, they will therefore open 20 housing units to Longyearbyen’s population.
184541.subtitle_en: The demolition of buildings in Lia is about to begin. In connection with this, LL, Store Norske and Statsbygg are launching a pilot project.

184557.excerpt_en: By giving people the opportunity to build and own their own homes, they will also gain a more long-term perspective in Longyearbyen. We also believe it should be easier for people working in the private sector to find housing.
184557.subtitle_en: We in Svalbard Conservative Party believe that good, suitable and, above all, safe housing is important for people’s well-being.
184557.tags_en: opinions, local elections, letters to the editor, politics

184578.excerpt_en: When the bear made its way into Barentsburg, it was not frightened off at first. “The bear came right into town, but they had trouble scaring it away.”
184578.subtitle_en: A polar bear has been near Barentsburg for the past few days.
184578.tags_en: Barentsburg, Governor of Svalbard, polar bear, news, helicopter
184578.title_en: After a couple of days, they had to call in a helicopter

184596.excerpt_en: The most delicious aromas waft from the kitchen at the meteorological station on Bjørnøya. And when you also see the sign in the dining room announcing four meals a day, you know something good is in store.
184596.subtitle_en: “We’re spoiled,” say those who work on Bjørnøya, referring to the excellent food. Sandra Kræmer plays a major role in that pampering. She herself likes seafood best.
184596.tags_en: food, people, Bjørnøya, Svalbard life, back page, chef
184596.title_en: Sandra picks up the finest ingredients at the pier

184615.excerpt_en: The world’s best school is built around students’ interests and dreams, extensive choice, low teacher and student turnover—and, of course, lots and lots of joy. Longyearbyen Local Council must invest in the school; after all, we are the future.
184615.subtitle_en: “We in Svalbard Conservative Party know that the school is Longyearbyen’s most important resource. That is why we will urge Svalbard Conservatives to strengthen the school if the Conservatives come into a position to do so.”

184621.excerpt_en: A polar bear visited Barentsburg on both Saturday and Sunday. It came right into town and was not frightened off by the locals.
184621.subtitle_en: The polar bear that was in Barentsburg over the weekend returned.
184621.tags_en: news, Barentsburg, Governor of Svalbard, polar bear
184621.title_en: Had to chase polar bear away from Barentsburg—again

184625.excerpt_en: “It’s a completely indescribable feeling. I don’t think anyone understands what it has been like not being able to leave here.”
184625.subtitle_en: Omid Abolhasani (39), from Iran, has been on Svalbard for almost ten years straight. Now he has received the documents he needs to travel and visit his family.
184625.tags_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, travel ban, foreigners, news, laws, Iran, wives, Governor of Svalbard
184625.title_en: “Now I’m getting a whole new life”

184660.excerpt_en: At 3:30 p.m. on Wednesday, police received a report that a dog had been chasing a reindeer. The dog had escaped from the town’s dog yard, Svalbardposten learned initially.
184660.subtitle_en: The reindeer was frightened and exhausted. The dog owner can expect a response from the police.
184660.tags_en: news, loose dog, Governor of Svalbard, dog yard, reindeer
184660.title_en: Dog chased reindeer towards the fjord

184666.excerpt_en: Should one laugh or cry? It was actually a little difficult to work out when I opened Svalbardposten last Thursday.
184666.subtitle_en: “What makes it especially comical is that Figenschou points out that the Conservatives’ candidates ‘help draw up the programme they are elected on.’”

184676.excerpt_en: Public health is about creating a good local community where people want to live, work and build their lives. Longyearbyen has a long tradition of voluntary work focused on promoting the health and well-being of its residents.
184676.subtitle_en: “The time is ripe to take a closer look at public-health work as a shared community responsibility.”

184679.excerpt_en: After several years of waiting, the government will present a business strategy for Svalbard this afternoon. Sustainability and seriousness are key themes in the strategy.
184679.subtitle_en: Greater emphasis on knowledge-based and sustainable business, while preventing unserious operators from establishing themselves. That is the main message of the government’s business strategy for Svalbard, which will be presented this afternoon.
184679.tags_en: Arctic policy, test station, Store Norske, tourism, government, politics, restructuring, business, news, tourism, innovation, cruise tourism
184679.title_en: “Industries that put further pressure on infrastructure are not wanted”

184693.excerpt_en: “I’m a little wiser now. Tourism was perhaps what made the biggest impression on me.”
184693.subtitle_en: Yesterday, Thursday, Svalbardposten held the final political debate before the election.

184716.excerpt_en: During Monday evening’s debate at Kroa, the candidates for local council leader were asked how they would help maintain veterinary coverage with an emergency on-call service in Longyearbyen. Most of them answered that this was the result of political cooperation among several parties over time, and that they wanted to continue with this strategy.
184716.subtitle_en: “We want local politicians who will fight to secure Longyearbyen its fair share of the community pie, regardless of sector.”
184716.tags_en: reader letter, veterinarian, local elections, opinion
184716.title_en: Don’t vote Labour if you care about animal welfare

184726.excerpt_en: First of all, it goes without saying that Labour is not opposed to animal welfare—in fact, quite the contrary!
184726.subtitle_en: Expressing yourself clearly and being understood can be challenging. And when Svalbard Vet tries to sum up the debate at Kroa from an animal-welfare perspective, we understand that things have gone seriously wrong.
184726.tags_en: politics, Labour Party, reader letter, local elections, opinion, veterinarian
184726.title_en: Of course Labour supports good animal welfare!

184744.excerpt_en: Svalbard is a wonderful place. Not only is it a particularly lovely place to live, but running the community is quite different from doing so in any municipality on the mainland.
184744.subtitle_en: “If we are to succeed, there is one thing that matters: cooperation.”
184744.tags_en: opinion, local elections, reader letter, politics

184753.excerpt_en:
On the local council, Lyb FrP will work to:
- Find an area in the land-use plan for accommodation for tourism employees.
- Provide a year-round school bus service. Safe transport to and from school.
- Reverse the compulsory summer closure of kindergartens.
- Build infrastructure that keeps cruise tourists out of the traffic.
- Investigate hydrogen power plants.
184753.subtitle_en: “Help us win representation on the local council!”
184753.title_en: Vote for the Progress Party—and you’ll get this:

184761.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen Local Council has been governed by Labour since its establishment. I would not go so far as to claim that the Local Council is badly run, but we in the Conservatives believe there is room for more in this town.
184761.subtitle_en: “We in the Conservatives want the Local Council to become a service organization that is accessible to all residents.”

184763.excerpt_en: We continue our series of historical photographs with a new picture taken by Hans Tollefsen in the late 1950s. We borrowed the photographs from Svalbard Museum.
184763.subtitle_en: Playing in the snow in the 1950s.
184763.tags_en: history, life in Svalbard, historical photograph
184763.title_en: Playing in the Snow in the 1950s

184767.excerpt_en: When Svalbardposten’s reporter went to perform their civic duty at 3 p.m. on Sunday, there was a queue. A steady stream of eligible voters entered the premises. “It comes in waves.”
184767.subtitle_en: There was a strong turnout in the hours after the polling station opened on Sunday.
184767.tags_en: Svalbard Liberals, Svalbard Conservatives, Svalbard Labour Party, news, Longyearbyen Progress Party, local elections, Svalbard Greens
184767.title_en: Local Election Gets Off to a Good Start

184796.excerpt_en: “The government is committed to strengthening emergency preparedness in the northern regions.”
184796.subtitle_en: The government proposes permanently extending the sailing season for the Governor’s vessel M/S “Polarsyssel” from nine to ten months a year.

184800.excerpt_en: Unfortunately, we have witnessed far too many such situations in recent years: animals becoming trapped and suffering a terrible death.
184800.subtitle_en: Seeing reindeer fighting for their lives, trapped in barbed wire and old steel cables, is something we do not want to see.
184800.tags_en: editorial, cultural heritage, animal tragedy, animal welfare, opinions

184802.excerpt_en: Last weekend, you could read about a reindeer bull that became tangled in a steel cable at Fuglefjella.
184802.subtitle_en: Everything dating from before 1946 is considered cultural heritage in Svalbard. “If it poses a danger to animals and people, it can be removed,” says the Governor’s cultural heritage adviser. But call first.
184802.tags_en: news, cultural heritage, animal tragedy, reindeer
184802.title_en: If Cultural Heritage Sites Pose a Danger, They Can Be Removed

184810.excerpt_en: The money will be used to further develop Ny-Ålesund as a Norwegian platform for international natural science research in the Arctic. “We are increasing the allocation to enable the station to conduct environmental and climate research of even greater importance to the entire world.”
184810.subtitle_en: The government proposes increasing the operating grant for Ny-Ålesund Research Station by NOK 12 million in 2020.
184810.title_en: More Funding for Operations at Ny-Ålesund Research Station

184830.excerpt_en: Below are the allocations the government proposes for next year’s Svalbard budget. The Governor’s transport service, comprising operations of “Polarsyssel” and the rescue helicopters, is the largest single allocation.
184830.subtitle_en: Funding for the Governor’s vessel “Polarsyssel” and two rescue helicopters accounts for nearly 40 percent of Svalbard’s total national budget.
184830.tags_en: national budget, news, Governor of Svalbard, Longyearbyen Local Council, helicopter services, emergency preparedness, Polarsyssel
184830.title_en: Most Goes to the Governor’s Transport Services

184850.excerpt_en: The counting team at the cultural centre worked flat out after the polling stations closed at 8 p.m. tonight. All the advance votes have now been counted.
184850.subtitle_en: The advance votes have been counted. They show the Liberals currently in the lead, with Labour close behind.

184855.excerpt_en: Local council chair Arild Olsen (Labour) raised his voice when he entered the venue where the election watch party was being held in central Longyearbyen. It suddenly became rather quiet.
184855.subtitle_en: At 9:45 p.m. tonight, the result of the vote count was announced at Stationen. There was loud cheering from Labour and the Liberals, the two largest parties.

184903.excerpt_en: Labour gets five representatives on the local council, while the Liberals get four after Tuesday evening’s final count. For a long time, it looked as though both would get five of the council’s fifteen seats, but once all the votes had been counted, the Liberals lost one seat.
184903.subtitle_en: Just five votes separate Labour and the Liberals, but Labour secured one more seat on the local council for the coming term.
184903.title_en: Labour Won the Most Votes and Seats

184906.excerpt_en: Varisa’s first Svalbard memory is seeing a walrus. She was six, had just moved up from Thailand and had never seen anything like it before. “I was terrified,” she says, laughing.
184906.subtitle_en: Varisa Phothisat (18) can hardly wait to leave Svalbard after twelve years on the island. She has little fondness for the coming polar night.

184912.excerpt_en: Party platforms are important in an election, but in a small community like Longyearbyen, the candidates themselves also matter. Many people have personal ties to numerous candidates, and this can be decisive when casting a vote.
184912.subtitle_en: Many voters chose to mark politicians and give them an extra personal vote. Here you can see who received the most.
184912.title_en: Check Who Received the Most Personal Votes

184921.excerpt_en: When 98 percent of the votes had been counted on Monday evening—with no personal votes or candidate write-ins included—the trend was clear. Svalbard’s Liberals had scored a resounding election victory.
184921.subtitle_en: The Liberals had a breakthrough election and are entering negotiations to secure the local council chair. But Labour emerged as the largest party by the narrowest of margins.
184921.tags_en: Svalbard Liberals, Svalbard Conservatives, Svalbard Labour Party, news, Longyearbyen Progress Party, local elections, Svalbard Greens
184921.title_en: There Will Be a Battle for the Top Spot

184935.excerpt_en: Just nine votes separated Venstre and Labour on Tuesday afternoon when Svalbardposten went to press. Venstre had 333 votes, while Labour had received 342 after 98 percent of the votes had been counted.
184935.subtitle_en: It will be exciting to see what agreements are reached between the parties and who ultimately ends up as local council chair.
184935.tags_en: opinions, local election, local council chair, chair, Labour Party, Venstre

184958.excerpt_en: Governor of Svalbard Kjerstin Askholt would have liked to see the boat here year-round. “We are pleased that it will now be extended to ten months, but of course I would have liked to see it extended to twelve months.”
184958.subtitle_en: The government proposes permanently extending the sailing season for the Governor of Svalbard’s vessel M/S “Polarsyssel” from nine to ten months a year.
184958.tags_en: Polarsyssel, news, Kjerstin Askholt, Governor of Svalbard, national budget
184958.title_en: “I would have liked to have it here for 12 months”

184964.excerpt_en: Bergdal sold the apartment in April 2013 for just over NOK 1.5 million to Anika Paust and Vide Brandt. The buyers sued Bergdal after Gamle sykehuset was evacuated in February 2016, seeking to have the sale rescinded.
184964.subtitle_en: Arne Oddvar Bergdal sold an apartment in Gamle sykehuset in 2013. Hålogaland Court of Appeal has ruled that he must take the apartment back and refund the buyers.
184964.title_en: Lost and must rescind the sale

184986.excerpt_en: “Try our fish cakes. They’re absolutely delicious,” Mari advertised from the tent in the town centre on Sunday.
184986.subtitle_en: Mari Torgersen (9) was one of many children offering their own delicacies at Smak Svalbard.

184990.excerpt_en: Two new weather stations have now been installed in what could be called the “inland and higher-lying areas” of Nordenskiöld Land. One is at Janssonhaugen in Adventdalen, and the other is at Reindalspasset at the top of Reindalen.
184990.subtitle_en: Weather forecasts for the interior—and perhaps Spitsbergen’s east coast—will now be more reliable. “And we will have a better basis for research,” says Åshild Ønvik Pedersen.
184990.tags_en: Norwegian Polar Institute, Norwegian Polar Institute, Norwegian Meteorological Institute, meteorology, climate, weather observations, research, news
184990.title_en: Better weather forecasts and climate understanding

185010.excerpt_en: “The reason is that LL wanted to focus on traffic safety and the dark season we are now entering. We have many activities in our town; some are in the centre, while others are by the church, the school and the sports hall.”
185010.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council has handed out free reflective vests to all pupils at Longyearbyen School. More than 270 pupils received vests in total.
185010.tags_en: news, reflective vests, LL, Longyearbyen School

185012.excerpt_en: We continue with another photograph from the series taken by Hans Tollefsen in the late 1950s. We have borrowed the pictures from Svalbard Museum.
185012.subtitle_en: This week we see three children at Haugen on a winter’s day in the 1950s.
185012.tags_en: historical photograph, life in Svalbard, days gone by, history

185022.excerpt_en: He is standing at the new playground taking shape in Gruvedalen. Here, he thinks everything looks very good.
185022.subtitle_en: “It is fair to say there are things that need attention,” says playground inspector Ole Christian Wiig, who inspected the town’s playgrounds on behalf of LL and Store Norske.
185022.tags_en: childhood, news, Longyearbyen Local Council, playground, health and safety, property, children, safety

185038.excerpt_en: “If we raise NOK 100,000, principal Espen Klungseth Rotevatn will shave off his beard,” says Therese Elise Dødker Haave (22). Rotevatn was not entirely on board at first, but then he thought about it and realised it was highly unlikely that the students would manage it.
185038.subtitle_en: Students at Svalbard Folk High School have received extra inspiration to raise money for this year’s TV fundraising campaign. Now they need help.
185038.tags_en: Svalbard Folk High School, news, TV fundraising campaign, beard

185053.excerpt_en: On 28 December last year, the shrimp trawler “Northguider” ran aground in Hinlopen Strait.
185053.subtitle_en: The damage to the “Northguider” has turned out to be more extensive than initially thought. There is a strong chance it will remain at Sparreneset this winter.
185053.tags_en: Northguider, Nordaustlandet, Norwegian Coastal Administration, Hinlopen Strait, insurance, fisheries, news
185053.title_en: Salvage company must come up with a new plan—now

185068.excerpt_en: Just before midnight on Sunday, the outcome of the political negotiations of the past few days became clear. “I’m very pleased that we have established a good political rapport with two relevant parties in Longyearbyen.”
185068.subtitle_en: Labour, the Conservatives and the Progress Party have joined forces. Labour will therefore have the local council chair for another four years.
185068.tags_en: news, local council chair, politics, local election
185068.title_en: Arild Olsen (Labour) gets four more years

185075.excerpt_en: That Labour could reach an agreement with the Conservatives was perhaps not entirely unexpected, but I suspect Labour voters will find it hard to swallow that newcomer the Progress Party was brought along for the ride. We do not think it is going too far to call this a betrayal of the voters.
185075.subtitle_en: On Monday morning, more than a few of us probably choked on our coffee when we heard that Labour had entered into a technical agreement with the Conservatives and the Progress Party. They are evidently doing everything they can to retain their position—and the local council chair.

185083.excerpt_en: On Monday morning, the Venstre politician and the rest of Longyearbyen woke to the news that Høyre, Frp and Ap had entered into an agreement securing a majority. Ap’s Arild Olsen will become local council leader, the three parties announced.
185083.subtitle_en: “I didn’t see that coming. I have to admit that honestly,” says local council leader candidate Terje Aunevik (V).
185083.tags_en: news, local council, politics, local elections

185110.excerpt_en: The bird has been named “Duckie,” and Fogden goes down to the Sea Area every day to look for her. Most of the time, the eider comes over to Fogden to say hello.
185110.subtitle_en: Barbara Fogden may have Svalbard’s most unusual pet: an eider duck.
185110.title_en: She has a very unusual pet

185126.excerpt_en: The entire town lost power for the first time at 6:40 p.m. on Monday, and the outage lasted about 15 minutes. Morten Dyrstad, technical sector manager at Longyearbyen Local Council, explains that it was caused by a data error. “When one of the components is replaced, we have to upgrade the entire control system.”
185126.subtitle_en: The power went out yesterday evening and overnight during major maintenance and upgrades at the power plant.
185126.title_en: Everything back up after two power outages

185135.excerpt_en: More than anything, he is looking forward to being able to attend concerts in his new life somewhere in Eastern Norway. He is an avid Iron Maiden fan and likes hard rock and metal. “I’m looking forward to being able to go to concerts and get home again the same day.”
185135.subtitle_en: Alexander Flygel (30) has made up his mind. On 3 November, he is moving away from Longyearbyen after having lived there all his adult life.
185135.tags_en: Svalbard shop, Svalbard life, moving, people
185135.title_en: “I need some time on the mainland now”

185152.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Coastal Administration has now confirmed that the shrimp trawler will remain there until next year. Its project manager, Rune Bergstrøm, met with the insurance company Gard yesterday.
185152.subtitle_en: “Northguider” will remain where it is over the winter.
185152.tags_en: news, Governor of Svalbard, Norwegian Coastal Administration, Hinlopen, Northguider
185152.title_en: Salvage company unable to do more this autumn

185175.excerpt_en: Six politicians are standing outside Næringsbygget, where the local council is based. The mood is upbeat, and conversation flows easily.
185175.subtitle_en: A coalition consisting of Ap, Høyre and Frp has secured a majority in the next local council. “We quickly found common ground,” they say.
185175.tags_en: news, local council leader, local politics, politics, local elections
185175.title_en: They have promised not to “eat” each other over the next four years

185182.excerpt_en: They claim the newspaper is being unreasonable when we cast doubt on whether Labour voters wanted to bring Frp along, thereby calling it a betrayal of the voters. Høyre is also being criticized for abandoning its promises in its eagerness for power.
185182.subtitle_en: The criticism from the Labour Party has poured onto social media after Svalbardposten published the comment “The art of swallowing camels” online on Monday.
185182.tags_en: opinion, local elections, local council leader, editorial, politics
185182.title_en: A battle for power and positions

185186.excerpt_en: “Our door is open, and it has been all along,” says Karine Hauan (V). Venstre has contacted Høyre several times to initiate negotiations, but has so far been unsuccessful.
185186.subtitle_en: Venstre still wants to secure a majority with the center-right parties. It is offering Høyre the local council leader’s position.
185186.tags_en: local council leader, politics, local elections, news, local council
185186.title_en: Offers the possibility of a purely center-right majority

185191.excerpt_en: The first thing you hear is the clinking of cutlery against porcelain bowls and the lively chatter from the crowded tables in the Longyearbyen School cafeteria. It is four o’clock and the queue for the sodd station is long, but nobody is complaining.
185191.subtitle_en: Yesterday, the annual TV fundraising collection was held once again at Longyearbyen School.
185191.tags_en: news, volunteer effort, TV fundraising campaign, Longyearbyen School

185201.excerpt_en: Coverage director Bjørn Amundsen has visited Svalbard many times before. Now he is pleased that 5G testing is coming here. “We began piloting as early as last autumn.”
185201.subtitle_en: Svalbard has been selected as one of ten locations where Telenor will test 5G. The pilot project starts on Sunday.

185214.excerpt_en: More and more money continues to come in for the annual TV fundraising campaign. Campaign leader Anne-Lise Klungseth Sandvik is delighted after the weekend.
185214.subtitle_en: Nearly NOK 80,000 was raised at the flea market at UNIS over the weekend. It is the best result in the event’s history so far.

185236.excerpt_en: As darkness gradually replaces the endless daylight and calm settles in after a hectic summer season, Longyearbyen’s residents retreat to the town’s various gathering places. Cultural life is thriving, and Svalbardians are just as likely to meet downtown over a cup of coffee or a good dinner as they are to meet at home in the living room.
185236.subtitle_en: Byens beste was launched as an initiative between Svalbardposten and Josh Wing, head chef at Polfareren. He was used to the local newspaper holding competitions for local businesses and asked whether Svalbardposten might like to do something similar. The restaurant industry was chosen, and Byens beste/Top of the Town was born.
185236.title_en: Did you see who won this year’s competition?

185238.excerpt_en: “I think there is far too much open debate on social media. I have chosen to stay away from it myself,” says Høyre’s top candidate, Stein-Ove Johannessen.
185238.subtitle_en: Venstre’s offer to let Høyre have the local council leader, while keeping the door open to a fully center-right majority, appears to be falling on deaf ears.
185238.tags_en: news, local council leader, politics, local elections
185238.title_en: Political dirty laundry aired in public

185262.excerpt_en: He had it specially built, and it is his home throughout the winter. In summer, he lives on a boat.
185262.subtitle_en: “Come in! Would you like some coffee?” Timon Brüggeman (28) welcomes Svalbardposten to his mobile home at the campsite.
185262.tags_en: news, politics, house prices, housing policy, housing market, housing, rent
185262.title_en: “They throw the most vulnerable under the bus”

185301.excerpt_en: The photographs were taken by deputy governor’s officer Carl A. Wendt in the summer and autumn of 1960.
185301.subtitle_en: We are starting a new series of photographs borrowed from Svalbard Museum. The first picture shows a group of well-dressed gentlemen.
185301.tags_en: Svalbard Museum, life on Svalbard, history, historical photograph

185306.excerpt_en: Of the 379 homes they have in total, approximately 280 are rented to parties outside Store Norske. “The exception is a small number of homes that are being renovated.”
185306.subtitle_en: Store Norske is the only one of the three public housing managers that also rents to private individuals.
185306.tags_en: news, Longyearbyen Local Council, housing pool, housing market, homes, Store Norske
185306.title_en: Renting out more than they want to

185332.excerpt_en: Researchers used figures from the annual reindeer counts in Adventdalen, Reindalen and Brøggerhalvøya, which have been conducted for more than 40 years, as the basis for the estimate they are now publishing.
185332.subtitle_en: For the first time, the Svalbard reindeer population has been scientifically estimated. “Most animals are found in the large valleys, and even today the reindeer are reclaiming their former range,” says reindeer researcher Mathilde Le Moullec.
185332.tags_en: research, news, NTNU, Norwegian Polar Institute, hunting, reindeer, wildlife, reindeer count
185332.title_en: Now we know how many reindeer live on Svalbard

185335.excerpt_en: He therefore paid 80,000 kroner for the polar bear skin at Sunday’s auction for the TV fundraising campaign. The fact that the money also supports a good cause is a nice bonus.
185335.subtitle_en: “I really wanted that skin,” says Kristian Angen.
185335.tags_en: news, polar bear, Hornsund, TV fundraising campaign, auction, polar bear skin

185360.excerpt_en: “We’re as on track as we can be. All that remains is to print some programmes, posters and the like,” says Espen Helgesen, head of Longyearbyen Bluesklubb.
185360.subtitle_en: More than 30 concerts await you from Thursday to Sunday. The organisers now hope the audience will decide to buy tickets.
185360.tags_en: culture, news, Dark Season Blues, blues festival, concert
185360.title_en: Now they hope you’ll buy a ticket

185368.excerpt_en: For the twelfth year in a row, Svalbard tops the rankings as the “municipality” in Norway where the most money has been donated per resident. At the latest check, at 2 p.m. on Monday afternoon, the counter had just reached one million kroner.
185368.subtitle_en: Svalbard residents gave more than ten times the national average in the TV fundraising campaign.
185368.tags_en: news, TV fundraising campaign, volunteer effort, collection volunteer, auction, fundraising
185368.title_en: We raised more than one million kroner

185396.excerpt_en: This is good news for animal welfare, and also good news for the possibility of preserving jobs in the local veterinary service.
185396.subtitle_en: Local council leader Arild Olsen confirms in an article in Svalbardposten online on 5 October that there is still cross-party agreement on the need to safeguard animal welfare through an on-call veterinary service.
185396.tags_en: opinion, local elections, reader letter, veterinary medicine

185399.excerpt_en: He arrived on Svalbard in autumn 2010, and the first thing that struck him was the beautiful colours on the horizon as darkness descended over the mountains. And then it was simply dark.
185399.subtitle_en: Jon Kristian Bø (54) has lived on Svalbard for nine years. The man from Lier was looking for a change from the stress of the mainland, and has now found peace and love in the Arctic wilderness.
185399.tags_en: Svalbard people, life on Svalbard, people

185404.excerpt_en: When you see a polar bear and a reindeer being chased down the town-centre streets, you know it is almost time for a new cinema commercial. Last winter, Longyearbyen Local Council made commercials in which a polar bear and local council leader Arild Olsen were reprimanded for failing to handle their waste properly.
185404.subtitle_en: Some rather unusual animals were spotted in the town’s streets recently.

185410.excerpt_en: She claims that Labour has betrayed its voters by joining forces with the Conservatives and the Progress Party. As a Labour voter, I can find no basis for that claim.
185410.subtitle_en: I must say I’m rather surprised that the editor has still managed to get both coffee and politics—and possibly facts too—stuck in his throat.
185410.tags_en: local elections, local council, reader letter, opinion
185410.title_en: The art of swallowing your morning coffee

185413.excerpt_en: “It’s completely pointless,” sighs Ronny Strømnes, managing director of Coop Svalbard. On Tuesday morning, employees at Svalbardbutikken discovered empty packaging for glitter socks.
185413.subtitle_en: The woman in her 50s who lives permanently on Svalbard could clearly afford the socks she stole from Svalbardbutikken on Tuesday.
185413.title_en: Caught stealing two pairs of socks priced at NOK 49.90

185436.excerpt_en: When Svalbardposten went to press this week, the official figures showed that Svalbard had contributed exactly one million kroner. That means each person donated 420 kroner—no less than ten times the national average.
185436.subtitle_en: For the twelfth year in a row, Svalbard residents were the most generous during the TV fundraising campaign. Much of this is probably due to what could be called the Anne Lise effect. But what happens now?
185436.tags_en: pensioner, fundraising campaign, volunteering, people, Anne Lise K. Sandvik, TV fundraising campaign, news
185436.title_en: “Now I want to take one autumn off,” says Anne Lise (71)

185450.excerpt_en: From now on, her children and grandchildren will get to enjoy more time with their grandmother when next autumn comes around. Walks in the woods and countryside on the mainland, along with berry picking, will then take priority.
185450.subtitle_en: “Yes, we’ve heard that before, but this time she means it,” she says. This was the final TV fundraising campaign for which Anne Lise Klungseth Sandvik was responsible.

185463.excerpt_en: The violence continued over an extended period, from the summer of 2014 until October last year. This has caused some headaches for the prosecution.
185463.subtitle_en: A woman in her 40s who lives permanently on Svalbard must appear before Nord-Troms District Court, charged with assaulting her own child.
185463.tags_en: news, child abuse, Penal Code, Nord-Troms District Court

185468.excerpt_en: Ødegård took the opportunity to highlight the efforts made by all the volunteers involved in the festival. “Just think: 80 people here in our little town want to contribute. Volunteering deserves to be celebrated,” he says.
185468.subtitle_en: Cultural affairs director Roger Zahl Ødegård officially opened this year’s Dark Season Blues festival tonight. Over the next few days, 16 bands will perform 31 concerts at ten different venues.
185468.tags_en: Dark Season Blues, blues festival, news

185483.excerpt_en: “I have no comment,” says Anders Magne Lindseth. He is the newly elected Labour representative on the local council, which will be formally constituted next Monday.
185483.subtitle_en: Not everyone is happy that the Labour Party has joined forces with the Progress Party.
185483.tags_en: politics, news, local elections, local council, Conservative Party, Progress Party, Svalbard Labour Party
185483.title_en: In like a rocket—silent as an oyster

185496.excerpt_en: “Today, we import products like these from mainland Norway and abroad, which is absurd,” says Robert Johansen of Svalbard Brewery. The brewery has been working on its own water product for some time, and the plan was originally to launch it on the market earlier.
185496.subtitle_en: Svalbard Vann is hoped to replace Ramlösa on Svalbard.
185496.title_en: You can buy this in stores today

185503.excerpt_en: After an hour, the total passed NOK 100,000; 45 minutes later, it reached NOK 200,000. The funds raised at the auction continued to climb steadily.
185503.subtitle_en: Only the government, Norconsult and Equinor made larger contributions than the Svalbard auction.
185503.tags_en: news, polar bear skin, fundraising, auction, TV-aksjonen
185503.title_en: The auction was the country’s largest private contribution

185518.excerpt_en: Allegedly, the Left’s lead negotiator Oddmund Rønning was so mean and brazen in the post-election negotiations that the Conservatives deemed it legitimate to break off the talks, abandon their election promises and turn to Labour. Imagine that—Oddmund Rønning demanded that the largest party should get the council chair!
185518.subtitle_en: Once again, the political constellations are different from what one might have expected based on the election result.
185518.title_en: Longyearbyen circus and the Conservatives’ silence

185528.excerpt_en: In May, Svalbardposten reported that 41 new homes could be at risk of demolition. The mountainside above the homes might not have been stable enough for snow fences to be installed there.
185528.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate has found that the mountain is stable enough to install new supporting avalanche barriers in Lia.
185528.tags_en: avalanche protection, news, NVE, Longyearbyen Local Council, Lia, Sukkertoppen, homes, demolition

185539.excerpt_en: Iris Dahle Bjørkmann, Mary-Ann Dahle’s daughter, confirms that they have accepted an offer from Svalbard Wildlife Eiendom AS for Mary-Ann’s Polarrigg. Several interested buyers had come forward.
185539.subtitle_en: Sold to Svalbard Wildlife Eiendom AS.
185539.tags_en: news, Svalbard Wildlife Eiendom, Mary Ann’s Polarrigg

185554.excerpt_en: “I’m not retiring; I’m just changing my address,” she says with a smile. She wants to live closer to her two adult children, and living in Tromsø is also more practical for her work.
185554.subtitle_en: After more than 30 years in Longyearbyen, Frigg Jørgensen is moving to Tromsø. She will continue as head of AECO.
185554.title_en: Only changing her address from Svalbard to Tromsø

185560.excerpt_en: The Labour Party, Conservative Party and Progress Party, which have joined forces, appear satisfied with the state of affairs. The Left’s courtship and attempts to open a dialogue with the Conservatives do not seem to have produced results—at least not by the time Svalbardposten went to press this week.
185560.subtitle_en: After some turbulent days following the local election, there has been complete silence from the politicians. At least, nothing has leaked to the newsroom.

185577.excerpt_en: Arnoldus Schytte Blix has owned the “Sallyhamn” trapping station at Kapp William, including its outstations, since 1975. The station was built by Waldemar Kræmer in 1937 and has been regularly maintained by the Governor as an official cabin.
185577.subtitle_en: Bjørn Fjukstad and Arnstein Skaare have bought the “Sallyhamn” trapping station in the far north of Spitsbergen. They will rent it out free of charge to permanent residents and researchers.
185577.title_en: Providing access to the “Sallyhamn” trapping station

185582.excerpt_en: We continue with historic photographs taken in Colesbukta in 1960. The photographer is Senior Police Officer to the Governor Carl A.
185582.tags_en: historic photograph, life in Svalbard, history

185584.excerpt_en: With a total of eight concerts spread across two floors, Saturday could certainly be called the main event of this weekend’s Dark Season Blues festival. Many people turned up and saw bands including Tora, Monster Mike Welch, Earl Thomas with Igor Prado & Just Groove, and Sari Schorr, to name a few.
185584.subtitle_en: The atmosphere was impeccable at Saturday’s major blues festival at Huset.
185584.tags_en: news, Dark Season Blues, Governor of Svalbard, concert
185584.title_en: Good vibes at the blues festival

185593.excerpt_en: Inside an ordinary Coca-Cola can, students at UNIS have integrated selected systems found in a satellite. These include a temperature gauge, air-pressure gauge, GPS, magnetic-field sensor, accelerometer and gyroscope.
185593.subtitle_en: How do you learn about space technology? At UNIS, geophysics students learn about satellite technology and construction by building their own.

185613.excerpt_en: Automester Svalbard officially opened its workshop in Longyearbyen before the weekend, making it the world’s northernmost automotive workshop.
185613.subtitle_en: This winter, you can “call Falck” if you get stranded on your snowmobile.

185629.excerpt_en: On Friday last week, Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) wrote on its Facebook page that Avinor had iced the rink and hoped to open it the following day. But after a mild night, the opening was postponed by one day.
185629.subtitle_en: The skating rink opened for the season on Sunday. There was plenty of activity from day one.
185629.title_en: Ice hockey season gets under way

185631.excerpt_en: Just under a year ago, Arctic Memory received NOK 1.7 million from SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge to be used for a concept study. The study was to examine what kind of attraction could be built in connection with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault and the Arctic World Archive inside Mine 3.
185631.subtitle_en: A proposed visitor centre for the Seed Vault and the Archive Vault would tower over the landscape.
185631.tags_en: Arctic World Archive, Arctic Memory, news, Svalbard Global Seed Vault
185631.title_en: Ready for a 50-metre-high building by the shooting range?

185635.excerpt_en: Following this year’s local election, there has been much back-and-forth in Svalbardposten’s columns. The Labour Party and the Conservative Party have signed a cooperation agreement.
185635.subtitle_en: On Monday evening, 28 October, the local council will hold its first meeting since the election. The final decisions will be made on who becomes council chair and who will head the committees.
185635.tags_en: news, local elections, politics, local council, council chair, meeting
185635.title_en: Follow the local council’s first meeting here

185651.excerpt_en: A number of whale species can be found around Svalbard. Only three species live there year-round: bowhead whales, narwhals and belugas.
185651.subtitle_en: Economists believe they have found the answer.
185651.title_en: How much is a whale worth?

185668.excerpt_en: On Monday evening, three weeks after election day itself, the new local council held its first meeting. Arild Olsen (Labour) was formally elected as chair of the local council.
185668.subtitle_en: The new local council’s first meeting proceeded in an orderly manner. The chief administrative officer prepared the elected representatives for an important part of the work beginning this week.
185668.tags_en: news, local council, politics, local elections
185668.title_en: Peace and harmony at the local council’s first meeting

185680.excerpt_en: Around 30 different participants attended the official opening of the Seed Vault’s service building. As usual when it comes to the seed repository, there was a large press presence.
185680.subtitle_en: Minister of Agriculture and Food Olaug Bollestad (Christian Democratic Party) opened the service building at the Seed Vault. She stressed that the project is bigger than us.
185680.tags_en: army, Statsbygg, Olaug Bollestad, news, Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Svalbard Global Seed Vault
185680.title_en: The Seed Vault Once Again Ready for Eternity

185688.subtitle_en: When the news broke on Monday morning about the three-party alliance between Labour, the Conservatives and the Progress Party, Svalbardposten’s editor wrote a commentary that completely missed the mark.
185688.tags_en: local elections, reader contributions, letters to the editor, opinions

185702.excerpt_en: This, and much more, can be gleaned from the political platform agreed by the Labour Party and the Conservative Party. The platform has been named the Polarfarer Declaration—not because they are embarking on a political polar expedition, but because it was signed at the Polarfarer restaurant in central Longyearbyen on Monday evening this week.
185702.subtitle_en: The decision to impose summer holidays in kindergartens will be reversed, the port will be spun off as a separate entity, and they will determine the best way to pay for new kindergartens—privately or publicly.
185702.tags_en: politics, local elections, local council, news
185702.title_en: Concrete targets to be met within 100 days

185717.excerpt_en: “When I first got here, I thought, ‘Where the fuck have I ended up? I’ve never been this far from home before,’” he says in English. The university’s location was a major reason he came here.
185717.subtitle_en: Sidney Bickerton (20) has been on Svalbard since the beginning of August. He is here to take part in an educational programme in Arctic geology.
185717.tags_en: Svalbard people, life on Svalbard, back page, people
185717.title_en: He’s Never Been This Far from Home

185727.excerpt_en: This small “research vessel” has been on a mission west of Svalbard since August 8.
185727.subtitle_en: On Saturday, September 28, a sail buoy arrived in Longyearbyen for the first time in history. It sailed into Isfjorden and was picked up by UNIS Polaris.

185730.excerpt_en: The Halloween tradition, brought to the United States by Irish and Scottish immigrants, has spread to such remote corners of the world as Longyearbyen. The local shop has equipped its entrance with hollowed-out pumpkin heads, and everyone may have stocked up on sweets to buy their way out of a “trick.”
185730.subtitle_en: With the dark season comes Halloween. It arrives on Thursday.
185730.title_en: You Can Expect a Spooky Visit

185740.excerpt_en: “I have led the blues club since 2011, and I need to evaluate my own position. Perhaps it is time to hand over the reins to someone else,” he says.
185740.subtitle_en: This year’s festival figures are not yet finalized. Longyearbyen Blues Club leader Espen Helgesen is unsure whether he will continue to lead the festival.
185740.title_en: The End of the Blues Festival?

185743.excerpt_en: The three parties that now hold a majority on the local council have drawn up a joint platform. This is a document in which they set out, among other things, the issues on which they agree and disagree.
185743.subtitle_en: They believe the newspaper’s election coverage was unbalanced.
185743.title_en: Labour, Conservatives and Progress Party Wanted to Boycott Svalbardposten

185757.excerpt_en: Representatives from the Labour Party, the Conservative Party and the Progress Party arrived in suit jackets and with freshly combed hair, ready to embark on four new years. Svalbardposten was, of course, not present when the three parties that will govern reached agreements on cooperation and policy.
185757.subtitle_en: On Monday, the first local council meeting took place without any major debates.

185776.excerpt_en: Today, Samskipnaden will celebrate its 50th year. The occasion will be marked at UNIS with a concert by the wild Svalbard duo Trond Fødsel.
185776.subtitle_en: The 50th anniversary will be marked at UNIS tonight.
185776.tags_en: student welfare organization, Student Welfare Organization in Tromsø, news
185776.title_en: Playing a Concert for the Celebrating Student Welfare Organization

185781.excerpt_en: Sam and Avaz Ziaei are among those who lost their apartments at the Old Hospital in 2016. This happened after Multiconsult issued a report concluding that the condition of the building was unsatisfactory.
185781.subtitle_en: Sam and Avaz Ziaei’s complaint about the condition of the units they bought at the Old Hospital was submitted just over a month too late.

185783.excerpt_en: The lowest temperature measured this month is -14.5°C, compared with -9°C as the lowest temperature in October 2018. “We were actually talking about you as recently as yesterday, saying that you were approaching normal,” says Trond Robertsen of the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. When Robertsen refers to normal, he means the average temperature for 1960–1990.
185783.subtitle_en: We have to go back to 2015 to find an October as cold as the one we have had this year.

185798.excerpt_en: Automester Svalbard is located just a few metres north of Svalbard Auto, and can therefore rightly call itself the world’s northernmost car workshop. The workshop received a distinguished visit during its official opening ahead of the weekend. – Proud Janno Groene is the managing director of German-owned NDS Group, the supplier to the Automester chain in Norway.
185798.subtitle_en: When Automester Svalbard was formally opened ahead of the weekend, the world’s first Falck rescue snowmobile was introduced at the same time.
185798.title_en: Workshop and Rescue Service in One

185811.excerpt_en: The Arc is the name of a proposed visitor centre associated with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault and the Arctic World Archive. With support from, among others, Sparebank 1 Nord-Norge, Arctic Memory commissioned a feasibility study showing what could be built in connection with the two vaults.
185811.subtitle_en: The Seed Vault and the Arctic World Archive offer fantastic opportunities. Arctic Memory is gauging interest in a visitor centre in the area and presented The Arc before the weekend.
185811.tags_en: Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Snøhetta, news, Seed Vault, Arctic World Archive, Arctic Memory

185816.excerpt_en: This summer, rubbish has been collected along Svalbard’s beaches. Aktiv i friluft (Svalbard Turn) and the Governor of Svalbard have each organised their own cleanup expeditions.
185816.subtitle_en: Where does the rubbish along Svalbard’s coast come from? That is one of the questions they want to answer.
185816.tags_en: rubbish, beach cleanup, news, environment, marine litter
185816.title_en: Detective Work Among the Beach Litter

185824.excerpt_en: Pupils in grades 1–10 will soon be able to take the bus to school in the morning.
185824.subtitle_en: From Monday, 4 November, children will be able to take the school bus.

185848.excerpt_en: This photograph was taken in the summer of 1960, once again by deputy governor Carl A. Wendt.
185848.subtitle_en: We continue with a scene from Colesbukta in our series of historical images borrowed from Svalbard Museum.

185853.excerpt_en: Four temporary artworks were visited during the walk, where the artists spoke about the work involved in creating them. All the works address the problem of marine litter.
185853.subtitle_en: Last Saturday, Artica Svalbard invited people to an art walk.
185853.title_en: An Art Walk Among Marine Litter

185869.excerpt_en: Inside Svalbard Bryggeri’s premises, it is warm and comfortable. It is warm even though the district heating is switched off.
185869.subtitle_en: If Svalbard Bryggeri gets access to enough woodchips, it could produce 1.4 million kilowatt-hours of district heating a year.
185869.title_en: Burns Waste and Could Provide District Heating

185876.excerpt_en: The exhibition, held at Galleri Svalbard, is titled “What Remains When the Thoughts Have Gone.” “What is the title about?” “Yes, you tell me. I suppose it is about dreaming of arriving somewhere as if I had never been there before.”
185876.subtitle_en: Olaf Storø first came to Svalbard 30 years ago. Next week, as part of Kunstpause Svalbard, he will exhibit much of the work he has created.

185879.excerpt_en: This is the largest increase recorded since 2009, Statistics Norway (SSB) reports on its website.
185879.subtitle_en: A total of 121 people registered their move to Longyearbyen and Ny-Ålesund during the first half of this year.
185879.title_en: Biggest Population Growth in Ten Years

185911.title_en: Here Are the Members of All the Local Council Committees

185933.excerpt_en: “The cleanup of the Lunckefjell mine is well advanced and will be completed in 2020. We are now preparing for the next phase of the project,” says Jan Morten Ertsaas, managing director of Store Norske.
185933.subtitle_en: Four contracting companies have submitted bids for further cleanup work in Svea. The work is scheduled to begin in spring 2020.
185933.tags_en: news, Hæhre Entreprenør, Store Norske, environmental project
185933.title_en: Four Bid to Clean Up Svea

185935.excerpt_en: “We are still waiting for some prices, but as a starting point we can say that we will be upgrading it,” says Gunnar Garfors, NRK’s radio distribution adviser. Widely used: It was in June this year that Garfors visited Longyearbyen to inspect the town’s medium-wave facility.
185935.subtitle_en: Earlier this year, Svalbardposten reported that NRK was considering shutting down medium-wave broadcasting. It has now been decided that the system will be upgraded instead.

185943.subtitle_en: The town’s engagement in litter picking is strong. This year, it has resulted in more than 30 tonnes of rubbish being removed from the natural environment.

185976.excerpt_en: Kongsfjorden on Spitsbergen’s west coast is influenced by the northward-flowing West Spitsbergen Current. It is a branch of the warmer North Atlantic Current.
185976.subtitle_en: Research from Kongsfjorden outside Ny-Ålesund shows that a gull species can reveal ongoing climate change.
185976.title_en: Black-legged kittiwakes tell researchers about climate change

185988.excerpt_en: For those living in Longyearbyen, Oddny is a familiar face behind the counter at Posten. Collecting and sending parcels and handing out mail are handled by experienced hands, with a smile and a small comment about the weather whenever Oddny is at work.
185988.subtitle_en: After ten years in Svalbard, Oddny Slatlem’s time has come to an end. She and her husband recently left the archipelago.

185998.excerpt_en: “We ended up in a mess because we believed what Høyre wrote about centre-right cooperation in its programme,” says Oddmund Rønning, who was appointed to negotiate on Venstre’s behalf after the election. What really happened between the majority parties and Venstre after election night?
185998.subtitle_en: Venstre’s lead negotiator says questions remain unanswered about what happened in the post-election negotiations.

186019.excerpt_en: “It was great to see so many people dressed up and so eager to show off their costumes,” says club leader Marius Simavik. The fifth- to seventh-graders went first, followed by parties for lower- and upper-secondary students.
186019.subtitle_en: There was a Halloween party at the club on Friday. It was popular.

186026.excerpt_en: The Governor has extensive experience of protecting areas in Svalbard. But conservation has always focused on areas far out in the wilderness.
186026.subtitle_en: The Governor is to draw up a new management plan, expand Nordenskiöld Land National Park and possibly protect the lower parts of Adventdalen. They have asked for input, and the responses have been numerous.
186026.tags_en: nature conservation, news, Governor, Adventdalen, national park, conservation

186050.excerpt_en: The Ministry of Climate and the Environment has asked the Governor to prepare a comprehensive management plan for the entire area and initiate planning processes covering the Sassen-Bünsow Land, Nordre Isfjorden, Nordenskiöld Land and Indre Wijdefjorden national parks.
186050.subtitle_en: A massive conservation effort covering central Spitsbergen is getting under way.
186050.tags_en: Van Mijenfjorden, conservation plan, leader, opinion

186052.excerpt_en: A small reflective vest sprints past the boat buoys and up toward the trapping cabins at the top of the sledding hill. “Try to find me, Ingrid,” calls the speedy shadow.
186052.subtitle_en: Gruvedalen’s brand-new playground has officially opened.

186062.excerpt_en: “Some board members have stepped down, and we have brought in two new ones who felt that we absolutely had to try to make this happen. We made a joint assessment and concluded that we should give it a try.”

186095.excerpt_en: The trapping station at Austfjordnes is empty for the second winter in a row this year. The reason is that the Governor has carried out improvement work on the cabin there.
186095.subtitle_en: Would you like to spend the winter at Austfjordnes, at the head of Wijdefjorden? You can apply now.

186102.excerpt_en: It was the Governor’s boat, “Polarsyssel”, that transported 25 pupils and five teachers and assistants there. When they arrived, they were met on the quay by a Russian teacher and three school pupils.
186102.subtitle_en: On Wednesday, October 30, the fourth grade went on a trip to Barentsburg.
186102.title_en: Learned Russian dancing on a visit

186125.excerpt_en: “It’s great fun. And it was also really fun being goalkeeper, even though it’s difficult to see where the ball is all the time,” says Thor Eklund.

186141.subtitle_en: World-renowned pianist Leif Ove Andsnes is coming to Longyearbyen.

186144.excerpt_en: A total of 79 applicants competed for the NOK 8.5 million that DIP was to distribute. In the end, 18 projects were selected, including LPO Arkitekter’s project in Longyearbyen.

186166.excerpt_en: In an email to the Longyearbyen Community Council, he describes several dangerous situations that have occurred. “I have repeatedly experienced dangerous situations at the Hilmar Rekstens vei/232/229 junction. In every case, cars came from Road 229 or Road 232 and ignored both the speed limit and the obligation to yield.”
186166.subtitle_en: The improvements to the road system where Road 232 meets Road 229 and Hilmar Rekstens vei were intended to make conditions safer for vulnerable road users. That has not happened, says Malte Jochmann.

186178.excerpt_en: The monthly cost is around NOK 5 million, meaning that “Polarsyssel” will provide year-round emergency preparedness, compared with the current nine months.

186194.excerpt_en: “These are areas on which we had broad agreement when we spoke after the election. They also give us something to steer by now that we have begun a new four-year term,” says Community Council leader Arild Olsen (Labour).
186194.subtitle_en: The school will be opened for overnight stays and Norwegian-language instruction will be strengthened. Within 100 days, these and three other goals are to be achieved by the majority group on the Community Council.
186194.tags_en: Longyearbyen School, Conservative Party, Progress Party, Labour Party, Svalbard Turn, news, politics
186194.title_en: Arild & Co. to achieve political goals by February

186200.subtitle_en: Although the festival is being scaled back, there will be no shortage of artists.

186293.subtitle_en: The government is allocating an additional NOK 10 million for expanded operations of the Governor’s vessel M/S “Polarsyssel.”

186302.excerpt_en: Matches were played in seven different sports: football, volleyball, chess, badminton, table tennis, basketball and indoor football. Longyearbyen has won every sports exchange so far this year and faced little resistance in the football match.

186315.subtitle_en: The open-access sports hall has given users greater freedom. Now they also want it open at night. The arrangement will be evaluated at the end of the year.

186339.excerpt_en: As the local council’s committees work on the budget, the Progress Party has proposed expanding the school bus service. It expects to receive support from its majority partners in Labour and the Conservatives.

186345.excerpt_en: “It was surprisingly well attended, and we received lots of positive feedback from those who came. That makes it easier to arrange another one,” says Merethe Stiberg, head of Aktiv i friluft.
