187444.title_en: Local Support for the Government’s Proposed Restrictions

187454.excerpt_en: On a small rise in the southern part of the playground, the children from Polarflokken Kindergarten have gathered with the staff. A fire crackles in a fire pan beside a colourful floodlight.
187454.subtitle_en: Polarflokken Kindergarten has received the climbing tower from the former Longyearbyen Kindergarten. Tuesday saw the official opening of the newly relocated playground equipment.

187458.excerpt_en: “It was caused by an internal technical fault connected with a voltage measurement,” says Hans Normann, energy manager at LL. The power was out for around 20 minutes.
187458.subtitle_en: Yesterday, Tuesday, at around 6:15 p.m., the power went out throughout the town.
187458.title_en: Power Cut Across the Entire Town

187487.excerpt_en: “I want to task the regional health authority with stationing an extra jet in Tromsø during the winter. A jet can handle longer missions, particularly to Svalbard.”
187487.subtitle_en: Health Minister Bent Høie (Conservative) today presented several measures to strengthen emergency preparedness in Northern Norway. One is to station an extra jet in Tromsø during the winter, which will also serve Svalbard.
187487.title_en: Minister Wants an Extra Jet in Tromsø

187502.excerpt_en: 2019 has been a year with plenty to look back on. Hopefully, Svalbardposten has kept you up to date and informed about the most important issues and events in town.
187502.subtitle_en: We have put together an 80-page Christmas edition that we hope you will relax with over the holidays. There should be something for everyone, young and old.
187502.title_en: A Source of Both Irritation and Joy

187509.excerpt_en: At the top of Vei 230, a snow fence has been built. Two lights burn there, sheltered from the strong wind.
187509.subtitle_en: Today marks four years since the avalanche took two lives from us.
187509.tags_en: Sukkertoppen avalanche, avalanche, news, accident, Spisshusene
187509.title_en: Some Things We Must Never Forget

187539.excerpt_en: Update: According to VG, three people were evacuated from “Lance.” VG’s journalist and photographer were not among them.
187539.subtitle_en: A medical evacuation from “Lance” is scheduled for today, Friday.

187544.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten compared the prices of Christmas goods at Svalbardbutikken with prices at the largest mainland stores. We checked prices at Coop Extra, Kiwi and Rema 1000 and found an average price for the goods.
187544.subtitle_en: The Christmas price war dominates headlines on mainland Norway.

187557.excerpt_en: The newcomers, the Svalbard Folk High School choir, opened the Christmas concert with the beautiful “Northern Norwegian Christmas Hymn,” followed by “A Star Shines Tonight.” They also had excellent soloists among them, Regine Heien and Brage Stokseth.
187557.subtitle_en: The traditional Christmas concert at Svalbard Church is a sure sign that Christmas is approaching.
187557.tags_en: news, Christmas concert, Svalbard Church, magazine
187557.title_en: The Town’s Singers and Musicians Welcomed Christmas

187566.excerpt_en: The back of the photograph reads: “Christmas Eve at the telegraph station. From left: Strøm, Jensen Taranger, Hansen, Ego, Sannæs, Mikkelsen and Kristiansen (the steward).”
187566.subtitle_en: This week’s historical photograph is from Christmas Eve 1914 and was loaned by the Svalbard Museum.

187581.excerpt_en: At the year’s final local council meeting, someone asked whether the town’s alpine slope, which opened last year, could become a permanent facility.
187581.subtitle_en: A group of parents is demanding action on the town’s alpine facility. “Local politicians should have taken responsibility here,” says Dag Arne Husdal.
187581.tags_en: youth, news, winter, Longyearbyen Local Council, children, alpine slope, activities, skiing
187581.title_en: Parents Remind Officials That the Slope Was the Top Priority

187588.excerpt_en: They have welcomed many new scouts this autumn, and as far as the leaders have been able to determine, the group has never been larger. Fourteen new scouts joined.
187588.subtitle_en: Last Thursday was the Christmas gathering for Svalbard Church’s scout group.

187593.excerpt_en: The station’s doors and windows have been reinforced, the surviving dog has moved indoors, door blockers have been installed, and the crew does not go outside more than necessary.
187593.subtitle_en: This year’s Christmas trip to Hornsund was especially unusual. The polar bear attack a few weeks ago still affects the crew’s everyday life.

187637.excerpt_en: Per Arne Totland has had a special interest in Svalbard and Norwegian Arctic policy for many years. “A Hundred Years from Now, Everything Is Hidden” is a political thriller set in Russia, Germany, Sweden and Finland—but very much in Norway and Longyearbyen as well.
187637.subtitle_en: Per Arne Totland (61) has sold the TV rights to the novel “A Hundred Years from Now, Everything Is Hidden.”
187637.title_en: Svalbard Book Could Become a TV Series

187658.excerpt_en: “Putting out the fire in the small sauna was not difficult. The problem was the shower of sparks that rose many, many metres into the air,” says Fire Chief Jan Olav Sæter.
187658.subtitle_en: Fire Chief Jan Olav Sæter will follow up on the sauna fire at Hotellneset this weekend.
187658.tags_en: fire, news, Longyearbyen Fire and Rescue
187658.title_en: A Shower of Sparks at Hotellneset on Saturday

187691.excerpt_en: “Oh, look! There we are,” exclaims Kristin Mork.
187691.subtitle_en: Twenty-five years ago, their Christmas poems were published in Svalbardposten’s Christmas issue. “Oh help, are we really that old?” Emelie Våtvik says when we confront her with her poetry.
187691.tags_en: school, news, magazine, Christmas, history, Svalbardposten, growing up in Longyearbyen
187691.title_en: Looking at What They Made for the Christmas Newspaper 25 Years Ago

187693.excerpt_en: He brought a “Lucas” defibrillator. “It is a genuine pleasure and joy to present this to the skilled professionals at the hospital. We potentially have the world’s longest resuscitation interval here, and this will help avoid a time penalty,” says Gilbert.
187693.subtitle_en: Chief physician Mads Gilbert had an extra surprise for Longyearbyen Hospital during the annual Christmas lunch on 23 December.
187693.title_en: Brought a Christmas Gift to the Hospital

187699.excerpt_en: “I started to feel it a little. You spend so many years training, and it seems a shame simply to set it aside.”
187699.subtitle_en: Tone Heide left her job as a veterinarian this summer and had planned to take a break from the profession. After just a few months, she decided that she wanted to continue working as a veterinarian after all.

187713.excerpt_en: After the avalanche in 2015, this hymn burned itself into my memory as something that always stirs emotions. I carry it with me and sing it on my Christmas rounds as I now travel east: “God’s peace over mountain and hill.”
187713.subtitle_en: The Christmas hymn that has stayed with me most strongly from my years in Svalbard is “Nordnorsk julesalme.”

187739.excerpt_en: Update: The polar bear is now on the other side of the pass at Longyearbreen. The Governor of Svalbard will continue using a helicopter to push the bear towards Colesdalen.
187739.subtitle_en: At around half past six this morning, a polar bear was spotted in town, in the area between Coop and Kroa.

187765.excerpt_en: The sixth grade has made Christmas pages for the newspaper. This autumn, the class learned about the media. They have made podcasts and television news, while one group produced material for this year’s Christmas newspaper.
187765.subtitle_en: We interviewed Silvia Galli in the school library. We asked her about the school’s Snøles reading campaign, which ran from 1 to 30 November.
187765.tags_en: culture, Svalbard life, books, library, children, Christmas

187822.excerpt_en: In addition to enquiries from several media outlets, she has gained many new followers on both Instagram and Facebook, as well as nearly 50 friend requests. “A great many people ask for the film, and people also send messages to tell me about copyrights and things like that.”
187822.subtitle_en: Marie Lørup Stenshøj (27) filmed the polar bear as it walked past her apartment. The response afterwards has been enormous.
187822.title_en: She Never Imagined the Enormous Response

187839.excerpt_en: “We were out within ten minutes, and spotted the bear fairly quickly in the river by Melkeveien,” says senior police officer at the Governor’s Office Anders Haugerud. Eight people were out at the time, spread across seven vehicles, following the bear out of the town centre and up towards Huset.
187839.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the polar bear in town at 6:23 a.m. on Thursday. The caller said a bear was heading from the closed-down kindergarten at Skjæringa towards the river.
187839.title_en: Governor’s Office Escorted Polar Bear Out of Town

187852.excerpt_en: The polar night is approaching on Halvmåneøya. The sun is already well below the horizon, and the days are merely one long twilight.
187852.subtitle_en: “Trappers claim that the polar night is depressing and that one is not oneself during that period; that is simply nonsense—we certainly notice nothing.” (K. Bjåen, 1947)
187852.title_en: Christmas in the Trapper’s Cabin – Halvmåneøya 1947

187856.excerpt_en: At around six o’clock on Saturday morning, the Governor of Svalbard issued a notice urging people to exercise caution. At the time, the Governor’s personnel were out trying to drive the bear out of town.
187856.subtitle_en: The polar bear seen in central Longyearbyen on Thursday morning returned on Saturday morning.
187856.title_en: The Polar Bear Returned to Town

187863.excerpt_en: I have honestly been very puzzled by this year’s school-bus arrangement and the time the school opens. The school bus picks up the children at around 7:45 a.m., and they arrive at school a few minutes later.
187863.subtitle_en: Today I received the confirmation I needed to speak clearly about what I think of a practice introduced at the school during this polar night season.
187863.title_en: Does the School Take the Children’s Safety Seriously?

187887.excerpt_en: “This means we cannot fully predict which direction the bear will move in next. We are therefore asking people to be extremely cautious when they are out and about.”
187887.subtitle_en: Because of the weather conditions, the Governor of Svalbard’s helicopter has now had to abandon the original plan to push the polar bear towards Van Mijenfjorden. The bear’s last known position was at the head of Bjørndalen.
187887.title_en: Operation Called Off Due to Bad Weather

187917.excerpt_en: “The old boys got rather strange, I wonder if we’ll make it to Shang-Po-Lar?” In the song “Grønnhjelm,” Knut Magne Myrland sings about the newly hired miner who arrives on the freighter “Binny” from Harstad. The old boys are experienced men in Store Norske Spitsbergen Kulkompani.
187917.subtitle_en: In the shadow of the Kings Bay accident, a remarkable nightlife event in Longyearbyen comes to light.
187917.title_en: The Kings Bay Accident, “Shang-Po-Lar,” and the 1962–63 New Year’s Party

187922.excerpt_en: Update at 12 noon: The Governor of Svalbard never observed the polar bear while out earlier trying to locate it, and is therefore asking people to take extra care. “We have personnel on standby.”
187922.subtitle_en: The polar bear was spotted in Bjørndalen again on Sunday morning, after being driven out of the area yesterday.

187926.excerpt_en: The café is undergoing a complete renovation, with nearly three million kroner invested in the refurbishment. But Fruene will still be Fruene, assures general manager Tove Beate Eide. “There is always an element of excitement in processes like these.”
187926.subtitle_en: New Year’s Eve will be Fruene’s last opening day before it closes for almost four weeks.

187935.excerpt_en: Terje Carlsen, communications adviser with the Governor of Svalbard, stresses the importance of people staying alert when travelling outdoors. “In addition, people should carry a weapon when travelling outside the settlement. This bear is a reminder that it can be anywhere.”
187935.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has still not seen the polar bear that entered the town, after it was last observed in Bjørndalen on Sunday morning.
187935.title_en: “A reminder that the bear can be anywhere”

187953.excerpt_en: Last winter, the old ski lift was finally moved to Lia. It was a welcome and long-awaited amenity.
187953.subtitle_en: Parents are joining forces to expand the ski slope.

187960.excerpt_en: Perhaps it is no surprise that polar bear stories top the list. The polar bear that recently visited the town attracted attention from both Svalbard residents and people from outside.1.
187960.subtitle_en: 2019 is virtually behind us. These ten stories had the most readers over the past year.
187960.title_en: These stories attracted the most attention

187971.excerpt_en: Fireworks and people evidently did not scare the bear away. At a quarter to one on the night of 1 January…
187971.subtitle_en: The Governor’s helicopter was airborne shortly after midnight. The polar bear that has visited the town over the past week is probably back.

187989.excerpt_en: The polar bear was euthanised at 4 a.m. in Hanaskogdalen during the night of 1 January.
187989.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has euthanised the polar bear that had repeatedly approached the settlement recently. The situation was no longer considered safe.
187989.title_en: The polar bear has been shot

188022.excerpt_en: Terje Carlsen, communications adviser with the Governor of Svalbard, says the male bear was sedated and tagged in Adventdalen in April 2016. “So it has been here before. That time, it was flown to Kinnvika on Nordaustlandet,” he says.
188022.subtitle_en: The polar bear that was euthanised at 4 a.m. on New Year’s Day in Hanaskogdalen had been near Longyearbyen before. In 2016, it was flown to Nordaustlandet.
188022.title_en: It was a seven-year-old male bear

188036.excerpt_en: Just as cars have to undergo an MOT test, ships also need to be checked for faults and deficiencies from time to time. MS «Norbjørn», the vessel that transports goods to and from Svalbard, is to be recertified in January.
188036.subtitle_en: MS «Norbjørn» is to be recertified, leaving Coop without a boat connection for three weeks.
188036.tags_en: Ronny Strømnes, Coop Svalbard, Coop, Svalbardbutikken, news
188036.title_en: Three weeks without a boat connection

188073.excerpt_en: Questions have been raised about the risk of avalanches and consideration for the environment and industrial heritage. The latter two considerations will limit the terrain that can be used for downhill skiing.
188073.subtitle_en: A downhill ski slope for children is essential to their well-being and health. A ski lift and permanent location are on the Local Council’s action plan for the next four years (see SP, 19 December 2019). But the priorities are uncertain.
188073.title_en: A long wait for a permanent ski slope?

188080.excerpt_en: The school day begins on Monday, 6 January.
188080.subtitle_en: On Monday, the school will assess whether to introduce further safety measures against polar bears.
188080.tags_en: security, school, Longyearbyen School, polar bear, children, news
188080.title_en: Reassessing security measures after polar bear visits

188091.excerpt_en: We have just come through a decade of little ice in the Arctic. This winter, too, the ice extent around the North Pole is close to a record low, but we notice little of that in Svalbard.
188091.subtitle_en: There has not been this much sea ice around Svalbard since 2010. At Bring, they have been assured by the Governor of Svalbard that «Norbjørn» will receive assistance if it cannot make its way through the ice.
188091.tags_en: sea ice, Norwegian Meteorological Institute, climate, ice conditions, pack ice, winter, Bring, news
188091.title_en: Easterly winds could help the snowmobile season

188101.excerpt_en: Many people breathed a sigh of relief when Svalbardposten issue number four last year reported that «Northguider» had been successfully emptied of environmentally hazardous substances.
188101.subtitle_en: The shrimp trawler «Northguider» is still lying in Hinlopen Strait after its accident during the Christmas holidays in 2018. In January, there was relief when the vessel was successfully emptied of environmentally hazardous substances.

188114.excerpt_en: There was great jubilation in the Croatian family last June. Longyearbyen Local Council had initially rejected the application for a school place for the ten-year-old, who has special needs.
188114.subtitle_en: After a year-long battle, Ivano Cafuta, 10, was finally given a place at school.

188121.excerpt_en: When the newspaper can show such clear, good pictures of polar bears, our website traffic takes off. We do feel a little sorry for Jon Kristian Bø, whose boat suffered considerable damage.
188121.subtitle_en: The bear that climbed into Jon Kristian Bø’s boat in Tempelfjorden in September was Svalbardposten’s second most-read story of 2019.

188130.excerpt_en: At the beginning of October, Svalbardposten presented Omid’s story. In November, we were also able to present his first meeting with his mother in all those years.
188130.subtitle_en: Omid Abolhasani has more patience than most. After spending ten consecutive years in Longyearbyen and on Svalbard, he was finally free to move around again.

188134.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified that the polar bear had been spotted in Adventdalen just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. It was heading towards town. “We arrived 10–15 minutes later and saw fresh polar bear tracks from the road in the area near Isdammen.”
188134.subtitle_en: When the polar bear returned to Longyearbyen for the fourth time in a short period on New Year’s Eve, the Governor of Svalbard chose to euthanise it. According to senior police officer Ole Jakob Malmo, sedating and relocating the bear was not a realistic option.

188149.excerpt_en: The decision to euthanise the polar bear was made after careful consideration. According to polar bear researcher Jon Aars, it was a problem bear that would most likely have found its way back to town again even if it had been flown far away to Nordaustlandet.
188149.subtitle_en: Debate on social media exploded after a polar bear that had entered Longyearbyen and the surrounding area no fewer than four times during the Christmas holidays was shot by the Governor of Svalbard.
188149.tags_en: shot polar bear, leader, polar bear visit, polar bear in town, polar bear, opinions

188160.excerpt_en: Around 100 students attended the opening in Møysalen on Wednesday morning. This week, they are beginning a one-week safety course.
188160.subtitle_en: At 9 a.m. on Wednesday, the new semester got under way at UNIS.

188163.excerpt_en: “We’ve put on our spending trousers and want ordinary people to join in the anniversary celebrations,” says bank manager Trond Hellstad. What self-respecting town doesn’t have a bank?
188163.subtitle_en: With a business seminar on Friday and a public celebration on Saturday, the town’s bank is inviting people to its 60th-anniversary festivities.
188163.tags_en: news, the house, public celebration, SpareBank 1, bank, anniversary

188176.excerpt_en: AMS/Airwing remained on standby in Tromsø until 5 January.
188176.subtitle_en: The Air Ambulance Service HF has entered into agreements with Danish Joinjet and Norwegian AMS/Airwing to provide jet emergency preparedness from Tromsø until 5 April this year.
188176.title_en: Jet aircraft strengthens emergency preparedness in Tromsø

188190.excerpt_en: There has not been this much ice around Svalbard since the winter of 2010–11. So far, shipping traffic around Svalbard has not been significantly affected by the ice.
188190.subtitle_en: Brings’ freighter “Norbjørn” is currently receiving help from the Coast Guard to get through the ice. This has not happened since the winter of 2009.
188190.tags_en: Bring, boat, sea ice, Coast Guard, news, pack ice

188206.excerpt_en: As part of the bank’s 60th-anniversary celebrations this weekend, it is holding a business seminar tomorrow. The people scheduled to speak at the seminar were supposed to have arrived on the cancelled flight.
188206.subtitle_en: Both the postal flight and SAS’s flight to Longyearbyen were cancelled on Thursday, 9 January, due to strong winds and a slippery runway in Tromsø.

188212.excerpt_en: Every year, Store Norske uses 180,000 litres of diesel at Isfjord Radio. Now it wants to put an end to this in order to reduce its carbon footprint.
188212.subtitle_en: A range of measures in the buildings, combined with renewable energy supplies, will cut diesel consumption by two-thirds. “A pioneering project for other places in Svalbard,” says Store Norske.
188212.tags_en: Telenor, solar power, wind power, news, Isfjord Radio, renewable energy, energy transition, energy, Basecamp Spitsbergen, Store Norske

188214.excerpt_en: This summer, Store Norske put the next phase of the environmental project and clean-up in Svea/Lunckefjell out to tender. Just before Christmas, Hæhre Entreprenør AS was notified that it had been selected and would be awarded phase 2A.
188214.subtitle_en: Next week, Store Norske will sign the contract for the next phase of the clean-up in Svea. If everything goes according to plan, the entrance to Svea Nord will be sealed for good in March.
188214.tags_en: Svea, Store Norske, news, environmental project, Svea Nord
188214.title_en: Entering the next phase in Svea

188241.excerpt_en: When Svalbardposten spoke to the polar bear researcher after the first bear visit, he said it was not unlikely that it was the young male that had stayed in Isfjorden during the summer. “(...) It doesn’t look like a very old bear.”
188241.subtitle_en: Rumours that two different polar bears visited during the Christmas holidays have been circulating around town. Polar bear researcher Jon Aars is fairly certain that it was just one bear.
188241.title_en: “I’d be surprised if they were two different bears”

188269.excerpt_en: On Monday this week, the leadership at Longyearbyen School held a meeting on polar bear safety. It followed the polar bear visit to the town during the Christmas holidays.
188269.subtitle_en: The school leadership and the Governor of Svalbard currently agree that they will not change their polar bear safety procedures. However, some measures—such as later school-bus departures—may be considered.
188269.tags_en: security, Longyearbyen School, polar bear visit, school, children, news

188271.excerpt_en: “Previous polar bear seminars have been among the best attended, so we expect many people will be interested in coming now after the polar bear visits over the Christmas holidays,” says Eva Therese Jenssen, head of communications at UNIS.
188271.subtitle_en: The annual Svalbard Seminar is just around the corner. Organisers expect considerable interest in Wednesday’s opening lecture on polar bears, given by polar bear researcher Jon Aars.
188271.title_en: Kicks off with polar bear researcher

188282.excerpt_en: The commemoration will be held under the auspices of the Governor on Sunday afternoon, 9 February.
188282.subtitle_en: On 9 February, the Norwegian authorities will hold an event in Longyearbyen. The event will focus on the historical background of the Svalbard Treaty.

188292.excerpt_en: Coal production in Mine 7 will eventually come to an end, and a new energy source must be phased in. Many suppliers are interested in Svalbard as a test bed for new energy solutions.
188292.subtitle_en: We can look back on a decade that brought major changes to the Longyearbyen community. The pace of transformation will most likely increase over the next ten years. The energy transition is one area we know will receive considerable attention.

188306.excerpt_en: The day began with a steady stream of people at Huset, where Anne Lise Klungseth Sandvik talked about the building’s history. Later there were speeches and entertainment on stage, with Trond Hellstad, the Longyearbyen branch manager, guiding the audience through a packed programme.
188306.subtitle_en: The bank went all out when it celebrated its 60th anniversary over the weekend.

188321.excerpt_en: Charlotte was only ten when she moved to Longyearbyen. When her family moved back to the mainland while she was in upper secondary school, Charlotte chose to stay.
188321.subtitle_en: Although she is only 29, Charlotte Sandmo has recently bought a house on the mainland.

188327.excerpt_en: This autumn, the government presented an industry strategy for Svalbard, advocating, among other things, making businesses—including tourism—more sustainable. Later in the autumn, it also proposed introducing caps on cruise ships.
188327.subtitle_en: “This could lead to fewer tourists choosing Svalbard, but it will ensure a good tourism offering with healthy profits for local operators,” says Trade and Industry Minister Torbjørn Røe Isaksen (Conservative).
188327.title_en: Government Wants Certified Guides on Svalbard

188329.excerpt_en: This week’s historical image is a postcard loaned by Svalbard Museum. It shows a locomotive with carriages in Ny-Ålesund, circa 1917.
188329.subtitle_en: This week’s historical photo glimpse comes from Ny-Ålesund.

188341.excerpt_en: “This time, we wanted active girls themselves to provide the instruction, to try to get more girls in Longyearbyen interested in football,” says John W. Olsen, head of the football section.
188341.subtitle_en: In cooperation with IF Fløya and NFF Troms, Svalbard Turn invited players to a football camp last week. One of the groups instructed was the J7–10 age group.
188341.title_en: Svalbard Turn Gives Girls’ Football a Boost

188358.excerpt_en: “This is very good news, and a regulation we warmly welcome,” says Ronny Strømnes, chair of Visit Svalbard, in a press release. The government plans to tighten the rules.
188358.subtitle_en: Visit Svalbard supports the government’s plans for certified guides on Svalbard.

188365.excerpt_en: The reason the ‘cork money’ was not distributed in November or December as usual is that the local elections took up the staff who were supposed to administer all the applications. And there were applications—43 of them.
188365.subtitle_en: The money was actually supposed to be distributed before Christmas. On Thursday, 16 January, OKU will decide who receives funding and who does not.
188365.tags_en: Childhood and Culture Committee, news, Longyearbyen Community Council, politics, cork money, volunteering, OKU
188365.title_en: Thursday, OKU Decides Who Gets ‘Cork Money’

188392.excerpt_en: “If nothing is done, we fear serious accidents. That would not look good for anyone,” said Franka Leiterer, a board member of the Svalbard Guide Association, when Svalbardposten spoke to her before Christmas.
188392.subtitle_en: Today, anyone can take on guide work on Svalbard, both on land and on the water. The local guide association has campaigned for certification requirements.
188392.tags_en: tourism, government, news, guides, guiding industry, education, regulation
188392.title_en: Guide Association Feared Accidents—Now They Are Being Heard

188412.excerpt_en: This autumn, the government presented an industry strategy for Svalbard, advocating, among other things, making businesses—including tourism—more sustainable. Not long afterwards, it said it would introduce tighter restrictions on cruise tourism.
188412.subtitle_en: In 2014, the ministry rejected certification for guides and companies. Now the matter is back on the Governor’s desk.
188412.tags_en: Svalbard Environmental Protection Act, government, news, tourism, regulation
188412.title_en: Will Tackle the Svalbard Environmental Protection Act

188414.excerpt_en: On Tuesday came the news that the government will impose stricter requirements on the tourism industry and is considering certification for guides operating on and around Svalbard.
188414.subtitle_en: Certification should have been made compulsory as early as 2014, when the tourist regulations were considered.
188414.title_en: Yes to Stricter Requirements for Guides

188424.excerpt_en: The watercolours he is exhibiting this time are exclusively Svalbard scenes. “The subjects are really secondary. What I want to convey is more a sense of atmosphere,” says the artist.
188424.subtitle_en: Sigurd Slembe (75) has visited Svalbard five times. On Thursday, he opens an exhibition at Galleri Svalbard.

188456.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten meets a group of UNIS students on Monday morning. One of the activities on the day’s schedule is sea-ice safety.
188456.subtitle_en: For a full week, UNIS students practise what to do if something goes wrong while out on trips. It all concludes with a major exercise on Longyearbreen.

188471.excerpt_en: They have played several concerts before, including at UKM (the Youth Cultural Festival), on 17 May and at Polarjazz, but they have little experience playing on a large stage.
188471.subtitle_en: Rocka Reinsdyr was the local act when the bank celebrated its own 60th anniversary at Huset. The young musicians have been playing together for nearly a year.

188487.excerpt_en: On Sunday, Aktiv i friluft organised a Christmas tree burning in the waterfront area.
188487.subtitle_en: Thirty Christmas trees went up in smoke on Sunday.

188492.excerpt_en: Mads Gilbert, chief medical officer at the University Hospital of North Norway (UNN), believes there has long been an obvious need for an air ambulance jet stationed in Tromsø.
188492.subtitle_en: Last week came the news that Luftambulansetjenesten HF had arranged a temporary solution with a jet aircraft in Tromsø. It will remain on standby until 5 April.

188505.excerpt_en: The annual Christmas event with the Governor of Svalbard and Svalbard Church in Barentsburg was held on Monday, 13 January—one week late.
188505.subtitle_en: Both Father Frost and the church elves added an extra touch to the Christmas celebration in Barentsburg.

188524.excerpt_en: This week’s historical image is a postcard of a man in a boat by Kongsbreen near Ny-Ålesund, taken around 1920. The postcard is on loan from Svalbard Museum.
188524.subtitle_en: Kongsbreen has retreated considerably since this picture was taken.

188530.excerpt_en: At around 7 p.m. on Saturday, the Governor of Svalbard was notified that a dog was chasing a reindeer near the Community Centre. The Governor’s patrol, along with others who helped at the scene, quickly brought the loose dog under control.
188530.subtitle_en: “You risk being fined,” says senior police officer Espen Olsen of the Governor of Svalbard’s office.
188530.tags_en: reindeer, Governor of Svalbard, loose dogs, animal welfare, news
188530.title_en: Loose Dog Chased Reindeer near the Community Centre

188544.excerpt_en: Although most of us on board are biologists studying biological processes during the polar night, we also carry out routine temperature measurements in the fjords.
188544.subtitle_en: We are currently on a polar-night expedition aboard the research vessel Helmer Hanssen. This is the ninth year we have conducted an expedition in the area at this time of year.

188558.excerpt_en: Three new diesel generators will be housed in a building in the area where the coal receiving facility is today. Everything is being built as modules in Germany and will be shipped to Longyearbyen.
188558.subtitle_en: All the agreements are in place. Construction of the backup power plant will begin this spring.

188572.excerpt_en: He has lived in Longyearbyen since March and worked for local tradespeople. “There is a lot to learn and a lot to deal with. We are also entering an exciting period with the renovation of Fruene,” says the new centre manager.
188572.subtitle_en: Svein Erik Iversen, 45, has taken over as centre and operations manager at Lompi Centre, succeeding Trond Strugstad.
188572.tags_en: Lompi Centre, news, people, shops, working life, jobs

188579.excerpt_en: Over the past seven years, six different ministers have been responsible for Svalbard. The latest was Ingvill Smines Tybring-Gjedde (Progress Party), but now her tenure is ending too.
188579.subtitle_en: The Progress Party is leaving the government. Among other things, this means that the Svalbard minister will be replaced.
188579.title_en: Must Wait for a New Svalbard Minister

188582.excerpt_en: I read the report about the latest bear visit to Longyearbyen and the discussions surrounding it. I was an environmental protection consultant with the Governor of Svalbard from 1991 to 1994 and was responsible for coordinating environmental and cultural heritage protection at the time.
188582.subtitle_en: Reidar Hindrum was an environmental protection consultant with the Governor of Svalbard in the early 1990s. At the time, one of his tasks was sedating polar bears.
188582.title_en: When the Governor Sedated a Polar Bear

188597.excerpt_en: “I have always sought out exotic places where it is warm and pleasant. I have actually never been fond of winter,” says Trude.
188597.subtitle_en: Trude Røsholt, 40, has worked and studied in Africa, Australia and Asia. Now she has settled in Longyearbyen.

188614.excerpt_en: After years of declining ticket sales, the festival board had to take a trip to the proverbial drawing board last year. They decided to go for it in 2020.
188614.subtitle_en: “We’re taking a small step back to the starting point,” says board member Trond Strugstad about this year’s Polarjazz. But the festival has a couple of pleasant surprises up its sleeve.
188614.tags_en: life in Svalbard, Ny-Ålesund, youth, culture, festival, Polarjazz
188614.title_en: If You’re Lucky—and Generous—You Could Join the Trip to Ny-Ålesund

188628.excerpt_en: Profits from alcohol sales at Nordpolet go toward welfare initiatives in Longyearbyen and Svea. Now the board wants to establish an outlet in the airport’s departure hall as well.
188628.tags_en: news, Svalbard Airport, airport, Avinor, alcohol, Nordpolet

188636.excerpt_en: Earlier this month, Svalbardposten reported that the next phase in Svea was now beginning. The contract, worth around NOK 100 million, has now been signed.
188636.subtitle_en: Hæhre Entreprenør AS will be responsible for Phase 2A, which involves removing roads and infrastructure in the Svea Nord mine. Store Norske writes this in a press release.

188639.excerpt_en: The polar bear shot on New Year’s Eve has now been measured and weighed by the Governor’s environmental protection department. As we have already reported, it was a seven-year-old male bear.
188639.subtitle_en: The bear shot on New Year’s Eve has been measured and weighed.

188661.excerpt_en: Two close encounters involving tourists and guides in the field fortunately ended well, even though the bear appeared suddenly and came very close. We live in an extraordinarily beautiful and scenic place, but here it is we humans who must adapt to the weather, natural hazards and wildlife.
188661.subtitle_en: There have been more polar bear incidents in recent weeks than there have been for quite some time. The Governor will consider a more robust emergency response.
188661.title_en: More Polar Bear Encounters—Measures Must Be Considered

188669.excerpt_en: This year’s sun drawing is a colorful creation that smiles warmly at you. The artist behind it is seventh-grader Angela Santos Fruza. “Maybe it won because of that shade of blue.”
188669.subtitle_en: Angela, 12, has always enjoyed drawing, but was a little surprised when she heard that she had won.
188669.tags_en: Sun Festival, Sun Day, Longyearbyen School, people, children, life in Svalbard, Sun Festival Week, sun drawing

188676.excerpt_en: Hurtigruten Svalbard supports certification for guides in Svalbard, but the government’s announcement last week raises many questions.
188676.subtitle_en: “The local tourism industry must be closely involved in the process of deciding what the certification scheme should contain and who should own it,” says Tore Magne Hoem, director of experiences at Hurtigruten Svalbard.
188676.tags_en: tourism, news, tourism, Hurtigruten Svalbard, guides, government
188676.title_en: Curious to See What Happens Next

188687.excerpt_en: Audun Salte, general manager of Svalbard Husky, is himself a former Arctic nature-guide student, has been a member of the Svalbard Guide Association, and has worked for guides’ rights. He thinks certification requirements are entirely appropriate, but stresses that the scheme must be flexible. “Who will be responsible for the certification?”
188687.subtitle_en: “As early as 1950, Zapffe, Norway’s greatest outdoor philosopher, said that closing off nature is not the answer to protecting nature. People who use it must be informed,” he says.
188687.tags_en: tourism, news, guides, guiding industry, working life, Svalbard Husky

188693.excerpt_en: At 11 a.m. today, Erna Solberg and her new government emerged onto the Palace Square. One of them will be responsible for implementing Norway’s Svalbard policy.
188693.subtitle_en: The last time she was in Svalbard, she attended the move-in ceremony for the newest homes in Gruvedalen. Today, she was appointed the new Svalbard minister.
188693.title_en: She Is the New Svalbard Minister

188720.excerpt_en: “Among other things, we will look at the possibility of building an even more robust emergency response system for polar bears. It is natural for us to sit down and consider whether we should do anything differently.”
188720.subtitle_en: Governor Kjerstin Askholt will hold a meeting with the Norwegian Polar Institute (NPI) following several polar bear incidents in recent weeks.
188720.tags_en: safety, governor, Norwegian Polar Institute, polar bear, news
188720.title_en: The Governor Wants to Learn from the Incidents

188723.excerpt_en: This weekend, four football teams—two girls’ teams and two boys’ teams—are heading to Tromsø for a football tournament. They came close to not making the trip at all.
188723.subtitle_en: This football group came close to missing out on its Tromsø weekend.
188723.tags_en: Svalbard Turn, Tromsø, football, flights, children, news
188723.title_en: It Turned into a Football Weekend After All

188735.excerpt_en: This week’s historical image is an overview of Longyearbyen, showing houses, the church, barracks, a cowshed and more in the winter of 1941. The image was loaned by Svalbard Museum and comes from Jens A.’s album.

188750.excerpt_en: She began in the position on 1 December.
188750.subtitle_en: Anja Kristine Salo, 34, is the new director of communications at the Norwegian Polar Institute.
188750.title_en: New appointment at the Norwegian Polar Institute

188764.excerpt_en: Grete Bossart and Trine Berntsen won the prize for best hats at this year’s Wifal at Huset on Saturday evening. The two were also appointed honorary members after many years of creating wonderful hats.
188764.subtitle_en: They won a prize and were made honorary members.

188766.excerpt_en: Last Thursday, the political Education and Culture Committee (OKU) held a meeting to distribute money from the liquor-fund pool. The committee had a record-large pot to allocate.
188766.subtitle_en: “This was absolutely crucial to keeping the project moving forward,” says Dag Arne Husdal, who has been one of the driving forces behind improving the slalom slope.
188766.tags_en: Education and Culture Committee, politics, news, culture, liquor-store funds, sport, volunteering, alpine slope, OKU
188766.title_en: Liquor-store funds give the ski-slope project more momentum

188772.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen’s cultural and sporting life is “blessed” with a large additional pot of money. No other municipality with just over 2,000 residents can enjoy direct transfers from its local liquor outlet.
188772.subtitle_en: A liquor outlet at the airport could bring more hard cash into the coffers, which would in turn benefit the town’s cultural and sporting life.

188788.excerpt_en: “I think those of us who have performed this kind of service deserve it. I realized I was eligible when I saw in Svalbardposten last autumn that Geir Hekne had received the medal,” says Tåsåsen.
188788.subtitle_en: Olav Tåsåsen has been a mechanic in Ny-Ålesund for five years. For the past year and a half, he has held the same position with the Governor of Svalbard in Longyearbyen. Now he is also a decorated soldier.
188788.title_en: Receives the Chief of Defence’s medal

188802.excerpt_en: “We have emphasized using different voices to shed light on this historic event. It will have a conversational lecture format and is intended for non-specialists,” says Governor Kjerstin Askholt.
188802.subtitle_en: On Sunday, 9 February, the Governor of Svalbard, UNIS and Svalbard Museum are inviting people to a joint event marking the centenary of the Svalbard Treaty.
188802.tags_en: Svalbard Treaty, Governor of Svalbard, news
188802.title_en: Commemorating the anniversary with a seminar and songs

188807.excerpt_en: This is confirmed by Mary-Ann Dahle’s daughter, Iris Dahle Bjørkmann. She is now running the hotel and restaurant.
188807.subtitle_en: Mary-Ann’s Polarrigg has been put up for sale, and several interested parties had come forward. The sales process has now been halted until further notice.
188807.title_en: The sale is off for now

188809.excerpt_en: For many marine organisms, moonlight—which reflects sunlight from below the horizon—and bioluminescence are more than enough to meet their basic needs: finding a partner (or two) and food! More than 20 years ago, planning began for the major International Polar Year 2007–2008.
188809.subtitle_en: While most of us walk around waiting for the light, many animals and algae out there thrive in the dark.
188809.title_en: While We Wait for the Light

188826.excerpt_en: So says environmental protection director Morten Wedege of the Governor of Svalbard, in a notice on the Governor’s website. Twelve trapping teams applied to overwinter.
188826.subtitle_en: Last autumn, the Governor of Svalbard advertised an overwintering trapping concession at Austfjordnes for the 2020/2021 season. None of the applicants had all the qualifications the Governor required to operate the trapping cabin.
188826.title_en: Governor changes course—not lending out Austfjordnes

188849.excerpt_en: “I’m a little frayed around the edges now,” she says with a laugh. Over the past month, the premises have undergone a complete renovation.
188849.subtitle_en: The day before Fruene reopens, Svalbardposten meets owner Tove Eide. The process has been chaotic, she says.

188863.excerpt_en: Four teams, both boys’ and girls’ teams, enjoyed a great trip to the Fløya tournament in Tromsø last weekend, but it was a close call. Technical problems with the aircraft on Thursday afternoon postponed the departure until Friday morning.
188863.subtitle_en: For a while, it looked like the football weekend in Tromsø would be called off when the flight was cancelled.
188863.title_en: Great to have a football weekend in Tromsø

188888.excerpt_en: The Svalbard Guide Association wants to professionalize the guiding profession and secure good working conditions. For 18 months, the LO branch Handel og Kontor has been working to create the industry’s first collective agreement.
188888.subtitle_en: They are working on Norway’s first collective agreement for nature guides, but long working days and the desire to run multi-day trips make it challenging.
188888.tags_en: travel industry, guides, employment rights, working life, tourism, news
188888.title_en: Difficult to create a collective agreement that accommodates long trips

188904.excerpt_en: Questions concerning guides’ working conditions are just as relevant on the mainland as in Svalbard. So says Joakim Løvseth Elvenes, chair of the Norwegian Nature Guide Association. “From what we hear, some operators are not serious.”
188904.subtitle_en: The Norwegian Nature Guide Association wants to work with the guide association in Svalbard to professionalize the occupation.
188904.tags_en: guides, news, employment rights, working life, guiding industry
188904.title_en: Just as relevant on the mainland

188917.excerpt_en: The driver, who was alone in the car, was driving from Gruve 7 when a reindeer got in the way. “He swerved to avoid it, the car skidded, and he drove off the road,” says senior police officer Espen Olsen of the Governor’s office. The incident occurred just before 12:30 on Thursday, and all emergency services were at the scene shortly afterwards.
188917.subtitle_en: A car ended up in a ditch by Lomdammen in Adventdalen today, Thursday.

188919.excerpt_en: Credit to the guides and the relatively small companies Svalbard Wildlife Expedition and Basecamp Explorer for addressing this issue and seeking a collective agreement.
188919.subtitle_en: This week, Svalbardposten has taken a closer look at guides’ working-time arrangements and their desire for a collective agreement adapted to the industry.
188919.title_en: Tour guiding on the edge of the law

188939.excerpt_en: Latest: The polar bear has been tranquilised and, as we go to press at 9:45 p.m., is aboard the Governor of Svalbard’s helicopter. Throughout Thursday evening’s operation, the Governor’s office received assistance from the Norwegian Polar Institute.
188939.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard’s office is out trying to scare it towards Revneset.
188939.tags_en: news, Hotellneset, Hiorthhamn, Adventfjorden, Governor of Svalbard, polar bear

188943.excerpt_en: Polarjazz 2020 is officially under way. And anyone who wanted to was free to jazz up the atmosphere at the festival’s warm-up event at the cultural centre on Thursday evening.
188943.subtitle_en: “An accessible opportunity for anyone who wants to take the stage—with professional equipment and direction,” said host Mona Dahl.
188943.tags_en: Polarjazz, Longyearbyen Cultural Centre, culture, jazz, festival, life on Svalbard
188943.title_en: Jazz Festival Kicks Off with a Warm-Up

188958.excerpt_en: The area stretches all the way from Svea Nord, down Höganesveien to Svea Centre, and out to Kapp Amsterdam.
188958.subtitle_en: In connection with the start of phase 2A in Svea, Store Norske is imposing a travel ban in parts of the area.
188958.tags_en: Store Norske, snowmobile, snowmobile, news, travel ban, travel, Svea
188958.title_en: Store Norske Imposes Travel Ban in Svea

188964.excerpt_en: Shortly after four o’clock on Friday afternoon, Svalbardposten confirmed that the polar bear tranquilised on Thursday was female. The polar bear will be autopsied within “a few days”.
188964.subtitle_en: The polar bear that was tranquilised yesterday and was scheduled to be transported to Kinnvika in Nordaustlandet died during helicopter transport.
188964.tags_en: news, tranquilisation, Governor of Svalbard, polar bear
188964.title_en: Polar Bear That Died During Helicopter Transport Was Female

188974.excerpt_en: The contract is worth NOK 316 million, making it the largest contract Husfabrikken has entered into. “We are pleased that the organisation chose Skanska. Our experience from completing the housing project in Gruvedalen was important in winning this contract,” says Terje Mjøen, managing director of Husfabrikken, in a press release.
188974.subtitle_en: Skanska Husfabrikken will build student housing for the Arctic Student Welfare Organisation of Norway in Svalbard. It previously built the new homes in Gruvedalen for Statsbygg.

189009.excerpt_en: There were 17 fewer fire callouts in 2019 than the year before. At the same time, the number of actual fires and incidents that nearly became fires fell from 16 in 2018 to eight in 2019.
189009.subtitle_en: There was a marked decline in the number of fire callouts over the past year.

189016.excerpt_en: This week’s historical photograph shows D/S “Siglufjord” at the ice edge in Kongsfjorden near Ny-Ålesund in spring 1918. Luggage and equipment were transported by sledges across the ice to Ny-Ålesund.

189020.excerpt_en: To be part of the group, you must have been born between 1960 and 1985 and have lived in Svalbard for at least one year during the previous century. Around 500 people qualify, and 175 of them were in Svalbard last weekend.
189020.subtitle_en: Every five years, former Svalbard residents organise what they themselves call a reunion for young people. It took place last weekend.
189020.title_en: “We Carried Milk Pails Home and Got Provisions on the Doorstep”

189032.excerpt_en: It has now been more than a year since the wrecked shrimp trawler “Northguider” was emptied of environmentally hazardous contents. The wreck is still lying at Sparreneset in Hinlopen Strait, but the clearance operation was considered highly successful.
189032.subtitle_en: The state has sued the shipping company and insurer of “Northguider”. They want reimbursement for money the state spent clearing the wreck.
189032.tags_en: court case, economy, Northguider, pollution, news

189064.excerpt_en: Last week, the Norwegian Polar Institute received the test results. “A tissue sample was taken from the bear that was shot, and we also submitted a scat sample from the one seen on Boxing Day.”
189064.subtitle_en: After a polar bear was shot by the Governor of Svalbard’s office in the early hours of 1 January, DNA samples were submitted from two of the sightings. They show that at least two different bears were involved.

189069.excerpt_en: The Arctic Student Welfare Organisation of Norway has long wanted to build new student rooms in a location safe from avalanches in Longyearbyen. Last year, the Longyearbyen Community Council approved the plans, which provide housing for up to 300 students.
189069.subtitle_en: Construction of student housing at Elvesletta is delayed. As a result, the folk high school must change its plans for the next academic year.
189069.tags_en: student housing, Svalbard Folk High School, Arctic Student Welfare Organisation of Norway, Elvesletta, news
189069.title_en: The Folk High School Must Scale Up More Slowly

189072.excerpt_en: They write this in a press release issued today, Tuesday. The intention is to consolidate the housing stock under Statsbygg and Store Norske Boliger. “Housing policy is an effective tool for further developing Longyearbyen as a viable local community, in line with the objectives of Svalbard policy.”
189072.subtitle_en: The government wants to reduce the number of housing managers in Longyearbyen to make administration more efficient.
189072.title_en: Government Wants State Housing Consolidated under Statsbygg and Store Norske Boliger

189079.excerpt_en: Russia is requesting a meeting with Norway to discuss issues concerning Svalbard. Among other things, it is unhappy with the restrictions Norway imposes on helicopter traffic and commercial activity in Svalbard.
189079.subtitle_en: The message from Russia’s Foreign Ministry was sent to Norway’s Foreign Minister Ine Eriksen Søreide, High North News reports.
189079.title_en: Russian Foreign Ministry Requests Meeting with Foreign Minister on Svalbard

189100.excerpt_en: The aim is for barnacle geese to start nesting there. Barnacle geese nest on cliffs, among other places, to protect themselves from Arctic foxes.
189100.subtitle_en: The Longyearbyen Field Biology Association (LOFF) has installed nesting platforms on six of the town’s cableway supports.

189109.excerpt_en: Work on the new lighting design in the premises has been under way for about a month. Everything has now been switched to LED lighting.
189109.subtitle_en: Svalbard Museum has made the biggest upgrade to its exhibition since opening in 2006.

189115.excerpt_en: According to communications adviser Terje Carlsen, the Governor of Svalbard’s office has no further information to provide at this time. Morten Wedege, environmental protection chief at the Governor’s office, says the samples must be analysed before anything can be said about the cause of death. “A number of samples were taken and will now be analysed.”
189115.subtitle_en: The polar bear that died during helicopter transport was autopsied on Sunday. The remaining test results will be available in just under a month.

189120.excerpt_en: “Since we have not carried out inspections and have no documentation, it is difficult for me to say anything concrete.”
189120.subtitle_en: The Labour Inspection Authority cannot say whether tourism companies in Svalbard are operating legally today.
189120.tags_en: news, tourism, Labour Inspection Authority, labour rights, working life, guides

189126.excerpt_en: Berle is the new chief administrative officer at the Governor of Svalbard’s office and started the job on 2 August.
189126.subtitle_en: Margrete Grinaker Berle (52) is looking forward to—and dreading—the snowmobile season. First, she has to get her licence.

189129.excerpt_en: Sometimes the world simply isn’t the way we thought it was. And sometimes you are lucky enough to be in the right place at the right time, entirely by chance.
189129.subtitle_en: While we wait for the light, not everything goes as we had imagined.
189129.title_en: While We Wait for the Light (II)

189147.excerpt_en: This week is dedicated to the Svalbard Treaty. On the television, NRK’s minute-by-minute broadcast runs around the clock.
189147.subtitle_en: Hear the voices of Svalbard. We interviewed one hundred people about what the place means to them.
189147.tags_en: news, anniversary, people, Svalbard Treaty, magazine
189147.title_en: One Hundred Years and One Hundred Answers

189168.excerpt_en: For the occasion, the school has bought a Sámi flag, which adorns the stage in “Hålen.” The day is also being marked by pupils at the lower and upper secondary schools. “Bidos is being served in the cafeteria today.”
189168.subtitle_en: 6 February is the Sámi National Day. Nearly 30 people from the Sámi national theatre are in Longyearbyen, together with musicians from the Arctic Philharmonic.

189176.excerpt_en: At 4:29 p.m. on 26 October 2017, the Norwegian Safety Investigation Authority received a report from Svalbard Airport, Longyearbyen, that a helicopter travelling from Pyramiden to the Heerodden helicopter base near Barentsburg was missing.
189176.subtitle_en: In October 2017, a helicopter crashed en route to Barentsburg, killing eight people. It was not the crash landing itself that caused their deaths.
189176.tags_en: news, helicopter accident, helicopter, Heerodden, Accident Investigation Board, Barentsburg, accident
189176.title_en: Eight People Died—Now We Know What Happened

189186.excerpt_en: “The book is not a biography of Harald. It is a story about Svalbard, and Harald is part of it.”
189186.subtitle_en: Birger Amundsen has written yet another book, this time about trapper Harald Soleim, their friendship and Svalbard in a broader sense.
189186.tags_en: culture, film, news, trapping history, books, Birger Amundsen, Harald Soleim
189186.title_en: Writing About Life in Svalbard and His Friendship with Harald Soleim

189190.excerpt_en: Paris, 9 February 1920: Negotiating leader Wedel Jarlsberg signs the Svalbard Treaty on behalf of Norway.
189190.subtitle_en: As part of her doctoral studies, UNIS researcher Dina Brode-Roger has examined the Svalbard Treaty more closely and how, 100 years later, it still plays a major role in the daily lives of Svalbard’s residents.

189204.excerpt_en: “If Svalbard were a person, it would be going through puberty with major hormonal swings. You never know what tomorrow will bring,” says Mark Sabbatini (52).
189204.subtitle_en: We have spoken to one hundred people about what Svalbard means to them.
189204.tags_en: news, Svalbard Treaty, anniversary, people, magazine
189204.title_en: Part 3 of 4: A Hundred Voices on Svalbard

189220.excerpt_en: Svalbard is a special place, completely unlike anywhere else I have lived or visited as a tourist. Most people who have been here agree on that.
189220.subtitle_en: We are celebrating the centenary of the Svalbard Treaty on 9 February. This week, we have therefore asked 100 people what Svalbard means to them. We received just as many different answers. First and foremost, many thanks to everyone who contributed.

189246.excerpt_en: This week’s historical picture shows residents of Grumant on the main street. The photographer is Carl A.
189246.subtitle_en: This is what the Soviet mining town of Grumant looked like in the 1960s.

189251.excerpt_en: The sighting was made in a very popular hiking area. It is snowing and visibility is poor.
189251.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has received a report of a possible polar bear near Ninavarden on Platåberget.

189264.excerpt_en: She writes to Svalbardposten: “It’s great fun to see that you enjoy the pictures from my grandfather (Jens Kristoffer Bay) and father (Jens A. Bay) during their stays in Svalbard, which we donated to the museum last year.”
189264.subtitle_en: Tone Bay has sent us more information about the picture we published in issue number 5.

189270.excerpt_en: Just before the New Year, Svalbard Delivery Service became a reality. After sitting on the idea for a long time, the couple began exploring the possibility of starting a business and researched how to do it. “I don’t understand why nobody has done this before.”
189270.subtitle_en: Several years ago, Romano Juric and Zeljka Novokmet came up with the idea of running a food delivery service in Longyearbyen.

189276.excerpt_en: A completely new entrance will be built where the old one is now. There will be new toilets, a more practical cloakroom solution and a new technical room. “We’re looking forward to that.”
189276.subtitle_en: Svalbard Church is to receive new piles and a new foundation and undergo renovation. The work means the church will be closed in the evenings and without toilet and kitchen facilities until summer.
189276.title_en: Parts of the Church Must Close

189301.excerpt_en: We know that organisms out there can respond to light we cannot see, and we know that the polar night is not simply uninterrupted darkness. But measuring light in the dark is far more difficult than one might think.
189301.subtitle_en: While we wait for the light, we still struggle to define just how “dark” or “light” it really is during the polar night.
189301.title_en: While We Wait for the Light (III)

189304.excerpt_en: With eleven concerts from Thursday to Sunday, there was no shortage of things to attend anyway. Board member Espen Klungseth Rotevatn is very pleased with the weekend. “I think we all agree that it was a success.”
189304.subtitle_en: The Polarjazz board decided to cut one day from the festival programme. It turned out to be a wise decision.

189313.excerpt_en: The off-season is to be strengthened so that guides have work all year round. The Working Environment Act is to be applied so that no one is exploited.
189313.subtitle_en: The guiding profession in Svalbard is once again receiving considerable attention. As before, year-round employment, collective agreements and certifications are required.
189313.title_en: A Diverse Working Life or Bureaucratic Conformity?

189327.excerpt_en: Many wanted to attend the commemoration of 100 years of the Svalbard Treaty in Møysalen at Forskningsparken on Sunday evening.
189327.subtitle_en: There was barely room to park outside Forskningsparken on Sunday evening.

189333.excerpt_en: Young and old were treated to a reunion with much-loved old songs at Saturday’s concert, “The Song Treasury,” at the culture centre. The fourth grade had spent a couple of months rehearsing all the songs.
189333.subtitle_en: The Arctic Chamber Music Festival was opened in style by the new head of culture.

189355.excerpt_en: The Childhood and Culture Committee (OKU) distributes the money, and the fund’s statutes state that any distribution exceeding NOK 300,000 must be approved by the local council. Two applicants, Longyearbyen Blues Club and LL’s Culture and Sports Unit, applied for NOK 437,000 and NOK 535,000, respectively.
189355.subtitle_en: Earlier this year, money from the cork fund was distributed. Now two applicants have been granted additional funding.

189358.excerpt_en: The government’s press release said, among other things, that “the aim is to ensure housing for public-sector employees” and that “the community must not grow beyond its current level.” “The press release itself was not surprising, but its clarity was somewhat surprising, because the starting point was simply the management of public housing stock.”
189358.subtitle_en: The government wants to make housing management more efficient. The result could be an even tighter housing market. Local Council leader Arild Olsen believes there is no reason to worry.

189361.excerpt_en: Among other things, this means taking over the housing stock belonging to UNIS and Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) and placing its management in state hands.
