196012.title_en: Worried about what happens when crisis support ends

196026.excerpt_en: Fresh back from her Easter holiday, Anne-Marit Heggelund is raising hopes for those of us eager to get rid of our coronavirus hair. The Saxifraga salon at Lompen Centre aims to open on Monday the 27th.
196026.subtitle_en: Saxifraga hair salon aims to open on Monday, 27 April.

196029.excerpt_en: The board of LO Svalbard announced on Wednesday that this year’s May Day event will not take place. “It is because of the coronavirus situation we are currently in,” LO leader Svein Jonny Albrigtsen writes to Svalbardposten.
196029.subtitle_en: The May Day celebration has been cancelled in Svalbard. We must also expect the Constitution Day celebrations on 17 May to be different from usual.

196032.excerpt_en: Create a regular column featuring snippets from recent local history—Longyearbyen’s history. Give readers knowledge of why this or that place is called what it is.
196032.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen is now a more historyless society than ever, and Svalbardposten does little or nothing to remedy this. (Apart from the Christmas issue and the weekly historical photograph.) I therefore have a proposal for the editorial team:

196042.excerpt_en: The coronavirus situation is making everything difficult. A recent risk assessment conducted by Longyearbyen Community Council, for example, shows that recruiting for vacant positions may be challenging. Nevertheless, the Governor’s office expects to recruit a new environmental protection chief as planned. “We are essentially planning to conduct interviews on Skype.”
196042.subtitle_en: Twenty-three people have applied for the position of environmental protection chief at the Governor’s office. But none will be invited to a conventional job interview.
196042.tags_en: news, Governor’s environmental protection department, working life, coronavirus crisis

196055.excerpt_en: Those who have arrived to find the door closed may have concluded that the coronavirus crisis has shut Longyearbyen Thai Shop. That is not the case, owner Phairin Nanthawisit assures us.
196055.subtitle_en: The Thai shop at Elvesletta has been closed for two days a week because of coronavirus.

196075.excerpt_en: “Normally, we more or less break even over the year as a whole. But the coronavirus pandemic hit Svalbard during the high season, which means most of the income disappears.”
196075.subtitle_en: Tommy Jordbrudal of Husky Travellers has spent the past few weeks processing cancellations worth NOK 700,000–800,000. More cancellations are arriving every day.

196092.excerpt_en: On Friday, it was decided that Svalbard would be covered by the Act on a temporary compensation scheme for businesses suffering a major fall in turnover. “The crisis resulting from the coronavirus outbreak is also affecting Svalbard.”
196092.subtitle_en: The government is providing emergency financial assistance to companies and sole proprietorships hit hard by the coronavirus crisis.

196108.excerpt_en: This is stated in a press release from Gran Municipality, where Saugnes has been chief municipal executive since moving from Longyearbyen in 2016 after three and a half years. “It’s probably the dream job.”
196108.subtitle_en: The former head of administration at Longyearbyen Community Council has been appointed the new managing director of Kings Bay AS.
196108.title_en: Lars Ole Saugnes appointed director of Kings Bay

196113.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen will slowly but surely return to normal after the coronavirus crisis. The youngest children and some pupils will be first, returning to kindergarten and primary school next week.
196113.subtitle_en: It is just as important to serve those lower down as those higher up in the system.

196122.excerpt_en: Målfrid Baik, regional director of NHO Arctic, says she fully understands the reasoning behind Community Council leader Arild Olsen’s proposal to require businesses to provide a form of unemployment insurance for third-country nationals—a group of employees who, under the current system, have no income if they are temporarily laid off. “I understand the intention behind the proposal—the social responsibility,” says Baik.
196122.subtitle_en: NHO understands the wish, but does not support the idea of unemployment insurance for foreigners in Svalbard.

196147.excerpt_en: Communications company OneWeb is bankrupt, reports Highnorthnews.com. The company was to provide high-speed internet coverage across the Arctic using several hundred satellites.
196147.subtitle_en: A major Svalsat customer has gone bankrupt because of the coronavirus crisis.

196152.excerpt_en: “Don’t leave it sitting in the mud!” That is the first thing snowmobile mechanic Frank Skorpen at IGP thinks of.
196152.subtitle_en: It will soon be time to park your snowmobile for the season. A few simple steps can save you a lot of trouble when you next head out.
196152.title_en: Out of the mud—and remove the battery

196161.excerpt_en: It was warm last week, and the little snow that remained is melting away. The change came overnight Sunday.
196161.subtitle_en: Temperatures fell below freezing again on Monday after the mild spell. The Governor nevertheless reminds snowmobile drivers to avoid driving on bare ground.

196185.excerpt_en: So far, the Storting has adopted several rescue packages. Those aimed at businesses and relevant to Svalbard’s tourism industry include liquidity loans and cash support covering a certain percentage of unavoidable costs.
196185.subtitle_en: The answer is through the emergency aid packages in the short term, but without customers most businesses will quickly die. Immediate predictability is now needed.
196185.title_en: How can Svalbard’s jobs be saved?

196195.excerpt_en: “The email was sent to the group leaders to find out which groups might be able to resume if we are given permission. In that case, it must be done in consultation with Longyearbyen Community Council and the public health officer,” says Svalbard Turn chair Silje M.
196195.subtitle_en: Last week, Svalbard Turn sent an inquiry to the club’s coaches about the possibilities of restarting some of the club’s activities.
196195.tags_en: news, Svalbard Turn, coronavirus crisis, culture
196195.title_en: Assessing the possibility of restarting training

196200.excerpt_en: “We are in a normal, abnormal situation,” observes Carl Einar Ianssen. The managing director of Svalbard Airport describes a workday shaped by the situation we are in, with the number of passengers passing through the airport countable on two hands. “During Easter, we did have up to 20 passengers a day.”
196200.subtitle_en: On average, ten travelers arrive at the airport each day during the coronavirus crisis.
196200.tags_en: travel, Svalbard Airport, coronavirus crisis, news

196203.excerpt_en: Principal Espen Klungseth Rotevatn is back in the office at Lompen Senteret after five weeks combining working from home with caring for a child at home. High on the agenda is the government’s additional allocation to folk high schools.
196203.subtitle_en: Svalbard Folk High School is fully enrolled for the next academic year. It is also awaiting its share of NOK 65 million in crisis funding.
196203.tags_en: news, Svalbard Folk High School, coronavirus crisis

196226.excerpt_en: Like Figenschou, I too am both impressed and enthusiastic about the solidarity and cooperation currently characterizing nations and local communities alike. But in his readers’ letter, Figenschou also succumbs to the temptation to point an accusing finger at the local bank.
196226.subtitle_en: In a readers’ letter published online by Svalbardposten on April 10, titled “A Joint Effort to Preserve the Town’s Jobs,” Kjetil Figenschou highlights the spirit of volunteerism and willingness to contribute that characterize our country in these difficult times.
196226.tags_en: readers’ letters, coronavirus crisis, bank, opinion

196228.excerpt_en: LO Svalbard encourages everyone to follow the May 1 celebration digitally. “LO’s central event will be streamed online from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.”
196228.subtitle_en: This year’s May 1 march has been canceled. Everyone is invited to join online.
196228.tags_en: coronavirus crisis, news, May 1, working life

196241.excerpt_en: Some wonderfully beautiful Easter days have passed. The new postmaster has not yet managed to buy a snowmobile, but he definitely plans to. “I used to ride quite a lot of motorcycles.”
196241.subtitle_en: Terje Gjeitnes (52) started his job as post office manager in November. So far, he and his wife are thoroughly enjoying it.
196241.tags_en: postman, the postal service, people, back page, life in Svalbard

196248.excerpt_en: “The celebration will be based on tradition, but naturally there will be some changes and adaptations in light of the situation we are in,” says Frode Westby Thorstad, chair of the May 17 committee.
196248.subtitle_en: As of today, it has still not been decided how this year’s May 17 celebration will be held in Longyearbyen. But there is no doubt that there will be some form of celebration.
196248.title_en: It Will Be a Dignified and Pleasant Celebration

196272.excerpt_en: It keeps away anyone without strong reasons for coming, who might unknowingly bring infection with them. There is no reason to oppose opening daycare centers and schools for the youngest children here, where there is no infection.
196272.subtitle_en: As far as we know, Covid-19 has not yet reached the “island.” Quarantine for those arriving here is a sensible measure.

196274.excerpt_en: It was through her husband’s cousin that Kanokkan Philuek (60) and her husband in Thailand learned about the possibility of working in Longyearbyen. They moved and settled here. Twenty years later, Kanokkan Philuek lives with her daughter and two grandchildren.
196274.subtitle_en: After 20 years in Svalbard, the future is uncertain for the family from Thailand.
196274.tags_en: news, coronavirus crisis, ISS, working life, Thailand

196287.excerpt_en: They have received crisis unemployment benefits until June 20; after that, the payments stop.
196287.subtitle_en: The coronavirus crisis is affecting us all, but in different ways. For third-country nationals in Longyearbyen, their livelihoods vanished almost overnight when Norway shut down on March 12.

196301.excerpt_en: By the application deadline on April 15, UNIS had received approximately as many applicants as in previous years.
196301.subtitle_en: UNIS has received just as many applications as in previous years. Most likely, it will offer a reduced program through Christmas.
196301.title_en: Same Number of Applicants; Reviewing Course Offerings

196310.excerpt_en: Editor and managing director Hilde Røsvik delivered the difficult news on Thursday morning: Svalbardposten is suffering a major drop in advertising sales. As a result, employees in the newspaper’s marketing department are being partially furloughed. “Unfortunately, we have no other choice.”
196310.subtitle_en: The coronavirus crisis is also affecting the local newspaper in Longyearbyen. Employees in Svalbardposten’s marketing department are being partially furloughed.

196320.excerpt_en: That is according to a press release from Nature and Youth. “Several young people are planning a digital school strike on Friday. They will set a world record for the number of strikers in one country.”
196320.subtitle_en: A global school strike for the climate was planned for April 24, but the new measures introduced in response to the coronavirus pandemic made it difficult to carry out. Now environmental organizations have arranged a coronavirus-friendly school strike.
196320.tags_en: news, Svalbard Nature and Youth, climate

196325.excerpt_en: “March ended with a 12.5 percent decline. We can already see that the decline in April is sharp, currently standing at 36 percent,” says Ronny Strømnes, managing director of Coop Svalbard.
196325.subtitle_en: Svalbardbutikken has laid off more employees temporarily since Svalbardposten last spoke to them. April’s sales figures look bleak.

196338.excerpt_en: “Coronavirus brought challenges, as some employees had to go into quarantine. But the contractor solved this by changing the shifts so operations could continue without interruption, so it worked out well,” says Marit Devik, project manager at Store Norske Boliger.
196338.subtitle_en: The demolition of the buildings in Lia will probably be complete at the beginning of June. So far, everything is going according to plan.

196343.excerpt_en: Because of strict infection-control rules, Svalbardposten’s reporter is not allowed inside the daycare center.
196343.subtitle_en: The daycare centers in Longyearbyen reopened this week. Edward Prytz Mathisen (6), Håkon Hammervoll Helgesen (6) and Sofia Sitdikova (5) of Kullungen daycare center are pleased.
196343.tags_en: news, Kullungen daycare center, coronavirus crisis, Polarflokken daycare center, daycare center, Longyearbyen School
196343.title_en: Happy to Be Back at Daycare

196364.excerpt_en: Unfortunately, the negative trend is moving faster than the transition. Reduced air and car traffic during these virus-stricken times has produced a short-term positive environmental effect.
196364.subtitle_en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges of our time. In contrast to the response to the crisis caused by Covid-19, the transition to a low-emission society is proceeding slowly.

196379.excerpt_en: Last summer, an unsuccessful attempt was made to remove the wreck of the “Northguider” from Hinlopen Strait. A new attempt will be made in late summer.
196379.subtitle_en: The wreck of the Northguider is to be removed from Hinlopen Strait piece by piece. The Norwegian Coastal Administration will lead the operation, while the Governor of Svalbard will closely monitor the process.

196409.excerpt_en: “I hope I ultimately get a favorable decision,” says film producer Asgeir Helgestad of Arctic Light. He is well under way with the sequel to the polar bear film “Queen Without Land.”
196409.subtitle_en: Filmmaker is denied permission to use a snowmobile to film a world-famous polar bear. He is appealing the rejection to the directorate.
196409.tags_en: motorized traffic, polar bear filming, polar bears, travel ban, Governor of Svalbard, news, snowmobiles
196409.title_en: Snowmobile Ban Could Halt New Polar Bear Film

196412.excerpt_en: I received a phone call two Easters ago. Soon afterward, I was offered the job as director of the Artica Svalbard foundation, even though I had not applied.
196412.subtitle_en: Now I am leaving the mountains behind. I lived in Svalbard for two years, and I would have loved to stay longer. These have been two very important years of my life.
196412.title_en: Thank You for the Wonderful Friendships, Longyearbyen

196414.excerpt_en: The project to provide a unified daycare service in Longyearbyen has made a U-turn, to use local council leader Arild Olsen’s words. The matter was considered by the Administration Committee (AU) on Wednesday.
196414.subtitle_en: A new large daycare center in Longyearbyen would have cost NOK 124 million—more than twice the initial estimate. The project is being sent back to square one.
196414.tags_en: Polarflokken daycare center, news, daycare coverage, Administration Committee, slush avalanche, avalanche protection, Vannledningsdalen
196414.title_en: Large Daycare Center Costs Twice as Much

196426.excerpt_en: Frantz Johannes Vangen, union representative for Fellesforbundet for more than 40 hotel employees at Hurtigruten Svalbard, has been temporarily laid off until mid-June. “As a Norwegian, I am relatively well off,” he says. Other union members he represents are from countries outside the EU and EEA, and they are experiencing the situation as far more dramatic.
196426.subtitle_en: The Hurtigruten union representative thinks the companies are rejecting the unemployment-benefit proposal too quickly.
196426.tags_en: Longyearbyen Local Council, coronavirus crisis, Hurtigruten Svalbard, working life, news
196426.title_en: “Cannot be locked into one solution straight away”

196438.excerpt_en: The extreme exercise took place on Franz Josef Land, a Russian archipelago east of Svalbard. The soldiers conducted a three-day exercise on Alexandra Land.
196438.subtitle_en: Using a new parachute system, Russian soldiers have carried out jumps from an altitude of 10,000 metres in the Arctic.

196462.excerpt_en: The coronavirus closure came at a very inconvenient time for Camilla Flygel Granstrøm and Polar Spa. The appointment book was almost full when the government decided that beauty and hair salons would close from the 12th.
196462.subtitle_en: Polar Spa is back after its coronavirus closure, with a full booking schedule for the next few days.
196462.tags_en: news, Polar Spa, coronavirus crisis, Lompensenteret

196465.excerpt_en: Telenor’s red building at Skjæringa in Longyearbyen dates originally from the 1950s. It has been remodelled and extended several times, and bears the marks of time and the forces of nature. It is not protected. “It is in seriously poor condition and will collapse,” sums up Christian Skottun.
196465.subtitle_en: Adapted to the historic environment and future visions. That is the recipe as the Red Building at Skjæringa is demolished and replaced.
196465.tags_en: news, Telenor Svalbard, Skjæringa, building matters
196465.title_en: This is what the new Telenor building will look like

196475.excerpt_en: This year’s May Day event will feature Store Norske Male Choir, an address from the LO leader and words from the priest.
196475.subtitle_en: Svalbard Church will broadcast a recorded May Day event on 1 May.
196475.tags_en: Store Norske Male Choir, Svalbard Church, coronavirus crisis, 1 May, news

196488.excerpt_en: “Homework is fun, and Norwegian and maths and things like that,” Elias replies when asked why he was happy to return. “And Mum is super-strict and not very good at homework,” Frøya adds, something Elias says also applies to his father.
196488.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen School reopened for grades 1 to 4 on Monday. Second-graders Frøya Myhren (8) and Elias Leite (7) thought it was great fun.

196514.excerpt_en: Steve Daldorff Torgersen, general manager of Karlsberger Pub, learns from Svalbardposten that the cash support for March has arrived. It has been published on the Norwegian Tax Administration’s transparency pages for the scheme.
196514.subtitle_en: So far, ten Svalbard businesses have received almost half a million kroner in coronavirus support. “It is a great help,” says a pub owner in Longyearbyen.
196514.tags_en: news, coronavirus crisis, Karlsberger, Gruvelageret, Stationen

196528.excerpt_en: Unis says in a press release that management has decided not to hold ordinary admissions for any of the planned summer and autumn courses in 2020. In other words, these courses are cancelled.
196528.subtitle_en: After a thorough review of what a new normal situation will look like this autumn, Unis management has decided to cancel all autumn courses.
196528.title_en: Cancelling all Unis courses for the rest of the year

196530.excerpt_en: “Many people called us—people are good at speaking up. We went down and talked to the youths,” says Senior Police Officer Kjell Arne Lundin.
196530.subtitle_en: On Tuesday afternoon, the Governor of Svalbard received several calls about young people playing on the ice below SSU.
196530.tags_en: police, Governor of Svalbard officer, news
196530.title_en: Told to get off the ice

196541.excerpt_en: This article was written before Finance Minister Jan Tore Sanner announced the new economic measures the government would introduce. “We are opening up the scheme so that businesses ordered to close will receive compensation for unavoidable costs associated with caring for animals.”
196541.subtitle_en: More than NOK 610 million has been distributed to businesses nationwide through the government’s compensation scheme. None of the kennels receive support for dog food.
196541.title_en: Dog food not considered a fixed cost

196555.excerpt_en: “We are in an extremely difficult situation, without a single guest. The entire tourism industry on Svalbard is at a standstill.”
196555.subtitle_en: Hurtigruten CEO Daniel Skjeldam wants more predictable quarantine rules and an opening for Norwegian tourists this summer. Otherwise, things look bleak.
196555.tags_en: news, Hurtigruten Svalbard, laid-off workers, coronavirus crisis

196561.excerpt_en: Svalbard Turn’s application to the Norwegian Gaming and Foundation Authority is for just over NOK 392,000. It will cover part of the financial loss after this year’s ski marathon had to be cancelled because of coronavirus. “We are losing more revenue than we are allowed to apply for,” says general manager Silje M.
196561.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn has applied to the Norwegian Gaming and Foundation Authority for emergency support.
196561.tags_en: Svalbard Ski Marathon, Svalbard Turn, news, coronavirus crisis, Spitsbergen Marathon

196574.excerpt_en: “One of our logistics employees noticed that we had a large batch of dog food that was soon due to expire.”
196574.subtitle_en: An employee in logistics at Coop Norge noticed several hundred kilos of dog food nearing its expiry date. It has now been sent to Longyearbyen.
196574.tags_en: coronavirus crisis, kennel, Coop Svalbard, news
196574.title_en: Donating 900 kilos of dog food to the kennels

196581.excerpt_en: Svalbard Church will publish the May Day broadcast on Facebook at 9 a.m.
196581.subtitle_en: When the traditional event was cancelled because of coronavirus, the church stepped in and made an online broadcast of Longyearbyen’s May Day event.
196581.title_en: Watch this year’s May Day event here

196630.excerpt_en: We also note that several of our contemporaries travel back up after a few years—some to stay, and others to have a proper bout of frustration and confusion about where they belong.
196630.subtitle_en: We have now been back home for five years after living in Longyearbyen for four. This period has given us some experience of how this “disorder” manifests itself.
196630.title_en: An amateur psychiatric analysis of the phenomenon

196646.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard received a report about the snowmobile driving at around 7:30 p.m. on Friday. “We responded and found the person shortly afterwards. A blood sample was taken and witnesses were questioned,” says Senior Police Officer Atle Rokkan.
196646.subtitle_en: An adult male permanent resident was caught driving a snowmobile under the influence on Friday evening.
196646.title_en: Caught driving a snowmobile under the influence

196670.excerpt_en: Tore Skaarer is one of our loyal subscribers. He has been one since 1994.
196670.subtitle_en: In a garden in Lillestrøm, the birds have been given these elegant terraced houses to move into this spring.

196679.excerpt_en: After two years, she is holding the brand-new book “My World Is Melting” in her hands, feeling a little nervous. Wednesday, 6.
196679.subtitle_en: Line Nagell Ylvisåker wanted to learn more about climate change and its consequences. It became a book.
196679.tags_en: magazine, author, book launch, news, Longyearbyen Public Library

196697.excerpt_en: Holm is a qualified lawyer and works as an HR adviser at Unis. Originally from Bergen, he worked as a department manager at Nav in Valdres before coming here.
196697.subtitle_en: Olaf Kristian Saggau Holm (56) has everything he needs and has found peace on Svalbard.
196697.tags_en: coronavirus crisis, life on Svalbard, back page, people

196710.excerpt_en: This means that the same person could become ill several times. Letting the virus spread in the hope of achieving “herd immunity” (Sweden, England) was a dubious experiment.
196710.subtitle_en: The World Health Organization finds that Covid-19 patients develop antibodies, but still cannot confirm lasting immunity.

196722.excerpt_en: Before the weekend, the Ministry of Finance announced in a press release that it would open “the possibility for businesses ordered to close to receive compensation for unavoidable costs related to caring for animals. This also includes feed.”
196722.subtitle_en: Dog businesses in Svalbard will receive support for feed, the Ministry of Finance assures. Tourism businesses will also receive support better adapted to the seasonal nature of their income.
196722.tags_en: news, politics, dog kennel, coronavirus crisis

196725.excerpt_en: Environmentally friendly electricity quickly became an issue when Hurtigruten Svalbard introduced electric snowmobiles this winter. “Electricity from a coal-fired power plant is obviously a paradox when charging environmentally friendly vehicles,” we have found.
196725.subtitle_en: A wind turbine is planned near IGP at Sjøskrenten. The 11-meter-high test turbine will provide charging power for electric snowmobiles during the polar night.
196725.tags_en: snowmobile, environmental protection, igp, hurtigruten svalbard, wind power, news

196733.excerpt_en: Svalbard Airport is still allowed to shoot geese to protect air traffic. The Governor of Svalbard has decided this.
196733.subtitle_en: Flocks of geese near Longyearbyen Airport pose a small but serious problem. Permission has therefore been granted to cull birds to protect air traffic from collisions.
196733.tags_en: news, svalbard airport, birdlife, aviation safety, barnacle geese

196744.excerpt_en: We must end the 14-day quarantine after arrival in Longyearbyen as soon as possible and establish a clear, imminent date for reopening. Endless extensions and uncertainty about reopening are deepening the crisis for businesses and all their dedicated employees.
196744.subtitle_en: Tourism in Svalbard is now on the verge of collapsing. This is a warning and a call for action directed at local and national authorities.

196760.excerpt_en: NHO Arctic writes this in a press release. Foreign guest nights fell by 52 percent, while Norwegian guest nights fell by 71 percent.
196760.subtitle_en: Accommodation businesses in Svalbard saw a 64 percent decline in March 2020 compared with the same month the previous year.

196771.excerpt_en: “This is a major milestone,” says Per Erik Opseth, director of the Norwegian Mapping Authority’s Geodetic Division. The observatory opened in June 2018, and work has continued ever since to install all its functions.
196771.subtitle_en: The first antenna at the new Earth observation observatory in Ny-Ålesund was commissioned on Thursday.

196794.excerpt_en: “We did a considerable amount of political work; that work did not come for free. The government has been very clear that the scheme will not continue, and is explicit about the conditions that apply.”
196794.subtitle_en: People from countries outside the EEA received temporary support until June 20. No effort is being made to extend the benefit.

196796.excerpt_en: Vladimir Prokofiev found the dead bird, took the photograph and posted it on Ros og info on Monday. The crane found dead in Colesdalen had been completely off course. “Only 13 observations of cranes in Svalbard were previously recorded between 1970 and 2019.”
196796.subtitle_en: A lone crane was found dead in Colesdalen. It had veered dramatically off course and ended up in Svalbard.

196800.excerpt_en: The managing director of the Svalbard company that has so far received the largest single cash-support payment from the state, Basecamp Explorer Spitsbergen AS, warns against believing that the danger has passed. “We of course greatly appreciate the support scheme for fixed expenses; it is a big help.”
196800.subtitle_en: Compensation for some of the expenses is welcome. Nevertheless, cash support is small change for an industry bleeding millions each week. A tourism company is asking for a date for reopening Svalbard to tourists—to save businesses and jobs.
196800.tags_en: tourism, news, coronavirus crisis, basecamp spitsbergen, tourism

196812.excerpt_en: With reduced capacity, the option of serving food and extra space, Svalbard Brewery can resume its tradition of opening the pub on Fridays. The Norwegian Directorate of Health and the Governor have given the green light. “It’s nice to be able to accommodate the many people who have asked when we would be back.”
196812.subtitle_en: The pub at Svalbard Brewery will reopen with coronavirus measures in place this coming Friday.

196829.excerpt_en: Library director Elin Anita Olsrud will speak with author and freelance journalist Line Nagell Ylvisåker about her new book at Longyearbyen Public Library.
196829.subtitle_en: A former Svalbardposten journalist is launching her first book, “My World Is Melting,” at the library this evening.

196841.excerpt_en: “We have been in contact with more people and businesses in town who are struggling and are extremely distressed by the situation. We then looked into it in detail and find that the justifications are vague—both in terms of emergency preparedness and infection control,” says Stein-Ove Johannessen, group leader of Svalbard Høyre.
196841.subtitle_en: Svalbard Høyre has sent a request to the Ministry of Health and Care Services asking it to overturn the Governor’s decision to impose quarantine requirements on visitors.
196841.title_en: Urges Government to Override Governor’s Decision to Extend Quarantine

196851.excerpt_en: There is a time for everything, and my time for hair is over. It has been for a long time, and I have an unsentimental attitude toward it.
196851.subtitle_en: The world is sad enough as it is without also being sad on top of your head.
196851.title_en: Our Man Says Goodbye to His Coronavirus Haircut

196856.excerpt_en: The Center for Investigative Journalism (Sujo) and the Norwegian Association of Local Newspapers (LLA) want to find the coronavirus stories that have not been told. These days, they are distributing a questionnaire encouraging people throughout Norway to complete the form included in this article.
196856.subtitle_en: Do you have a coronavirus story to tell? We would appreciate it if you could spend two minutes completing the questionnaire at the bottom of this article.
196856.title_en: Do You Have a Coronavirus Story to Tell?

196859.excerpt_en: Library director Elin Anita Olsrud has accepted a new job as library director in Kragerø. She starts the new job on July 1.
196859.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Public Library has a one-year temporary position available for a library director. Seventeen women and seven men have applied.

196872.excerpt_en: “It has developed in entirely the wrong direction. The number of vehicles has exploded, and people are taking the law into their own hands—perhaps because of ignorance, and not necessarily out of malice.”
196872.subtitle_en: More than 2,000 snowmobiles are now to be parked for the season. With no suitable parking spaces available, people are getting creative—in flowerbeds, playgrounds and sandpits.
196872.title_en: “People Are Taking the Law into Their Own Hands”

196883.excerpt_en: The roughly 300 permanent residents from countries outside the EU/EEA are excluded and receive no money when furloughed. Until June 20.
196883.subtitle_en: While businesses are fighting to return to more normal conditions, one group among us has already been given a final end date.

196892.excerpt_en: The ski festival, or Telenor Festival, normally consists of eight races. This year, they managed to hold two before the town was shut down because of the coronavirus pandemic.
196892.subtitle_en: From May 7, organizations were allowed to arrange activities for up to 50 people. Svalbard Turn quickly organized the Children’s Ski Festival.

196910.excerpt_en: “It’s been almost an entire summer holiday without all the students here. It was great to have grades one through four back; now it will be even better when everyone returns.”
196910.subtitle_en: By next week, homeschooling will be over. All the students will return to school and to a slightly different everyday life.
196910.title_en: “Fantastic to Have All the Students Back”

203041.excerpt_en: It was entirely by chance that Henrik ended up at Svalbard Folk High School. He had originally applied for a scholarship position at Rønningen Folk High School, where he attended the previous year. “A friend told me about an available scholarship position in Longyearbyen,” he says with a smile.
203041.subtitle_en: Henrik Wirak Onsrud, 19, says he has been in Longyearbyen for 47 days. He is a scholarship student on the Music, Culture and Stage programme at Svalbard Folk High School.

203049.excerpt_en: The Governor was notified of suspicious plants on 1 October.
203049.subtitle_en: Two raspberry plants have been removed from Longyearbyen. The Governor thanks an observant resident.

203059.excerpt_en: At 11 p.m. on Sunday, almost NOK 1 million had been raised in Svalbard for the TV campaign. NOK 465,000 came from the auction at the cultural centre. “We are topping the donor rankings again this year,” concluded Anne Lise Klungseth Sandvik, head of the Svalbard TV campaign, at the cultural centre on Sunday evening.
203059.subtitle_en: With a contribution of almost NOK 400 per resident, Svalbard tops this year’s TV campaign donor rankings.

203071.excerpt_en: “Now it is about competing for Norwegian guests. We are trying to convey that Svalbard is not merely an expedition destination, as many may believe,” says Håkon Daae Brensholm.
203071.subtitle_en: Visit Svalbard’s work to market Svalbard is not stopping, even though tourists are staying away. Quite the opposite.

203092.excerpt_en: A resident recently submitted an anonymous alert about a potentially serious matter, alleging a danger to life and health because the bridge over Road 503, Melkeveien between the town centre and Skjæringa, is still not in place.
203092.subtitle_en: A new bridge over Melkeveien is planned for 2022. By then, it will have been four years since the old one was demolished.
203092.title_en: A long road to a new bridge

203100.excerpt_en: The bank is sending a negative signal by closing down just as Longyearbyen is under severe coronavirus pressure. SNN’s excellent local reputation was built by the people behind the counter and in the rooms behind it, not by electronic “solutions”.
203100.subtitle_en: Sad, and simply sad, that the “management” of Sparebanken Nord-Norge (SNN) does not see its Svalbard branch as a feather in its cap, a jewel SNN can afford. Money is all that counts. Not other values.

203108.excerpt_en: “When we bought the electric snowmobiles, it was paradoxical that they were to be powered by electricity produced from coal. We therefore opened a dialogue with Assemblin about the wind turbine, which in turn contacted its suppliers,” says Tore Hoem.
203108.subtitle_en: Eight electric snowmobiles were purchased in autumn 2019. This spring, solar panels were installed on the roof of IGP. Now the wind turbine is also up and running.

203120.excerpt_en: Guest figures from accommodation providers in Longyearbyen show a handful fewer daily guests this week than last week. On average, there are 137 guests per day, with a larger number arriving toward the weekend.
203120.subtitle_en: Tourist traffic is declining slowly. This week, we have 137 guests a day.

203128.excerpt_en: There is considerable suspense surrounding the conveyor system, as it was completely flooded this summer. “Everything has been damp, and water has seeped in everywhere. With the freezing temperatures, it has also frozen.”
203128.subtitle_en: The equipment needed to restore power to the mine is in place, and the conveyor system will be test-run this Wednesday.

203140.excerpt_en: “The aim is to prevent otherwise viable tourism businesses from going bankrupt, safeguard jobs, and give the industry time and room to adapt to the situation,” says Nybø. The scheme applies from 1.
203140.subtitle_en: Tourism businesses suffering a sharp drop in turnover will have a share of their fixed, unavoidable costs covered through the end of the year. This was announced at a press conference with Minister of Trade and Industry Iselin Nybø today, Tuesday.

203148.excerpt_en: We can genuinely pat ourselves on the back and agree that we are stronger together. A great deal of work, ingenuity and imagination lies behind this year’s result.
203148.subtitle_en: Once again, Svalbard tops the TV-Action donation table. A tremendous effort by the town’s residents, businesses, schools and other organisations has produced another fantastic result.

203156.excerpt_en: The administration of Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) wants to locate Galleri Svalbard, the cinema and the youth club in one place. The main reason is to save money, since both the gallery and the cinema currently operate at a loss.
203156.subtitle_en: LL wants to bring the youth club, gallery and cinema together in new premises. This would provide a better service and improve finances.
203156.tags_en: UHU, culture, cinema, Galleri Svalbard, youth club, news
203156.title_en: Plans to bring cinema, gallery and youth club together

203168.excerpt_en: Consto Svalbard, which is carrying out the work, is now working progressively around the building so it can be enclosed soon. “In two to three weeks, there will be major changes—the front will largely be in place, with windows and cladding.”
203168.subtitle_en: Within a few weeks, the façade around the northern end and the front of the “new” Svalbardbutikken will be in place.
203168.title_en: Major changes in the coming weeks

203180.excerpt_en: The Port Board and the Administration Committee approved port director Kjetil Bråten’s proposal on Tuesday. In practice, this means the port authority will launch a tender service for cruise ships from summer 2021.
203180.subtitle_en: Politicians support launching a tender service for cruise ships in Longyearbyen.
203180.tags_en: Port of Longyearbyen, news, cruise tourism
203180.title_en: Plans to provide transport for cruise ships

203208.title_en: These have applied for the job

203217.excerpt_en: Sparebank1 Nord-Norge (SNN) is Longyearbyen Local Council’s main banking connection. Its operating account currently holds NOK 216 million.
203217.subtitle_en: While local politicians in Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) support a boycott campaign against Sparebanken Nord-Norge, LL is one of the bank’s largest customers on Svalbard.
203217.title_en: Caught in a contradiction at the bank door

203243.excerpt_en: The project was unanimously approved by politicians on the Education and Culture Committee (OKU) after a briefing by Are Nundal, head of culture and sports at Longyearbyen Local Council, on Thursday afternoon. In total, the plans envisage Galleri Svalbard, a cinema auditorium and the youth club using 800 square metres on the second floor of the Coop building.
203243.subtitle_en: Politicians want to co-locate the gallery, cinema and youth club on the second floor of the new section of the Coop building in the town centre.

203243.title_en: Moving to the second floor of the Coop building

203257.excerpt_en: “The scheme will become operational as quickly as possible, and we are now working on its design and administration. I am keen to listen to the input I have received from the Svalbard community and will begin talks with a possible administrator as soon as possible,” Nybø tells Svalbardposten.
203257.subtitle_en: The government has proposed a temporary NOK 25 million grant scheme for tourism on Svalbard. Minister of Trade and Industry Iselin Nybø says they are now working out the details.
203257.title_en: “Will become operational as quickly as possible”

203265.excerpt_en: Aeco represents most operators running expedition cruises on Svalbard. It is now introducing recommended industry standards for its guides. “This is crucial to ensuring sustainable tourism in the Arctic,” says managing director Frigg Jørgensen in a press release.
203265.subtitle_en: The cruise organisation Aeco is introducing training standards for expedition cruise guides on Svalbard.
203265.title_en: Aeco sets requirements for cruise guides

203299.excerpt_en: Until renovations began, it was a church open around the clock, where everyone was welcome without being expected to contribute in any way, either through services or money. Many people in town live far from their families and perhaps also without a close network, at least during their first period here.
203299.subtitle_en: The church has, and has always had, a very special place in the Longyearbyen community. It is a meeting place across generations, faiths and nationalities.
203299.title_en: An important meeting place for the entire town

203307.excerpt_en: This week, DS Entrepenør signed a contract with the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE) to protect the rest of Sukkertoppen from avalanches. It is the same company that built the supporting structures on the mountain two years ago. According to NVE, the contract is worth NOK 52 million.
203307.subtitle_en: The contractor will fly people to Sukkertoppen by helicopter every day when the remaining avalanche protection on Sukkertoppen is installed from next year.
203307.title_en: Plans to use helicopter every day

203315.excerpt_en: In the letter, the ministry writes that it has proved difficult to find a good replacement for the title, which has become established as a unique designation for the state’s highest-ranking official on Svalbard.
203315.subtitle_en: Earlier this month, the Ministry of Justice and Public Security (JD) sent a letter to the Language Council asking for its assessment of the ministry’s proposal for a new title for the Governor of Svalbard.
203315.tags_en: news, Governor of Svalbard, Ministry of Justice and Public Security
203315.title_en: Asks Language Council for help with title

203323.subtitle_en: The power plant will get two new backup boilers. The million-kroner investment is necessary to secure the district-heating supply.

203363.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen and Barentsburg support the petition campaign to retain the local bank.

203399.subtitle_en: The long-term goal was to restart operations at Gruve 7 during October. Last week, he hoped it would happen this weekend. Now, the hope is sometime this week.

203407.subtitle_en: Are Nundal, head of culture and sports at Longyearbyen Local Council (LL), has applied to the Norwegian Film Institute for support for an outdoor cinema in Longyearbyen.

203415.excerpt_en: “There were several highly qualified applicants for the editor’s position. It has been a luxury situation for a small local newspaper,” says Robert Nilsen, chair of the Svalbardposten board.
203415.subtitle_en: Børre Haugli has been appointed the new editor of Svalbardposten from the start of the new year. A three-year-old dream is becoming reality.

203423.excerpt_en: Torgeir Prytz and Cecilie Østerlie are new board members of the Svalbardposten Foundation. The local council unanimously approved this on Tuesday evening.
203423.subtitle_en: Politicians and journalists in Longyearbyen agree that politicians should be kept off the newspaper’s board. The deputy leader of the local council warns of the consequences.

203480.subtitle_en: Literature Night brought together around 30 people and several nationalities to read and listen on Thursday.

203542.subtitle_en: Several of the 70 people renting out private homes and/or cabins in Svalbard can expect closer scrutiny from the authorities. “Those who break laws and regulations must be stopped,” warns Svalbard Frp.

You don’t need a snow shovel today, but a broom,” laughs duty meteorologist Pernille Borander.
203560.subtitle_en: The combination of little snow on the ground and strong gales is like a sandstorm in Longyearbyen.

203570.subtitle_en: On Sunday morning, mine manager Per Nilssen declared that the restart was a reality.

203592.excerpt_en: The mood around the table at Rabalder Café is good, even though the subject is serious enough. There are 22 Americans living in Longyearbyen.

203616.excerpt_en: Longyearbyen’s new backup power plant was recently delivered. The modules are being installed on the foundation that has stood ready since the summer. “That is partly due to Covid-19,” production manager Merwyn Salberg Thomsen replies when asked why it has been delayed.
203616.subtitle_en: With the new backup power plant in place, the electricity supply is more secure than ever.

203628.excerpt_en: The library opened its doors at seven on Wednesday morning. They served both coffee and baguettes to those sitting in front of the large TV screen.
203628.subtitle_en: It is hushed at Longyearbyen Public Library, where everyone is eagerly following the live broadcast of the US presidential election.

203638.subtitle_en: Businesses fear Svalbard will be shut down as a result of increased spread of infection. That is not being considered.

203650.subtitle_en: Musicians from mainland Norway are being flown in to perform with the Longyearbyen Symphony Orchestra.

203676.subtitle_en: From the night of November 7, a nationwide ban on alcohol service after midnight will be reinstated.

203686.excerpt_en: The government’s coronavirus restrictions are hitting an already hard-pressed tourism and nightlife industry on Svalbard. “It’s as bad as feared, but unfortunately not surprising. An even greater sense of seriousness is sinking in, especially for our industry,” says Ronny Brunvoll, managing director of Visit Svalbard.
203686.subtitle_en: Tourism businesses on Svalbard are desperate over stricter coronavirus measures. But they may save the Christmas and New Year season.

203694.subtitle_en: Kristin Cecilie Meyer-Skottun moved to Longyearbyen last year when her husband got a job at Telenor. One of her most important criteria before moving was a stable veterinary service.

At that point, she had operated the clinic without a paid veterinary on-call service for six years, and eventually the burden became too much.
203704.subtitle_en: Running a permanent veterinary service on Svalbard has proved to be a roller coaster of good and bad news.
203704.title_en: A Shame for the Town’s Two- and Four-Legged Residents

203712.excerpt_en: Parent Espen Klungseth Rotevatn is sounding the alarm about road safety at the junction of Hilmar Rekstens vei and Vei 232. “There are dangerous traffic situations here every day. Another parent raised the problem a year ago without anything happening,” says the former Green Party politician.
203712.subtitle_en: Politicians and parents fear accidents involving children at a junction with poor visibility. Labour wants a roundabout—and one-way traffic while we wait.

203720.tags_en: news, Minister of Climate and the Environment
203720.title_en: Proposing a Ban on Heavy Fuel Oil in Svalbard

203736.subtitle_en: A man has been charged with drunk driving in the early hours of Saturday.

203744.excerpt_en: It was a cold winter day in February that was to become “their” day. Michael, from Australia, was not even supposed to be working at Green Dog that day, but a colleague politely asked him to swap shifts, and reluctantly he said yes.
203744.subtitle_en: Camilla Marie Åsdam and Michael Hoare are a true “Svalbard couple.”

206294.subtitle_en: Our daily fresh bread has been saved from a coronavirus-related shutdown. Bakehuset Nord-Norge has made the decision.

206326.subtitle_en: Individuals and couples, friends and female friends have applied.
206326.title_en: Ten Applications to Trap at Austfjordnes

211725.tags_en: news, coal ship, heavy-fuel-oil ban, coal quay

211741.excerpt_en: A powerful tracked Caterpillar vehicle is like a dot in the middle of Adventdalen. It crawls across freshly fallen snow, headed for Todalen.
211741.subtitle_en: But it was not the cabin’s owners who were taking a cabin trip—it was Gøril Hammer’s cabin and her family travelling from Foxdalen to Todalen.
211741.tags_en: news, cabin, Foxdalen cabin area, Todalen, cabin plots
211741.title_en: The Cabin Trip of the Century

211769.excerpt_en: The avalanche did not reach the buildings, and there is no indication that anyone was caught in it. The Governor of Svalbard is investigating the area.
211769.subtitle_en: A large avalanche has run almost down to the road below Nybyen. Later on Sunday, an avalanche was also reported in Fardalen.
211769.title_en: Large Avalanches at Nybyen and in Fardalen

211777.excerpt_en: The consultation deadline for the expansion of Nordenskiöld Land National Park passed last week. The Governor of Svalbard received 37 submissions.
211777.subtitle_en: The consultation responses support expanding Nordenskiöld Land National Park, but many are deeply concerned.
211777.title_en: Yes to Protection—but at What Price?

211792.excerpt_en: The state, which owns Store Norske, will finance Store Norske’s purchase of Hurtigruten’s buildings in Svalbard through the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries (NFD), providing NOK 276 million in equity and a NOK 414 million loan, according to a press release on the NFD’s website. “NFD’s approval and contribution are conditional on consent …”
211792.subtitle_en: The state is providing equity and a loan to Store Norske to finance the property deal with Hurtigruten Svalbard.

211798.excerpt_en: According to Per Brochmann, destination director at Hurtigruten Svalbard, they have long been in dialogue with Store Norske regarding the property sale. “Store Norske was the best partner both in terms of price and because they are local. They have been here a long time and will be here for a long time.”
211798.subtitle_en: On Monday it became clear that Store Norske is taking over Hurtigruten Group’s buildings in Svalbard.

211812.excerpt_en: This applies for the time being until Tuesday. They write this in a press release.
211812.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard has decided to maintain the evacuation and travel ban in Nybyen, and the residence and travel ban above the built-up area in Lia.

211815.excerpt_en: “Active Outdoors” began as a project at Svalbard Turn in autumn 2014. The project aims to motivate and facilitate outdoor activities for Longyearbyen’s population, and to promote inclusion and public health.
211815.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn was founded on 6 September 1930. Today, Svalbard Turn is a multi-sport club with 24 sections and a total of 900 members. Our vision is to create the joy of sport for everyone in Longyearbyen. The club’s work shall be characterised by commitment, volunteerism and equality.

211837.excerpt_en: People also throw ordinary rubbish into the cabin-toilet container. “It happens quite often,” says technical director Kjersti Olsen Ingerø of Longyearbyen Local Council (LL). The container now has even clearer labelling.
211837.subtitle_en: Many people throw rubbish into toilet containers. Very clear labelling and the threat of a NOK 4,000 fine are intended to put an end to the bad habit.

211843.excerpt_en: A total of 22 men and 21 women have applied for the job, a fixed-term position for three plus three years. The duties include professional responsibility for managing Svalbard’s protected areas, guidance on the regulations in the Svalbard Environmental Protection Act, information and lecturing, and some fieldwork, the Governor writes in the job advertisement.
211843.subtitle_en: Forty-three applicants want to become nature managers with the Governor of Svalbard. Five of them live in Longyearbyen.
211843.title_en: These Applicants Want to Be Nature Managers with the Governor

211848.excerpt_en: Based on avalanche-professional advice from Skred AS, the Governor of Svalbard is lifting the evacuation and the travel and residence bans in Nybyen, as well as the travel and residence ban in Lia, from 11:00 on Tuesday, 30 March.
211848.subtitle_en: The evacuation of Nybyen has been lifted.

211875.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten’s large Easter newspaper is a tradition for both cabin owners and town walkers to enjoy throughout Easter, and 2021 is no exception. This year’s Easter edition can be bought at selected newsstands or read as an e-paper.
211875.subtitle_en: You will find this year’s Easter crossword on pages 18 and 19 of the Easter edition. Have you found the solution? You could win a six-month digital subscription to Svalbardposten.

211886.excerpt_en: The year’s likely biggest outdoor weekend lies ahead. Svalbardposten has spoken with meteorologist Ine-Therese Pedersen and Sigmund Andersen, subject coordinator for Arctic Nature Guide in Svalbard.
211886.subtitle_en: A low-pressure system threatens the Easter weather, and a high avalanche danger on south- and west-facing slopes means precautions must be taken before heading out.

211895.excerpt_en: Before the weekend, Store Norske entered into agreements with Kverneland Energi AS and Assemblin AS in Spitsbergen for the first phase of the energy transition at Isfjord Radio. According to the press release, this means a battery bank and a so-called thermal storage facility will be built at Isfjord before summer.
211895.subtitle_en: Isfjord Radio will run partly on batteries during the summer. Longyearbyen Energy’s battery solution will come a little later.
211895.title_en: Store Norske First with Battery Power

211947.excerpt_en: The polar bear is Svalbard’s symbol and brand. Even so, few tourists are fortunate enough to experience one in the wild.
211947.subtitle_en: The typical Svalbard tourist learns about Svalbard’s history from Longyearbyen’s many stuffed polar bears. We have 17 of them.
211947.tags_en: polar bear, Svalbard Museum, history, news, tourism

211950.excerpt_en: When people break through into glacier crevasses or glacier accidents occur, it is often explained by a poor snow winter and/or extensive summer melting. That may of course be the case where crevasses have existed previously.
211950.subtitle_en: There are several reasons why snow bridges can be poor, especially here in Svalbard.
211950.tags_en: opinion pieces, glacier crevasse, opinions, glaciers

211977.excerpt_en: A man was sent back to the mainland on Friday after arriving in Longyearbyen from abroad via Gardermoen without first completing quarantine. This is a breach of the Covid regulations, the Governor states in a press release.
211977.subtitle_en: Man stopped at airport and had to return to quarantine on the mainland.

211983.excerpt_en: The weather was not glorious, but it could certainly have been worse. Attendance was good as visitors and cabin residents gathered at the cross erected at the site by Kjell Mork in 1998. “Proof of what individuals can leave behind,” Pastor Siv Limstrand said as she opened the service.
211983.subtitle_en: Around 50 people attended the traditional Easter service at Vindodden on Good Friday.

212039.excerpt_en: The Governor’s decision to evacuate the buildings on the uphill side of the road in Nybyen is based on avalanche assessments by Skred AS and weather forecasts, according to a notice on the Governor’s website. Svalbardposten has been informed that approximately 50 people are staying at the affected addresses.
212039.subtitle_en: Around 50 people must evacuate Nybyen by 7 p.m. tonight because of avalanche danger.

212076.excerpt_en: Politicians recently voted to put Store Norske’s plan to build 50 new homes at Elvesletta out for public review. The existing houses, with a total of 32 apartments, will receive new and improved foundations.
212076.subtitle_en: Houses from Lia and Svea could get a new lease of life at Elvesletta as Store Norske nearly triples the number of homes there.

212087.excerpt_en: On Saturday, the Governor decided to evacuate the buildings on the uphill side of the road in Nybyen. A ban on staying and travelling has also been introduced above all buildings, from the southern side of Spisshusene to the southern end of the settlement in Nybyen.
212087.subtitle_en: The Governor, together with Skred AS, NVE and Longyearbyen Local Council, will meet at 2 p.m. on Monday to assess the evacuation situation in Nybyen and the other measures adopted in connection with the avalanche situation in Longyearbyen.
212087.title_en: New assessment of evacuation Monday afternoon

212116.excerpt_en: Through a contact in Longyearbyen, the four skiers requested assistance from the Governor at around 2:30 p.m. on Sunday. The weather in the area was extremely poor, and they had lost a tent and were wet and cold. “We sent out a helicopter, which managed to land near the group at around 7 p.m.”
212116.subtitle_en: The Governor’s rescue helicopter picked up four skiers near Isbukta in southern Spitsbergen on Sunday evening.

212122.excerpt_en: The only thing we know about the director of the Soviet Union’s coal mines on Svalbard on that January day in 1938 is that he was executed by firing squad in a Moscow prison basement. Mikhail Plisetski was a staunch communist from Gomel in Belarus.
212122.subtitle_en: We do not know what Mikhail Plisetski imagined in the final seconds of his life. Standing there blindfolded, he may have seen the ice-covered Grønfjorden sparkling in the spring sunshine. Perhaps it was Maja and Alexander playing exuberantly, or maybe his wife Rachel’s smile.
212122.title_en: The Svalbard director who was executed

212130.excerpt_en: “When we came further in, we found the car in a ditch by the old airport in Adventdalen. The people who had taken it had disappeared by then,” says Kjell Arne Lundin, chief superintendent at the Governor’s office.
212130.subtitle_en: They got a surprise when they came out of the cabin in Bolterdalen early Monday morning. The car was gone.

212139.excerpt_en: Based on avalanche advice from Skred AS and weather forecasts, the Governor is lifting the evacuation of Nybyen as well as the ban on travel and staying in the area, with immediate effect. The road from Longyearbyen School to Nybyen will also reopen, the Governor writes in a press release.
212139.subtitle_en: The 50 people evacuated from Nybyen can return immediately.

212147.excerpt_en: “It is different here, but very exciting. At Bjerke, people face challenges such as substance abuse, overcrowding and child poverty, but there is a very large cultural department and many employees.”
212147.subtitle_en: Vibeke Olsgård, 40, was youth coordinator in Groruddalen for seven years before taking the same position in Longyearbyen.

212152.excerpt_en: A large avalanche has occurred on the mountainside near Barentsburg. No one was caught in it.
212152.subtitle_en: The avalanche came down near the dog yard and across the snowmobile trail.

212161.excerpt_en: I signed up for Facebook (FB) in 2007, but have never become an active personal user. Mostly I have used it professionally—by posting articles in media outlets where I have worked.
212161.subtitle_en: Why does “everything” happen on Facebook in Longyearbyen?

212181.excerpt_en: In Tromsø cemetery stands a gravestone with a bronze plaque bearing the inscription: “Geologist Brit Hofseth, 24 years.” The grave appears not to have been tended.
212181.subtitle_en: Geologist Brit Hofseth died just 24 years old during a research expedition. “She could have become a pioneering woman in Norwegian polar research,” says literary scholar Anka Ryall.
212181.title_en: The research prodigy reduced to a femme fatale

212238.excerpt_en: The mail plane from Tromsø has been cancelled because of poor visibility, Posten reports. This means goods and parcels must be sent on the next flight.
212238.subtitle_en: Due to bad weather, this week’s print edition will not arrive until Friday.

212248.excerpt_en: The word itself comes from the Old Norse dugnaðr, meaning “help, support” or “virtue, good quality.” Over the past year, the word has made a comeback, and with a certain resignation it is often used in connection with the greatest collective effort of our time: the fight against infectious disease.
212248.subtitle_en: Dugnad. A word once associated with volunteering in a positive sense—when people join forces and contribute their time for free to something.

212267.excerpt_en: That means a total of 350 of the approximately 500 unvaccinated people over the age of 45 have booked an appointment. “Of course, one would always wish for more, but there are several reasons why people do not want it.”
212267.subtitle_en: Thursday’s vaccination session is full, with 200 people registered. So far, 150 people have signed up for vaccination next Wednesday.
212267.title_en: Hopes more people sign up next week

212278.excerpt_en: Kristina, 14 months old, is on the waiting list for a kindergarten place in Longyearbyen. Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) has informed the family that they cannot expect a place before autumn.
212278.subtitle_en: Flexible working hours are the solution for a family whose daughter is on the waiting list for a kindergarten place. They hope a place will become available before autumn.
212278.title_en: “It is hard to be on a waiting list”

212280.excerpt_en: The government writes in a press release. “It has been a dream ever since I was on the plane heading down in 2010,” Fause tells Svalbardposten. He was deputy Governor of Svalbard from 2008 to 2010.
212280.subtitle_en: This summer, Lars Fause will take over from current Governor Kjerstin Askholt.
212280.title_en: Lars Fause to become new Governor of Svalbard

212294.excerpt_en: Based on avalanche assessments by Skred AS and the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE), the Governor has decided to evacuate the buildings on the uphill side of the road in Nybyen until further notice, a press release states. The houses must be emptied by 6 p.m. today, Friday.
212294.subtitle_en: Large snow cornices could fall from Gruvefjellet. The Governor orders Nybyen evacuated indefinitely.

212322.excerpt_en: The danger of snow-cornice avalanches from Gruvefjellet is literally looming and unpredictable. The evacuation of 117 people could therefore be prolonged. “LL is assisting with practical matters such as bus transport and finding accommodation for the evacuees,” says LL chief administrative officer Hege Walør Fagertun. Twenty-nine of those evacuated are tourists staying at Guesthouse 102.
212322.subtitle_en: Students, pupils, workers and tourists are being accommodated elsewhere for as long as the evacuation of Nybyen lasts. A total of 117 people, according to Longyearbyen Local Council (LL).

212326.excerpt_en: Just under four months after its unveiling, the writing on the wall is being taken down. The illuminated letters spelling “Make The North Great Again” have been clearly visible by the UNIS intersection and Galleri Svalbard.
212326.subtitle_en: The controversial illuminated art sign is being removed today. It is going to Greenland.
212326.tags_en: culture, news, Northern Norwegian Art Museum

212338.excerpt_en: The Ministry of Health and Care Services told Svalbardposten this Thursday. “It has been decided that from 26 March, testing will be free if you use the testing station at Gardermoen or in central Tromsø.”
212338.subtitle_en: When testing for permanent residents became free at Gardermoen and in Tromsø on 26 March, the possibility of reimbursement was also removed.
212338.title_en: No Reimbursement for Testing Costs After 26 March

212346.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the large avalanche at Hiorthfjellet shortly after 9 a.m. on Saturday. The avalanche came down the eastern mountainside, across the snowmobile trail to Linken and towards the cabins.
212346.subtitle_en: No one was caught in the avalanche near Hiorthhamn.
212346.title_en: No One Caught in Hiorthfjell Avalanche

212355.excerpt_en: “Because conditions are extreme,” explains communications adviser Terje Carlsen of the Governor of Svalbard’s office. The Governor is therefore making a temporary change to the Motor Traffic Regulations and now permits snowmobile travel from Reindalen through Tverrdalen and Bolterdalen.
212355.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard permits travel in an area closed to snowmobiles until Monday.

212368.excerpt_en: And here, it is completely impossible to disagree. When you go to the post office—which happens often—you are greeted with service and cheerfulness that can turn a bad day around.
212368.subtitle_en: Sometimes it is good to honour everyday heroes. Tommy Albrigtsen thought Terje Gjeitnes and Tone Karin Heggdal at the post office in Longyearbyen deserved a cake.

212373.excerpt_en: “The Postal Services Act states that postal delivery in Norway should have the same price regardless of geography. The argument for having a Svalbard surcharge, meanwhile, is that it costs more to send mail here.”
212373.subtitle_en: Since 2004, it has been more expensive to send parcels to and from Svalbard than elsewhere in the country. Now a formal complaint will be submitted.

212381.excerpt_en: At around 3 a.m. on Sunday, personnel from the Governor of Svalbard had to go out to assist a heavily intoxicated person in central Longyearbyen. “The person was unable to look after themselves and could not find the way home,” acting chief constable Lisbeth Hansen tells Svalbardposten.
212381.subtitle_en: “The person could not find the way.”

212395.excerpt_en: The snow cornices on Gruvefjellet, or blocks of them, could be dangerous if they fall. They could also trigger avalanches on the mountainside above Nybyen.
212395.subtitle_en: There is a risk that buildings could be damaged if the snow cornices above Nybyen are blasted down.

212398.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard inspected the area after an avalanche came down from Gruvefjellet near Nybyen on Sunday. “A snow cornice collapsed and caused an avalanche. It is behind Guesthouse 102 in Nybyen.”
212398.subtitle_en: An avalanche from Gruvefjellet on Sunday did not reach the buildings.

212426.excerpt_en: It is complicated, but it is here to stay as part of the future of money. Bankers and technicians agree.
212426.subtitle_en: You can now “dig” for new Svalbard money online.

212447.excerpt_en: The Fruene café has received NOK 270,000 from Svalbard Package 1. General manager Tove Beate Eide has run Fruene at Lompen Centre since 2003 and describes a challenging coronavirus year. “At times, it has been incredibly difficult.”
212447.subtitle_en: Fruene is using a government grant to get its chocolate exports to the mainland moving again.
212447.title_en: Restarts Chocolate Sales to Mainland Norway

212449.excerpt_en: “I have great understanding for the challenges and frustrations faced by families with children,” says Kristin Furu Grøtting. The Labour politician chairs the committee responsible for childhood and education policy.
212449.subtitle_en: Kristin Furu Grøtting (Labour), chair of the Committee for Education, Culture and Youth (OKU), understands the parents’ frustration. But she still has no solution for those waiting for a kindergarten place.

212471.excerpt_en: “I feel just as sick today as I did yesterday, so to speak,” she told Svalbardposten last Thursday. When she spoke to Nav by phone about the case, she was allegedly asked why she had not submitted a new application for unemployment benefits in August.
212471.subtitle_en: Over the past month, Lene Dyngeland regularly submitted notification cards to Nav. Last Wednesday, she received the discouraging news: she had lost her right to unemployment benefits in August. Just hours later— the day after Dyngeland filed an appeal and Svalbardposten asked questions—Nav reversed its decision.
212471.title_en: Lost Her Right to Unemployment Benefits Last Year

212480.excerpt_en: “I have largely worked in local government, but now I have the opportunity to gain knowledge and insight into another part of public administration. It will be very exciting,” she tells Svalbardposten.
212480.subtitle_en: The current chief administrative officer of Longyearbyen Local Council, Hege Walør Fagertun, has accepted a position as chief administrative officer with the Governor of Svalbard.
212480.title_en: Fagertun to Become Chief Administrative Officer at Skjæringa

212485.excerpt_en: In addition to responsibility for vaccinating Longyearbyen’s population, Longyearbyen Hospital has also been tasked with vaccinating the populations of Barentsburg, Ny-Ålesund and Hornsund. When these vaccinations take place, healthcare personnel will most likely be flown to the settlements by helicopter. “During these days, both helicopter and hospital emergency preparedness will be weakened.”
212485.subtitle_en: This week, Longyearbyen will receive 1,690 vaccine doses in addition to those already scheduled to be administered.

212498.excerpt_en: “Restricting children’s and young people’s education is unique; it is the complete opposite of how we were trained at the educational institution. Here, they want to allow sufficient time during the consultation process—it is clear,” says Frode Westby Thorstad, principal of Longyearbyen School.
212498.subtitle_en: The current regulations are unclear. The rules will now be clarified, and the result could be a restriction of the right to special education in Longyearbyen.
212498.title_en: Wants to Restrict the Right to Special Education

212505.excerpt_en: Ten years after its launch, Svalbard Catering is running at full capacity. Half of its original staff are working part-time because of the coronavirus pandemic. “The crisis came along with a mountain of goods.”
212505.subtitle_en: The coronavirus-hit catering company is hungry for new customers. With a government grant, it is targeting growth in working lunches and dinner dishes.

212507.excerpt_en: The Port Authority should continue to own and, for the time being, operate “Svalbad”. That is the view of harbourmaster and case officer Kjetil Bråten and the chief administrative officer of Longyearbyen Local Council (LL).
212507.subtitle_en: The Port Authority still wants to own “Svalbad”. But after the coronavirus pandemic, someone else could run it, LL proposes.

212527.excerpt_en: While the first crisis package of NOK 25 million was earmarked for restructuring, LL describes the purpose of Svalbard Package 2, worth NOK 40 million, as improving the liquidity of tourism businesses on Svalbard through a compensation scheme.
212527.subtitle_en: Svalbard businesses may have up to half of last year’s coronavirus deficit covered. This is LL’s proposal for using NOK 40 million from Svalbard Package 2.

212529.excerpt_en: The Ministry of Justice and Public Security (JD) has asked the Ministry of Local Government and Modernisation to consider changes to the State Personnel Handbook for civil servants who apply for leave to work for the Governor’s Office.
212529.subtitle_en: In recent years, the Governor’s Office has found that the pool of applicants has narrowed and that appointments end earlier in the fixed term. Changes to the leave practice are now being proposed.

212547.excerpt_en: The number of guest nights in March was somewhat higher than last year, but 65 percent lower than in the last normal year, 2019. This is shown by fresh statistics from Visit Svalbard.
212547.subtitle_en: The coronavirus crisis continues to hit the tourism industry, March statistics from Visit Svalbard show.

212565.excerpt_en: The “Gågata 2021” project will be considered politically next week and approved by the local council on 4 May.
212565.subtitle_en: Next week, local politicians will make the final decision on building the new pedestrian street this summer—with lizards in the square.

212575.excerpt_en: There were only smiles, only joy, only beautiful trails, only brilliant weather—and only Svalbard at its best. “We came here to ski the Svalbard Ski Marathon, but we came anyway when it was cancelled. And then we got to take part in this.”
212575.subtitle_en: Why have a ski marathon when we have the Longyearbyen Ski Festival?
212575.title_en: Almost Better Than a Ski Marathon

article_keywords_en: chief superintendent of the Governor’s Office
212587.excerpt_en: “We received a report from five skiers that a polar bear had been in their camp during the night. They had tried to scare it off, but it was not easily frightened.”
212587.subtitle_en: Rescue crews had to extract five skiers at Krøkjebreen. By then, they had used up all their deterrent ammunition.
212587.title_en: Close Encounter with Polar Bear Became Too Much

212600.excerpt_en: “I’m not really a tourism professional, but a former alpine skier who competed at a good level. I came fifth in the senior national championships.”
212600.subtitle_en: Selling experiences on Svalbard is challenging these days. But being born in 1971 and taking up alpine skiing was challenging too.
212600.tags_en: Svalbard life, Hurtigruten Svalbard, people, tourism industry
212600.title_en: Alpine Skier in a Top Job

212613.excerpt_en: The mild weather has increased the risk of the cornices on top of Gruvefjellet collapsing. Sunday’s slide reached almost all the way down to the snowmobile trail leading up towards the evacuated buildings in Nybyen.
212613.subtitle_en: Earlier today, a snow cornice collapsed above Mine 2 B.
212613.title_en: Greater Risk of Snow Cornices Collapsing

212622.excerpt_en: Over the past year, the Governor has handled two domestic-violence cases. Hanne Beate Stenvaag, head of the Crisis Centre for Tromsø and the Surrounding Area, tells NRK that they know of several cases.
212622.subtitle_en: The crisis centre in Tromsø fears domestic violence on Svalbard is being underreported. “There is a risk that Svalbard could become a kind of haven for abusers,” warns centre manager Hanne Beate Stenvaag.

212635.excerpt_en: According to LL technical sector manager Morten Dyrstad, the amount in the agreement is around 50 percent of the actual excess consumption over the past three years. “Since the error is more than three years old, there is a statutory three-year limitation. The question has been how we should deal with those three years.”
212635.subtitle_en: Since 2006, Store Norske has paid 75 percent of the actual electricity consumption at Mine 7. They have now reached an agreement with Longyearbyen Local Council and will pay just over NOK 3.2 million in back payments.

212638.excerpt_en: Audun Salte and his wife Mia had long planned to make more of the dog yard in Adventdalen. When the restructuring funds arrived, it was time to think anew. “Mia and I have always had big visions for the dog yard.”
212638.subtitle_en: Svalbard Husky wants guests who come back—and remember the dogs’ names.

212676.excerpt_en: The background to the new regulations goes back many years. In 2009, after LL had repeatedly asked what provision they should offer for special education in upper secondary school, they were told by the Ministry of Education and Research that they were not required to offer it.
212676.subtitle_en: “The questions in the consultation concerning transition arrangements will be very important. Both we in the administration and the politicians must do a good job there to ensure good solutions,” says Hege Walør Fagertun, chief administrative officer of Longyearbyen Local Council.

212678.excerpt_en: You can find them both along the roads in Longyearbyen and in the Russian settlements of Pyramiden and Barentsburg, like bright spots in an otherwise sparse landscape. In a recent study, a group of researchers mapped alien plants on Svalbard.
212678.subtitle_en: Alien plants are invading Svalbard. Researchers have now developed a new mapping method to monitor non-native vegetation in polar regions.

212720.excerpt_en: “I still think it is right to wear a face mask. Especially where there are the most people, such as in grocery stores and restaurants.”
212720.subtitle_en: The requirement to wear face masks in Longyearbyen remains in force through today, Wednesday 21 April. The municipal chief medical officer hopes people will continue wearing masks.
212720.title_en: Encourages People to Keep Wearing Face Masks

212724.excerpt_en: He is an engineer at Svalsat and has been the project manager for the construction of SG12, the newest antenna in the park.
212724.subtitle_en: “In 2008, we were one of the world’s largest ground stations, with ten antennas,” says Kjetil Slettnes with a laugh.
212724.title_en: “It Was Supposed to Be a Public Celebration”

212737.excerpt_en: On 23 August, according to Gunnhild Masterbakk, head of the Children and Young People unit in Longyearbyen Local Council (LL), half of the youth centre in Longyearbyen will open its doors as a daycare centre.
212737.subtitle_en: The new daycare places in the youth centre this autumn have been allocated before they have even been built. By 23 August, all children who applied by the main admission deadline are to have a place in daycare.
212737.title_en: Daycare Centre to Open on 23 August

212743.excerpt_en: “We are taking some steps to ensure that people are well positioned on the day they have to find another employer or take on new duties at Store Norske.”
212743.subtitle_en: Both work in Svea and at Mine 7 are drawing to a close. All Store Norske employees can therefore apply for up to NOK 20,000 for further education.
212743.title_en: “Ensuring Employees Are in a Stronger Position When the Mine Closes”

212761.excerpt_en: The Governor evacuated the buildings on the uphill side of the road in Nybyen and imposed a ban on movement in the area because of avalanche danger on 9 April.
212761.subtitle_en: Some people are defying the barriers and driving snowmobiles beneath the cornices in Nybyen.

212778.excerpt_en: The Government said in a press release today, Friday. In Longyearbyen, this applies to 176 people, who received their first dose on 10.
212778.subtitle_en: Everyone who received a first dose of the AstraZeneca vaccine will now be offered the Pfizer or Moderna mRNA vaccines as a second dose.
212778.title_en: Pfizer or Moderna as Second Dose

212779.excerpt_en: Elisabeth Bourne is one of eight artists with studios at the art and craft centre associated with Galleri Svalbard. She set up here two years ago and has a background as a business owner in Seattle, USA.
212779.subtitle_en: Svalbard artist Elisabeth Bourne has run a business before. She would be happy to do so again, in Nybyen.
212779.title_en: Artist Wants to Run the Art Centre

212783.excerpt_en: Gallery Svalbard is scheduled to close in Nybyen on 30 June and reopen in new premises in the Coop building in the town centre.
212783.subtitle_en: The art and crafts centre in Nybyen will probably continue operating for at least three years. LL plans to hand its operation over to private parties.
212783.title_en: Art Centre to Continue in Nybyen

212791.excerpt_en: “I have always seen Svalbard as a fascinating place, but I have never aimed to move here. In 2010, a group of us were going to ski the Svalbard Ski Marathon.”
212791.subtitle_en: When Tore Råmundal, 66, was to take part in the world’s only ski marathon with armed guards in 2010, the famous ash cloud stopped him. On Saturday, he was his own guard during the Longyearbyen Ski Festival.
