432969.title_en: Another 41 Housing Units in the Danger Zone

433037.excerpt_en: “The new climate projections have established new parameters for the detailed design of the protective measures at Sukkertoppen. This applies particularly to the foundations,” regional director Knut Aune Hoseth writes in an email to Svalbardposten.
433037.subtitle_en: NVE will not prejudge the outcome, but the directorate admits that the climate projections have created new challenges.

433071.excerpt_en: They were found not far from the water’s edge. One woman and one man.
433071.subtitle_en: They set out on a ski trip from the research station on Friday. When they had not returned by Sunday morning, a search operation began. What they found was not what they had hoped for.

433205.excerpt_en: “We took a trial run of the new route and found that it was fine,” says 17 May committee chair Kristin Furu Grøtting.
433205.subtitle_en: Parade, speeches, ice cream, sausages and, not least, windless weather. Everything was as it should be on the national day.
433205.title_en: Longer route a success in the 17 May parade

433311.excerpt_en: When Minister of Research and Higher Education Iselin Nybø (Liberal Party) recently visited Svalbard, she brought an unexpected financial gift. UNIS has already come a long way in using nature as a laboratory and classroom, and new ways of teaching students will now be developed.
433311.subtitle_en: Students in Svalbard are already working in the world’s largest classroom. Now UNIS is receiving an additional NOK 4.7 million to make field teaching even better.
433311.title_en: Almost NOK 5 million for more field-based teaching

433566.excerpt_en: She meets Svalbardposten at Fruene. Beforehand, she had to think carefully about the request to appear on the back page. “The thought made me physically ill—almost nauseous, yes.”
433566.subtitle_en: Stine Teigen (40) leaves the summit hikes to others.
433566.tags_en: Svalbard Conservatives, Norwegian Arctic Student Welfare Organisation, Kroa, people, back page, Svalbard life

433569.excerpt_en: The time is long overdue to take a closer look at the facilities available for sport and physical activity in Longyearbyen. Svalbardhallen has been at capacity for several years.
433569.subtitle_en: We must put sports policy on the agenda.

434006.excerpt_en: “This will be the world’s most environmentally friendly ship. It will be able to run solely on electricity for three hours, wherever in the world it is,” says Atle Brynestad.
434006.subtitle_en: If everything goes according to plan for these two men, the first cruise ship with its home port in Longyearbyen will soon be a reality.
434006.tags_en: business, Longyearbyen port, cruise tourism, ship registry, cruise ship, news
434006.title_en: First cruise ship to have its home port in Longyearbyen

434119.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten stopped by Klassekampen’s stand outside Svalbardbutikken on Tuesday. Carl Mathias Karlsson was signing up for a free three-week subscription to Klassekampen. “I’m from Oslo and know the newspaper a little from my time there,” says the 28-year-old.
434119.subtitle_en: Consto employee Carl Mathias Karlsson (28) was happy to accept a free three-week subscription to Norway’s reddest newspaper.
434119.title_en: Klassekampen celebrates 50th anniversary in the north

434426.excerpt_en: Svalsat is the world’s largest station for downloading data. Its customer list includes NASA and a number of other international clients.
434426.subtitle_en: On Saturday, Svalsat invited the public to an open day. It was popular with young and old alike.
434426.title_en: Many Wanted to Reach Longyearbyen’s Rooftop

434489.excerpt_en: Three groups of gymnasts demonstrated their skills on Wednesday evening. They are divided into three groups, with nine coaches in total.
434489.subtitle_en: Young gymnasts from Svalbard Turn showed their best side for parents and other attendees on Wednesday.

434501.excerpt_en: Store Norske had closed the mine so that the women’s choir could perform in the surface facilities. Chairs had been set up in the large hall, and a small bar had been arranged.
434501.subtitle_en: The week’s cultural highlight came when Tundradundrene performed a concert in the mine.
434501.tags_en: culture, choir, concert, Mine 7, Tundradundrene, Store Norske, Svalbard life

434583.excerpt_en: Svalbardposten meets Fossnes in the control room at the power station. From here, she monitors everything happening inside the facility in her role as a plant operator.
434583.subtitle_en: For the first time, the power station has had a shift made up entirely of women. “It’s quite remarkable that it didn’t happen until now, in 2019,” says Helga Marie Fossnes.
434583.tags_en: news, gender equality, women, power station, working life, electricity
434583.title_en: Helga and Irina Make History at the Power Station

434768.excerpt_en: Fourteen-year-old Ella Krystad has lived in Longyearbyen virtually all her life. On Saturday, she ran 10 kilometres in 49:23, making her the fastest female runner.
434768.subtitle_en: Ella Krystad won the Spitsbergenmila in this year’s Spitsbergen Marathon. Longyearbyen also took a one-two finish in the men’s race, with 15-year-old Martin Higraff in second place.
434768.title_en: Ella (14) Was the Fastest Woman in the 10K

434810.excerpt_en: I’m wearing my snowmobile suit. Underneath, I have two layers of wool from head to toe.
434810.subtitle_en: Here I am, sitting on Deltaneset, enjoying the view. Fortunately, I’m not a badly dressed cruise pensioner.
434810.tags_en: search and rescue, Governor of Svalbard, Red Cross, rescue exercise, opinion, editorial, KV Svalbard, cruise, preparedness, exercise

435325.excerpt_en: At the tourism council’s board meeting in May, a unanimous board decided to expel the company, also known as Xarctic, effective immediately. The decision was taken because the company had breached the council’s guidelines. “They have violated the bylaws on several occasions.”
435325.subtitle_en: Experience Arctic was barred with immediate effect on 10 May after repeated violations of the association’s bylaws.
435325.tags_en: tourism industry, Visit Svalbard, news, guiding industry, tourism
435325.title_en: Barred from the Svalbard Tourism Council

435338.excerpt_en: “It’s simply nice to take part in this. Everyone has to contribute.”
435338.subtitle_en: Around a hundred enthusiastic litter pickers of all ages set out from Svalbardhallen on Wednesday afternoon.

435342.excerpt_en: With 553 participants, plus the children taking part in the mini-marathon, this year’s Spitsbergen Marathon made history as the race with by far the most participants to date. And the growth may continue. “We have already received quite a few registrations for next year’s marathon.”
435342.subtitle_en: No one who ran the 2019 Spitsbergen Marathon complained, but absolutely everyone highlighted the strong winds as a tough challenge.
435342.title_en: Tough Marathon in Strong Winds, but Only Smiles in Sight

435399.excerpt_en: Svalbard is a popular place for all kinds of businesses to start selling tourism products. New companies, including one-person businesses, keep appearing, all wanting a piece of the pie.
435399.subtitle_en: Tour operators and sole proprietorships that could damage the destination’s reputation must be stopped.

435470.excerpt_en: There is one fundamental difference between last year and this year, too. Last year, the Merseyside side lost to Real Madrid.
435470.subtitle_en: As last year, Liverpool reached the Champions League final. And as last year, Longyearbyen was marked by it.

435543.excerpt_en: “The boat is taking on water in the engine room. We are now sending pumping equipment from the Coast Guard vessel KV “Nordkapp,” Alf Hågensen of the Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway said at 9:05 Friday morning. “Polarsyssel” has also been dispatched to the area, and both of the Governor of Svalbard’s helicopters have been requested.

435543.title_en: Boat taking on water near Pyramiden

435612.subtitle_en: The sealing vessel “Havsel” has brought the situation under control after taking on water early Thursday morning.
435612.tags_en: news, Polarsyssel, Havsel, Joint Rescue Coordination Centre of Northern Norway

435896.excerpt_en: “I proposed holding local council meetings during the day. When that was voted down, it was undoubtedly the final nail in the coffin for my participation in local politics,” says Espen Klungseth Rotevatn (37).
435896.subtitle_en: Combining political office with family life ultimately became impossible for one of them. The other still serves on the local council, but says the most important thing is being a mother.
435896.tags_en: politics, local election, family, democracy, kindergarten, parents of young children, news
435896.title_en: “In the worst case, our age group could face a democratic deficit”

436011.excerpt_en: Increased precipitation causes more runoff from melting glaciers, greater river flows and larger quantities of sediment to be carried into Svalbard’s lakes. There is now solid evidence of this.
436011.subtitle_en: It is six metres long and may contain as much as 9,000 years of climate history. Samples from Lake Linné will help identify more reliable signs that today’s fluctuations are unnatural.
436011.tags_en: research, news, climate, Cape Linné, UNIS
436011.title_en: Seeking climate answers in Lake Linné

436079.excerpt_en: Melkeveien has been without a bridge since August last year. The only way past the site has been to walk across the riverbed of the Longyearelva.
436079.subtitle_en: “We are considering both temporary and permanent solutions,” LL says. Until then, the shortest road connection between the town centre and Skjæringa remains without a bridge.
436079.title_en: New bridge at least a year away

436137.excerpt_en: “I’ve really found my dream job,” Ida says with a smile when she meets Svalbardposten at Fruene café. The 33-year-old is referring to the job she got at the school in Longyearbyen this spring. There, she does everything from working in the after-school program to covering classes, and she has caught the bug. “No two days are alike, and the children give so much.”
436137.subtitle_en: Ida Lehn (33) was going to become a mechanical engineer. That was before she started working at Longyearbyen School.
436137.tags_en: Svalbard Conservatives, Longyearbyen School, people, back page, Svalbard life

436399.excerpt_en: “A new camp is planned in Svea from December 2019, and this removes the basis for tourism operations in Svea. The owners of the tourism company Svea Svalbard AS, Hurtigruten and Store Norske, will carry out an orderly winding-up of the company,” writes SNSK CEO Jan Morten Ertsaas in a press release.
436399.subtitle_en: After three seasons of tourist operations, Svea Svalbard is coming to an end.
436399.tags_en: Svea, Svea Svalbard, news, Store Norske
436399.title_en: Tourism in Svea to Be Wound Up

436452.excerpt_en: The government has adopted new and stricter rules for passenger ships operating in Svalbard. The regulation enters into force on 1.
436452.subtitle_en: The most sensible approach is prevention, restrictions on traffic and stricter safety requirements.
436452.title_en: Right to Tighten Safety Requirements for Ships

436640.excerpt_en: At nine o’clock on Friday morning, TUI’s “Mein Schiff 4” pulled into port in Longyearbyen. The ship is carrying more than 2,500 passengers, over 90 percent of them German, and all are German-speaking.
436640.subtitle_en: “Mein Schiff” will remain berthed in Longyearbyen for twelve hours.
436640.title_en: German Cruise Tourists Greeted by Glorious Weather

437068.excerpt_en: With large rubbish bags in hand and an alert eye, the very youngest joined the adults in a hunt for litter.
437068.subtitle_en: Just over 100 people collected more than four tonnes of rubbish.
437068.title_en: This Is How Much Rubbish They Collected

437605.excerpt_en: “I feel that alcohol use among adults in Longyearbyen is more taken for granted than what I’m used to from the mainland,” youth coordinator Ingeborg Runde tells Svalbardposten about the drinking culture. 471019.title_en: Looking at What They Made for the Christmas Newspaper 25 Years Ago

471068.subtitle_en: Tone Heide quit her job as a veterinarian this summer and had planned to take a break from the profession. After just a few months, she decided she wanted to continue working as a veterinarian after all.

471193.excerpt_en: After the avalanche in 2015, this hymn burned itself into my memory as something that always stirs emotions. I carry it with me and sing it on my Christmas rounds as I now travel east: “God’s peace over mountain and hill.”

471287.excerpt_en: Update: The polar bear is now on the other side of the pass at Longyearbreen. The Governor of Svalbard will continue using a helicopter to push the bear towards Colesdalen.
471287.subtitle_en: At around half past six this morning, a polar bear was spotted in town, in the area between Coop and Kroa.

471730.excerpt_en: In addition to enquiries from several media outlets, she has gained many new followers on both Instagram and Facebook, as well as nearly 50 friend requests. “A great many people ask for the film, and people also send messages to tell me about copyrights and things like that.”
471730.subtitle_en: Marie Lørup Stenshøj (27) filmed the polar bear as it walked past her apartment. The response afterwards has been enormous.

471757.excerpt_en: “We were out within ten minutes, and spotted the bear fairly quickly in the river by Melkeveien,” says senior police officer at the Governor’s Office Anders Haugerud. Eight people were out at the time, spread across seven vehicles, following the bear out of the town centre and up towards Huset.
471757.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard was notified of the polar bear in town at 6:23 a.m. on Thursday. The caller said a bear was heading from the closed-down kindergarten at Skjæringa towards the river.
471757.title_en: Governor’s Office Escorted Polar Bear Out of Town

471999.excerpt_en: At around six o’clock on Saturday morning, the Governor of Svalbard issued a notice urging people to exercise caution. At the time, the Governor’s personnel were out trying to drive the bear out of town.
471999.subtitle_en: The polar bear seen in central Longyearbyen on Thursday morning returned on Saturday morning.
471999.title_en: The Polar Bear Returned to Town

472006.excerpt_en: I have honestly been very puzzled by this year’s school-bus arrangement and the time the school opens. The school bus picks up the children at around 7:45 a.m., and they arrive at school a few minutes later.
472006.subtitle_en: Today I received the confirmation I needed to speak clearly about what I think of a practice introduced at the school during this polar night season.
472006.title_en: Does the School Take the Children’s Safety Seriously?

472052.title_en: Operation Called Off Due to Bad Weather

472208.subtitle_en: The polar bear was spotted in Bjørndalen again on Sunday morning, after being driven out of the area yesterday.

472213.excerpt_en: The café is undergoing a complete renovation, with nearly three million kroner invested in the refurbishment. But Fruene will still be Fruene, assures general manager Tove Beate Eide. “There is always an element of excitement in processes like these.”
472213.subtitle_en: New Year’s Eve will be Fruene’s last opening day before it closes for almost four weeks.

472401.excerpt_en: Fireworks and people evidently did not scare the bear away. At a quarter to one on the night of 1 January…
472401.subtitle_en: The Governor’s helicopter was airborne shortly after midnight. The polar bear that has visited the town over the past week is probably back.

472471.excerpt_en: Stig Onarheim (51) was born in Longyearbyen and has lived on Svalbard for a total of 39 years. He has experienced more than most people.

472471.title_en: Stig Was a Polar Bear Guard During the Drilling Operation at Haketangen

472799.excerpt_en: Just as cars have to undergo an MOT test, ships also need to be checked for faults and deficiencies from time to time. MS «Norbjørn», the vessel that transports goods to and from Svalbard, is to be recertified in January.

472974.title_en: A long wait for a permanent ski slope?

473084.excerpt_en: We have just come through a decade of little ice in the Arctic. This winter, too, the ice extent around the North Pole is close to a record low, but we notice little of that in Svalbard.

473084.title_en: Easterly winds could help the snowmobile season

473560.subtitle_en: Arnt Vegar Jensen (43) is no unfamiliar face in Svalbardposten. Almost ten years after moving to Longyearbyen, he will soon be heading back to Tromsø.

484089.subtitle_en: The extent of the snowmobile rider’s injuries is unknown.

The Governor also wishes to remind the public of the access restrictions on Mariaholmen, Midterhuksletta and Eholmen in Van Mijenfjorden National Park between 15.

485909.excerpt_en: At the same time, Store Norske is continuing its pilot project on the energy transition at the facility and has submitted an application to install solar panels.
485909.subtitle_en: The Directorate for Cultural Heritage has now begun the announced preservation process for Isfjord Radio at Kapp Linné.
485909.tags_en: news, Directorate for Cultural Heritage, Isfjord Radio

485936.excerpt_en: “Recently, many people have contacted us to ask whether we have bicycles for sale. In just the past few weeks, more than 30 people have got in touch to ask about bikes,” says Franka Leiterer, who runs the Svalbard Resykkelerings Workshop.
485936.subtitle_en: Franka Leiterer is certainly noticing that cycling season is under way. Almost every day, people interested in bicycles get in touch.
485936.tags_en: bicycle workshop, news, Svalbard Resykkelerings Workshop
485936.title_en: Seeing a surge in demand for bicycles

485947.excerpt_en: Some have reason to celebrate, even though no private individuals were awarded a cabin plot by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries (NFD) this time. “Those offered a cabin plot in this round have met the criteria we set in the call for applications, where we were particularly clear that increasing the number of cabin opportunities for as many people as possible…”
485947.subtitle_en: Twenty-five applications were received for six cabin plots, and the allocations have now been decided.
485947.tags_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries, cabin plots, news

485968.excerpt_en: A total of 26 applicants wanted to move to Svalbard and Longyearbyen for the position of communications adviser with the Governor of Svalbard after the application deadline passed on 22 May.
485968.subtitle_en: Among the 25 applicants who want to move to Svalbard are both a psychologist and an interpreter.
485968.tags_en: applicant list, communications, Governor of Svalbard, news, Longyearbyen
485968.title_en: These applicants want to become the Governor’s new communications adviser

485972.excerpt_en: Around 1 p.m. on Friday, the Governor of Svalbard was awaiting clarification about the condition of a person aboard a ship anchored in Kongsfjorden.
485972.subtitle_en: A person was picked up by helicopter by the Governor of Svalbard on Friday afternoon.

486003.excerpt_en: “The priest was a little worried beforehand that it might be extra cold because of the chunk of ice. But the water from Southern Norway was extra warm to compensate,” says a very happy dad, Bjørn-Arild Schancke, by phone from Kristiansand.
486003.subtitle_en: In complete secrecy, dad Bjørn-Arild Schancke carried the chunk of ice more than 2,000 kilometres. His daughter Milda was to be christened in water from “two worlds”.
486003.title_en: Milda is christened in water from the Arctic

486036.excerpt_en: Around 20 nautical miles north of Bear Island, the crew aboard S/Y Ultima Thule got quite a surprise. “A bird came flying in and perched on the sprayhood at the back. It looked very tired.”
486036.subtitle_en: “Suddenly there were six cuckoos on board,” says Rolf Markussen.
486036.title_en: A cuckoo came aboard north of Bear Island

486100.excerpt_en: Duen Experience started in 2016 and was in full operation from 2017. Every year, Øyvind Nilssen from Senja comes to Svalbard aboard the expedition ship Duen III to offer tourists tailored trips around Spitsbergen.
486100.subtitle_en: After several years in Longyearbyen harbour, Øyvind Nilssen believes it is time to discuss conditions at the harbour.
486100.title_en: “For this price, the harbour should have been better equipped”

486117.excerpt_en: Local Council leader Arild Olsen strongly criticised Minister of Trade and Industry Jan Christian Vestre after he said he was considering various partnership constellations that could help accelerate local business development with a view to creating new industrial jobs. “It is a misconception that we need more activity.”
486117.subtitle_en: “Business development is about so much more than growth; it is about what kind of society we want,” says Terje Aunevik (V) following Arild Olsen’s criticism.
486117.tags_en: Minister of Trade and Industry, politics, news
486117.title_en: More people react to criticism of the Minister of Trade and Industry

486149.excerpt_en: “Previously, we usually had three teams; this year there are two. One team will be based in Ny-Ålesund, while the other will be based at various locations around Isfjorden,” says Ingvild Øyjordet, a nature manager with the Governor of Svalbard.
486149.subtitle_en: This year, two police officers and two environmental experts will be out in the field for the Governor of Svalbard during the summer.
486149.tags_en: field inspectors, Governor of Svalbard, news
486149.title_en: They will have plenty to do

486159.excerpt_en: On Monday 13 June, Statsbygg handed the building over to the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority, the Norwegian Consumer Authority, NAV, Norwegian Health Network, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries, and the Norwegian Tax Administration.
486159.subtitle_en: The former post office and bank building in Longyearbyen has now been converted into new government workplaces.

486213.excerpt_en: “It’s great to see them perform at their best and cheer each other on. It’s really moving,” says youth worker Siri Hanseid Bendiksen as she stands beside the pool.
486213.subtitle_en: Cycling, running and swimming were on the agenda when this year’s triathlon was held at Longyearbyen School.
486213.title_en: “It’s fun to be able to push yourself”

486217.excerpt_en: Every year, the Svalbard Scout Group usually holds a scout camp before the holidays. Last year, things did not quite go according to plan because of bad weather, but this year’s trip was a success.
486217.subtitle_en: This year’s Scout trip to Farhamna and Forlandet was a success. See the photos here.

486262.excerpt_en: Using new measurement series from weather stations in northern and eastern Svalbard, researchers from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute have documented that warming in these areas is actually twice as great as in Longyearbyen and Ny-Ålesund in the west.
486262.subtitle_en: Nowhere in the world is warming happening faster than in Svalbard. A new study shows that the temperature increase is twice as large as researchers have observed so far.
486262.title_en: Warming in Svalbard is the fastest in the world

486286.excerpt_en: A cost estimate showing the impact of higher diesel prices indicates that Longyearbyen residents must prepare for considerably higher electricity and heating bills if the diesel solution is phased in as planned. The case documents still show that the administration wants to switch to diesel.
486286.subtitle_en: Electricity and heating could become 148 percent more expensive with diesel. Now the focus is on continued coal-fired operations.
486286.title_en: Electricity bill could be more than twice as high with diesel

486320.excerpt_en: Last week, it was once again time for a seed deposit at the seed storage facility. This time, 11 gene banks from Africa, America, Asia and Europe deposited a total of 19,391 seed samples in the vault.
486320.subtitle_en: On 10 June, seeds were deposited in the seed vault once again, and this time Spain and Lithuania also delivered their first seeds.
486320.title_en: First Seeds from Spain and Lithuania

486324.excerpt_en: Forty years is an eternity in Svalbard, where memory barely reaches ten years back in time. Three weeks ago, I asked in a letter to the editor of Svalbardposten about the Russian cabin that once stood on the bluff near the old museum at Skjæringa.

486334.excerpt_en: Jason Roberts is a busy man these days. When he is not working on shoots for various documentaries, he is usually filming the new drama series in Longyearbyen.
486334.subtitle_en: The documentaries “Polar Bear” and the behind-the-scenes film “Bear Witness” have attracted considerable attention since their release on Disney+.
486334.tags_en: polar bear filming, documentary, PolarX, news

486344.excerpt_en: The people of Svalbard should of course be allowed to enjoy everyday life, but record heat in Svalbard is not something communications advisers at the Norwegian Meteorological Institute in Oslo should celebrate. Editor Børre Haugli paid me a visit in Svalbardposten on 1…
486344.subtitle_en: A response to editor Børre Haugli.

486413.excerpt_en: At around 6 a.m. on Thursday, the expedition vessel M/S Virgo was back in Longyearbyen after running aground in Fuglefjorden on Tuesday morning.
486413.subtitle_en: M/S Virgo was back in Longyearbyen around 6 a.m. after running aground in Fuglefjorden.
486413.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, news, Polarsyssel, M/S Virgo
486413.title_en: Thanks the Governor of Svalbard for the assistance

486428.excerpt_en: The man in his 40s who is on trial faces a long list of offences. The victim in the case is Robert Hermansen, who has a long history in Svalbard.
486428.subtitle_en: Witnesses described a man out of control after last year’s violent incident—but he remembers nothing himself.
486428.tags_en: court case, Robert Hermansen, police, news
486428.title_en: “I was scared when we fell down the stairs and I realised I could be injured”

486490.excerpt_en: Head of Culture Are Nundal and acting general manager Tom Warner are enthusiastic as they present the Nordover concept. The aim is for the new art centre to become a creative meeting place where people can come to learn, exchange ideas and find inspiration.
486490.subtitle_en: The new art centre in the Coop building will be called Nordover, if Longyearbyen Community Council gets its way. And there are many plans for the premises.

486501.excerpt_en: The government is amending the regulations on local council elections, requiring non-Norwegian citizens to have lived for three years in a mainland Norwegian municipality in order to vote and stand for election to the local council in Longyearbyen. “This is intended to maintain the local council’s ties to the mainland and ensure that people have sufficient knowledge of…”
486501.subtitle_en: The government has now made up its mind. Without a connection to mainland Norway, foreign nationals will lose the right to vote and the opportunity to sit on the local council.
486501.tags_en: local council, news, right to vote, democracy
486501.title_en: Foreign nationals lose the right to vote

486527.excerpt_en: Airport director Hans Jørgen Bugge is moving on to new responsibilities at Avinor, the company said in an internal memo shared with Svalbardposten. “I will remain at Svalbard Airport until next summer and will serve as airport director until my successor is in place.”
486527.subtitle_en: Airport director Hans Jørgen Bugge has resigned and will move on to a new job at Avinor’s head office in Oslo next summer.
486527.tags_en: Avinor, airport director, news, Svalbard Airport

486558.excerpt_en: Is Norway playing a high-stakes game with the Svalbard Treaty? Two issues have led other treaty parties to express dissatisfaction with Norway’s administration, particularly Articles 2 and 3 on equal treatment, and Article 8 on the mining regulations.
486558.subtitle_en: Conflict over snow crab and winding down the mining regulations
486558.tags_en: Svalbard Treaty, snow crab, opinions, mining
486558.title_en: Conflict over snow crab and winding down the mining regulations

486574.excerpt_en: E24 has gained access to a letter from Trust Arktikugol director Alexander Veselov, received by Governor Lars Fause. In the letter, Veselov warns that the European sanctions against Russia, also adopted by Norway, do not permit “ensuring the emergency preparedness of Russian settlements for emergencies.”
486574.subtitle_en: The continued stoppage of the goods could threaten emergency preparedness ahead of the winter season in Barentsburg, says Trust Arktikugol.
486574.title_en: Seven tonnes of food for Barentsburg stopped at Storskog

486589.excerpt_en: The theme was Eurovision, and both students and venues were dressed in glitter and sequins for the occasion. The students had clearly practised a lot, because everything went off without a hitch.
486589.subtitle_en: There were surely many an itchy dancing foot when Longyearbyen School of Culture held its end-of-term show.
486589.tags_en: Svalbard life, cultural centre, School of Culture
486589.title_en: It swung at the cultural centre

486652.excerpt_en: The project to reuse the old recycling centre began in 2020, and Longyearbyen Community Council’s administration has now decided which concept it recommends that politicians pursue. Developed with LPO Architects, the concept aims to create a sustainable place for Longyearbyen’s residents.
486652.subtitle_en: Like the phoenix, the recycling centre will be reborn into a new life.

486660.excerpt_en: “What we hoped would not happen has now happened. I think it is wrong and a betrayal of the children in Longyearbyen,” says Nina Hallerud Normann.
486660.subtitle_en: On Friday, it became clear that children on Svalbard will lose their right to special education if they have substantial accommodation needs. This has prompted a reaction from Nina Normann.
486660.tags_en: rights, news, special education, government, Longyearbyen Community Council
486660.title_en: “A betrayal of the children in Longyearbyen”

article_keywords_en: Convention on the Rights of the Child
486683.excerpt_en: It is with a heavy heart that I read that the government is now carrying out its betrayal of the children in Longyearbyen. I find it incomprehensible that the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child does not apply to children on Svalbard.
486683.subtitle_en: No reason to be proud today
486683.tags_en: special education, Longyearbyen Community Council, opinions, Longyearbyen School
486683.title_en: No reason to be proud today

486719.excerpt_en: “We’re moving in on 1 February 2023,” says Espen Rotevatn, the folk high school’s principal. The new school will be closer to the centre, and everything will be gathered in one place. “In Nybyen, we had four different buildings, and we also used some rooms at Lompensenteret and Huset.”
486719.subtitle_en: The folk high school is moving to Sjøskrenten next year, and construction of the new school is well under way.
486719.title_en: “The premises will be bright and lovely”

486747.excerpt_en: The managing director of UNIS wrote a very good opinion piece about the ongoing energy transition in Longyearbyen on Saturday, 18 June 2022. Viewed from a global perspective, climate change is a global problem with local consequences, requiring corresponding action.
486747.subtitle_en: We have everything to gain by switching to diesel and phasing in renewables, writes Community Council leader Arild Olsen.

486756.excerpt_en: Birger Amundsen disagrees with the Governor’s proposal to move the trapping cabin in Rekvika to Longyearbyen, and also pays a visit to Svalbard Museum.
486756.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, trapping cabins, opinions, Svalbard Museum

486780.excerpt_en: In 1996, Jørn decided to buy a horse and start Svalbard Equestrian Centre. For many years he ran the centre, offering riding lessons for children and excursions for visitors.
486780.subtitle_en: From his hospital bed in Tromsø, Svalbard resident Jørn Dybdahl talks about his kidney cancer and his fight to make the authorities take responsibility.
486780.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, Avinor, Norwegian Environment Agency, news, pollution
486780.title_en: Jørn has kidney cancer: “The toxin is a contributing factor”

486812.excerpt_en: Last week, everyone without a mainland connection lost the right to vote and the opportunity to serve on the Community Council. This naturally affects foreign citizens, who make up one-third of Svalbard’s population.

486843.excerpt_en: On Tuesday evening, Longyearbyen Community Council took another step towards the energy transition. The politicians unanimously approved the NOK 56.2 million investment cost for a temporary diesel solution, but will take stock by November.
486843.subtitle_en: The politicians were unanimous in agreeing to continue work on a temporary diesel solution.
486843.tags_en: politics, Longyearbyen Community Council, news, energy transition
486843.title_en: “The greatest uncertainty is that we cannot get started”

486880.excerpt_en: In Svalbardposten’s never-ending search for excavation stories, we found one right in the town centre this week. Many readers have contacted the newspaper wondering what is going on, so here is the answer.
486880.subtitle_en: Many people have noticed a large excavator in front of the hospital.
486880.title_en: A new car park is on the way

486884.excerpt_en: Svalbard will be the coldest place in the country, with temperatures of 4–5 degrees, while the water temperature at Bjørnøya will be a refreshing 2.1 degrees, NTB writes in a press release. On Thursday evening, 23 June, Longyearbyen is forecast to have strong southeasterly winds, with gusts of 21–25 metres per second.
486884.subtitle_en: While some parts of the mainland look set to see the year’s warmest day, Midsummer Eve in Longyearbyen appears likely to be both cold and windy.

486945.excerpt_en: Avian flu has been detected on Svalbard for the first time.
486945.subtitle_en: It turned out that a glaucous gull found at Bringkaia in June had avian flu.

486964.excerpt_en: At the beginning of April, the government allocated NOK 100 million to efforts against foreign intelligence, hybrid threats and increased presence in the northern regions. It also wanted better controls on Svalbard and allocated NOK 8 million to introduce random identity checks.
486964.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard is increasing staff as part of efforts to strengthen identity checks on Svalbard.
486964.tags_en: news, border control, PST, Governor of Svalbard
486964.title_en: Increased passenger checks at the airport

486978.excerpt_en: On Thursday afternoon, the research park in Longyearbyen welcomed a distinguished visitor.
486978.subtitle_en: To mark 100 years since his great-grandfather’s death, a bust of Prince Albert I was unveiled by Albert II, Prince of Monaco, inside the research park.
486978.tags_en: Svalbard Museum, Norwegian Polar Institute, research park, Albert II, Prince of Monaco, news
486978.title_en: Bust of Prince Albert I unveiled

487012.excerpt_en: The road has been narrowed between Coop and Svalbard Hotell at the request of Longyearbyen Community Council. Work to replace the district-heating pipes began on the 13th.
487012.subtitle_en: Hilmar Rekstens vei has been narrowed in connection with the replacement of district-heating pipes. This will continue until around mid-August.
487012.tags_en: Hilmar Rekstens vei, district heating, Longyearbyen Community Council, news

487065.excerpt_en: Until recently, anyone who had lived in Longyearbyen for at least three years could vote in local elections. The requirement has now changed: unless they are Norwegian citizens, people must have lived for at least three years in a Norwegian mainland municipality to be eligible to vote.
487065.subtitle_en: Local council politicians have strong opinions about the government’s decision to tighten the rules on voting rights.
487065.title_en: “The Desire to Engage in Politics Is Diminishing”

487332.excerpt_en: I am a Danish citizen and have lived in the Arctic for 25 years. For the past 11 years, I have lived in Svalbard.
487332.subtitle_en: Open letter to Justice Minister Emilie Mehl
487332.title_en: Open Letter to Justice Minister Emilie Mehl

487394.excerpt_en: The coal-fired power plant is temporarily out of operation, and the diesel backup system has been activated. This follows problems at the power plant over the weekend.
487394.subtitle_en: Weekend incidents at the coal-fired power plant have led Longyearbyen Community Council to start diesel-powered energy production.
487394.tags_en: news, backup power plant, Longyearbyen Community Council, power plant
487394.title_en: Incident at coal-fired power plant—now running on backup

487402.excerpt_en: The Northern Norwegian Writers’ Association is celebrating its 50th anniversary and is inviting young people in Northern Norway and Svalbard to take part in a writing competition this summer. It has been awarded NOK 100,000 by Equinor for the writing project.
487402.subtitle_en: The competition’s theme is “culture clash,” and young people from Northern Norway and Svalbard are invited to participate this summer.
487402.tags_en: news, writing competition, Northern Norwegian Writers’ Association
487402.title_en: Invites Svalbard Youth to Writing Competition

487415.excerpt_en: The Pride parade in Oslo was originally scheduled for Saturday to mark Norway’s biggest celebration of queer love and diversity. Instead, the parade was postponed after 43-year-old Zaniar Matapour attacked random people in Oslo early Saturday morning.
487415.subtitle_en: After Saturday’s incident during the Pride festival in Oslo, Lene Jeanette Dyngeland believes Pride celebrations will only grow larger.
487415.title_en: Believes More People Will Engage in Pride

487428.excerpt_en: The Ministry of Transport has invited comments as it prepares a new tender for regional scheduled flights. In the letter, Lennarth Kvernmo, head of business development at Longyearbyen Local Council (LL), writes that residents, businesses and public authorities all experience instability in the service. “The cost of air tickets is based on market-driven supply and demand.”
487428.subtitle_en: In a consultation response, Longyearbyen Local Council points out instability in parts of the air service to and from Svalbard.
487428.title_en: Feedback on air services: “Struggling to meet demand”

487486.excerpt_en: The verdict supports Hermansen’s account: the man in his 40s attacked Hermansen, including by pulling and pushing him down a staircase.
487486.subtitle_en: A TV 2 employee subjected Robert Hermansen, 83, to serious violence. The verdict has now been delivered.
487486.tags_en: police, news, Robert Hermansen, court case
487486.title_en: Brutal Assault on Robert Hermansen, 83 – Verdict Announced

487576.excerpt_en: Konstantin Kosatsjev, chair of the Foreign Affairs Committee in Russia’s upper house, accuses Norway of violating the Svalbard Treaty after food supplies to Barentsburg were stopped at Storskog. The accusation comes from several quarters, including Kosatsjev, chair of the committee.
487576.subtitle_en: Russia’s consul general in Svalbard, Sergey Gushchin, says people in Barentsburg are not starving for the time being.
487576.title_en: Consul General: “The Total Food Supply Has Been Halved”

487580.excerpt_en: She has worked as both a screenwriter and director, and has a background in performing arts at various theatres. She is also a nonfiction author and freelance journalist, writing among other things for the commentary newspaper Ny Tid.
487580.subtitle_en: She was 18 when she first developed an interest in the polar regions. Author Marianne Solberg hopes to find inspiration and peace to write this summer.
487580.title_en: She Wants to Explore Nature’s Vulnerability

487590.excerpt_en: “During the night before Saturday, boiler 1 stopped, and during the night before Monday, boiler 2 stopped,” says Hans Normann, energy manager at the power plant.
487590.subtitle_en: Both grates inside the two boilers at the coal-fired power plant have jammed. In the meantime, the plant must therefore run on diesel.
487590.tags_en: news, power plant, backup power plant, coal-fired power plant
487590.title_en: Using 1,500 Litres of Diesel per Hour

487596.excerpt_en: The Russian hacker group Killnet is now believed to be behind a massive DDoS attack on several Norwegian websites today.
487596.subtitle_en: The halt to Russian goods being transported to Svalbard via Storskog is believed to be behind Wednesday’s attack on Norwegian websites by the hacker group Killnet.
487596.title_en: Food Blockade of Barentsburg Believed to Be Motive Behind Hacker Attack

487638.excerpt_en: Russia is currently pounding Norway with the Svalbard Treaty as ammunition. It is an old tactic on the Russian side and produces nothing but a little noise and a hint of smoke.

487682.excerpt_en: Russia has accused Norway of violating the Svalbard Treaty by preventing food deliveries to Russian miners in Barentsburg. The Norwegian embassy was summoned to the Russian Foreign Ministry over the matter. “Norway is not violating the Svalbard Treaty,” Foreign Minister Anniken Huitfeldt said.
487682.subtitle_en: Lawyer Arnt Angell says there is no definitive answer as to whether Norway is violating the Svalbard Treaty.
487682.title_en: Lawyer on Food Blockade: “They Are Stretching the Treaty to Its Limits”

487718.excerpt_en: On 10 April, Kristin Sommervold from Trondheim lost her life in a snowmobile accident.
487718.subtitle_en: The snowmobile accident near Longyearbreen in April, which resulted in a woman’s death, has now been dismissed.
487718.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, snowmobile accident, accident, news

487729.excerpt_en: Statistics Norway (SSB) confirms that it has received the figures, but due to staff holidays, they will not be published until August. Svalbard’s population statistics are released twice a year, and the figures for the first half of 2022 should already have been published.
487729.subtitle_en: Svalbardposten has repeatedly requested updated population statistics for Svalbard. The figures now appear likely to be released in August.

487765.excerpt_en: Last year, researchers tagged 90 Arctic char in the area around Isfjorden to increase knowledge of the fish’s movements and behavior on Svalbard. The research project, led by Akvaplan-niva, is now continuing.
487765.subtitle_en: Arctic char is the only native freshwater fish that lives and reproduces in Svalbard’s waterways, and researchers want to learn more about it.
487765.title_en: The Search for Arctic Char Continues

487769.excerpt_en: Last weekend, the national UKM festival was held in Stjørdal. Svalbard’s own Mia (16) Ekeblad Eggenfellner and Agnes (16) Viktoria Kristina Zaderwasser travelled there after advancing as one of the entries from the county festival in Finnsnes, Troms, at the end of April.
487769.subtitle_en: The national UKM festival was held in Stjørdalen from 24 to 27 June. Mia and Agnes took part as the festival’s final act.
487769.tags_en: Young Culture Meets, UKM, music festival, news

487779.excerpt_en: The two say that over the past 13 years they have arranged riding lessons for children and riding tours for tourists. They have also been responsible for caring for and feeding the three horses. “That means we have been here three or four times a day at certain periods.”
487779.subtitle_en: Hanna Halvarsson and Marianne Log Nyheim have been associated with Svalbard Equestrian Center since 2009. They are angry that they were not told about the contamination in the ground.
487779.title_en: “The Fact That No One Told Us Is a Scandal”

487814.excerpt_en: For the second month in a row, Svalbard is setting new temperature records. In May, Svalbardposten reported that a 46-year-old temperature record was broken after the weather station at Svalbard Airport recorded temperatures on Saturday the 28th.
487814.subtitle_en: And for only the second time since 1953, temperatures above 20 degrees were recorded on Bjørnøya on 29 June.
487814.tags_en: weather stations, news, Norwegian Meteorological Institute, temperature record
487814.title_en: Several New Temperature Records in June

487848.excerpt_en: This happened after a report came in at 7 p.m. Friday that a commercial fisherman had fallen ill. “The boat was approximately 30 nautical miles west of Isfjord Radio,” says senior police officer Kjell Arne Lundin of the Governor of Svalbard’s office.
487848.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard’s helicopter had to fly to Isfjord Radio on Friday evening.
487848.tags_en: news, fisheries, Governor of Svalbard, Isfjord Radio

487878.excerpt_en: Eva Therese Jenssen has been appointed communications adviser to the Governor of Svalbard. She is leaving her position as communications manager at UNIS, where she has worked for 16 years.
487878.subtitle_en: Twenty-five people applied for the job, but Eva Therese Jenssen came out on top.
487878.tags_en: appointment, communications, Governor of Svalbard, news
487878.title_en: She Is the Governor’s New Communications Adviser

487887.excerpt_en: The announcement that the SAS strike was a fact came at noon on Monday. SK4414 arrived at Svalbard Airport somewhat delayed and will almost certainly fly to Tromsø with its passengers today. “SK4414/SK4425 will return as normal, but everything else is cancelled.”
487887.subtitle_en: SAS is cancelling all flights to and from Svalbard from tomorrow after pilots went on strike at noon today.
487887.title_en: All SAS Flights to and from Svalbard Cancelled

487895.excerpt_en: At noon on Monday, it became clear that SAS mediation had ended in a strike, and more than 70 SAS flights have so far been cancelled. Per Brochmann, managing director of Hurtigruten Svalbard, says they are following the situation closely. “We still do not have the full overview, and have just held a management meeting about the matter.”
487895.subtitle_en: The local tourism industry in Longyearbyen is closely following the SAS strike.

487908.excerpt_en: Once again, several Norwegian websites have been hit by a new, likely Russian, cyberattack. The websites that may have been affected include the Norwegian National Security Authority.
487908.subtitle_en: New cyberattack targets Norwegian websites – Russian hackers claim responsibility.
487908.title_en: Russian Hackers Claim Responsibility for New Attack

487918.excerpt_en: In March, the Svalbard Tourism Council and Visit Svalbard decided to urge their members not to buy from Russian-owned companies because of the war in Ukraine. This has led several tourism operators to stop offering trips to Barentsburg or Pyramiden.
487918.subtitle_en: The tourism council is standing by its recommendation not to shop in Barentsburg or Pyramiden.
487918.tags_en: Visit Svalbard, news, Svalbard Tourism Council, sanctions
487918.title_en: Stands by Call to Avoid Shopping

487931.excerpt_en: Shortly before 3 p.m., it became clear that SAS flight SK4414 would fly to Svalbard on Monday and return to the mainland as normal. All other SAS flights to and from Svalbard are canceled from Tuesday onward.
487931.subtitle_en: Jens Binderup says no one on the full SAS flight to Svalbard knew whether they would be left in Tromsø or not.

This year’s season started earlier than usual, peaking as early as June, and throughout the summer 800 of Longyearbyen’s 1,000 hotel beds…

This time the ship will set out for the Nansen Basin north of Svalbard, but before departing, Longyearbyen residents are invited aboard.

504611.title_en: You now have to go here to get your money back

504621.excerpt_en: Snorre’s boyish smile is his trademark. His warm, witty replies come easily, but above all he is focused on continually improving the rescue crews’ ability to carry out the most extreme missions safely.
504621.subtitle_en: They are on duty 24/7 to save lives in one of the world’s most inhospitable climates. When the margins between their own safety and extreme weather narrow, the final word ultimately rests with the captain. Among the most experienced is Snorre Hagen.

504621.title_en: The veteran of the rescue family

504655.excerpt_en: At 2:14 p.m. on Monday, the Governor of Svalbard received a report of an injured guide at Kaldbukta. “A guide is said to have driven into a hole in the area around Kaldbukta and had to be picked up by helicopter.”
504655.subtitle_en: A guide is said to have suffered minor injuries after driving into a hole near Kaldbukta.
504655.title_en: Guide drives into a hole—airlifted out

504723.excerpt_en: Thirty-one women and 46 men have applied for the position of chief administrative officer with the Governor of Svalbard. Five of the applicants come from Longyearbyen.
504723.subtitle_en: Seventy-seven want to become the new chief administrative officer and 23 the new environmental protection officer. Governor Lars Fause is pleased.

504749.excerpt_en: “We have conducted a number of interviews in the case, both with the other participants in the tour and with the guide. No one is suspected or charged in the case.”
504749.subtitle_en: An American male tourist died after driving into a ravine on his way from Longyearbyen to Barentsburg last Wednesday. The Governor of Svalbard is continuing to investigate why.
504749.title_en: Suspect neither the guide nor the company

504762.excerpt_en: The schooner “Noorderlicht” ran aground off the Trøndelag coast during the night. “It ran aground at around 2:30, and we received the report half an hour later,” says rescue coordinator Kjetil Hagen at the Joint Rescue Coordination Centre Southern Norway to NTB. He says the boat has a list but is standing firmly on a small island.
504762.subtitle_en: It was scheduled to continue towards Narvik and Svalbard.

504907.excerpt_en: On Monday evening, the trail groomer rumbled across the car park towards Svalbardhallen before heading out into the terrain to groom tracks. The following day, the Longyearbyen Trail Association formally took over responsibility. “We are responsible for all trail grooming, both the floodlit trail and beyond Hiorthhamn towards Revneset,” says Silje Jakola-Fjeld, chair of the trail association.
504907.subtitle_en: From now on, the Longyearbyen Trail Association will be responsible for ski tracks in the areas around Longyearbyen. In the long term, it wants to expand the service.

504925.excerpt_en: At 4:47 p.m. on Thursday, the Governor of Svalbard received a report of a hiker who had probably broken an ankle on the way up Sukkertoppen, reports Taina Maria Bjørkås, chief superintendent with the Governor of Svalbard. “He managed to get down to the road by the water tower and was then transported to the hospital in a patrol vehicle,” says Bjørkås.

504925.title_en: Responded to a broken ankle and a hypothermic skier

504935.excerpt_en: On Friday morning, Longyearbyen Community Council apologized that the planned opening that day of the new cinema at Nordover would not take place. The cinema opening had already been anticipated for quite some time, so when Are Nundal, head of the cultural centre, announced that it would open on Friday the 24th.
504935.subtitle_en: Are Nundal apologizes and accepts full responsibility after today’s cinema opening was suddenly cancelled.
504935.tags_en: Longyearbyen Community Council, news, Nordover, cinema
504935.title_en: “We probably should have had a better overview”

504954.excerpt_en: The plan is to have an occupational health service in place as early as 1.

504954.tags_en: occupational health service, news, healthcare services

504994.excerpt_en: The incident is said to have occurred at around 2:15 p.m. at Fardalsbakken, in the direction of Longyearbyen, on Saturday. “It was a snowmobile accident in which the person was picked up by helicopter and transported on to the hospital,” says Elisabeth Barsnes, chief superintendent with the Governor of Svalbard. The Longyearbyen Local Community Plan states that Longyearbyen shall have a stable and adequate power supply at an acceptable price, and that CO2 emissions shall be reduced by at least 80 percent by 2030.

505020.subtitle_en: Not sure what to do over Easter? Don’t worry—we’ve put together an overview:

505079.excerpt_en: “It has been an instructive year for the Norwegian Customs Service. We established this operation at very short notice, and it took just six weeks from receiving the order to having staff in place,” says Customs Director Øystein Børmer.

505079.title_en: Will take a closer look at its Svalbard mission

505108.excerpt_en: “The black one is Svartenbrandt, and the gray one is Miss Bunny Penny,” says Anika Paust as Svalbardposten is invited into her home to meet the two four-legged creatures. The rabbits are the hermeline breed and originally come from Haugesund, but are now in their fifth year as Svalbard residents.
505108.subtitle_en: While some people have dogs or parrots as companions, two Easter bunnies have found a home with Australian Anika Paust.

505151.excerpt_en: At 5:50 p.m. on Tuesday, the Governor’s Office received a tip from a cabin owner about a reindeer calf limping in Todalen. “The cabin owner reported that the calf was limping and that it appeared to have wounds on one of its hind legs,” says senior officer Magnar Silseth of the Governor’s Office.

505151.title_en: “A dog was running loose in the area”

505177.excerpt_en: The 100-ton building housing the Kongsfjord Shop in Ny-Ålesund was pushed aside by hand on Wednesday. The move was necessary because climate change has caused rot damage, subsidence and structural distortions in the building.

505177.title_en: Moved the Kongsfjord Shop by hand

505327.excerpt_en: On Palm Sunday, five of the six young people were confirmed at Svalbard Church. 505426.excerpt_en: Fritz Wedel Jarlsberg is often referred to as the father of the Svalbard Treaty—a title he was more than happy to embrace.
505426.subtitle_en: He was happiest among Europe’s monarchs, and a social hub in the most distinguished salons of Paris, London, Madrid and Kristiania. In Sassendalen, he would have been completely helpless. Yet he is the man we can thank for the windswept islands near the North Pole being Norwegian territory.
505426.title_en: The social lion who secured Svalbard for Norway

505449.excerpt_en: The crematorium was installed in December 2021. Since then, a total of 43 cremations have been carried out, according to the incinerator’s display.

The resident had fallen asleep and left it unattended,” says police superintendent Kjell Arne Lundin of the Governor’s Office.

505608.excerpt_en: The fire alarm went off at Svalbard Airport on Tuesday evening. “Fortunately, there was no fire, but a water leak from a fan heater above the entrance door. Since hot water came out, it produced steam,” says airport director Ragnhild Kommisrud.

505663.title_en: To collaborate on renewable energy solutions

505686.excerpt_en: According to a press release from the Governor of Svalbard, the incident occurred on Thursday evening, when the bears visited the cabin area at Vindodden by Tempelfjorden. Cabin owners scared the bears away, and they took to the water in Tempelfjorden. After a while, however, they saw that the female bear was lying completely still in the sea with her head underwater, while the cub swam around.

505741.excerpt_en: On Friday, the Governor of Svalbard decided to impose a travel and stay ban on Road 300 after several days of wind and snow. This came shortly after a one-day travel and stay ban had been in place above Road 100.

The Governor’s Office arrived at Huset 15 minutes later.

505839.subtitle_en: On Tuesday, the Governor of Svalbard reported a break-in at a building in Nybyen. They do not know how long the person had been inside.

505853.excerpt_en: In a press release, the Governor of Svalbard says that, following a recommendation from NGI, it is lifting the travel and stay ban on Road 300 from Huset down to the junction by the old museum. The area has been open to traffic since noon on Tuesday.
505853.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard is now lifting the travel and stay ban on Road 300.
505853.tags_en: Governor of Svalbard, news, avalanche, travel ban

505888.excerpt_en: On Wednesday morning, the Governor of Svalbard confirmed that the polar bear found dead in the water near Vindodden was the bear marked N23992.
