520098.excerpt_en: The deadline for applying for grants in the Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund’s autumn allocation round expired on 15 September. The fund has up to NOK 10 million available for project support in autumn 2023.
520098.subtitle_en: The Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund has received applications totalling NOK 21.8 million in this autumn’s application round. The fund has NOK 10 million available for project support.
520098.title_en: 48 Applications to the Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund

520141.excerpt_en: Earlier this autumn, Trust Arktikugol put up a Russian Orthodox cross in Pyramiden. The Governor of Svalbard decided that it had to be removed because it had been erected without permission and in breach of Pyramiden’s land-use plan.
520141.subtitle_en: The case concerning the Russian Orthodox cross in Pyramiden is now with the Ministry of Climate and the Environment.
520141.tags_en: Svalbard, Ministry of Climate and the Environment, Trust Arktikugol, Governor of Svalbard, Russian Orthodox cross, news
520141.title_en: The Complaint Has Been Forwarded to the Central Authorities

520148.excerpt_en: When the four-month report was considered at the local council meeting, there was once again extensive discussion about Longyearbyen Local Council’s overspending. The project for the new maintenance hall and terminal at the port has become far more expensive than initially assumed.
520148.subtitle_en: The handling of the project for a new maintenance hall at the port sparked major debate in the local council.
520148.tags_en: local politics, tenders, overspending, maintenance hall, longyearbyen local council, news, longyearbyen port
520148.title_en: Wants new maintenance hall sent back for political consideration

520152.excerpt_en: If the plan proceeds as intended, Tromsø’s 110 emergency centre will begin receiving alarms next week, in parallel with the centre at Energiverket. “We have made good progress with the transfer, but one final technical part remains.”
520152.subtitle_en: From the New Year, only the 112 emergency centre will have a local service on the island, as the current direct alerts and 110 calls are transferred to the mainland.
520152.tags_en: emergency dispatch centre, 110 emergency centre, news, Tromsø, Longyearbyen, direct alerts, fire service
520152.title_en: 110 Emergency Dispatch Centre to Move to Tromsø at New Year

520156.excerpt_en: The traditional sports exchange with Barentsburg was due to take place in the Russian settlement in mid-November. Svalbard Turn has now declined. “The situation is unchanged from the last assessment.”
520156.subtitle_en: Svalbard Turn has declined the sports exchange with Barentsburg in November. “The situation is unchanged,” says the chair of the board.
520156.tags_en: invitation declined, Trust Arktikugol, Svalbard Turn, sports exchange, Barentsburg, news

520202.excerpt_en: The photograph is from Walter Wellmann’s attempt to reach the North Pole aboard the airship America in 1907. The picture was taken by Theodor Lerner, also known as the “Prince of Fog.”
520202.tags_en: 20th-century history, Walter Wellmann, news, North Pole, airships, historical photograph, history, expeditions

520220.excerpt_en: All clubs and associations in Longyearbyen can apply for support from the NOK 2 million fund, provided the money is used for public-benefit initiatives for the population of Longyearbyen.
520220.subtitle_en: This summer, Longyearbyen Local Council decided to establish a fixed framework for awarding the cork funds. Today is the final deadline to apply for this year’s NOK 2 million fund.

520234.excerpt_en: Politicians on the Administration Committee received bad news about the Nordover art centre. Nordover has seen falling revenue throughout the year.
520234.subtitle_en: Nordover ran at a substantial loss in its first year. Carina Borch Abrahamsen, head of culture and sports, now hopes an adjusted budget will help create more realistic expectations for revenue.
520234.tags_en: news, economy, Nordover art centre, culture, Coop, politics
520234.title_en: Too Few People Visiting the Tveter Exhibition

520300.excerpt_en: Erik Gjemble spent just over a year at Lompen Centre before heading back to the mainland. New duties within the Olav Thon Group are taking him to Eastern Norway, where he will become manager of a larger shopping centre.
520300.subtitle_en: Gjemble will begin his new duties on 1 December. By then, a new management team will also be in place at Lompen Centre.
520300.tags_en: centre manager, Lompen Centre, Olav Thon Group, Svalbard, news
520300.title_en: Erik Gjemble to Become Centre Manager in Eastern Norway

520307.excerpt_en: “Everyone is really excited and happy that we can hold a meet,” says Malin Persson, head of Svalbard Turn’s swimming group, about this weekend’s meet at Svalbardhallen.
520307.subtitle_en: The swimming club is hosting a major meet this weekend. Many of the swimmers in Longyearbyen are looking forward to it.

520355.excerpt_en: “It was bloody great, bloody scary, and I was nervous. But it’s really nice to have a meet so close to home, and all in all it was very fun,” says 12-year-old Lev Shestov of Svalbard Turn.
520355.subtitle_en: Eighty-two swimmers from Northern Norway competed at Svalbardhallen over the weekend. A new generation of Svalbard swimmers set many personal records.
520355.tags_en: swimming meet, news, swimming, meet, Isfjord Swim, Svalbard Turn
520355.title_en: “It Was Bloody Great and Bloody Scary”

article_keywords_en: Convention on the Rights of the Child
520374.excerpt_en: Last year, new regulations were introduced for primary and secondary education in Longyearbyen. The right to special education applies only to pupils needing “minor or moderate” accommodation.
520374.subtitle_en: SV deputy leader Torgeir Knag Fylkesnes has submitted questions to the Minister of Education about the new school regulations. The background is consultation feedback that they violate the Convention on the Rights of the Child.
520374.title_en: Questions Raised Over Lack of Right to Schooling

520502.excerpt_en: About a month ago, Avinor began work inside the airport on a small scale. On Wednesday, the contractors were more or less finished moving walls.
520502.subtitle_en: New X-ray machines and reorganized baggage handling are bringing temporary changes for passengers.
520502.tags_en: renovation, airport, news, baggage, avinor, security equipment

520557.excerpt_en: “Last year, we received feedback that local residents wanted an early-booking opportunity, and that technical solutions existed for this. We thought it was a good idea, but instead we chose to create a pleasant event at Tio Monchos tonight,” says festival director Trond Strugstad.
520557.subtitle_en: The last Polarjazz festival sold out completely. Organizers were encouraged to offer local residents an early-booking opportunity. Now they have listened.

520612.excerpt_en: There is plenty going on when Svalbardposten meets Yann Rashid for a chat about his latest project ahead of the Christmas fair. He arrived by plane on Friday, and so far has only had time to check that the car starts and that everything was in order at his office at the airport.
520612.subtitle_en: Ten years after Yann Rashid sold his very first hat and neck warmer, he launched his biggest venture to date: an entirely new Moomin collection.
520612.tags_en: arctic edge, news, business, christmas fair, collection, yann rashid, the moomins, svalbardposten

520618.excerpt_en: “It is important for adults to speak kindly to and about one another, and with empathy. We can practise with the children using positive words with one another,” says Anja Torstensen.
520618.subtitle_en: On Wednesday evening, Forebyggende Forum invited people to a discussion evening about hurtful language. The message is clear: parents must take their share of the responsibility.
520618.tags_en: news, language use, longyearbyen, discussion evening, prevention, children and young people
520618.title_en: Calling an adult a “bitch” is not okay

520629.excerpt_en: For 20 to 30 minutes on Tuesday evening, the Governor’s Office received prank calls from several children. According to police sergeant Håkon Wessel Finstad, there were several calls from several children. “It was a classic prank call, with silly phrases and laughter.”
520629.subtitle_en: On Tuesday, the Governor’s Office experienced several children making prank calls to the emergency number. “This is very unfortunate,” says police sergeant Håkon Finstad of the Governor’s Office.
520629.tags_en: governor’s office, news, parental responsibility, prank calls, emergency number
520629.title_en: Made prank calls to the emergency number several times

520725.excerpt_en: On Tuesday, 21 November, the Youth Council is inviting Longyearbyen residents to join a candlelit procession for the children of Gaza.
520725.subtitle_en: Youth Council leader Embla Abild says Tuesday’s procession is not a political demonstration, but an expression of solidarity.
520725.tags_en: news, longyearbyen, children in war, candlelit procession, youth council
520725.title_en: Invites people to candlelit procession for children in Gaza

520874.excerpt_en: Eventually, a queuing system had to be set up outside the cultural centre hall as well. When the traditional Christmas fair opened on Saturday, many people came looking for things for themselves and Christmas gifts for their families.
520874.subtitle_en: It did not take long for a queue to form to enter this year’s Christmas fair when the cultural centre opened the doors to the hall on Saturday.
520874.title_en: Christmas fair was overflowing with activity

520982.excerpt_en: The application deadline for support for initiatives and purposes benefiting Longyearbyen’s population expired on 15 November.
520982.subtitle_en: A total of 37 applicants are seeking this year’s surplus fund from Nordpolet.
520982.tags_en: news, application deadline, longyearbyen local council, longyearbyen, local council, cork funds, arctic chamber music festival, support
520982.title_en: These applicants have applied for cork funds this year

521005.excerpt_en: A year ago, the control tower was transported the long way from Svea to Longyearbyen. First by Hæhre’s truck convoy to Kapp Amsterdam, and then out onto the open sea on a voyage of more than 100 nautical miles.
521005.subtitle_en: The former control tower from Svea now stands safely at Sjøskrenten in Longyearbyen. Last week, the entire town was invited to the opening celebration.
521005.tags_en: sjøskrenten, news, sustainability, architecture, svalbard, control tower, reuse
521005.title_en: The control tower has found its place

521046.excerpt_en: The venue itself called after a local man in his 20s became difficult and aggressive inside. According to police sergeant Taina Maria Schogster Bjørkås of the Governor’s Office, they received the report at approximately 1:45 a.m. on Saturday.
521046.subtitle_en: In the early hours of Saturday, the Governor’s patrol had to respond to the nightlife scene in Longyearbyen.
521046.tags_en: brief, nightlife, police, governor’s office, venue

521100.excerpt_en: A storm was forecast for Svalbard on Tuesday for the days ahead. According to state meteorologist Ine-Therese Pedersen, the bad weather is the result of a major low-pressure system developing over Jan Mayen.
521100.subtitle_en: Strong wind gusts and red-level avalanche danger are forecast for Svalbard over the next few days.
521100.tags_en: state meteorologist, avalanche danger, news, svalbard, storm, weather
521100.title_en: Meteorologist: “It may be wise to secure loose objects”

521116.excerpt_en: From March this year until the end of June, the amount of sea ice in the Fram Strait was much higher than normal. It then stabilized before increasing markedly in late September and early October, analyses from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute show.
521116.subtitle_en: “The situation we are observing in the Fram Strait is unusual and must be closely monitored,” says William Copeland, a researcher with the ice service at the Norwegian Meteorological Institute.
521116.tags_en: brief, sea ice, climate change, greenland, fram strait, norwegian meteorological institute
521116.title_en: Unusually large amount of sea ice between Svalbard and Greenland

521174.excerpt_en: On Wednesday, the politicians held their first working meeting on next year’s budget. There was considerable anticipation about the energy tariffs Svalbard Energi would present.
521174.subtitle_en: When Svalbard Energi presented its new proposed energy tariffs on Wednesday, several politicians reacted to what they considered a dramatic increase.
521174.tags_en: energy supply, energy consumption, news, tariff increases, energy utility, energy transition, fees, svalbard energi

521178.excerpt_en: The lift is working as it should, the platter lifts are in place, lift operators are being trained, and the piste team has received a snow groomer from Store Norske. In August, the cultural and sports unit hoped the ski slope would open in December, but the opening will not take place until the new year. “Things take a little time.”
521178.subtitle_en: Testing, more volunteers and snow are among the things that must be in place before Longyearbyen residents can hit the slopes at the new facility.
521178.title_en: Ski slope nearly ready—but won’t open until next year

521204.excerpt_en: A local tourism company has been issued a penalty notice for violating the traffic ban in a bird reserve. Such travel is prohibited from the 15th.
521204.subtitle_en: After several trips to the bird reserve by the Gåsøyane islands in Isfjorden, a local tourism company has been handed a hefty fine.
521204.tags_en: news, tourism company, environmental protection, bird reserve, penalty notice, traffic ban

521241.excerpt_en: At the request of the Ministry of Petroleum and Energy, the Research Council has assessed the research basis for establishing a combined research and test centre in Longyearbyen. Under the plan, such a centre would develop zero- or low-emission energy adapted to Arctic needs.
521241.subtitle_en: Svalbard’s business community will not be able to bear the costs of a new test centre for green energy. Moreover, many similar centres already exist.
521241.tags_en: energy research, Arctic, Research Council, Longyearbyen, news, renewable energy
521241.title_en: Says energy test-centre plan should be put on ice

521291.excerpt_en: In the time ahead, Ole Magnus Rapp will write stories for Svalbardposten. With funding from Fritt Ord, the Alta native will contribute news, both big and small, to the newspaper until the 7th.
521291.subtitle_en: Over the next few weeks, you will see Ole Magnus Rapp’s (64) byline in Svalbardposten.
521291.tags_en: journalism, svalbardposten, fritt ord, ole magnus rapp, svalbard, news
521291.title_en: “I’m interested in so much, including Svalbard’s place in the world”

521299.excerpt_en: The Norwegian Board of Health Supervision submitted its preliminary report on the incident involving a heart patient who needed air ambulance transport from Svalbard in May last year. Until 15.
521299.subtitle_en: The delayed supervisory report on emergency preparedness and Svalbard’s air ambulances is now in its final phase, according to the Norwegian Board of Health Supervision.
521299.tags_en: supervisory report, air ambulance transport, emergency preparedness, Norwegian Board of Health Supervision, health trust, Svalbard, news
521299.title_en: Expects final report by the end of the year

521303.excerpt_en: When the application deadline expired on 6 November, it became clear that many people wanted to take up the position of CEO of Svalbard Energi.
521303.subtitle_en: The applicants include a former energy manager, a former technical manager and a former head of operations at Svea, as well as current interim manager Guttorm Nygård.
521303.tags_en: CEO, Svalbard Energi, news, North Norwegian Leadership Development, public applicant list, recruitment
521303.title_en: These 34 want to become Svalbard Energi’s new CEO

521307.excerpt_en: The photograph is from a Norwegian visit to Barentsburg in 1956 and was taken by Erling Johann Nødtvedt, who was the priest in Longyearbyen from 1951 to 1960. Here, the Norwegian delegation is being shown around the greenhouse.
521307.tags_en: history, historical photograph, animal husbandry, Longyearbyen, news, self-sufficiency, Barentsburg

521327.excerpt_en: This summer came the news that there would be changes to the Governor’s management team. Bente Rønning was appointed head of environmental protection and took up the post at the beginning of November. “The first weeks in the new job have been very hectic; there is a great deal to learn.”
521327.subtitle_en: Head of Environmental Protection Bente Rønning, Deputy Governor Katharina Rise and Head of Administration Bjørg Holen are new members of the Governor’s management team.
521327.tags_en: news, head of environmental protection, Governor’s management team, Svalbard, sustainability, Deputy Governor
521327.title_en: Three New Members of the Governor’s Management Team

521360.excerpt_en: Now the Pointed Houses, the pedestrian street and visiting sled-dog puppies are being highlighted as attractions. Potential tourists are invited on cave walks beneath the glacier, to experiences at the museum, to galleries, on dog-sled rides around the “town” and on guided tours in the surrounding area focusing on history, flora and fauna.
521360.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen’s tourism industry will focus more on attractions close to the town centre. Polar bears, walruses and long snowmobile tours are not mentioned in the new advertising.

521376.excerpt_en: Most of the tourism industry’s climate emissions in Svalbard are linked to flights to and from the archipelago. Visit Svalbard employees, led by tourism director Ronny Brunvoll, will now lead by example and buy carbon offsets for their upcoming flights.
521376.subtitle_en: Only four percent of passengers flying to Svalbard have paid extra for biofuel, a measure intended to reduce emissions of harmful greenhouse gases.
521376.tags_en: carbon offsets, climate emissions, biofuel, Svalbard, tourism industry, news
521376.title_en: Buying carbon offsets for Svalbard flights

521398.excerpt_en: The aim of working to lengthen stays in Longyearbyen is to improve tourism-industry earnings and reduce the environmental footprint. This was a central topic at the Svalbard Tourism Council’s autumn meeting.
521398.subtitle_en: Future tourists could be required to stay longer in Longyearbyen. The tourism industry is proposing better flight connections, free experiences and more low-threshold activities to encourage tourists to extend their visits.
521398.tags_en: sustainable tourism, news, climate footprint, Svalbard, tourism, tourism council
521398.title_en: How they want to get tourists to stay longer

521409.excerpt_en: The deadline for applying for grants in the Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund’s autumn allocation passed in September. The distribution is now clear and has been published (see the list at the bottom of the article).
521409.subtitle_en: Forty-eight applications to the Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund have resulted in 25 grants. The Norwegian Polar Institute received the largest sum.
521409.tags_en: applications, grants, news, Svalbard Environmental Protection Fund, environmental protection, financing
521409.title_en: NOK 9.1 million for environmental protection measures

521467.excerpt_en: “I began using my own methods on myself. That is where therapy begins—with something painful and difficult, something from which it is not easy to see a way out,” says Peder Kjøs.
521467.subtitle_en: Can a book about coping with life help a community without a locally based psychological service? As part of Preventive Forum, psychologist Peder Kjøs visited Longyearbyen to explain how we can feel better.
521467.tags_en: polar night, therapy, psychology, self-help, news, Peder Kjøs, Svalbard

521501.excerpt_en: At around 11:30 p.m. on Saturday, police went to a bar in Longyearbyen. An intoxicated person was causing a disturbance.
521501.subtitle_en: Police were called to both a bar and an accommodation facility overnight Saturday.

521523.excerpt_en: It will be a huge leap from the small historic lift by the school to the slope the town can look forward to. There is every reason to be grateful, while also being aware of the tasks or projects that have been put on hold for the sake of the slope.
521523.subtitle_en: Ski lift, artificial snow and grooming machine
521523.title_en: Ski lift, artificial snow and grooming machine

521591.excerpt_en: A number of concerts and cultural events took place in November, including the cultural school concert, where 100 children and young people filled the stage with singing and dancing.
521591.subtitle_en: Few places with 2,500 inhabitants have as vibrant a cultural life as Longyearbyen.
521591.tags_en: culture, concerts, news, music, cultural events, Longyearbyen
521591.title_en: Events one after another: “It’s good that we reach out”

521601.excerpt_en: Ny-Ålesund is the last Norwegian settlement with a permanent population to be connected to the mobile network. Bluetooth and Wi-Fi have previously been banned out of consideration for the many instruments used in research.
521601.subtitle_en: The new era finally arrives in Ny-Ålesund on Tuesday. Not everyone likes it, but the research settlement in northwestern Svalbard is now on the mobile network.
521601.tags_en: mobile network, Ny-Ålesund, news, Kings Bay AS, research, Telenor Svalbard

521624.excerpt_en: Last year, every part of the trapping station was carefully dismantled, wrapped in bubble wrap and transported to the museum’s storage facility. Several people were critical of moving the protected cultural monument.
521624.subtitle_en: The very special trapping hut in Rekvika has been saved from the sea and will be a central attraction in the “new” Svalbard Museum. Now the station is being rebuilt indoors, piece by piece.
521624.tags_en: Svalbard, cultural heritage, news, trapping station, archaeology, Directorate for Cultural Heritage

521657.excerpt_en: The town’s new art centre opened its doors in November 2022. Longyearbyen Local Council (LL) celebrated that the Kåre Tveter exhibition had been given new, modern premises and museum-standard ventilation.
521657.subtitle_en: According to Longyearbyen Local Council, it has lacked them since before opening.
521657.tags_en: Longyearbyen Local Council, art centre, culture, news, marketing strategy, declining visitor numbers, declining income
521657.title_en: Lacked both a business plan and a marketing strategy

521661.excerpt_en: After the switch from coal to diesel, Svalbard Energi announced higher energy prices. However, the exact cost in kroner and øre remains unclear.
521661.subtitle_en: Higher energy prices from Svalbard Energi will likely amount to several thousand kroner a year for Longyearbyen residents. It is prompting reactions.
521661.title_en: Residents on higher energy prices: “It’s going to be very expensive”

521685.excerpt_en: Today’s agenda: After-use of the old waste facility; Phoenix Project phase 1 – BP2 – implementation; Svalbard Energi fee regulations; 2024 budget and financial plan 2024–2027; application for post-employment compensation upon the departure of the community council leader.
521685.subtitle_en: You can watch Wednesday’s meeting of the Administration Committee here.
521685.tags_en: waste facility, 2024 budget, fee regulations, news, Phoenix Project
521685.title_en: Watch the Administration Committee budget meeting here

521696.excerpt_en: Politicians did not welcome the proposed 75 percent increase in energy charges from Svalbard Energi. When the Administration Committee put a substantial number of questions to Svalbard Energi CEO Guttorm Nygård on Wednesday, it did not change the politicians’ view that the increases would be excessive.
521696.subtitle_en: The Conservative Party and the Liberal Party announced on Wednesday that they would not approve the proposed fees from Svalbard Energi.
521696.tags_en: fees and tariffs, Svalbard Energi, diesel price, energy supply, politics, news
521696.title_en: Wants to freeze district heating rates

521725.excerpt_en: Over the next year, a total of NOK 3.1 million must be cut from education and culture. This is proposed by the administration of Longyearbyen Community Council (LL) in the 2024 budget.
521725.subtitle_en: A cut of more than three million kroner in schools and kindergartens is necessary, according to the administration of Longyearbyen Community Council.
521725.title_en: Proposes multimillion-kroner cuts to education and culture

521761.excerpt_en: Four years and three months after a Danish citizen drove drunk on Svalbard, he stood trial for the offence in Nord-Troms and Senja District Court. The man, in his 50s, appeared before the court on Saturday the 24th.
521761.subtitle_en: The case was first sent to the Danish authorities in 2020, but at the defendant’s lawyer’s request, it was returned. Then it remained pending.
521761.tags_en: Nord-Troms and Senja District Court, the Governor, Svalbard, drunk driving, news, court case
521761.title_en: Drove Drunk on Svalbard in 2019—Convicted Only This Year

521783.excerpt_en: When the ban was introduced, the Svalbard–Barents Sea population was on its knees. Hunting had been intense for many decades, and self-triggered traps in particular were highly effective methods.
521783.subtitle_en: The protection of polar bears 50 years ago was controversial. Svalbard trappers gave young researchers from the south a frosty reception.

521796.excerpt_en: The new interactive exhibitions will let visitors see giant swimming lizards, follow the Northern Lights dancing over Svalbard’s mountains and watch polar bear cubs at play. “The content of the exhibitions will change substantially with the times, while the museum’s physical design will remain largely as before,” says director Eystein Markusson.
521796.subtitle_en: The first tourists, research and the Cold War will feature prominently in the exhibitions when Svalbard Museum reopens after refurbishment in February.
521796.tags_en: exhibition, climate change, tourism, news, cultural history, Svalbard Museum
521796.title_en: Tourists and Lizards Go on Display

521806.excerpt_en: Energy manager Guttorm Nygård said this during Monday’s meeting of the Administration Committee. It also emerged that Svalbard Energi is considering purchasing several new diesel engines to ensure sufficient capacity.
521806.subtitle_en: Svalbard Energi does not have enough employees to restart the coal-fired power plant for an extended operating period.
521806.title_en: Cannot resume permanent coal operations overnight

521816.excerpt_en: In total, more than 150 Norwegian fire engines and ambulances have been donated to Ukraine over the past 18 months. In addition, many truckloads of generators, breathing apparatus, assorted rescue equipment, boats, firefighters’ clothing and much more have been sent. “Ukraine is literally on fire.”
521816.subtitle_en: The two fire engines from Svea have arrived in Ukraine and have been warmly received by the fire and rescue service in the Dnipro region.
521816.tags_en: Norwegian-Ukrainian fire and ambulance support, fire engines, Ukraine, news, rescue equipment, Store Norske

521856.subtitle_en: When everything burned—and the warmth afterwards
521856.tags_en: fire, fire alarm, news, Longyearbyen, evacuation, fire service
521856.title_en: When everything burned—and the warmth afterwards

521871.excerpt_en: This autumn, the University Centre in Svalbard, UNIS, turns 30. Its beginnings were unconventional, and there would probably not have been a university centre at 78 degrees north if no one had been swept away.
521871.subtitle_en: An enthusiastic cabinet minister who took shortcuts, a man with a Colt, a local lobby and a week-long study trip by boat to Moffen—and just like that, Longyearbyen got a university centre.
521871.tags_en: news, Svalbard, UNIS, University Centre in Svalbard, higher education, Arctic research

521911.excerpt_en: Researchers have begun using new technology, and sensors are reporting abundant life in the sea even when it is at its darkest and coldest. “Everyone knows that a birch tree loses its leaves in autumn and goes dormant.”
521911.subtitle_en: The kelp forest on Svalbard grows more in winter than in summer. Even in freezing, pitch-black seas, the algae find nutrients that fuel growth.
521911.tags_en: climate change, Svalbard, NTNU, marine research, biodiversity, news
521911.title_en: Kelp Forest Grows in the Polar Night

521925.excerpt_en: This year’s gingerbread city, on display at Lompensenteret on Sunday, was packed with imagination and creativity. Funken, the pointed-roof houses and Næringsbygget are all in place.
521925.subtitle_en: Perhaps the finest gingerbread city ever saw the light of day on Sunday. It featured beautiful architecture, lovely decorations and plenty of warmth. But buildings are still missing from the edible city.
521925.tags_en: architecture, secondary-school project, Lompensenteret, creativity, news, gingerbread city

521964.excerpt_en: This summer, Longyearbyen Local Council examined our rubbish to evaluate residents’ source sorting. The result is now in.
521964.subtitle_en: Longyearbyen Local Council has evaluated residents’ source sorting. The conclusion is that only half of the waste is sorted correctly.
521964.tags_en: waste audit, Longyearbyen, food waste, waste sorting, news, reuse

522026.excerpt_en: Extreme whitewater athlete Aniol Serrasoles kayaked over Austfonna this summer, the BBC reports.
522026.subtitle_en: Spanish kayaker Aniol Serrasoles (32) completed the world’s longest whitewater kayaking drop on Svalbard this summer.
522026.tags_en: Aniol Serrasoles, extreme athlete, Austfonna, Svalbard, whitewater kayaking, news
522026.title_en: Whitewater Kayaker Drops 20 Metres from Glacier

522078.excerpt_en: To ensure proper inspection of incoming waste and prevent incorrect sorting, the recycling centre is now banning black garbage bags. “Our aim is to send more waste for material recycling, so it can be turned into new raw materials and products.”
522078.subtitle_en: From now on, you may not deliver rubbish in black garbage bags at the recycling centre.

524254.excerpt_en: The year we have just left behind will go down in history as one of the warmest years ever recorded by humans. At the same time, many parts of the country experienced record cold in early December and snow chaos in the south this January.
524254.subtitle_en: The future and a new blue ocean

524260.subtitle_en: Parts of the snowmaking system at the ski slope have frozen. A backup solution is now in place, and Svalbard Turn is planning an official opening on 7 February.

524315.excerpt_en: Electricity and district heating costs have risen substantially since the Community Council decided last autumn to switch energy production from coal to diesel. To shield residents, the Community Council decided in December to freeze electricity and district heating charges for ordinary customers at 2023 levels.
524315.subtitle_en: Ksat, Svalbard Airport, Unis and Store Norske are asking the Ministry of Justice to assess whether the Community Council is legally entitled to place all the costs of the energy transition on them.

524332.excerpt_en: At around 3:30 p.m. on Sunday, a male driver was caught in an alcohol check at the airport, according to senior police officer Thomas Antonsen of the Governor’s Office. “How many drivers were checked?” “I’m not sure how many were checked, but one was caught,” Antonsen replied. The person was taken to hospital for a blood test.
524332.subtitle_en: The check was carried out at the airport on Sunday afternoon.
524332.tags_en: investigation, alcohol check, traffic, senior police officer at the Governor’s Office, airport, news

524349.excerpt_en: Passengers who were due to travel north on the Norwegian flight on Monday will get a new flight to Longyearbyen on Tuesday. This is because the aircraft that was due to arrive at Svalbard Airport on Monday was diverted to Evenes because of the snowfall in Tromsø.
524349.subtitle_en: Technical problems and snowfall in Tromsø have caused trouble for Svalbard flights in recent days.
524349.tags_en: Norwegian, air traffic, Avinor, weather conditions, news, SAS, Tromsø, technical fault

524365.excerpt_en: Community Council leader Terje Aunevik (V) says they are in dialogue with Store Norske (Mine 7), Ksat, Svalbard Airport and Unis about why they passed the higher energy prices on to them. On Tuesday morning, Svalbardposten reported that the four companies had sent a letter to the Ministry of Justice.
524365.subtitle_en: Community Council leader Terje Aunevik believes that by safeguarding local residents, local politicians create more calm and stability than they would by doing the opposite.

524365.title_en: “The proposal that caused the least trouble”

524412.subtitle_en: When Nordover opened, it had neither a business plan nor a marketing strategy. According to Arild Hammerhaug, chief administrative officer of Longyearbyen Community Council, they chose to open in order to secure revenue.

The letter, signed by Director General Ildar Neverov, was first sent to the Governor of Svalbard at the end of November.

524518.subtitle_en: The jury will now review them and decide what the ski slope should be called.

524538.excerpt_en: Senior police officer Taina Maria Schogster Bjørkås of the Governor’s Office tells Svalbardposten that none of the seven cars checked resulted in any action being taken. “We carried out a small alcohol check early this morning.”
524538.subtitle_en: The Governor of Svalbard conducted roadside alcohol checks on drivers on Thursday morning.

524605.excerpt_en: The tourism facility at Kapp Linné is already generating significantly fewer climate-damaging emissions. The goal is to operate entirely on 90 percent renewable energy.

524609.subtitle_en: Two snowploughs at Tromsø Airport were damaged on Thursday evening. If snow arrives, this could mean major delays for air traffic to and from Svalbard.

524609.title_en: Snowplough trouble in Tromsø could cause further delays

524751.excerpt_en: Tuesday and Wednesday are set to be chilly this week, with temperatures dropping to as low as minus 26, according to yr.no. That is admittedly not as cold as it recently was on the mainland, where temperatures of nearly 40 degrees below zero were recorded in several places.

524755.subtitle_en: Through several surveys, marine researchers found healthy numbers of Iceland scallops around Svalbard. They now recommend expanding the experimental fishery for the sub-Arctic scallop species.

524755.title_en: Optimism for Scallop Species around Svalbard

524759.tags_en: Finnsnes Winter Swim, Svalbard Turn swimming group, personal records, swimming meet, Arctic Ocean swimming, news

524813.title_en: Plans New Fibre-Optic Cable between Svalbard, Jan Mayen and Bodø

524821.subtitle_en: Work continued on Wednesday to open the water pipe to Nybyen and Huset, which froze on Tuesday. At the same time, brown water was reported in Elvesletta.

525096.excerpt_en: There are three engines at the reserve power plant. The one that was damaged on Christmas Eve will be removed for repairs on Monday.
525096.subtitle_en: On Christmas Eve, one of the engines at the eastern reserve power plant broke down, causing a major oil spill. The engine will be removed for repairs on Monday. All engines at the reserve power plant will then be taken out of service, Longyearbyen Local Council reports.

525128.excerpt_en: Early last summer, a walrus carcass washed ashore at Hopen Meteorological Station. 525149.title_en: Engine Will Not Be Removed Until Thursday

525153.excerpt_en: The boil-water advisory for Nybyen and Huset remains in effect, according to Longyearbyen Local Council. The reason is that the water pipe between the town centre and Nybyen has not yet been cleared for use.

525197.excerpt_en: The exhibition created as the lower secondary school’s major joint project was unveiled on Monday. Students across the grades have worked together toward one goal.
525197.subtitle_en: Over the next two weeks, the lower secondary school will present a special exhibition on Svalbard’s history, dating back to the 1600s.
525197.tags_en: school project, northward, exhibition, Svalbard’s history, lower secondary school, news
525197.title_en: Have You Seen What the Young People Are Exhibiting?

525201.excerpt_en: If the forecast holds, strong gusts are expected both on the mountains and down in Longyeardalen. Yr.no reports that winds ranging from near-gale to full gale force may arrive from 7 p.m. this evening.

525201.title_en: Winds Could Reach Storm Force on Monday Afternoon

525257.excerpt_en: The Governor of Svalbard reports this on its website. According to the Governor, the two drivers had become stuck in the bad weather.

525257.tags_en: bad weather, snowmobile drivers, rescue operation, brief, Joint Rescue Coordination Centre Northern Norway, Governor of Svalbard
525257.title_en: Two Snowmobile Drivers Rescued from De Geerdalen

525262.tags_en: detailed plan, demolition of housing, avalanche risk, news, KSAT, Longyearbyen Community Council

525299.excerpt_en: In a letter to Trust Arktikugol, the Governor of Svalbard writes that they have been informed that a sign had been put up in Barentsburg prohibiting driving faster than 20 kilometres per hour. The Governor cannot see that there is a valid decision authorizing the signage and asks the trust to remove it immediately.
525299.subtitle_en: Trust Arktikugol put up speed-limit signs in Barentsburg, but was told to take them down because it had not applied to the Governor of Svalbard for permission.

525312.excerpt_en: The historical photograph in Svalbardposten’s Christmas issue shows, as Svalbard Museum explains, Carl Ben Eielson in the foreground and George Hubert Wilkins in the background. The photograph shows the aircraft that took them from Barrow, Alaska, to Svalbard in April 1928.
525312.subtitle_en: Landed at Daumannsøyra in a blinding snowstorm
525312.tags_en: Svalbard, opinions, aviation history, history, historical photograph
525312.title_en: Landed at Daumannsøyra in a Blinding Snowstorm

525321.excerpt_en: “The change in weather has caused ice to form on the runway, so that’s what we’re battling,” Langnes airport operations manager Per-Erik Nordsveen told NRK. According to the airport, an ambulance plane from Svalbard circled over the airport while it was closed.
525321.subtitle_en: Tromsø Airport Langnes closed on Tuesday afternoon because of ice on the runway. An ambulance plane had to circle the airport, while the SAS aircraft diverted to Bardufoss.

525321.title_en: Ambulance Plane from Svalbard Forced to Circle

525346.excerpt_en: “SAS is joining the team!” was the headline of the press release published by Longyearbyen Community Council on Wednesday. The text promotes the opportunity to get cheaper flights to and from Svalbard through SAS.
525346.subtitle_en: On Wednesday, SAS launched a punch-card scheme for flights to and from Svalbard, Oslo and Tromsø. But it does not guarantee a seat if you do not already have a ticket. The offer is not permanent, and cheaper tickets may still be available through the low-fare calendar.
525346.tags_en: news, SAS, airline tickets, Longyearbyen, discount, punch card
525346.title_en: “I Doubt This Is Something Most People Will Cheer About”

525378.excerpt_en: In a letter to the Ministry of Education and Research, UNIS argues that students must continue to be granted permanent-resident status, with the same rights to travel in nature. In 2021, the Ministry of Justice presented a proposal for new regulations on safety in the field in Svalbard.
525378.subtitle_en: UNIS believes there would be serious consequences if students and guest lecturers had to apply for permission to travel outside the land-use planning area.
525378.tags_en: Ministry of Education and Research, Ministry of Justice, Regulations on Safety in the Field, environmental regulations, UNIS, news, Svalbard, safety regulations

525382.excerpt_en: See the video of the move at the bottom of the article. On Thursday, the defective engine in Backup Power Plant East was removed after breaking down on 23 December.

525398.subtitle_en: The Red Cross avalanche group has professionalized its activities over the past 20 years. But surviving an avalanche still depends on your companion.

525410.title_en: Board of Health Supervision: Risk of Service Failure Remains

525440.title_en: Longyearbyen Community Council Terminates Rental Agreement with Consulate in Barentsburg

525464.title_en: Refused to Leave Venue and Clung to the Wall

525585.title_en: Another Windy Monday Could Be on the Way
